procedures.name_en: Traveller declares goods to a customs officer on arrival to claim the >24-hour USD 2,000 accompanied-baggage exemption (itemized duty-free quantities as supplementary notes)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客为适用超24小时USD2000随身行李免税于抵达时向海关关员申报（分项免税数量仅作附属说明）
procedures.agency: Tanzania Revenue Authority (TRA) — Customs and Excise Department
procedures.applicability_en: Per TRA's official 'Returning Resident and First Arrival' page. The only declaration action the page names for an ordinary traveller is this: for a person who has been outside the partner states for a period in excess of 24 hours, goods up to the value of two thousand ($2000) dollars for each traveller shall be exempted when imported by the traveller in his or her accompanied baggage upon his or her person and declared by him or her to an officer — an on-the-spot declaration to an officer at the border. The page names no form and states no medium (electronic or paper), so this is an on-the-spot declaration only, and neither an electronic nor a paper form is implied. The page's version of the USD 2,000 sentence leaves its cross-reference blank ('other than goods referred to in paragraph of this item'), so the excluded-goods carve-out cannot be confirmed; the Rev 2019 statute text's parallel sentence (¶5(9)) reads 'other than goods referred to in Paragraph 8 of this item', noted only as context and not used to fill the TRA page's blank. Amount cross-check: the EAC Gazette of 31 December 2024 (Legal Notice No. EAC/427/2024, made under section 114(3) of the East African Community Customs Management Act 2004; RRA-hosted PDF) amends the Act's Fifth Schedule in Part B by substituting in paragraph 5(9) the words 'five hundred' with the words 'two thousand'; TRA's current page matches the amended figure, while the Tanzania Trade Portal's Rev 2019 copy of ¶5(9) still shows the pre-amendment 'United States Dollars five Hundred' — the older figure is superseded for the amount only and is not used to override the current USD 2,000. The itemized consumable quantities are stated only as supplementary conditions of the exemption, not an independent form-based procedure: goods imported by passengers arriving from places outside the partner states must be the property of and accompany the passenger, be for the passenger's personal or household use in a partner state, and be of such kinds and in such quantities as the proper officer may allow — an officer's discretionary condition, not a form. Duty shall not be levied on the following goods imported by and in the possession of the passenger, but the spirits line is an open conflict between official sources, not a confirmed safe limit: the TRA page states 'Spirits (including liquors) or wine, not exceeding two (2) litres', while the Tanzania Government Trade Portal-hosted EAC Customs Management Act 2004 (Revised 30 June 2019), Fifth Schedule Part B item 5, paragraph (6)(a) (PDF pages 167–169/printed pages 161–163) states 'spirits (including liquors) or wine, not exceeding one litre or wine not exceeding two litres' — i.e. spirits not exceeding one litre, or wine not exceeding two litres. The two sources agree on wine at two litres; they conflict on spirits (TRA 2 litres vs the 2019 revised statute text 1 litre). The 2024 Legal Notice EAC/427/2024 amended only paragraph 5(9) and did not touch the spirits line, so it cannot resolve the conflict; that the TRA webpage is newer is not evidence that the statute quantity is superseded, and without a later formal amendment or competent-authority confirmation the TRA page cannot be declared wrong either — the spirits allowance is therefore left at 1 litre or 2 litres unconfirmed, pending the competent authority or the current revised text. Perfumes and toilet water not exceeding in all one half litre, of which not more than one quarter may be perfume — no unit is given for 'one quarter' on the TRA page or in the Rev 2019 parallel wording of ¶5(6)(b) ('perfume and toilet water not exceeding in all one half litre, of which not more than a quarter may be perfume'), so only the 0.5 litre total is confirmed and the separate perfume share remains open; and cigarettes, cigars, cheroots, cigarillos, tobacco and snuff not exceeding in all 250 grammes in weight (identical in ¶5(6)(c) of the Rev 2019 text). Age boundary: TRA's Note that the import duty free allowance shall be granted only to passengers who have attained the age of eighteen (18) years is a page-level note whose matching sentence in the Rev 2019 statute sits at the end of paragraph 6, the consumables (spirits/perfumes/tobacco) list; neither the Note nor the statute ties an age condition to the >24-hour USD 2,000 clause (¶5(9)), whose only stated proviso is absence from the partner states in excess of 24 hours — whether any age limit applies to the USD 2,000 threshold is not confirmed by the available texts. The Note also states the duty free allowances shall not be allowed when imported in unaccompanied baggage. The Customs Baggage Declaration (BD) appears only in the page's attachments list, which serves the page's returning-resident/first-arrival process (see TZ-returning-resident-effects); the page does not state that every ordinary passenger must submit a BD, and the BD's technical medium is nowhere stated on the page. The page mentions no fee for these arrival exemptions; no online channel is stated.
procedures.applicability_zh: 据TRA官方「Returning Resident and First Arrival」页。该页对普通旅客唯一明示的申报动作是：在伙伴国之外停留超过24小时者，每位旅客价值不超过两千美元（$2000）的货物，由该旅客以随身行李并随身携带进口且向关员申报时免税——即入境时在口岸当场向关员申报；页面未点名任何表格，也未写明介质（电子或纸质），故仅为口岸当场申报，不涉及电子或纸质表格。该USD2000句在页面上的交叉引用留空（「other than goods referred to in paragraph of this item」缺段号），其排除范围无法确认；Rev2019法条文本的平行句（第5(9)段）作「other than goods referred to in Paragraph 8 of this item」，此处仅作参考，不据以补TRA页留空。金额交叉核验：2024年12月31日EAC Gazette（Legal Notice No. EAC/427/2024，依East African Community Customs Management Act 2004第114(3)条作出，卢旺达税务局托管PDF）将该法Fifth Schedule Part B第5(9)段的「five hundred」替换为「two thousand」；TRA当期页面与修改后金额一致，而坦桑贸易门户Rev2019文本第5(9)段仍为修改前的「United States Dollars five Hundred」——该旧数仅在金额层面被取代，不得据以覆盖现行USD2000。分项免税数量仅作该免税的附属说明，不是独立的表格申报程序：自伙伴国以外地点抵达的旅客，其货物须为旅客本人所有并随行、供旅客在伙伴国作个人或家庭使用，且种类与数量以关员酌情允许为限——此为关员裁量条件，不是表格。下列货物由旅客进口且在其随身携带中时不征关税，但其中烈酒一句在官方来源之间存在未决冲突、不作为已确认的安全限额：TRA当期页写「Spirits (including liquors) or wine, not exceeding two (2) litres」，而坦桑尼亚政府贸易门户托管的EAC Customs Management Act 2004（Revised 30 June 2019）第五附表Part B item5第(6)(a)段（PDF页167–169/印刷页161–163）写「spirits (including liquors) or wine, not exceeding one litre or wine not exceeding two litres」——即烈酒不超过1升、或葡萄酒不超过2升。两源葡萄酒2升一致；烈酒冲突（TRA 2升 vs 2019修订法条1升）。2024年Legal Notice EAC/427/2024仅改第5(9)段、未触烈酒句，不能解决该冲突；网页较新不构成法条数量已被取代的证明，无后续正式修法或主管机关确认亦不得断言TRA页错误——故烈酒限额在1升与2升之间尚未确认，待主管机关或现行修订文本确认。香水和化妆水合计不超过半升，其中香水不得超过one quarter——TRA页与Rev2019平行条文第5(6)(b)段（「perfume and toilet water not exceeding in all one half litre, of which not more than a quarter may be perfume」）均未给出该quarter的计量单位，故仅0.5升总额已确认，香水单独份额仍待确认；香烟、雪茄、方头雪茄、小雪茄、烟草及鼻烟合计不超过250克（与Rev2019第5(6)(c)段逐字一致）。年龄边界：TRA页Note「进口免税额度仅授予年满十八周岁的旅客」为页面级注记，其在Rev2019法条中的对应句位于第6段（烈酒/香水/烟草清单）之末；该Note与法条均未把年龄条件连到超24小时USD2000条款（第5(9)段），该句唯一明示条件是在伙伴国之外停留超过24小时——USD2000门槛是否设有年龄限制，现有文本未确认。该Note另写明免税额度以非随身行李进口时不予适用。海关行李申报单（BD）仅出现于该页附件清单，服务于本页回流居民/初次抵达程序（见TZ-returning-resident-effects）；页面并未规定每位普通旅客均须提交BD，且BD的技术介质全页未写明。上述入境免税页面未提及任何费用；未写明线上渠道。
procedures.timing_en: Applies at the customs point on arrival to goods imported in the traveller's accompanied baggage or upon his or her person; the USD 2,000 sentence itself requires accompanied baggage upon the person, and the TRA Note excludes unaccompanied baggage for the duty free allowances. The page states no separate form, fee, or deadline for the declaration to the officer; the declaration is made on the spot to an officer, and the page names neither an electronic nor a paper form.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时在海关环节适用于以随身行李进口或随身携带的货物；USD2000句本身即要求随身行李并随身携带，TRA Note亦排除以非随身行李进口的免税额度。页面未为向关员申报规定单独表格、费用或期限；该申报为当场向关员作出，页面未点名电子或纸质表格。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客為適用超24小時USD2000隨身行李免稅於抵達時向海關關員申報（分項免稅數量僅作附屬說明）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 據TRA官方「Returning Resident and First Arrival」頁。該頁對普通旅客唯一明示的申報動作是：在夥伴國之外停留超過24小時者，每位旅客價值不超過兩千美元（$2000）的貨物，由該旅客以隨身行李並隨身攜帶進口且向關員申報時免稅——即入境時在口岸當場向關員申報；頁面未點名任何表格，也未寫明介質（電子或紙質），故僅為口岸當場申報，不涉及電子或紙質表格。該USD2000句在頁面上的交叉引用留空（「other than goods referred to in paragraph of this item」缺段號），其排除範圍無法確認；Rev2019法條文本的平行句（第5(9)段）作「other than goods referred to in Paragraph 8 of this item」，此處僅作參考，不據以補TRA頁留空。金額交叉核驗：2024年12月31日EAC Gazette（Legal Notice No. EAC/427/2024，依East African Community Customs Management Act 2004第114(3)條作出，盧旺達稅務局託管PDF）將該法Fifth Schedule Part B第5(9)段的「five hundred」替換為「two thousand」；TRA當期頁面與修改後金額一致，而坦桑貿易門戶Rev2019文本第5(9)段仍為修改前的「United States Dollars five Hundred」——該舊數僅在金額層面被取代，不得據以覆蓋現行USD2000。分項免稅數量僅作該免稅的附屬說明，不是獨立的表格申報程序：自夥伴國以外地點抵達的旅客，其貨物須為旅客本人所有並隨行、供旅客在夥伴國作個人或家庭使用，且種類與數量以關員酌情允許為限——此為關員裁量條件，不是表格。下列貨物由旅客進口且在其隨身攜帶中時不徵關稅，但其中烈酒一句在官方來源之間存在未決衝突、不作為已確認的安全限額：TRA當期頁寫「Spirits (including liquors) or wine, not exceeding two (2) litres」，而坦桑尼亞政府貿易門戶託管的EAC Customs Management Act 2004（Revised 30 June 2019）第五附表Part B item5第(6)(a)段（PDF頁167–169/印刷頁161–163）寫「spirits (including liquors) or wine, not exceeding one litre or wine not exceeding two litres」——即烈酒不超過1升、或葡萄酒不超過2升。兩源葡萄酒2升一致；烈酒衝突（TRA 2升 vs 2019修訂法條1升）。2024年Legal Notice EAC/427/2024僅改第5(9)段、未觸烈酒句，不能解決該衝突；網頁較新不構成法條數量已被取代的證明，無後續正式修法或主管機關確認亦不得斷言TRA頁錯誤——故烈酒限額在1升與2升之間尚未確認，待主管機關或現行修訂文本確認。香水和化妝水合計不超過半升，其中香水不得超過one quarter——TRA頁與Rev2019平行條文第5(6)(b)段（「perfume and toilet water not exceeding in all one half litre, of which not more than a quarter may be perfume」）均未給出該quarter的計量單位，故僅0.5升總額已確認，香水單獨份額仍待確認；香菸、雪茄、方頭雪茄、小雪茄、菸草及鼻菸合計不超過250克（與Rev2019第5(6)(c)段逐字一致）。年齡邊界：TRA頁Note「進口免稅額度僅授予年滿十八週歲的旅客」為頁面級註記，其在Rev2019法條中的對應句位於第6段（烈酒/香水/菸草清單）之末；該Note與法條均未把年齡條件連到超24小時USD2000條款（第5(9)段），該句唯一明示條件是在夥伴國之外停留超過24小時——USD2000門檻是否設有年齡限制，現有文本未確認。該Note另寫明免稅額度以非隨身行李進口時不予適用。海關行李申報單（BD）僅出現於該頁附件清單，服務於本頁迴流居民/初次抵達程序（見TZ-returning-resident-effects）；頁面並未規定每位普通旅客均須提交BD，且BD的技術介質全頁未寫明。上述入境免稅頁面未提及任何費用；未寫明線上渠道。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時在海關環節適用於以隨身行李進口或隨身攜帶的貨物；USD2000句本身即要求隨身行李並隨身攜帶，TRA Note亦排除以非隨身行李進口的免稅額度。頁面未為向關員申報規定單獨表格、費用或期限；該申報為當場向關員作出，頁面未點名電子或紙質表格。

procedures.name_en: Returning residents and first arrivals — household effects, motor vehicle and 90/360-day import window
procedures.name_zh: 回流居民与初次抵达者——家用物品、机动车与90/360天进口时限
procedures.agency: Tanzania Revenue Authority (TRA) — Customs and Excise Department
procedures.applicability_en: Per TRA's official 'Returning Resident and First Arrival' page. Qualification — this exemption applies only to travellers who meet these conditions: a person who is arriving in Tanzania for the first time, or a returning citizen, whom the proper officer authorizes as bona fide changing residence from a place outside Tanzania to a place in Tanzania (and therefore qualifies for duty-free status); such a person must not previously have been granted an exemption and must not have resided in Tanzania before arrival other than on temporary non-resident visits (TRA's sentence is ungrammatical; this is its plain content, not extrapolated). Allowable goods for a returning resident who has attained the age of eighteen years: wearing apparel; personal and household effects of any kind which were in the passenger's personal or household use in the former place of residence; and one motor vehicle — excluding buses and minibuses of seating capacity of more than 13 passengers and load-carrying vehicles of load-carrying capacity exceeding two tonnes — which must not be eight years or more from the date of manufacture, of cubic capacity not exceeding 3000 (TRA gives no cc unit; the unit remains unknown), and which the passenger has personally owned and used outside Tanzania for at least twelve months (excluding the period of the voyage in the case of shipment). Timing: exemptions are granted in respect of baggage imported within ninety days from the date of arrival of the passenger, or such further period not exceeding three hundred and sixty days from such arrival as the Commissioner may allow. Statute-level structure (per the Tanzania Government Trade Portal-hosted EAC Customs Management Act 2004, Revised 30 June 2019 — Fifth Schedule Part B item 5, PDF pages 167–169/printed pages 161–163; this same-law official-portal copy, ten years more recent, replaces the superseded KRA-hosted Rev 2009 PDF as the structural source): paragraph 1(a) requires goods to be the property of and accompany the passenger, except as provided in paragraph 7; paragraph 7 grants the 90/360-day window for the exemptions under paragraphs (3)-(5) (first arrivals and returning residents changing residence, temporary visitors, and residents returning from visits), while its last sentence confines the unaccompanied-baggage exclusion to the paragraph (6) allowances (spirits/wine, perfumes/toilet water, tobacco). TRA's simplified Note ('the duty free allowances granted in accordance with the law shall not be allowed when imported in unaccompanied baggage') is read against that structure: the apparent tension is resolved at statute level — later, including unaccompanied, import within 90/360 days is contemplated only for the paragraph (3)-(5)-type effects and vehicle (on the vehicle conditions), while the consumable allowances and the >24-hour USD 2,000 threshold remain accompanied-only; unaccompanied shipments are therefore not blanket duty-free. Version boundary of that reading: the EAC Gazette of 31 December 2024 (Legal Notice No. EAC/427/2024) amends only the paragraph 5(9) amount ('five hundred' to 'two thousand') and does not restate paragraph 7; the Rev 2019 portal copy consolidates in-situ amendment footnotes only up to its 30 June 2019 revision date (its ¶5(9) footnote reaches only EAC/13/2010), so it cannot prove that no later amendment altered paragraph 7's structure; and the current consolidated EAC text (2008 code, 2025 Amendment Act) was not accessible on the EAC site, so whether any amendment since 2019 changed paragraph 7 remains unconfirmed. The structural reading above therefore rests on the Rev 2019 text plus TRA's current page and is not a verbatim reading of the consolidated law. The Rev 2019 copy's paragraph 5(9) still shows the pre-2024 'United States Dollars five Hundred' and is not used for the current amount. Change of residence: where a person granted exemption changes residence to a place outside the partner states within ninety (90) days from arrival, the household effects must be exported within thirty (30) days, or up to sixty (60) days as the Commissioner may allow, otherwise duty becomes payable from the day of importation. Attachments listed on the page for this returning-resident/first-arrival process (page-scoped, not a requirement stated for every ordinary passenger): a copy of passport; packing list; duly filled Customs Baggage Declaration (BD), available at Customs Offices; original Bill of Lading or Air Way Bill; invoices to prove the duration of ownership of goods; resident permit or evidence of study abroad; registration card (when importing a motor vehicle); insurance plan for the motor vehicle in the exporting country. Form and fees as stated: TRA says the BD is available at Customs Offices but does not state whether it is issued as a paper form or in another medium; the page mentions no online submission, which does not by itself rule out an online channel elsewhere; the page mentions no fee for this process.
procedures.applicability_zh: 据TRA官方「Returning Resident and First Arrival」页。资格——该免税仅适用于符合以下条件者：初次抵达坦桑尼亚者或回流公民，经关员认定为真实（bona fide）把居住地由坦桑境外迁入坦桑境内（因而符合免税资格）；且此前未获过免税、抵达前未在坦桑居住（临时非居民访问除外）——TRA原句语法有误，此处仅取其明示内容，不作外推。年满十八周岁回流居民的允许物品：衣着；在原居住地作个人或家庭使用过的各类个人及家用物品；一辆机动车——排除座位超过13人的客车/小巴与载重超过2吨的载货车——自制造之日起不满八年、气缸容量（cubic capacity）不超过3000（TRA未给cc单位，单位保留未知），且乘客本人在坦桑境外自有并使用至少十二个月（海运时航运期不计）。时限：对乘客抵达之日起九十日内进口的行李给予免税，或经专员准许延长至抵达后不超过三百六十日。法条层级结构（据坦桑尼亚政府贸易门户托管的EAC Customs Management Act 2004（Revised 30 June 2019）——Fifth Schedule Part B item 5，PDF页167–169/印刷页161–163；该同法官方门户文本较KRA托管的Rev 2009近十年，取代其作为结构来源）：第1(a)条要求货物为旅客所有并随行，惟「except as provided in Paragraph 7」除外；第7段把90/360天窗口授予第(3)-(5)段的免税（初次抵达/回流居民变更居住、临时访客、探访后返回的居民），其末句把非随身行李排除限于第(6)段额度（烈酒/葡萄酒、香水/化妆水、烟草）。TRA简化Note（「依法律给予的免税额度以非随身行李进口时不予适用」）依该结构解读：表面张力在法条层级解决——90/360天内迟后（含非随身）进口仅对第(3)-(5)段类物品与车辆（须满足车辆条件）可获免税，而消耗品额度与超24小时USD2000门槛仍限随身；因此非随身后运并非当然免税。该解读的版次边界：2024-12-31 EAC Gazette（Legal Notice No. EAC/427/2024）仅修订第5(9)段金额（five hundred改two thousand），不复述第7段；Rev2019门户文本的随文修订注记仅汇至其2019-06-30修订日（第5(9)段注记仅及EAC/13/2010），故不能证明其后再无修法改动第7段结构；现行EAC合并文本（2008法典、2025修正法）在EAC官网未能访问，2019年以来是否有修法改动第7段无法确认。上述结构解读因此以「Rev2019＋TRA当期页」为依据，不视为对现行合并条文的逐字读取。Rev2019文本第5(9)段仍为2024年修改前的「United States Dollars five Hundred」，不用于现行金额。迁居：获免税者若在抵达后九十日内把居住地迁往伙伴国之外，须在三十日内（经专员准许可至六十日）出口其家用物品，否则自进口之日起补缴关税。该页为此回流居民/初次抵达程序列出的附件（属本页对象，并非对每位普通旅客的要求）：护照复印件；装箱单；填妥的海关行李申报单（BD），海关办事处备取；正本提单或空运单；证明物品持有时长的发票；居留许可或境外就读证明；机动车登记卡（进口机动车时）；出口国机动车保险。表格与费用按原文：TRA仅说明BD在海关办事处可取得，未写明它是纸质表格还是其他介质；页面未提及线上提交，但这本身不等于不存在线上渠道；页面未提及本流程的任何费用。
procedures.timing_en: Baggage must be imported within 90 days of arrival, extendable to a further period not exceeding 360 days as the Commissioner may allow; under the Act's structure this window covers the paragraph (3)-(5) effects and vehicle exemptions, while the consumable paragraph (6) allowances and the >24-hour USD 2,000 threshold are accompanied-only. Household effects must be re-exported within 30 days (extendable to 60) if residence is moved outside the partner states within 90 days of arrival, failing which duty is payable from the day of importation.
procedures.timing_zh: 行李须在抵达后90日内进口，经专员准许可延至不超过360日；依该法结构，此窗口覆盖第(3)-(5)段物品与车辆免税，而第(6)段消耗品额度与超24小时USD2000限额仅限随身。若在抵达后90日内把居住地迁往伙伴国之外，家用物品须在30日内（可延至60日）复运出境，否则自进口之日起计缴关税。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 迴流居民與初次抵達者——家用物品、機動車與90/360天進口時限
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 據TRA官方「Returning Resident and First Arrival」頁。資格——該免稅僅適用於符合以下條件者：初次抵達坦桑尼亞者或迴流公民，經關員認定為真實（bona fide）把居住地由坦桑境外遷入坦桑境內（因而符合免稅資格）；且此前未獲過免稅、抵達前未在坦桑居住（臨時非居民訪問除外）——TRA原句語法有誤，此處僅取其明示內容，不作外推。年滿十八週歲迴流居民的允許物品：衣著；在原居住地作個人或家庭使用過的各類個人及家用物品；一輛機動車——排除座位超過13人的客車/小巴與載重超過2噸的載貨車——自制造之日起不滿八年、氣缸容量（cubic capacity）不超過3000（TRA未給cc單位，單位保留未知），且乘客本人在坦桑境外自有並使用至少十二個月（海運時航運期不計）。時限：對乘客抵達之日起九十日內進口的行李給予免稅，或經專員准許延長至抵達後不超過三百六十日。法條層級結構（據坦桑尼亞政府貿易門戶託管的EAC Customs Management Act 2004（Revised 30 June 2019）——Fifth Schedule Part B item 5，PDF頁167–169/印刷頁161–163；該同法官方門戶文本較KRA託管的Rev 2009近十年，取代其作為結構來源）：第1(a)條要求貨物為旅客所有並隨行，惟「except as provided in Paragraph 7」除外；第7段把90/360天窗口授予第(3)-(5)段的免稅（初次抵達/迴流居民變更居住、臨時訪客、探訪後返回的居民），其末句把非隨身行李排除限於第(6)段額度（烈酒/葡萄酒、香水/化妝水、菸草）。TRA簡化Note（「依法律給予的免稅額度以非隨身行李進口時不予適用」）依該結構解讀：表面張力在法條層級解決——90/360天內遲後（含非隨身）進口僅對第(3)-(5)段類物品與車輛（須滿足車輛條件）可獲免稅，而消耗品額度與超24小時USD2000門檻仍限隨身；因此非隨身後運並非當然免稅。該解讀的版次邊界：2024-12-31 EAC Gazette（Legal Notice No. EAC/427/2024）僅修訂第5(9)段金額（five hundred改two thousand），不復述第7段；Rev2019門戶文本的隨文修訂註記僅匯至其2019-06-30修訂日（第5(9)段註記僅及EAC/13/2010），故不能證明其後再無修法改動第7段結構；現行EAC合併文本（2008法典、2025修正法）在EAC官網未能訪問，2019年以來是否有修法改動第7段無法確認。上述結構解讀因此以「Rev2019＋TRA當期頁」為依據，不視為對現行合併條文的逐字讀取。Rev2019文本第5(9)段仍為2024年修改前的「United States Dollars five Hundred」，不用於現行金額。遷居：獲免稅者若在抵達後九十日內把居住地遷往夥伴國之外，須在三十日內（經專員准許可至六十日）出口其家用物品，否則自進口之日起補繳關稅。該頁為此迴流居民/初次抵達程序列出的附件（屬本頁對象，並非對每位普通旅客的要求）：護照複印件；裝箱單；填妥的海關行李申報單（BD），海關辦事處備取；正本提單或空運單；證明物品持有時長的發票；居留許可或境外就讀證明；機動車登記卡（進口機動車時）；出口國機動車保險。表格與費用按原文：TRA僅說明BD在海關辦事處可取得，未寫明它是紙質表格還是其他介質；頁面未提及線上提交，但這本身不等於不存線上上渠道；頁面未提及本流程的任何費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 行李須在抵達後90日內進口，經專員准許可延至不超過360日；依該法結構，此窗口覆蓋第(3)-(5)段物品與車輛免稅，而第(6)段消耗品額度與超24小時USD2000限額僅限隨身。若在抵達後90日內把居住地遷往夥伴國之外，家用物品須在30日內（可延至60日）復運出境，否則自進口之日起計繳關稅。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of currency and bearer negotiable instruments worth US$10,000 or its equivalent (entering or leaving mainland Tanzania)
procedures.name_zh: 现金及不记名可转让票据申报（价值1万美元或等值；入境或出境坦桑尼亚大陆）
procedures.agency: Tanzania Revenue Authority — Customs (forms go to the Financial Intelligence Unit)
procedures.applicability_en: A person entering or leaving the United Republic with currency or bearer negotiable instruments worth US$10,000 or its equivalent in Tanzanian shillings or another currency must fill in the Cross-Border Declaration of Currency and Bearer Negotiable Instruments form (Form I, First Schedule of the Anti-Money Laundering (Cross-Border Declaration of Currency and Bearer Negotiable Instruments) Regulations, 2016) and present it to Customs for inspection. Currency and instruments are added together, and the amount is converted at the Bank of Tanzania official rate in effect when the money crosses the border. Bearer negotiable instruments include bank drafts, promissory notes, cheques, money orders, travellers' cheques, bearer bonds, postal orders and prepaid cards. The Regulations apply to mainland Tanzania and cover money carried on the person or in luggage or a vehicle, shipped in containerised cargo, or sent by mail. The Customs officer keeps the original form and hands the declarant a duplicate copy. The Foreign Exchange Regulations, 2022 (regulation 4) repeat the duty for foreign currency exceeding US$10,000, to be declared to Customs at arrival or departure. The two texts differ at exactly US$10,000: the Anti-Money Laundering Regulations say "equal to or above" and the form says "at least", while the Foreign Exchange Regulations say "exceeding".
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境或出境坦桑尼亚联合共和国时，携带价值1万美元或等值坦桑尼亚先令/其他货币的现金或不记名可转让票据者，须填写《现金及不记名可转让票据跨境申报表》（Form I，《2016年反洗钱（现金及不记名可转让票据跨境申报）条例》第一附表），并交海关检查。现金与票据合并计算，金额按货币越境时坦桑尼亚银行的官方汇率折算。不记名可转让票据包括银行汇票、本票、支票、汇票、旅行支票、不记名债券、邮政汇票和预付卡。该条例适用于坦桑尼亚大陆，涵盖随身或随行李、车辆携带，集装箱货运和邮寄的款项。海关关员留存申报表原件，并把副本交给申报人。《2022年外汇条例》第4条对超过1万美元的外币重申了该义务，须在抵达或离境时向海关申报。两部文本在恰为1万美元时措辞不同：反洗钱条例写"等于或高于"，表格写"至少"，外汇条例写"超过"。
procedures.timing_en: Made on the form at the Customs point when entering or leaving, and presented to the Customs officer there.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或出境时在海关点填写申报表，并当场交给海关关员。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金及不記名可轉讓票據申報（價值1萬美元或等值；入境或出境坦桑尼亞大陸）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境或出境坦桑尼亞聯合共和國時，攜帶價值1萬美元或等值坦桑尼亞先令/其他貨幣的現金或不記名可轉讓票據者，須填寫《現金及不記名可轉讓票據跨境申報表》（Form I，《2016年反洗錢（現金及不記名可轉讓票據跨境申報）條例》第一附表），並交海關檢查。現金與票據合併計算，金額按貨幣越境時坦桑尼亞銀行的官方匯率折算。不記名可轉讓票據包括銀行匯票、本票、支票、匯票、旅行支票、不記名債券、郵政匯票和預付卡。該條例適用於坦桑尼亞大陸，涵蓋隨身或隨行李、車輛攜帶，集裝箱貨運和郵寄的款項。海關關員留存申報表原件，並把副本交給申報人。《2022年外匯條例》第4條對超過1萬美元的外幣重申了該義務，須在抵達或離境時向海關申報。兩部文本在恰為1萬美元時措辭不同：反洗錢條例寫"等於或高於"，表格寫"至少"，外匯條例寫"超過"。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或出境時在海關點填寫申報表，並當場交給海關關員。

procedures.name_en: Visa on arrival for listed nationals
procedures.name_zh: 名单内国籍落地签
procedures.agency: Zambia Department of Immigration
procedures.applicability_en: Nationals of the countries listed on the Department of Immigration page can get a visa to Zambia on arrival at any port of entry, or from selected Zambian missions abroad. The page publishes the full list of eligible countries.
procedures.applicability_zh: 移民部页面所列国籍的公民可在任意入境口岸办理落地签，或在指定赞比亚驻外机构办理。适用国家的完整名单见该页面。
procedures.timing_en: Issued at the port of entry on arrival, or obtained in advance from selected Zambian missions abroad.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时在入境口岸签发，或提前在指定赞比亚驻外机构办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 名單內國籍落地簽
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 移民部頁面所列國籍的公民可在任意入境口岸辦理落地簽，或在指定贊比亞駐外機構辦理。適用國家的完整名單見該頁面。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時在入境口岸簽發，或提前在指定贊比亞駐外機構辦理。

procedures.name_en: Traveller allowances and Form CE6 goods declaration — Zambia Revenue Authority
procedures.name_zh: 旅客免税额度与CE6表格货物申报——赞比亚税务局
procedures.agency: Zambia Revenue Authority (ZRA)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers arriving in Zambia with accompanied baggage. Per the ZRA 'Importation of Goods' page captured live 2026-09-26. Traveller's allowances: a traveler is entitled to import goods worth USD 1,000 duty free, and any excess as long as the taxes are below K10; the goods must not be for commercial purposes or belong to any person who is not a traveler, and rebates do not apply to gifts bought for family or friends. A traveler at least 18 years old is additionally entitled to import duty free the following quantities of excisable goods: 2.5 litres of clear beer; 0.5 kg of tobacco or 0.5 kg of cigars or 400 sticks of cigarettes; 2.5 litres of wine; 1.5 litres of spirits. Traveller's goods not covered by the allowances are declared and cleared as follows: the traveler completes declaration Form CE6 and presents it to customs together with any other supporting documents; customs assess the duty payable after physically checking the goods; payment is made and a receipt is issued. Consignment bands on the same page: small-value consignments (CIF value more than USD 1,000 but not exceeding USD 2,000) need no clearing agent and are liable to duties and taxes; large-value consignments above USD 2,000 require a clearing agent and electronic declaration. Note on scope: the ZRA page states the allowances and the Form CE6 process described above, and does not mention a USD 5,000 threshold or red/green channels.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：携带随行行李抵达赞比亚的旅客。据赞比亚税务局（ZRA）「货物进口」页面（2026-09-26 实时取得）。旅客免税额度：旅客可免税进口价值 1,000 美元的物品，超出部分只要税款低于 K10 亦可缴税进口；物品不得用于商业目的或属于非旅客本人；返利不适用于为家人朋友购买的礼品。年满 18 岁的旅客另可免税进口以下数量的应税物品：清啤 2.5 升；烟草 0.5 公斤或雪茄 0.5 公斤或卷烟 400 支；葡萄酒 2.5 升；烈酒 1.5 升。不在额度内的旅客物品按以下程序申报清关：旅客填写 CE6 申报表并连同其他证明文件提交海关；海关实物查验后核定应缴税款；缴税并开具收据。同页的分档：小价值包裹（CIF 价值超 1,000 美元但不超过 2,000 美元）无需报关行，须缴税费；价值超 2,000 美元的大价值包裹需报关行并电子申报。范围说明：赞比亚税务局页面载有上述免税额度与 CE6 申报流程，未提及 5,000 美元门槛或红/绿通道。
procedures.timing_en: For traveller's goods not covered by the allowances: complete declaration Form CE6, submit it to customs together with any other supporting documents; customs assess the duty payable after physically checking the goods; payment of taxes is made and a receipt is issued.
procedures.timing_zh: 额度外的旅客物品：填写 CE6 申报表，连同其他证明文件提交海关；海关实物查验后核定应缴税款；缴税并取得收据。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客免稅額度與CE6表格貨物申報——贊比亞稅務局
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：攜帶隨行行李抵達贊比亞的旅客。據贊比亞稅務局（ZRA）「貨物進口」頁面（2026-09-26 實時取得）。旅客免稅額度：旅客可免稅進口價值 1,000 美元的物品，超出部分只要稅款低於 K10 亦可繳稅進口；物品不得用於商業目的或屬於非旅客本人；返利不適用於為家人朋友購買的禮品。年滿 18 歲的旅客另可免稅進口以下數量的應稅物品：清啤 2.5 升；菸草 0.5 公斤或雪茄 0.5 公斤或捲菸 400 支；葡萄酒 2.5 升；烈酒 1.5 升。不在額度內的旅客物品按以下程序申報清關：旅客填寫 CE6 申報表並連同其他證明文件提交海關；海關實物查驗後核定應繳稅款；繳稅並開具收據。同頁的分檔：小价值包裹（CIF 價值超 1,000 美元但不超過 2,000 美元）無需報關行，須繳稅費；價值超 2,000 美元的大價值包裹需報關行並電子申報。範圍說明：贊比亞稅務局頁面載有上述免稅額度與 CE6 申報流程，未提及 5,000 美元門檻或紅/綠通道。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 額度外的旅客物品：填寫 CE6 申報表，連同其他證明文件提交海關；海關實物查驗後核定應繳稅款；繳稅並取得收據。

procedures.name_en: Currency declaration for amounts above USD 5,000 — Zambia Revenue Authority
procedures.name_zh: 超过5,000美元等值的货币申报——赞比亚税务局
procedures.agency: Zambia Revenue Authority (ZRA)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: both entering and leaving Zambia. Anyone importing into or exporting from Zambia currency notes, in any currency, worth more than the equivalent of USD 5,000 must make a declaration in the prescribed form (Customs and Excise Act, Chapter 322, section 41A). The Act's Currency Declaration Form (Customs Form No. 47A) asks for name, nationality, passport number, port of entry or exit, and each currency with its amount and US dollar equivalent. ZRA's Integrated Border Declaration Form, which visitors file on the ZRA Customs Portal or the TaxOnApp mobile app, has a currency section for travellers carrying more than USD 5,000, and ZRA says any amount above USD 5,000 must be declared before the customs official at the point of entry or exit. Zambia sets no limit on how much currency can be brought in or taken out; the duty is to declare amounts above the threshold. If an officer has reason to believe the declaration was not made or is false, the officer may search the person and baggage, and currency notes found above the threshold are seized and forfeited to the state; the owner may appeal to the Commissioner-General within thirty days. Registered banks, bureaux de change and other licensed financial institutions are exempt. The Act speaks of currency notes and does not mention cheques or other bearer instruments.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：入境和出境均适用。任何人携带货币纸钞（任何币种）入境或出境，价值超过5,000美元等值的，须按规定表格申报（《海关与消费税法》第322章第41A条）。法律附带的货币申报表（海关表格第47A号）要求填写姓名、国籍、护照号码、入境或出境口岸，以及每种货币的金额和美元等值。赞比亚税务局（ZRA）的综合边境申报表（Integrated Border Declaration Form）可由访客在ZRA海关门户或TaxOnApp手机应用上提交，其中设有货币申报部分，供携带超过5,000美元的旅客使用；ZRA写明超过5,000美元的金额须在入境或出境口岸向海关官员申报。赞比亚对携带入出境的货币总额没有上限，义务是申报超过门槛的部分。官员有理由认为未申报或申报不实的，可搜查本人及行李；搜出超过门槛的货币纸钞将被扣押并没收归国家，物主可在30日内向税务局总局长申诉。注册银行、货币兑换所及其他持牌金融机构豁免。法律条文针对货币纸钞，未提及支票或其他无记名票据。
procedures.timing_en: On entering or leaving Zambia, declared to a customs officer at the port of entry or exit. Visitors can file the Integrated Border Declaration Form in advance on the Customs Portal or TaxOnApp.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或出境时向口岸海关官员申报；访客可提前在海关门户或TaxOnApp上提交综合边境申报表。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超過5,000美元等值的貨幣申報——贊比亞稅務局
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：入境和出境均適用。任何人攜帶貨幣紙鈔（任何幣種）入境或出境，價值超過5,000美元等值的，須按規定表格申報（《海關與消費稅法》第322章第41A條）。法律附帶的貨幣申報表（海關表格第47A號）要求填寫姓名、國籍、護照號碼、入境或出境口岸，以及每種貨幣的金額和美元等值。贊比亞稅務局（ZRA）的綜合邊境申報表（Integrated Border Declaration Form）可由訪客在ZRA海關門戶或TaxOnApp手機應用上提交，其中設有貨幣申報部分，供攜帶超過5,000美元的旅客使用；ZRA寫明超過5,000美元的金額須在入境或出境口岸向海關官員申報。贊比亞對攜帶入出境的貨幣總額沒有上限，義務是申報超過門檻的部分。官員有理由認為未申報或申報不實的，可搜查本人及行李；搜出超過門檻的貨幣紙鈔將被扣押並沒收歸國家，物主可在30日內向稅務局總局長申訴。註冊銀行、貨幣兌換所及其他持牌金融機構豁免。法律條文針對貨幣紙鈔，未提及支票或其他無記名票據。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或出境時向口岸海關官員申報；訪客可提前在海關門戶或TaxOnApp上提交綜合邊境申報表。

procedures.name_en: Traveller's rebate — duty-free allowance on imported goods
procedures.name_zh: 旅客免税额度（traveller's rebate）——入境物品减免
procedures.agency: Zimbabwe Revenue Authority (ZIMRA)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: goods imported into Zimbabwe by travellers (returning residents, tourists/visitors, immigrants and diplomats; crew members excluded). Two components per ZIMRA. (1) Total Rebate: granted on all used personal effects — used clothes and toilet requisites, excluding articles such as radios and cameras. (2) Partial Rebate: granted once a month, on the traveller's first entry into Zimbabwe in that calendar month, subject to conditions: goods properly declared; not for resale or of a commercial nature; value not exceeding US$200; alcoholic beverages not more than 5 litres of which not more than 2 litres may be spirits, and the traveller is 18 years or above; the traveller is not a crew member; and the goods exclude blankets, refrigerators, laundry soap, cooking oil, stoves, beds, mattresses, flour, maize meal, sugar, meat, fish, powdered milk, yoghurt, cheese, eggs, corn puffs, jam and honey. ZIMRA's worked example: goods worth $610 of which $360 qualify — rebate $200, excess $160, duty at 40% = $64; excluded items (e.g. stoves) are dutiable on full value. ZIMRA states eligible travellers include returning residents, tourists/visitors, immigrants and diplomats.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：旅客带入津巴布韦的物品（适用对象为回归居民、游客/访客、移民与外交人员；机组人员除外）。据 ZIMRA，该免税额度分两部分。（1）全额额度（Total Rebate）：适用于全部已使用个人物品——已用的衣物和洗漱用品，但不包括收音机、相机等物品。（2）部分额度（Partial Rebate）：每个日历月内首次入境时适用一次，条件为：物品已如实申报；非转售或商用性质；价值不超过200美元；酒精饮料不超过5升、其中烈酒不超过2升，且旅客年满18岁；旅客不是机组人员；且物品不属于以下排除清单——毛毯、冰箱、洗衣皂、食用油、炉具、床、床垫、面粉、玉米粉、糖、肉、鱼、奶粉、酸奶、奶酪、鸡蛋、玉米膨化食品、果酱和蜂蜜。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival: the rebate applies on the date of first entry into Zimbabwe in a calendar month; goods must be properly declared at the border.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时适用：免税额度按日历月内首次入境日期适用；物品须在口岸如实申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客免稅額度（traveller's rebate）——入境物品減免
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：旅客帶入津巴布韋的物品（適用對象為迴歸居民、遊客/訪客、移民與外交人員；機組人員除外）。據 ZIMRA，該免稅額度分兩部分。（1）全額額度（Total Rebate）：適用於全部已使用個人物品——已用的衣物和洗漱用品，但不包括收音機、相機等物品。（2）部分額度（Partial Rebate）：每個日曆月內首次入境時適用一次，條件為：物品已如實申報；非轉售或商用性質；價值不超過200美元；酒精飲料不超過5升、其中烈酒不超過2升，且旅客年滿18歲；旅客不是機組人員；且物品不屬於以下排除清單——毛毯、冰箱、洗衣皂、食用油、爐具、床、床墊、麵粉、玉米粉、糖、肉、魚、奶粉、酸奶、奶酪、雞蛋、玉米膨化食品、果醬和蜂蜜。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時適用：免稅額度按日曆月內首次入境日期適用；物品須在口岸如實申報。

procedures.name_en: Traveller currency entry declaration and exit proof by duplicate (BNA Aviso 6/22)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客货币入境申报及出境交验副联（安哥拉国家银行第6/22号通告）
procedures.agency: Banco Nacional de Angola; entry declaration form supplied and validated by the customs services at the border (CPLP table: Customs or Fiscal Police)
procedures.applicability_en: Under BNA Aviso 6/22 of 3 March 2022 (effective 30 days after publication, i.e. 2 April 2022), natural persons, whether FX-resident or non-resident, entering Angola with national or foreign currency of total value equal to or above USD 10,000 equivalent must declare it at entry by completing the customs-supplied declaration form; the traveller personally completes and signs the form, customs validates it, retains the original and hands the duplicate to the traveller (Art. 3). Art. 3(1) states no age limit, while the official CPLP table labels this row adults. Non-resident natural persons may exit with foreign currency only up to the value they brought in; where that value is equal to or above USD 10,000 equivalent they must prove it on exit by handing the validated duplicate to the exit customs (Art. 4(3)-(4)) - exactly USD 10,000 is covered ('igual ou superior'), overriding the CPLP FAQ's generic 'superior'. Departure amounts are carry caps, not separate forms: residents up to USD 10,000 equivalent in total; unaccompanied resident minors under 18 up to USD 1,000 (Art. 4(1)-(2)); border authorities may still condition exit on suspicion of a criminal offence regardless of the limits (Art. 5).
procedures.applicability_zh: 依安哥拉国家银行第6/22号通告（2022年3月3日公布，公布后30日生效，即2022年4月2日）：居民与非居民外汇自然人入境携本国或外国货币，总额达1万美元等值及以上者，必须在入境时填写海关提供的申报表申报；该表由旅客本人填写并签署，海关核验后留存正本、将副联交还旅客（第3条）。第3条第1款条文未设年龄限制，而CPLP官方表格将入境行标注为成年人。非居民自然人出境仅可携出与其入境带入额度相同的外币；该额度达1万美元等值及以上时，须在出境时向出境海关交付经核验的申报副联以证明该款原带入（第4条第3、4款）——恰为1万美元亦在交验之列（'igual ou superior'），CPLP常见问题中笼统的'superior'（超过）表述不能改变条文。出境数额属携带上限而非另设表格：居民出境合计不超过1万美元等值；无陪伴的未满18岁居民限1,000美元（第4条第1、2款）；边境当局对涉犯罪嫌疑的旅客仍可不论限额限制其货币出境（第5条）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival at an external border when carrying currency of total value at or above USD 10,000 equivalent (fill in, sign and hand over the form; keep the validated duplicate); on departure, a non-resident taking out at or above USD 10,000 equivalent hands the duplicate to exit customs.
procedures.timing_zh: 携货币总额达1万美元等值及以上者，抵达对外边境时办理（本人填表签署并递交，留存经核验副联）；非居民出境携出达1万美元等值及以上时，将副联交出境海关。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客貨幣入境申報及出境交驗副聯（安哥拉國家銀行第6/22號通告）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 依安哥拉國家銀行第6/22號通告（2022年3月3日公佈，公佈後30日生效，即2022年4月2日）：居民與非居民外匯自然人入境攜本國或外國貨幣，總額達1萬美元等值及以上者，必須在入境時填寫海關提供的申報表申報；該表由旅客本人填寫並簽署，海關核驗後留存正本、將副聯交還旅客（第3條）。第3條第1款條文未設年齡限制，而CPLP官方表格將入境行標註為成年人。非居民自然人出境僅可攜出與其入境帶入額度相同的外幣；該額度達1萬美元等值及以上時，須在出境時向出境海關交付經核驗的申報副聯以證明該款原帶入（第4條第3、4款）——恰為1萬美元亦在交驗之列（'igual ou superior'），CPLP常見問題中籠統的'superior'（超過）表述不能改變條文。出境數額屬攜帶上限而非另設表格：居民出境合計不超過1萬美元等值；無陪伴的未滿18歲居民限1,000美元（第4條第1、2款）；邊境當局對涉犯罪嫌疑的旅客仍可不論限額限制其貨幣出境（第5條）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 攜貨幣總額達1萬美元等值及以上者，抵達對外邊境時辦理（本人填表簽署並遞交，留存經核驗副聯）；非居民出境攜出達1萬美元等值及以上時，將副聯交出境海關。

procedures.name_en: Pre-arrival passenger customs declaration via 'Douane Cmr' / 'Customs Cmr' app
procedures.name_zh: 经「Douane Cmr / Customs Cmr」应用的下机前旅客海关申报
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes du Cameroun (1 Dec 2023 communiqué as relayed by CNCC; App Store listing states © Cameroon Customs, developer Sankei Cries Inc.)
procedures.applicability_en: CNCC's page republishes a report ending 'Source: Investir au Cameroun' about a communiqué signed 1 December 2023 by Customs Director-General Edwin Fongod Nuvaga: from 1 January 2024, air passengers bound for Cameroon must download Douane Cmr / Customs Cmr (Google Play, App Store) and validate and submit an electronic questionnaire before disembarkation, replacing airline-distributed paper forms; the form covers flight number, passenger identity, passport number, goods/baggage and currencies; a QR reference stored on the phone is to be scanned by customs agents at disembarkation; customs is quoted ('D'après la douane') calling the service free. The CNCC page is a relayed report, not the signed communiqué; the 'free' wording is a 2023 press quote, not a fee text. The App Store listing (read on 2026-09-28: v1.2.0 dated 2025-07-02, Free, © Cameroon Customs, developer Sankei Cries Inc.) shows the app downloadable as of that day and says declarations can be created offline, any number of times, before departure, while the generated QR code can only be used at airports equipped with an electronic declaration terminal, with start dates deferred to the Cameroon Customs website (Bafoussam, Bamenda, Bertoua, Douala, Garoua, Salak, Ngaoundere, Yaounde-Nsimalen listed); the store's 'Free' label is a download price, not evidence of the declaration service's fee. Neither the relayed announcement nor the app-store listing confirms that an electronic declaration terminal at any specific airport has been activated, that a declaration can actually be completed and submitted to a server, or the service's current fee (whether it is still free of charge in 2026 has no official confirmation). The 2026-09-28 re-check reached page persistence and store availability only, not on-site completion at any airport.
procedures.applicability_zh: CNCC页面转载一篇末尾注明「Source: Investir au Cameroun」的报道，述及海关总局长 Edwin Fongod Nuvaga 于2023年12月1日签署的公告：自2024年1月1日起，飞往喀麦隆的航空旅客须下载 Douane Cmr / Customs Cmr（Google Play、App Store），在下机前验证并提交电子问卷，取代航空公司发放的纸表；问卷涵盖航班号、旅客身份、护照号、行李货物及货币；申报存于手机生成二维码参考号，下机时由海关人员扫描查验；报道以「D'après la douane」引述海关称该服务免费。该页属转述报道，非签署公告原件；「免费」系2023年报道引语，非收费文本。App Store 店铺页（2026-09-28核读：v1.2.0，2025-07-02，免费，© Cameroon Customs，开发者 Sankei Cries Inc.）显示应用当日仍可下载，并载明可在出发前离线、不限次数地创建申报，所生成二维码仅在设有电子申报终端的机场可用，启用日期以喀麦隆海关网站为准（列名 Bafoussam、Bamenda、Bertoua、Douala、Garoua、Salak、Ngaoundere、Yaounde-Nsimalen 八场）；店铺「免费」为下载标价，不证明申报服务的费用。上述转述公告与应用店铺信息均未确认任一机场的电子申报终端已经启用、申报可实际完成并向服务器提交，也未说明服务现行的收费标准（2026年是否仍免费尚无官方确认）。2026-09-28复核仅及页面存续与店铺可获得性，不及任何机场的现场完成。
procedures.timing_en: Per the relayed 2023 announcement, the questionnaire is to be filled in and submitted before disembarking; per the App Store listing, declarations are created offline before departure and the generated QR is scanned on arrival at airports with an electronic terminal; neither the announcement nor the listing states that the declaration is transmitted online before disembarkation.
procedures.timing_zh: 按2023年转述公告，应在下机前填写并提交问卷；按 App Store 店铺描述，申报于出发前离线创建，所生成二维码于抵达设有电子终端的机场时扫描；转述公告与店铺信息均未载明申报会在下机前经网络传输。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 經「Douane Cmr / Customs Cmr」應用的下機前旅客海關申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: CNCC頁面轉載一篇末尾註明「Source: Investir au Cameroun」的報道，述及海關總局長 Edwin Fongod Nuvaga 於2023年12月1日簽署的公告：自2024年1月1日起，飛往喀麥隆的航空旅客須下載 Douane Cmr / Customs Cmr（Google Play、App Store），在下機前驗證並提交電子問卷，取代航空公司發放的紙表；問卷涵蓋航班號、旅客身份、護照號、行李貨物及貨幣；申報存於手機生成 QR Code 參考號，下機時由海關人員掃描查驗；報道以「D'après la douane」引述海關稱該服務免費。該頁屬轉述報道，非簽署公告原件；「免費」系2023年報道引語，非收費文本。App Store 店鋪頁（2026-09-28核讀：v1.2.0，2025-07-02，免費，© Cameroon Customs，開發者 Sankei Cries Inc.）顯示應用當日仍可下載，並載明可在出發前離線、不限次數地創建申報，所生成 QR Code 僅在設有電子申報終端的機場可用，啟用日期以喀麥隆海關網站為準（列名 Bafoussam、Bamenda、Bertoua、Douala、Garoua、Salak、Ngaoundere、Yaounde-Nsimalen 八場）；店鋪「免費」為下載標價，不證明申報服務的費用。上述轉述公告與應用店鋪資訊均未確認任一機場的電子申報終端已經啟用、申報可實際完成並向伺服器提交，也未說明服務現行的收費標準（2026年是否仍免費尚無官方確認）。2026-09-28複核僅及頁面存續與店鋪可獲得性，不及任何機場的現場完成。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 按2023年轉述公告，應在下機前填寫並提交問卷；按 App Store 店鋪描述，申報於出發前離線創建，所生成 QR Code 於抵達設有電子終端的機場時掃描；轉述公告與店鋪資訊均未載明申報會在下機前經網路傳輸。

procedures.name_en: Cash and instruments crossing the CEMAC external frontier, entry or exit (Reg. 02/18, Art. 77-79)
procedures.name_zh: 跨越CEMAC对外边境出入境的现金与票据（02/18条例第77-79条）
procedures.agency: BEAC / CEMAC (declared to customs services; applicable in Cameroon as a CEMAC member)
procedures.applicability_en: Regional rule for natural persons crossing the external CEMAC frontier, on entry or exit (Regulation 02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM, 2018). Art. 78: cash up to the equivalent of CFA 5,000,000, foreign currency and CFA francs combined, may be held without declaration ('ne dépassant pas', i.e. up to and including the threshold); any amount above 5 million ('Tout montant supérieur'), together with negotiable instruments and securities 'correspondant à ce seuil' (French wording kept verbatim; whether the threshold amount itself is included is not clarified), must be declared to the customs services. Incorrect or incomplete information means the declaration obligation is not performed; at frontier checks customs may require proof of the origin of funds, failing which the sums are confiscated and remitted to the central bank; residents entering CEMAC must hand their foreign currency over to an authorised intermediary (rétrocéder). Art. 79: non-residents leaving may take out foreign currency or other foreign means of payment up to the amount they declared on entry; with no entry declaration, or when taking out more than they brought in, they must justify the origin of amounts exceeding CFA 5,000,000. Art. 77's allocation of up to CFA 5,000,000 equivalent per person per trip (all payment means combined; duly justified larger needs are met by authorised intermediaries) is a travel FX purchase allocation, not an ordinary passenger form and not an absolute export prohibition. These provisions govern the external frontier and do not establish the rules for movement between CEMAC member states. Cameroon's national execution layer (douanes.cm form format, any fee) remains unverified; the CCAA airport guide separately instructs holders of foreign currency to prepare their passport to declare to customs and states 'un formulaire de déclaration de devises sera établi', without giving any threshold.
procedures.applicability_zh: 区域规定，适用于自然人出入境CEMAC对外边境（02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM条例，2018年）。第78条：现金（外币与中非法郎合并计算）不超过5,000,000中非法郎等值（「ne dépassant pas」，含本数）可免申报持有；「Tout montant supérieur」严格超过500万的部分，连同「correspondant à ce seuil」（原文照录，是否含500万本数不明）的可转让票据与有价证券，须向海关申报。信息不实或不完整即视为未履行申报义务；边境查验时海关可要求说明资金来源，无来源证明即没收款项并交中央银行；入境居民须将所持外币交授权中介回售（rétrocéder）。第79条：非居民离境最多携出其入境时申报的外币或其他对外支付手段金额；无入境申报、或携出超过本人带入额时，对超过5,000,000中非法郎的部分须证明来源。第77条按人按次旅行购汇配额5,000,000中非法郎等值（各种支付手段合并计算；经充分证明的更大需求由授权中介满足）系购汇配额，既非普通旅客表格，亦非绝对携出禁令。上述条文仅规范对外边境，不确立成员国之间的移动规则。喀麦隆本国执行层（douanes.cm 表单式样、是否收费）未核；CCAA机场指南另载持有外币者备护照向海关申报、「un formulaire de déclaration de devises sera établi」，未列任何门槛。
procedures.timing_en: At entry to or exit from the external CEMAC frontier.
procedures.timing_zh: 跨越CEMAC对外边境出入境时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨越CEMAC對外邊境出入境的現金與票據（02/18條例第77-79條）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 區域規定，適用於自然人出入境CEMAC對外邊境（02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM條例，2018年）。第78條：現金（外幣與中非法郎合併計算）不超過5,000,000中非法郎等值（「ne dépassant pas」，含本數）可免申報持有；「Tout montant supérieur」嚴格超過500萬的部分，連同「correspondant à ce seuil」（原文照錄，是否含500萬本數不明）的可轉讓票據與有價證券，須向海關申報。資訊不實或不完整即視為未履行申報義務；邊境查驗時海關可要求說明資金來源，無來源證明即沒收款項並交中央銀行；入境居民須將所持外幣交授權中介回售（rétrocéder）。第79條：非居民離境最多攜出其入境時申報的外幣或其他對外支付手段金額；無入境申報、或攜出超過本人帶入額時，對超過5,000,000中非法郎的部分須證明來源。第77條按人按次旅行購匯配額5,000,000中非法郎等值（各種支付手段合併計算；經充分證明的更大需求由授權中介滿足）系購匯配額，既非普通旅客表格，亦非絕對攜出禁令。上述條文僅規範對外邊境，不確立成員國之間的移動規則。喀麥隆本國執行層（douanes.cm 表單式樣、是否收費）未核；CCAA機場指南另載持有外幣者備護照向海關申報、「un formulaire de déclaration de devises sera établi」，未列任何門檻。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 跨越CEMAC對外邊境出入境時。

procedures.name_en: Cash movement to/from the Central African Republic across the external CEMAC frontier (Reg. 02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM, arts. 77-79, 168)
procedures.name_zh: 跨越CEMAC对外边境进出中非共和国的现金移动（2018年第02/18号外汇条例第77-79、168条）
procedures.agency: CEMAC regulation; declared to the customs services — in the Central African Republic the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI), Ministère des Finances et du Budget
procedures.applicability_en: CEMAC Regulation 02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM applies in the Central African Republic and governs natural persons crossing the external frontier of CEMAC, on entry or exit. Article 78: cash up to the equivalent of CFA 5,000,000, foreign currencies and CFA francs combined, may be held without declaration; any amount above CFA 5,000,000 or its equivalent in foreign currency, together with the negotiable instruments and securities 'correspondant à ce seuil', must be declared to the customs services — the regulation does not state whether that threshold is inclusive for such instruments. The declaration is not validly discharged if the information supplied is incorrect or incomplete. At border-control posts customs identify the traveller and may require additional information on the origin of the funds; absent justification the sums are confiscated and remitted to the Central Bank. Residents entering CEMAC must sell the foreign currency they hold to an authorised intermediary. Article 79: on departure, non-residents may take out foreign currency or any other foreign means of payment up to the amount they declared on entry; where no declaration was made on entry or where they carry more than they themselves brought in, amounts above CFA 5,000,000 must be justified as to provenance on pain of confiscation — a conditional proof-of-origin regime, not a general-purpose form and not an absolute export cap on all travellers. Article 77's CFA 5,000,000 travel allocation (all payment instruments combined, per person per trip, through authorised intermediaries; duly justified higher needs are also met by those intermediaries) is a foreign-exchange allocation, not an absolute export ceiling. Article 168 punishes non-declaration of sums above the authorised threshold on entry or exit with a fine computed on the excess plus confiscation of the undeclared sums (the scanned text's rate figures are ambiguous and are not asserted here). These provisions do not establish the rules for crossings between CEMAC member states, and no Central African Republic port-level form, fee or submission mechanics are set out in official information currently available to travellers.
procedures.applicability_zh: CEMAC 2018年第02/18号外汇条例在中非共和国适用，规范自然人跨越CEMAC对外边境的入境或出境。第78条：现金（外币与中非法郎合计）不超过5,000,000中非法郎等值，可免申报持有；超过5,000,000中非法郎或等值外币的任何款项，以及原文所称'correspondant à ce seuil'（与该门槛相对应）的可转让票据和有价证券，须向海关申报——条例原文未明确该门槛对此类票据是否含本数。所提供信息不实或不完整的，申报义务视为未履行。边境查验时海关识别旅客并可在必要时要求补充资金来源信息；无来源证明的款项被没收并上缴中央银行。居民进入CEMAC须将其持有的外币让售给授权中介。第79条：离境非居民可携出不超过其入境时申报数额的外币或其他境外支付手段；未作入境申报或携出超过本人带入数额的，对超过5,000,000中非法郎的部分须证明来源，否则没收——这是附条件的来源证明制度，不是普通表格，也不是对全体旅客的绝对携出上限。第77条500万中非法郎旅游供汇配额（各种支付方式合计、每人每次旅行、经授权中介办理；有正当理由的更高需求亦由授权中介满足）属供汇安排，不是绝对携出上限。第168条对出入境超过授权门槛未申报的按超额部分计罚款并没收未申报款项（扫描文本罚款率字样有歧义，此处不作断言）。上述条文不证明成员国之间的过境规则；目前可得的官方信息中亦未见中非共和国口岸层面的表格、费用或提交方式。
procedures.timing_en: When crossing the external CEMAC frontier, at entry or at exit; proof-of-origin obligations for non-residents arise at departure.
procedures.timing_zh: 跨越CEMAC对外边境入境或出境时；非居民来源证明义务在离境时产生。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨越CEMAC對外邊境進出中非共和國的現金移動（2018年第02/18號外匯條例第77-79、168條）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: CEMAC 2018年第02/18號外匯條例在中非共和國適用，規範自然人跨越CEMAC對外邊境的入境或出境。第78條：現金（外幣與中非法郎合計）不超過5,000,000中非法郎等值，可免申報持有；超過5,000,000中非法郎或等值外幣的任何款項，以及原文所稱'correspondant à ce seuil'（與該門檻相對應）的可轉讓票據和有價證券，須向海關申報——條例原文未明確該門檻對此類票據是否含本數。所提供資訊不實或不完整的，申報義務視為未履行。邊境查驗時海關識別旅客並可在必要時要求補充資金來源資訊；無來源證明的款項被沒收並上繳中央銀行。居民進入CEMAC須將其持有的外幣讓售給授權中介。第79條：離境非居民可攜出不超過其入境時申報數額的外幣或其他境外支付手段；未作入境申報或攜出超過本人帶入數額的，對超過5,000,000中非法郎的部分須證明來源，否則沒收——這是附條件的來源證明制度，不是普通表格，也不是對全體旅客的絕對攜出上限。第77條500萬中非法郎旅遊供匯配額（各種支付方式合計、每人每次旅行、經授權中介辦理；有正當理由的更高需求亦由授權中介滿足）屬供匯安排，不是絕對攜出上限。第168條對出入境超過授權門檻未申報的按超額部分計罰款並沒收未申報款項（掃描文本罰款率字樣有歧義，此處不作斷言）。上述條文不證明成員國之間的過境規則；目前可得的官方資訊中亦未見中非共和國口岸層面的表格、費用或提交方式。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 跨越CEMAC對外邊境入境或出境時；非居民來源證明義務在離境時產生。

procedures.name_en: Cash and foreign-currency declaration at Chad's borders (DGDDI traveller page; CEMAC Regulation 02/18, Arts. 78–79)
procedures.name_zh: 乍得边境现金与外币申报（DGDDI旅客页；CEMAC 02/18号条例第78–79条）
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects du Tchad (declared to the customs service at the border post); regional framework: CEMAC/UMAC (Règlement 02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM), BEAC
procedures.applicability_en: Chad's customs authority (DGDDI) instructs travellers entering Chad to declare any amount of foreign currency carried on themselves or in their baggage to the customs post on arrival; this instruction covers only foreign currency and does not extend to CFA francs. On leaving Chad, any export of foreign-currency cash or CFA-franc cash above the regulatory thresholds must be declared before crossing the border; the page states no figure for these thresholds. The mandatory declaration form is available at the border posts (airports, land borders and river crossings); the page does not say whether the form is paper or electronic, nor whether any fee applies, and it warns that non-declaration or false declaration attracts customs and criminal sanctions. The page cites the CEMAC Customs Code and Regulation 02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM of 21 December 2018. Under Article 78 of that regulation, natural persons crossing the borders of the CEMAC, on entry or on exit, may hold without declaration cash up to and including the equivalent of FCFA 5,000,000, foreign currency and CFA francs combined; any amount strictly above FCFA 5,000,000, together with the corresponding negotiable instruments and securities, must be declared to the customs services. Article 78 covers crossings of the CEMAC's own external borders; the published provisions do not state a rule for movements between CEMAC member states, and how that case is treated has not been officially settled. Article 78 also requires resident travellers entering the CEMAC to retrocede the foreign exchange they hold to an authorized intermediary. Under Article 79, non-resident travellers leaving the CEMAC may take out foreign currency or other foreign means of payment up to the amount they declared on entering the CEMAC; if they made no declaration on entry or take out more than they themselves brought in, they must justify the origin of the funds for the amounts strictly above FCFA 5,000,000. One case falls under both texts and they diverge on its face: a traveller entering Chad directly from outside CEMAC carrying only foreign-currency cash at or below the equivalent of FCFA 5,000,000 is instructed by the national page to declare that cash on arrival, whatever its amount, whereas Article 78 on its face allows cash up to and including that threshold, foreign currency and CFA francs combined, to be held without declaration. No published text establishes a formal hierarchy between the two, no national implementing provision reconciles them, and there is no official guidance on practice at Chad's border posts; which obligation prevails in that overlapping case has not been officially determined. The national instruction to declare has not been withdrawn or superseded, and the regional provision does not automatically override it. The regional rule means declaration is due only above FCFA 5,000,000 at the CEMAC's external borders; it does not mean that no declaration is needed below that amount on entry to Chad.
procedures.applicability_zh: 乍得DGDDI旅客页要求入境乍得的旅客在抵达时向海关岗申报随身携带或置于行李中的任何金额外币；该入境指引仅限外币，不延伸至中非法郎。离开乍得时，携出外币现金或中非法郎现金超过法定门槛的，须在越过边境前申报；该页未给出这些门槛的任何数字。强制性申报表在各口岸（机场、陆路边境和河流口岸）提供；页面未说明该表是纸质还是电子，也未说明是否收费，并警示不申报或虚假申报将招致海关与刑事制裁。该页引用CEMAC海关法典及2018年12月21日第02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM号条例。依据该条例第78条，跨越CEMAC边境的自然人，无论入境或出境，均可免申报持有最高达等值500万中非法郎（含本数）的现金，外币与中非法郎合并计算；严格超过500万中非法郎（不含本数）的任何金额，连同相应的可转让票据和有价证券，须向海关部门申报。第78条针对的是跨越CEMAC整体对外边境的情形；已公布条文中未见CEMAC成员国内部之间流动的规则，该情形如何处理尚无官方定论。第78条另要求入境CEMAC的居民旅客将其所持外汇让售给经核准的中介。依据第79条，离开CEMAC的非居民旅客可携出外币或其他外币支付手段，最高以其入境CEMAC时申报的金额为限；若入境时未作申报或携出额超过其自身带入金额，须对严格超过500万中非法郎（不含本数）的部分证明资金来源。存在同时落入两份文本且表面分歧的情形：旅客自CEMAC区域之外直接入境乍得、仅携带等于或低于等值500万中非法郎（含本数）的外币现金时，本国页要求不论金额一律在抵达时申报，而第78条表面允许免申报持有不超过该门槛的现金（外币与中非法郎合并计算）。两份文本之间没有公开的位阶依据，也没有可调和两者的本国实施细则或乍得口岸实务的官方说明，故该重叠情形下何项义务优先尚无官方定论；本国页的申报要求并未失效或被取代，区域条文也并不当然优先。区域条例的规则是在CEMAC对外边境仅严格超过500万中非法郎才须申报；它并不意味着入境乍得500万以下就免申报。
procedures.timing_en: Entry: at the customs post on arrival; exit: before crossing the border; under the regional regulation, on crossing the CEMAC's external borders in either direction.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境：抵达时在海关岗申报；出境：越过边境前申报；区域条例层面：跨越CEMAC对外边境时（入境或出境）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 乍得邊境現金與外幣申報（DGDDI旅客頁；CEMAC 02/18號條例第78–79條）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 乍得DGDDI旅客頁要求入境乍得的旅客在抵達時向海關崗申報隨身攜帶或置於行李中的任何金額外幣；該入境指引僅限外幣，不延伸至中非法郎。離開乍得時，攜出外幣現金或中非法郎現金超過法定門檻的，須在越過邊境前申報；該頁未給出這些門檻的任何數字。強制性申報表在各口岸（機場、陸路邊境和河流口岸）提供；頁面未說明該表是紙質還是電子，也未說明是否收費，並警示不申報或虛假申報將招致海關與刑事制裁。該頁引用CEMAC海關法典及2018年12月21日第02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM號條例。依據該條例第78條，跨越CEMAC邊境的自然人，無論入境或出境，均可免申報持有最高達等值500萬中非法郎（含本數）的現金，外幣與中非法郎合併計算；嚴格超過500萬中非法郎（不含本數）的任何金額，連同相應的可轉讓票據和有價證券，須向海關部門申報。第78條針對的是跨越CEMAC整體對外邊境的情形；已公佈條文中未見CEMAC成員國內部之間流動的規則，該情形如何處理尚無官方定論。第78條另要求入境CEMAC的居民旅客將其所持外匯讓售給經核准的中介。依據第79條，離開CEMAC的非居民旅客可攜出外幣或其他外幣支付手段，最高以其入境CEMAC時申報的金額為限；若入境時未作申報或攜出額超過其自身帶入金額，須對嚴格超過500萬中非法郎（不含本數）的部分證明資金來源。存在同時落入兩份文本且表面分歧的情形：旅客自CEMAC區域之外直接入境乍得、僅攜帶等於或低於等值500萬中非法郎（含本數）的外幣現金時，本國頁要求不論金額一律在抵達時申報，而第78條表面允許免申報持有不超過該門檻的現金（外幣與中非法郎合併計算）。兩份文本之間沒有公開的位階依據，也沒有可調和兩者的本國實施細則或乍得口岸實務的官方說明，故該重疊情形下何項義務優先尚無官方定論；本國頁的申報要求並未失效或被取代，區域條文也並不當然優先。區域條例的規則是在CEMAC對外邊境僅嚴格超過500萬中非法郎才須申報；它並不意味著入境乍得500萬以下就免申報。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境：抵達時在海關崗申報；出境：越過邊境前申報；區域條例層面：跨越CEMAC對外邊境時（入境或出境）。

procedures.name_en: Declaration to customs of cash above CFA 5,000,000 equivalent when crossing the external CEMAC frontier (Regulation 02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM arts. 78-79)
procedures.name_zh: 跨越CEMAC对外边境超过500万中非法郎等值现金向海关申报（2018年CEMAC/UMAC外汇条例第78-79条）
procedures.agency: CEMAC / UMAC regional regulation; declared to the customs services at border posts; applicable in Congo-Brazzaville as a CEMAC member state
procedures.applicability_en: Regional rule for natural persons crossing the external frontier of CEMAC, on entry or on exit (art. 78): they may hold without declaration cash not exceeding the equivalent of CFA 5,000,000, foreign currencies and CFA francs combined. Any amount strictly above CFA 5,000,000 or the equivalent in foreign currency, together with the negotiable instruments and securities 'correspondant à ce seuil' (corresponding to that threshold; the text does not state whether the threshold amount itself is included), must be declared to the customs services, failing which the sanctions provided for by the regulations in force apply; the declaration obligation is not performed if the information supplied by the person is incorrect or incomplete. During border-post controls the customs services identify the traveller and may, where necessary, require additional information on the origin of the funds; absent justification of origin, the sums are confiscated and remitted to the Central Bank. Resident travellers entering CEMAC must sell the foreign currency they hold to an authorised intermediary. Art. 79 sets a separate obligation for non-resident travellers leaving CEMAC, not an absolute export cap on all travellers: they may take out foreign currency or any other foreign means of payment up to the amount they declared on entry; where no entry declaration was made, or where they take out sums above their own contributions, they must justify the provenance of amounts above CFA 5,000,000, failing which the sums are confiscated and remitted to the Central Bank. Art. 77 caps the traveller foreign-exchange allocation, all payment means combined, at the equivalent of CFA 5,000,000 per person per trip, and duly justified higher needs are met by authorised intermediaries: it is an allocation channel, not a border form and not an absolute export ceiling. These articles govern crossing the external CEMAC frontier; they do not establish the rules for movements between CEMAC member states, and no Congo border form or fee appears in the available official texts.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于自然人跨越CEMAC对外边境入境或出境的区域规定（第78条）：可免申报持有不超过5,000,000中非法郎等值的现金，外币与中非法郎合并计算。严格超过500万中非法郎或其外币等值的任何金额，连同『与该门槛相当』（correspondant à ce seuil）的可转让票据及有价证券（原文未言明是否包含恰好等于该门槛的数额），须向海关申报，违者依现行法规受制裁；所提供信息不正确或不完整的，申报义务即未履行。在边境口岸查验时，海关识别旅客身份，必要时可要求补充资金来源信息；来源无法证明的，款项被没收并缴交中央银行。居民旅客进入CEMAC须将其持有的外币让售给授权中介。第79条是对离境非居民旅客的另一项义务，并非对一切旅客的绝对出口限额：非居民可携出不超过其入境时申报金额的外币或其他外国支付工具；未作入境申报或携出超过本人带入数额的，须对超过5,000,000中非法郎的部分证明来源，否则没收并缴交中央银行。第77条将旅客换汇额度（各种支付方式合并计算）限定为每人每次行程500万中非法郎等值，经充分证明的更高需求由授权中介满足：属配额渠道，非口岸表格，亦非绝对上限。上述条文仅规范跨越CEMAC对外边境，不确立成员国之间移动的规则；现有公开官方文本中没有刚果（布）本国口岸表格或费用。
procedures.timing_en: At the border post, when crossing the external CEMAC frontier in either direction: declare to customs when cash strictly exceeds CFA 5,000,000 equivalent; art. 79 proof of origin is required of non-residents at exit.
procedures.timing_zh: 在边境口岸跨越CEMAC对外边境出入境时：现金严格超过5,000,000中非法郎等值即须向海关申报；第79条非居民来源证明于出境时要求。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨越CEMAC對外邊境超過500萬中非法郎等值現金向海關申報（2018年CEMAC/UMAC外匯條例第78-79條）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於自然人跨越CEMAC對外邊境入境或出境的區域規定（第78條）：可免申報持有不超過5,000,000中非法郎等值的現金，外幣與中非法郎合併計算。嚴格超過500萬中非法郎或其外幣等值的任何金額，連同『與該門檻相當』（correspondant à ce seuil）的可轉讓票據及有價證券（原文未言明是否包含恰好等於該門檻的數額），須向海關申報，違者依現行法規受制裁；所提供資訊不正確或不完整的，申報義務即未履行。在邊境口岸查驗時，海關識別旅客身份，必要時可要求補充資金來源資訊；來源無法證明的，款項被沒收並繳交中央銀行。居民旅客進入CEMAC須將其持有的外幣讓售給授權中介。第79條是對離境非居民旅客的另一項義務，並非對一切旅客的絕對出口限額：非居民可攜出不超過其入境時申報金額的外幣或其他外國支付工具；未作入境申報或攜出超過本人帶入數額的，須對超過5,000,000中非法郎的部分證明來源，否則沒收並繳交中央銀行。第77條將旅客換匯額度（各種支付方式合併計算）限定為每人每次行程500萬中非法郎等值，經充分證明的更高需求由授權中介滿足：屬配額渠道，非口岸表格，亦非絕對上限。上述條文僅規範跨越CEMAC對外邊境，不確立成員國之間移動的規則；現有公開官方文本中沒有剛果（布）本國口岸表格或費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在邊境口岸跨越CEMAC對外邊境出入境時：現金嚴格超過5,000,000中非法郎等值即須向海關申報；第79條非居民來源證明於出境時要求。

procedures.name_en: Cash, securities and gold declaration at departure and arrival (≥ USD 10,000)
procedures.name_zh: 出入境现金、有价证券与黄金申报（≥1万美元）
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes et Accises (DGDA), RDC
procedures.applicability_en: Per the current DGDA traveller page, anyone transporting liquid cash of USD 10,000 or more, or its equivalent in other foreign currencies — Congolese resident or not, owner of the funds or not, including transports carried out for a legal person (company, association) — must make a declaration to the customs services, or where they are absent to the migration services, at departure and at arrival, and must justify the origin and destination of the funds. Items the page lists as declarable: banknotes and coins; bearer cheques; travellers cheques; cheques whose drawer is not the beneficiary; non-domiciled commercial paper; anonymous cashier's bonds; money orders; securities, capitalisation bonds and other negotiable or endorsable bearer debt claims; and gold, i.e. gold coins and unminted metal such as ingots, nuggets or other agglomerates of native gold containing at least 99.5% gold. Non-declaration or false declaration attracts the sanctions of Article 465 of the Customs Code, notably a fine of up to 50% of the sum concerned and retention of all the funds by customs. The page's opening paragraph separately states that no natural or legal person may travel on the national territory holding foreign-currency banknotes of USD 10,000 or more (except in localities without commercial-bank outlets, other authorised financial institutions or a Banque Centrale du Congo representation), as decided by the monetary authority; the underlying central-bank regulation was not obtained, so that domestic-travel restriction must not be presented as an independently verified prohibition on bringing USD 10,000 or more across the border, and since the page does not state how its two rules combine, no inference either way is recorded.
procedures.applicability_zh: 按DGDA现行旅客页：运送现金达到或超过1万美元或其他外币等值者——无论是否刚果居民、是否为资金所有人，含为法人（企业、协会）实施的运送——均须于出发时和抵达时向海关申报，无海关时向移民部门申报，并说明资金来源与去向。页面所列应申报标的：纸币与硬币；无记名支票；旅行支票；出票人非受益人的支票；未经托收的商业票据；无记名存单；汇单；有价证券、资本化债券及其他无记名或可背书转让的债权凭证；黄金（金币及未铸币金属，如含金至少99.5%的锭、块或其他天然金凝结物）。不申报或虚假申报适用《海关法》第465条处罚，包括最高可达涉案金额50%的罚款及由海关扣留全部资金。页面首段另称：任何自然人或法人均不得携带达到或超过1万美元或其等值的外币现钞在国境内旅行（无商业银行网点、其他获准金融机构或刚果央行派驻机构之地除外），并称此系货币当局决定；因该央行条例原文未取得，此项境内旅行限制不得被写成已经独立核实的“携带1万美元以上入境即被禁止”，页面亦未说明两段规则如何合并适用，故不作任何方向的推断记载。
procedures.timing_en: At departure and at arrival, to the customs services or, where absent, the migration services, per the DGDA traveller page.
procedures.timing_zh: 按DGDA旅客页：于出发时和抵达时向海关申报，无海关时向移民部门申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入境現金、有價證券與黃金申報（≥1萬美元）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 按DGDA現行旅客頁：運送現金達到或超過1萬美元或其他外幣等值者——無論是否剛果居民、是否為資金所有人，含為法人（企業、協會）實施的運送——均須於出發時和抵達時向海關申報，無海關時向移民部門申報，並說明資金來源與去向。頁面所列應申報標的：紙幣與硬幣；無記名支票；旅行支票；出票人非受益人的支票；未經托收的商業票據；無記名存單；匯單；有價證券、資本化債券及其他無記名或可背書轉讓的債權憑證；黃金（金幣及未鑄幣金屬，如含金至少99.5%的錠、塊或其他天然金凝結物）。不申報或虛假申報適用《海關法》第465條處罰，包括最高可達涉案金額50%的罰款及由海關扣留全部資金。頁面首段另稱：任何自然人或法人均不得攜帶達到或超過1萬美元或其等值的外幣現鈔在國境內旅行（無商業銀行網點、其他獲准金融機構或剛果央行派駐機構之地除外），並稱此係貨幣當局決定；因該央行條例原文未取得，此項境內旅行限制不得被寫成已經獨立核實的“攜帶1萬美元以上入境即被禁止”，頁面亦未說明兩段規則如何合併適用，故不作任何方向的推斷記載。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 按DGDA旅客頁：於出發時和抵達時向海關申報，無海關時向移民部門申報。

procedures.name_en: Cash and negotiable-instrument declaration when crossing the external CEMAC frontier (Règlement 02/18, arts. 78-79, 168)
procedures.name_zh: 跨越CEMAC对外边境的现金及可转让票据申报（2018年外汇条例第78–79、168条）
procedures.agency: CEMAC / UMAC (BEAC); declared to the customs services, applicable in Equatorial Guinea as a CEMAC member state
procedures.applicability_en: Regional rule of Règlement 02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM, applicable in Equatorial Guinea as a CEMAC member state: natural persons crossing the external frontier of CEMAC, on entry or on exit, may hold without declaration cash not exceeding ('ne dépassant pas') the equivalent of CFA 5,000,000, foreign currencies and CFA francs combined, so the threshold amount itself is exempt; any strictly higher amount, as well as negotiable instruments and securities 'correspondant à ce seuil', must be declared to the customs services, and the regulation does not state whether instruments valued exactly at the threshold are included (article 78). Article 168 confirms that non-declaration to the customs of sums above the authorised threshold, on leaving and entering the CEMAC area, is punished by a fine on the amount in excess of the threshold together with confiscation of the undeclared sums; the fine rate is printed unclearly in the official text, so no percentage is quoted. At border controls customs identify the traveller and may require additional information on the origin of funds, failing which the sums are confiscated and remitted to the central bank. Residents entering CEMAC must sell the foreign currency they hold to an authorised intermediary (article 78). Non-residents leaving CEMAC may take out foreign currency or other foreign means of payment up to the amount they declared on entry; if they made no entry declaration, or take out more than they brought in, they must justify the origin of amounts above CFA 5,000,000 (article 79). Article 77 caps the travel allocation of foreign currency purchased through authorised intermediaries at the equivalent of CFA 5,000,000 per person and per trip, duly justified higher needs being satisfiable; it is a purchase allocation, not an absolute export ceiling, and it creates no separate declaration threshold. Whether separate rules govern movement solely between CEMAC member states, and Equatorial Guinea's own forms, channels and fees, are not addressed in the official text.
procedures.applicability_zh: 《2018年CEMAC外汇条例》（Règlement 02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM）区域规定，对作为成员国的赤道几内亚适用：自然人跨越CEMAC对外边境，入境或出境，均可免申报持有'不超过（ne dépassant pas）'500万中非法郎等值的现钞（外币与中非法郎合计），即门槛数额本身免申报；严格超过该等值的金额以及'correspondant à ce seuil'的可转让票据与有价证券须向海关申报，条例未写明票据证券恰等于门槛时是否包含（第78条）。第168条确认，在离开和进入CEMAC区域两个方向，未向海关申报超过授权门槛的款项，按超出门槛的数额处以罚款并没收未申报款项；官方文本中罚率印制不清，不载明具体比例。边境查验时海关识别旅客并可要求补充资金来源信息，无法说明来源的款项被没收并交中央银行。居民进入CEMAC须将所持外汇让售给授权中介（第78条）。非居民离开CEMAC可携出不超过其入境申报数额的外币或其他境外支付手段；未作入境申报或携出超过本人带入数额的，须对超过500万中非法郎的部分证明来源（第79条）。第77条将经授权中介办理的旅游购汇配额定为每人每次旅行500万等值，有正当理由的更高需求可获满足；该条为购汇配额，并非绝对现钞携出上限，也不构成另行申报门槛。仅在成员国之间的移动是否适用另行规则、本国表单、渠道与费用，官方文本均未涉及。
procedures.timing_en: On each crossing of the external CEMAC frontier, entering or leaving; the article 79 origin check arises at departure.
procedures.timing_zh: 每次跨越CEMAC对外边境时，入境或出境均适用；第79条来源核查在离境时发生。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨越CEMAC對外邊境的現金及可轉讓票據申報（2018年外匯條例第78–79、168條）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 《2018年CEMAC外匯條例》（Règlement 02/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM）區域規定，對作為成員國的赤道幾內亞適用：自然人跨越CEMAC對外邊境，入境或出境，均可免申報持有'不超過（ne dépassant pas）'500萬中非法郎等值的現鈔（外幣與中非法郎合計），即門檻數額本身免申報；嚴格超過該等值的金額以及'correspondant à ce seuil'的可轉讓票據與有價證券須向海關申報，條例未寫明票據證券恰等於門檻時是否包含（第78條）。第168條確認，在離開和進入CEMAC區域兩個方向，未向海關申報超過授權門檻的款項，按超出門檻的數額處以罰款並沒收未申報款項；官方文本中罰率印製不清，不載明具體比例。邊境查驗時海關識別旅客並可要求補充資金來源資訊，無法說明來源的款項被沒收並交中央銀行。居民進入CEMAC須將所持外匯讓售給授權中介（第78條）。非居民離開CEMAC可攜出不超過其入境申報數額的外幣或其他境外支付手段；未作入境申報或攜出超過本人帶入數額的，須對超過500萬中非法郎的部分證明來源（第79條）。第77條將經授權中介辦理的旅遊購匯配額定為每人每次旅行500萬等值，有正當理由的更高需求可獲滿足；該條為購匯配額，並非絕對現鈔攜出上限，也不構成另行申報門檻。僅在成員國之間的移動是否適用另行規則、本國表單、渠道與費用，官方文本均未涉及。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 每次跨越CEMAC對外邊境時，入境或出境均適用；第79條來源核查在離境時發生。

procedures.name_en: Cash movement to/from Gabon (CEMAC external regulation, Art. 78-79, 168)
procedures.name_zh: 进出加蓬现金携带（CEMAC外汇条例第78-79、168条）
procedures.agency: BEAC / CEMAC (declared to customs services; applicable in Gabon as a CEMAC member)
procedures.applicability_en: Regional CEMAC foreign-exchange rule applied in Gabon when a natural person crosses the external CEMAC frontier at entry or exit (Art. 78 'frontières de la CEMAC'; Art. 168 'entrée/sortie de l'espace CEMAC'): cash of a combined value not exceeding CFA 5,000,000 equivalent, foreign currency and CFA francs together, may be held without declaration; any strictly higher cash amount must be declared to the customs services, and the obligation is not satisfied if the information given is incorrect or incomplete. Negotiable instruments and securities covered by the wording 'correspondant à ce seuil' (corresponding to that threshold) are likewise declarable; the article does not fix whether that threshold is inclusive for them. At border checks customs identify the traveller and may require additional information on the origin of funds; unjustified sums are confiscated and remitted to the Central Bank. Residents entering CEMAC must sell the foreign currency they hold to an authorised intermediary. Under Art. 79, non-residents leaving CEMAC may take out foreign currency or other foreign payment instruments up to the amount they declared on entry; with no entry declaration, or when carrying more than they brought in, they must justify the origin of amounts above CFA 5,000,000, failing which the sums are confiscated and remitted to the Central Bank. Art. 77 caps the allocation of travel foreign exchange at the equivalent of CFA 5,000,000 per person per trip, all payment means combined, through authorised intermediaries, which can satisfy duly justified higher requests; it is a purchase allocation, not an absolute export ceiling and not a declaration form. Art. 168 penalises non-declaration to customs of amounts above the authorised threshold on entry to or exit from the CEMAC area, with confiscation of undeclared sums. These provisions do not set out the rules for crossings between CEMAC member states; no Gabon-specific port form or fee has been confirmed by an official Gabonese source.
procedures.applicability_zh: 区域CEMAC外汇规定，适用于自然人入境或出境跨越CEMAC对外边境时（第78条“frontières de la CEMAC”，第168条称“entrée/sortie de l'espace CEMAC”）：现金合计不超过500万CFA等值（外币与中非法郎合并计算）可免申报持有；严格超过500万等值的现金须向海关申报，且信息不实或不完整的，申报义务不视为履行。可转让票据和有价证券按“correspondant à ce seuil”（相当于该门槛）的措辞一并申报，条文未明确该门槛对其是否含本数。边境查验时海关识别旅客并可在必要时要求补充资金来源信息，来源无正当说明的款项没收并上缴中央银行。进入CEMAC的居民旅客须将其持有的外币让售给授权中介。第79条下，非居民离境可携出不超过其入境时申报数额的外币或其他外国支付工具；无入境申报或携出超过本人带入数额的，对超过500万CFA的金额须证明来源，不能证明的没收并上缴中央银行。第77条购汇配额为每人每次旅行所有支付方式合计不超过500万CFA等值，经授权中介办理，有正当理由的更高需求可由授权中介满足；该配额不是绝对携出上限，也不是申报表单。第168条对在CEMAC区域出入境时超过许可门槛未向海关申报者处以罚款并没收未申报款项。上述条文不规定成员国之间的过境规则；加蓬是否另有国别口岸表单或收费，尚无加蓬官方来源确认。
procedures.timing_en: At entry to or exit from the external CEMAC frontier; the resident re-sale duty applies on entry, and the non-resident origin-proof duty arises at exit and at border checks.
procedures.timing_zh: 跨越CEMAC对外边境入境或出境时；居民让售义务在入境时，非居民来源证明义务在出境及边境查验时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出加蓬現金攜帶（CEMAC外匯條例第78-79、168條）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 區域CEMAC外匯規定，適用於自然人入境或出境跨越CEMAC對外邊境時（第78條“frontières de la CEMAC”，第168條稱“entrée/sortie de l'espace CEMAC”）：現金合計不超過500萬CFA等值（外幣與中非法郎合併計算）可免申報持有；嚴格超過500萬等值的現金須向海關申報，且資訊不實或不完整的，申報義務不視為履行。可轉讓票據和有價證券按“correspondant à ce seuil”（相當於該門檻）的措辭一併申報，條文未明確該門檻對其是否含本數。邊境查驗時海關識別旅客並可在必要時要求補充資金來源資訊，來源無正當說明的款項沒收並上繳中央銀行。進入CEMAC的居民旅客須將其持有的外幣讓售給授權中介。第79條下，非居民離境可攜出不超過其入境時申報數額的外幣或其他外國支付工具；無入境申報或攜出超過本人帶入數額的，對超過500萬CFA的金額須證明來源，不能證明的沒收並上繳中央銀行。第77條購匯配額為每人每次旅行所有支付方式合計不超過500萬CFA等值，經授權中介辦理，有正當理由的更高需求可由授權中介滿足；該配額不是絕對攜出上限，也不是申報表單。第168條對在CEMAC區域出入境時超過許可門檻未向海關申報者處以罰款並沒收未申報款項。上述條文不規定成員國之間的過境規則；加蓬是否另有國別口岸表單或收費，尚無加蓬官方來源確認。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 跨越CEMAC對外邊境入境或出境時；居民讓售義務在入境時，非居民來源證明義務在出境及邊境查驗時。

procedures.name_en: Baggage declaration on Form J on arrival (BURS)
procedures.name_zh: 入境行李申报（Form J）（博茨瓦纳税务局 BURS）
procedures.agency: Botswana Unified Revenue Service (BURS) — Customs & Excise
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: entry into Botswana. All persons entering Botswana must unreservedly declare all goods in their possession to a Customs official on duty, on the baggage declaration document Form J (BURS Customs Form J, 'Baggage and Currency Import Declaration Form', Revised 2007: Part 1 is completed by all persons entering Botswana — new resident / visitor or tourist / returning permanent resident / in transit; Part 2 by returning residents; Part 3 covers currency, see BW-currency-declaration). Baggage declarations may be verbal or written; when making them, travellers must declare all goods in their possession and their correct values, including: all goods acquired in or outside Botswana, including gifts such as wedding or birthday presents; repairs or alterations to any items or vehicle, even if performed free of charge; items bought in any duty-free shop, including on aircraft or ship; items carried for someone else; and items intended for sale or commercial use. Produce receipts and sales slips for goods purchased outside Botswana. Failure to declare goods and their correct values can lead to seizure and criminal prosecution or severe penalties of up to three times the value of the goods. Travellers/tourists importing (or exporting) accompanied personal household goods may make their baggage declaration to BURS themselves using Customs Form J; unaccompanied goods of individuals and goods of commercial entities must be cleared through registered clearing agents or companies registered to carry out their own customs clearance. Form J notes additionally require travellers returning to South Africa, Lesotho, Swaziland and Namibia via Botswana to complete the form and declare all goods. Duty-free allowances are a tax concession, not a separate declaration procedure and not a filing fee: claiming an allowance does not replace this baggage declaration — all goods must be declared on Form J whether or not they fall within an allowance (official BURS pages give conflicting allowance amounts, so confirm the current figures before relying on them).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：入境博茨瓦纳。所有入境人员须向值班海关官员毫无保留地申报所携全部物品，使用行李申报表格 Form J（BURS 海关表格 J《行李与货币进口申报表》，2007年修订版：第1部分由所有入境人员填写——新居民/游客/返回的永久居民/过境人员；第2部分由返博居民填写；第3部分为货币部分，见 BW-currency-declaration）。行李申报可口头或书面进行；申报时须申报所携全部物品及其真实价值，包括：在博茨瓦纳境内或境外获得的一切物品，含收受的礼物（如婚礼或生日礼品）；所持物品或车辆的修理/改装（即使免费）；在任何免税店购买的物品（含机上或船上免税品）；代他人携带的物品；以及拟出售或用于商业用途的物品。应出示境外购物收据与销售小票。不如实申报物品或其价值可致物品被没收，并可能引发刑事追诉或处最高达物品价值三倍的严重罚款。进口（或出口）随行个人家用物品的旅客/游客可自行向 BURS 办理行李申报（使用海关表格 J）；个人的未随行物品及商业实体的货物须经由注册报关代理或自行注册清关的公司办理。Form J 须知另要求经博茨瓦纳返回南非、莱索托、斯威士兰和纳米比亚的旅客填写该表并申报全部物品。免税额度属税收优惠，既非单独申报程序亦非申报手续费：享受免税额度不能替代本行李申报——无论物品是否在额度内，所有物品均须以 Form J 申报（官方 BURS 页面给出的额度金额相互冲突，依赖具体数额前请先核实现行标准）。
procedures.timing_en: When passing through Customs at the place where the traveller enters Botswana; Form J is completed there (all goods acquired outside Botswana must be declared on entry into Botswana).
procedures.timing_zh: 在旅客入境博茨瓦纳之地通过海关时申报；Form J 于该时填写（在博茨瓦纳境外获得的所有物品须于入境时申报）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境行李申報（Form J）（博茨瓦納稅務局 BURS）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：入境博茨瓦納。所有入境人員須向值班海關官員毫無保留地申報所攜全部物品，使用行李申報表格 Form J（BURS 海關表格 J《行李與貨幣進口申報表》，2007年修訂版：第1部分由所有入境人員填寫——新居民/遊客/返回的永久居民/過境人員；第2部分由返博居民填寫；第3部分為貨幣部分，見 BW-currency-declaration）。行李申報可口頭或書面進行；申報時須申報所攜全部物品及其真實價值，包括：在博茨瓦納境內或境外獲得的一切物品，含收受的禮物（如婚禮或生日禮品）；所持物品或車輛的修理/改裝（即使免費）；在任何免稅店購買的物品（含機上或船上免稅品）；代他人攜帶的物品；以及擬出售或用於商業用途的物品。應出示境外購物收據與銷售小票。不如實申報物品或其價值可致物品被沒收，並可能引發刑事追訴或處最高達物品價值三倍的嚴重罰款。進口（或出口）隨行個人家用物品的旅客/遊客可自行向 BURS 辦理行李申報（使用海關表格 J）；個人的未隨行物品及商業實體的貨物須經由註冊報關代理或自行註冊清關的公司辦理。Form J 須知另要求經博茨瓦納返回南非、萊索托、斯威士蘭和納米比亞的旅客填寫該表並申報全部物品。免稅額度屬稅收優惠，既非單獨申報程序亦非申報手續費：享受免稅額度不能替代本行李申報——無論物品是否在額度內，所有物品均須以 Form J 申報（官方 BURS 頁面給出的額度金額相互衝突，依賴具體數額前請先核實現行標準）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在旅客入境博茨瓦納之地通過海關時申報；Form J 於該時填寫（在博茨瓦納境外獲得的所有物品須於入境時申報）。

procedures.name_en: Exit baggage declaration obligation (BURS; written form unconfirmed)
procedures.name_zh: 出境行李申报义务（博茨瓦纳税务局 BURS；书面表格未确认）
procedures.agency: Botswana Unified Revenue Service (BURS) — Customs & Excise
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: exit from Botswana. BURS states that all persons leaving Botswana are required to unreservedly declare all goods in their possession to a Customs official on duty on a baggage declaration document called Form J, and the customs-clearance page states that travellers importing or exporting accompanied personal household goods may make their baggage declaration to BURS themselves using Customs Form J; BURS also states that baggage declarations may be verbal or written. The written declaration form (if any) actually used at departure is unconfirmed: the Form J PDF published by BURS is titled as an import declaration and does not by itself establish the written form used at departure. The same content requirement and sanctions apply to baggage declarations: declare all goods in your possession and their correct values (goods acquired in or outside Botswana, gifts, repairs/alterations even if free of charge, duty-free shop purchases, goods carried for someone else, goods for sale or commercial use); failure to declare can lead to seizure, criminal prosecution or penalties of up to three times the value of the goods. Check whether goods are subject to customs duties and taxes or to prohibitions or restrictions prior to exportation.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：离开博茨瓦纳。BURS《通过海关》页载明，所有离开博茨瓦纳的人员须毫无保留地向值班海关官员在称为 Form J 的行李申报单上申报所携全部物品；海关清关页亦载明，进口或出口随行个人家用物品的旅客可自行向 BURS 办理行李申报（使用海关表格 J）；BURS 亦说明行李申报可口头或书面进行。出境实际使用的书面申报表格（如有）未获确认：BURS 公布的 Form J PDF 标题为进口申报表，并不能据此确定出境所用的书面表格。行李申报同样须申报所携全部物品及其真实价值（在博茨瓦纳境内或境外获得的物品、礼物、修理/改装即使免费、免税店购物、代他人携带的物品、拟出售或商业用途的物品）；不如实申报可致没收、刑事追诉或处最高达物品价值三倍的罚款。出口前应核查货物是否涉及关税税费或禁止/限制。
procedures.timing_en: When leaving Botswana, at the border Customs point of departure; the written form/medium for exit is unconfirmed.
procedures.timing_zh: 离开博茨瓦纳时，在出境口岸海关检查点办理；出境书面表格/方式未确认。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出境行李申報義務（博茨瓦納稅務局 BURS；書面表格未確認）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：離開博茨瓦納。BURS《通過海關》頁載明，所有離開博茨瓦納的人員須毫無保留地向值班海關官員在稱為 Form J 的行李申報單上申報所攜全部物品；海關清關頁亦載明，進口或出口隨行個人家用物品的旅客可自行向 BURS 辦理行李申報（使用海關表格 J）；BURS 亦說明行李申報可口頭或書面進行。出境實際使用的書面申報表格（如有）未獲確認：BURS 公佈的 Form J PDF 標題為進口申報表，並不能據此確定出境所用的書面表格。行李申報同樣須申報所攜全部物品及其真實價值（在博茨瓦納境內或境外獲得的物品、禮物、修理/改裝即使免費、免稅店購物、代他人攜帶的物品、擬出售或商業用途的物品）；不如實申報可致沒收、刑事追訴或處最高達物品價值三倍的罰款。出口前應核查貨物是否涉及關稅稅費或禁止/限制。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 離開博茨瓦納時，在出境口岸海關檢查點辦理；出境書面表格/方式未確認。

procedures.name_en: Currency declaration on entry and exit (≥ BWP 10,000)
procedures.name_zh: 出入境货币申报（≥1万普拉等值）
procedures.agency: Botswana Unified Revenue Service (BURS) — Customs & Excise
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: both entry into and exit from Botswana. When entering or leaving Botswana, a traveller is required to declare Pula and/or foreign currency bank notes in their possession where the amount equals to or exceeds an equivalent of Ten Thousand Pula (P10,000) — the threshold is 'equals to or exceeds' (≥) and covers bank notes only. Travellers' cheques and other monetary instruments need not be declared (the obligation is not to be widened beyond bank notes). There is otherwise no restriction on the cross-border movement of bank notes in Botswana, but movements are monitored for purposes including collecting national statistics, monitoring capital flows and balance of payments, and enforcement of anti-money-laundering measures. Under the Customs and Excise Duty Act the definition of goods includes currency, and a person who fails to declare currency may be liable to prosecution. Context (entry side): Form J Part 3 'CURRENCY' is completed where currency equivalent to P10,000.00 or more is carried by the declarant and/or family; the form's notes require a family unit to declare money carried by each member where the aggregate in the family's possession is P10,000 or more, and warn that undeclared amounts of P10,000 or more are liable to seizure and the importer to prosecution under the Customs and Excise Duty Act. Whether the same written form is used at exit is unconfirmed.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：出入境博茨瓦纳均适用。出入境时，旅客所持普拉和/或外币纸币金额达到（equals to or exceeds）或超过1万普拉（P10,000）等值的，必须申报——门槛为「达到或超过」（≥），且仅限纸币。旅行支票及其他货币票据无须申报（义务范围不得扩大至纸币以外）。博茨瓦纳对钞票跨境流动本身并无限制，但出于收集国家统计、监测资本流动与国际收支及反洗钱执法等目的进行监控。《海关与消费税法》下「货物」定义包含货币，未申报货币者可能被起诉。背景（入境侧）：Form J 第3部分「货币」在申报人及/或其家庭携带等值P10,000.00或以上货币时填写；表格须知要求家庭所持合计达到P10,000或以上时，须申报每一成员所携款项，并警示未申报的P10,000或以上款项可被没收，进口人可依《海关与消费税法》被起诉。出境是否使用同一书面表格未获确认。
procedures.timing_en: Declared at the border when entering or leaving Botswana.
procedures.timing_zh: 出入境时在口岸申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入境貨幣申報（≥1萬普拉等值）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：出入境博茨瓦納均適用。出入境時，旅客所持普拉和/或外幣紙幣金額達到（equals to or exceeds）或超過1萬普拉（P10,000）等值的，必須申報——門檻為「達到或超過」（≥），且僅限紙幣。旅行支票及其他貨幣票據無須申報（義務範圍不得擴大至紙幣以外）。博茨瓦納對鈔票跨境流動本身並無限制，但出於收集國家統計、監測資本流動與國際收支及反洗錢執法等目的進行監控。《海關與消費稅法》下「貨物」定義包含貨幣，未申報貨幣者可能被起訴。背景（入境側）：Form J 第3部分「貨幣」在申報人及/或其家庭攜帶等值P10,000.00或以上貨幣時填寫；表格須知要求家庭所持合計達到P10,000或以上時，須申報每一成員所攜款項，並警示未申報的P10,000或以上款項可被沒收，進口人可依《海關與消費稅法》被起訴。出境是否使用同一書面表格未獲確認。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出入境時在口岸申報。

procedures.name_en: Cross-border cash declaration (> E15,000, AMLTF(Prevention) Act s.41)
procedures.name_zh: 跨境现金申报（超过1.5万里兰吉尼，2011年反洗钱法第41条）
procedures.agency: Eswatini Revenue Service (ERS) — Customs & Excise / Eswatini Police (declaration under the Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism (Prevention) Act, 2011)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: both entry into and exit from Eswatini. In accordance with Section 41 of the Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism (Prevention) Act, 2011, ALL persons entering or leaving Eswatini with cash or negotiable bearer instruments valued at more than E15,000 (fifteen thousand Emalangeni) or equivalent must declare this amount to Police or Customs officials at the point of entry/exit. The E15,000 value applies to the TOTAL amount of cash or negotiable bearer instruments; the declaration requirement cannot be avoided by carrying several different currencies or classes of negotiable instruments which separately amount to less than the equivalent of E15,000. It is an offence not to declare or to under-declare: penalty is a fine of up to E30,000 or imprisonment for up to 5 years, and the cash or instruments may be confiscated. A Customs or Police officer may search any luggage or board any vehicle to conduct a search for this purpose. 2026-09-29 current ERS text: per Section 41 of the Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism (Prevention) Act 2011, ALL persons entering or leaving Eswatini carrying cash or negotiable bearer instruments valued at more than E15,000 or the equivalent must declare to the Police or Customs officials at the point of entry or exit; the E15,000 value applies to the total amount of cash or negotiable bearer instruments.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：出入斯威士兰均适用。依《2011年洗钱与资助恐怖主义（防止）法》第41条，凡携带价值超过15,000里兰吉尼（或等值）现金或无记名可转让票据出入斯威士兰者，均须在出入境口岸向警方或海关申报。该15,000里兰吉尼以现金或票据的总额计算；拆分携带多种货币或票据、单项均低于等值15,000里兰吉尼的，不能规避申报义务。不申报或申报不实属违法：可处最高30,000里兰吉尼罚款或最高5年监禁，现金或票据可被没收。海关或警员可为搜查目的检查任何行李或登上任何车辆。 2026-09-29 ERS 现行正文：依 2011 年《洗钱及恐怖主义融资（预防）法》第 41 条，所有出入斯威士兰携带价值超过 E15,000（或等值）现金或无记名可转让票据之人须在出入境点向警察或海关官员申报；E15,000 按携带的现金或无记名可转让票据总额计。
procedures.timing_en: Declared to Police or Customs at the point of entry/exit.
procedures.timing_zh: 在出入境口岸向警方或海关申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境現金申報（超過1.5萬里蘭吉尼，2011年反洗錢法第41條）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：出入斯威士蘭均適用。依《2011年洗錢與資助恐怖主義（防止）法》第41條，凡攜帶價值超過15,000裡蘭吉尼（或等值）現金或無記名可轉讓票據出入斯威士蘭者，均須在出入境口岸向警方或海關申報。該15,000裡蘭吉尼以現金或票據的總額計算；拆分攜帶多種貨幣或票據、單項均低於等值15,000裡蘭吉尼的，不能規避申報義務。不申報或申報不實屬違法：可處最高30,000裡蘭吉尼罰款或最高5年監禁，現金或票據可被沒收。海關或警員可為搜查目的檢查任何行李或登上任何車輛。 2026-09-29 ERS 現行正文：依 2011 年《洗錢及恐怖主義融資（預防）法》第 41 條，所有出入斯威士蘭攜帶價值超過 E15,000（或等值）現金或無記名可轉讓票據之人須在出入境點向警察或海關官員申報；E15,000 按攜帶的現金或無記名可轉讓票據總額計。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在出入境口岸向警方或海關申報。
