procedures.name_en: Departure declaration of traveller goods — verbal up to FCFA 250,000 FOB
procedures.name_zh: 离境旅客货物申报——FOB不超过25万西非法郎可口头申报
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes du Mali (DGDM)
procedures.applicability_en: On departure from Mali, non-commercial goods exported by travellers whose FOB value does not exceed CFA 250,000 are declared verbally at export; above that threshold they are subject to written declaration filed through an approved customs declarant (déclarant en douane agréé). Commercial goods must be declared through an approved declarant. The official page sets departure goods rules only: it states no fee and says nothing about entry-side goods, cash declaration forms or border practice.
procedures.applicability_zh: 旅客自马里离境携带出口的非商业物品，FOB价值不超过25万CFA的，出口时口头申报；超过该限额的，须经授权报关人（déclarant en douane agréé）提交书面申报。商业货物须经授权报关人申报。官方页面仅规定出境货物规则：未载明费用，也未涉及入境物品、现金申报表格或口岸执行。
procedures.timing_en: At export clearance.
procedures.timing_zh: 出口通关时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 離境旅客貨物申報——FOB不超過25萬西非法郎可口頭申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 旅客自馬裡離境攜帶出口的非商業物品，FOB價值不超過25萬CFA的，出口時口頭申報；超過該限額的，須經授權報關人（déclarant en douane agréé）提交書面申報。商業貨物須經授權報關人申報。官方頁面僅規定出境貨物規則：未載明費用，也未涉及入境物品、現金申報表格或口岸執行。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出口通關時。

procedures.name_en: Customs declaration of physical cash and bearer negotiable instruments (UMOA route-based thresholds)
procedures.name_zh: 实体现金及无记名可转让票据海关申报（UMOA按路线分档）
procedures.agency: BCEAO regional instructions (002-03-2025; 231/07/2024), applying to Mali as a UEMOA member state; declaration lodged with the Customs administration at the Mali entry or exit point
procedures.applicability_en: AML/CFT cross-border cash reporting in force in Mali through UEMOA: any person, whatever their residence status, who physically transports cash or bearer negotiable instruments (no currency restriction stated) must declare to the Customs administration at the entry or exit point, at the moment of entry or exit, when the amount carried reaches the threshold set for the route, both thresholds being inclusive (the duty applies from the threshold amount onwards, i.e. at or above it). Two routes only. (1) Intra-UMOA: between Mali and another UEMOA member state, the threshold is CFA 10,000,000 or more (Instruction 002-03-2025 of 18 March 2025, in force from its date of signature). (2) Third state: to or from a state outside UEMOA, the threshold is CFA 5,000,000 or more (Instruction 231/07/2024 of 16 July 2024, in force from its date of signature, replacing Instruction 008-09-2017). The route alone fixes the threshold; the traveller's residence status does not. These rules form the general cash/bearer-instrument reporting regime, distinct from the separate traveller foreign-currency declaration duty under Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE (see ML-fx-payment-means-declaration); both duties can apply to the same journey. The two threshold instructions prescribe no form model; the Malian national form medium (paper or online), any fee, and actual border practice remain unknown — no Malian source states either way, and the regional texts do not prove that one form filed at one border post satisfies both duties.
procedures.applicability_zh: 经UEMOA机制适用于马里的反洗钱跨境现金申报：任何人（不限居民身份）实地运输现金或无记名可转让票据（条文未限定币种），于入境或出境时刻，所携金额达到按路线适用的阈值即须在出入境口岸向海关申报，两项阈值均含本数（达到阈值即触发，≥）。路线仅有两种：（1）UMOA成员国之间：马里与另一成员国之间，阈值为1,000万CFA及以上（002-03-2025号指令，2025年3月18日签署即生效）；（2）第三国：往返UEMOA以外国家，阈值为500万CFA及以上（231/07/2024号指令，2024年7月16日签署即生效，取代008-09-2017号指令）。阈值仅由路线决定，与旅客居民身份无关。上述规则构成一般性现金/票据申报制度，与06/07/2025/RFE号指令下的旅客外汇申报义务（见ML-fx-payment-means-declaration）分属两套制度，同一次旅行两项义务可同时成立。两项阈值指令均未规定表格式样；马里本国的表格介质（纸质或线上）、费用及口岸实际执行均未知——没有任何马里来源作相反表述，区域文本也不能证明同一口岸提交一份表格可同时满足两项义务。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of entry or exit; the declaration is made to the Customs administration at the entry or exit point whenever the carried total meets the route threshold.
procedures.timing_zh: 于入境或出境时刻办理；所携总额达到路线阈值时，在该出入境口岸向海关申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 實體現金及無記名可轉讓票據海關申報（UMOA按路線分檔）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 經UEMOA機制適用於馬裡的反洗錢跨境現金申報：任何人（不限居民身份）實地運輸現金或無記名可轉讓票據（條文未限定幣種），於入境或出境時刻，所攜金額達到按路線適用的閾值即須在出入境口岸向海關申報，兩項閾值均含本數（達到閾值即觸發，≥）。路線僅有兩種：（1）UMOA成員國之間：馬裡與另一成員國之間，閾值為1,000萬CFA及以上（002-03-2025號指令，2025年3月18日簽署即生效）；（2）第三國：往返UEMOA以外國家，閾值為500萬CFA及以上（231/07/2024號指令，2024年7月16日簽署即生效，取代008-09-2017號指令）。閾值僅由路線決定，與旅客居民身份無關。上述規則構成一般性現金/票據申報制度，與06/07/2025/RFE號指令下的旅客外匯申報義務（見ML-fx-payment-means-declaration）分屬兩套制度，同一次旅行兩項義務可同時成立。兩項閾值指令均未規定表格式樣；馬裡本國的表格介質（紙質或線上）、費用及口岸實際執行均未知——沒有任何馬裡來源作相反表述，區域文本也不能證明同一口岸提交一份表格可同時滿足兩項義務。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 於入境或出境時刻辦理；所攜總額達到路線閾值時，在該出入境口岸向海關申報。

procedures.name_en: Traveller foreign-currency declaration (Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客外汇申报（06/07/2025/RFE指令）
procedures.agency: BCEAO (Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE, adopted under Règlement 06/2024/CM/UEMOA and addressed to all UEMOA member states including Mali); written model set in the Instruction's Annex; declarations at the customs office
procedures.applicability_en: Foreign-exchange declaration duties for travellers under Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE, effective 1 August 2025 (article 14, which repeals all earlier instructions on the same object, notably 05-07-2011/RFE), adopted under Règlement 06/2024/CM/UEMOA of 20 December 2024 (which repealed and replaced the 2010 RFE regulation); the Instruction applies to Mali as a UEMOA member state. Residents (article 4): a resident leaving for a state outside UEMOA must declare the foreign-currency cash payment means carried when their countervalue in CFA strictly exceeds CFA 3,000,000 ('excède', i.e. greater than, not at, the threshold); article 4 states no form and does not refer to the Annex model for residents — whether the resident declaration uses that model is not stated; the declaration is made without prejudice to the AML/CFT regulation, so the separate AML cash/bearer-instrument declaration (see ML-cash-bni-customs-declaration) can apply to the same journey, and whether one submission at the same border post satisfies both duties is stated nowhere; false or incomplete declarations are sanctioned. Non-residents (article 7): at entry and again at exit of the national territory, a non-resident must declare in writing, on the model annexed to the Instruction («FORMULAIRE DE DECLARATION DE MOYENS DE PAIEMENT»), foreign banknotes or other cash payment means in foreign currency whose amount strictly exceeds a countervalue of CFA 500,000. Caution: the Instruction states declaration duties only — a declaration does not of itself authorise carrying amounts beyond the caps and other limits that Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE sets for foreign currency and CFA (allocation, carrying, surrender and export-evidence rules). The Annex is a paper form model and states no electronic submission channel; whether Mali uses a national edition of it, the actual medium at Malian border posts, and any fee remain unknown; no Malian source states either way.
procedures.applicability_zh: 06/07/2025/RFE号指令（2025年8月1日生效，第14条废止此前同客体指令，尤其05-07-2011/RFE）依据2024年12月20日06/2024/CM/UEMOA号规章（该规章废止并取代2010年外汇规章）制定，作为UEMOA成员国适用于马里的旅客外汇申报义务。居民（第4条）：居民前往UEMOA以外国家出境时，携带外币现金支付手段折合严格超过300万CFA（«excède»，为大于而非达到阈值，>）即须申报；第4条未规定式样，也未就居民援引附件表格——居民申报是否使用该式样原文未规定；该申报不影响（sans préjudice）反洗钱法规，故反洗钱现金/票据申报（见ML-cash-bni-customs-declaration）可于同次旅行并行成立，同一口岸一次提交能否同时满足两项义务任何文本均未规定；申报不实或残缺须受罚。非居民（第7条）：非居民入境及出境本国时，携带外币纸钞或其他形式外币现金支付手段，金额严格超过50万CFA等值（>）的，须按指令附件式样«FORMULAIRE DE DECLARATION DE MOYENS DE PAIEMENT»书面申报。提示：该指令仅规定申报义务——申报本身不等于获授权超限携带，06/07/2025/RFE号指令就外币及CFA另设配额、携带、售汇与出境凭据等限额。附件为纸质表样，未载电子提交渠道；马里是否使用本国版式、口岸实际介质及费用均未知；没有任何马里来源作相反表述。
procedures.timing_en: Residents: at the exit customs office, when leaving for a non-UEMOA state carrying foreign-currency cash whose countervalue exceeds CFA 3,000,000. Non-residents: in writing at entry and again at exit, when carrying foreign-currency cash above CFA 500,000 countervalue.
procedures.timing_zh: 居民：前往UEMOA以外国家出境时，于出境海关就折合超过300万CFA的外币现金申报。非居民：入境与出境各书面申报一次（超过50万CFA等值时）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客外匯申報（06/07/2025/RFE指令）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 06/07/2025/RFE號指令（2025年8月1日生效，第14條廢止此前同客體指令，尤其05-07-2011/RFE）依據2024年12月20日06/2024/CM/UEMOA號規章（該規章廢止並取代2010年外匯規章）制定，作為UEMOA成員國適用於馬裡的旅客外匯申報義務。居民（第4條）：居民前往UEMOA以外國家出境時，攜帶外幣現金支付手段摺合嚴格超過300萬CFA（«excède»，為大於而非達到閾值，>）即須申報；第4條未規定式樣，也未就居民援引附件表格——居民申報是否使用該式樣原文未規定；該申報不影響（sans préjudice）反洗錢法規，故反洗錢現金/票據申報（見ML-cash-bni-customs-declaration）可於同次旅行並行成立，同一口岸一次提交能否同時滿足兩項義務任何文本均未規定；申報不實或殘缺須受罰。非居民（第7條）：非居民入境及出境本國時，攜帶外幣紙鈔或其他形式外幣現金支付手段，金額嚴格超過50萬CFA等值（>）的，須按指令附件式樣«FORMULAIRE DE DECLARATION DE MOYENS DE PAIEMENT»書面申報。提示：該指令僅規定申報義務——申報本身不等於獲授權超限攜帶，06/07/2025/RFE號指令就外幣及CFA另設配額、攜帶、售匯與出境憑據等限額。附件為紙質表樣，未載電子提交渠道；馬裡是否使用本國版式、口岸實際介質及費用均未知；沒有任何馬裡來源作相反表述。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 居民：前往UEMOA以外國家出境時，於出境海關就摺合超過300萬CFA的外幣現金申報。非居民：入境與出境各書面申報一次（超過50萬CFA等值時）。

procedures.name_en: Franchise admission for goods of returning residents (procedure listed; conditions not published)
procedures.name_zh: 回国定居者物品免税程序（官方列名；条件未公布）
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes / Ministère des Finances, Mauritanie
procedures.applicability_en: People returning permanently may apply for customs-duty and tax relief on objects, effects, furniture and vehicles. The official application page requests a municipal moving certificate stating foreign-residence start/end dates, a vehicle registration in the applicant’s name dated at least one year before return, and a certificate of stay abroad (four years for diplomats, eight for others). Applications are received by the finance ministry cabinet and processed by DGD/D4. The stated processing period is 15 days and the application requires a 20 MRU fiscal stamp. This is an application subject to approval, not automatic traveller exemption.
procedures.applicability_zh: 永久回国者可申请物品、个人财物、家具和车辆的关税税费减免。政府详情页要求离境地市政搬迁证明列明境外居住起止日期、申请人名下且回国前至少已登记1年的车辆登记证、境外停留证明（外交人员4年，其他人员8年）。财政部内阁受理、DGD/D4处理；公布处理时间15天，申请需20 MRU印花税票。本项须申请获准，不是普通旅客自动豁免。
procedures.timing_en: Apply for permanent-return relief; official processing time is 15 days.
procedures.timing_zh: 永久回国减免申请；官方处理时间15天。

fee.note: 申请印花税票；不代表全部进口税费。

procedures.name_zh_hant: 回國定居者物品免稅程序（官方列名；條件未公佈）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 永久回國者可申請物品、個人財物、傢俱和車輛的關稅稅費減免。政府詳情頁要求離境地市政搬遷證明列明境外居住起止日期、申請人名下且回國前至少已登記1年的車輛登記證、境外停留證明（外交人員4年，其他人員8年）。財政部內閣受理、DGD/D4處理；公佈處理時間15天，申請需20 MRU印花稅票。本項須申請獲准，不是普通旅客自動豁免。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 永久回國減免申請；官方處理時間15天。

procedures.name_en: Owner declaration of non-commercial goods
procedures.name_zh: 非商业货物由货主申报
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes, Mauritanie
procedures.applicability_en: The government goods-clearance procedure says non-commercial operations may be declared by their owner; otherwise an accredited customs broker is required. The page concerns general goods clearance and requests a detailed declaration with shipping documents and invoices as applicable. It does not establish a passenger allowance or require every traveller to use the commercial cargo process.
procedures.applicability_zh: 政府货物通关程序说明：非商业操作可由货主本人申报，其他情形须认证报关人。该详情页为一般货物通关，要求详细申报及按情况附运输单据、发票；不能据此推导旅客免税额，或要求每名旅客都办理商业货运程序。
procedures.timing_en: When non-commercial goods require formal customs clearance.
procedures.timing_zh: 非商业货物需要办理正式海关通关时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 非商業貨物由貨主申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 政府貨物通關程序說明：非商業操作可由貨主本人申報，其他情形須認證報關人。該詳情頁為一般貨物通關，要求詳細申報及按情況附運輸單據、發票；不能據此推導旅客免稅額，或要求每名旅客都辦理商業貨運程序。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 非商業貨物需要辦理正式海關通關時。

procedures.name_en: Regional cash and foreign-currency declaration rules
procedures.name_zh: 区域现金与外汇申报规则
procedures.agency: BCEAO / UEMOA Commission (applies in NE as a UMOA/UEMOA member state; BCEAO member-states page lists Niger)
procedures.applicability_en: Regional rules applicable to Niger as a UMOA/UEMOA member state. (1) Cash and bearer-negotiable-instrument transport declaration: any person entering Niger from another Union member state, or leaving Niger for another member state, must declare physical cash and bearer negotiable instruments to the Customs administration at the entry or exit point when the amount reaches CFA 10,000,000 or more (threshold inclusive, 'à partir duquel'; Instruction 002-03-2025 of 18 March 2025); to or from a third state the threshold is CFA 5,000,000 or more (threshold inclusive; Instruction 231/07/2024 of 16 July 2024, which replaced Instruction 008-09-2017). Both apply symmetrically on entry and on exit. (2) Foreign-exchange rules of Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE, in force 1 August 2025 (replacing 05-07-2011/RFE): non-resident travellers must declare foreign-currency cash in writing, both on entry and on exit, whenever the amount strictly exceeds the counter-value of CFA 500,000 ('excède'); export above that level requires a prior entry declaration or a qualifying banknote-purchase receipt and cannot exceed the amount shown on that declaration or receipt. Residents travelling to a destination outside UEMOA declare foreign-currency cash strictly above CFA 3,000,000; the resident foreign-banknote travel allocation is capped at CFA 3,500,000 per person per trip; residents returning with foreign currency above CFA 500,000 must surrender it to an authorised intermediary within eight working days; CFA notes and coins carried outside UEMOA are capped at CFA 500,000. The thresholds in (1) are inclusive; those in (2) are strict. Quotas, surrender obligations and carriage caps are not a separate traveller form; declaration is not permission to carry an unlimited sum.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于尼日尔（UMOA/UEMOA成员，BCEAO官网成员国页列有 Niger）的区域规则：（1）现金与无记名可转让票据运输申报：自联盟成员国进入尼日尔、或离开尼日尔前往另一成员国的人，总额达到或超过1,000万 CFA（门槛含本数，"à partir duquel"；002-03-2025号指令，2025年3月18日）须在出入境时向口岸海关申报；往返第三国门槛为达到或超过500万 CFA（含本数；231/07/2024号指令，2024年7月16日，取代008-09-2017）。入出境双向适用。（2）外汇指令06/07/2025/RFE（2025年8月1日生效，取代05-07-2011/RFE）：非居民旅客入出境双向，外币现金金额严格超过50万 CFA等值（"excède"）即须书面申报；出境超过该数额须凭此前入境申报或符合条件的购钞凭据，且不得超过凭据金额。居民前往UEMOA以外地区，携带外币现金严格超过300万 CFA须申报；居民外币纸钞旅行配额每人每次上限350万 CFA；居民返回携外币超过50万 CFA须在8个工作日内售予授权中介；携CFA纸钞硬币前往区外上限50万 CFA。（1）之门槛含本数，（2）之门槛为严格超过。配额、售汇义务与携带上限不是另一张旅客表格；申报不代表无限额携带许可。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of entry or exit, at the customs point of entry or exit; resident currency surrender within eight working days after entry.
procedures.timing_zh: 出入境时在出入境口岸海关办理；居民售汇期限为入境后8个工作日。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 區域現金與外匯申報規則
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於尼日爾（UMOA/UEMOA成員，BCEAO官網成員國頁列有 Niger）的區域規則：（1）現金與無記名可轉讓票據運輸申報：自聯盟成員國進入尼日爾、或離開尼日爾前往另一成員國的人，總額達到或超過1,000萬 CFA（門檻含本數，"à partir duquel"；002-03-2025號指令，2025年3月18日）須在出入境時向口岸海關申報；往返第三國門檻為達到或超過500萬 CFA（含本數；231/07/2024號指令，2024年7月16日，取代008-09-2017）。入出境雙向適用。（2）外匯指令06/07/2025/RFE（2025年8月1日生效，取代05-07-2011/RFE）：非居民旅客入出境雙向，外幣現金金額嚴格超過50萬 CFA等值（"excède"）即須書面申報；出境超過該數額須憑此前入境申報或符合條件的購鈔憑據，且不得超過憑據金額。居民前往UEMOA以外地區，攜帶外幣現金嚴格超過300萬 CFA須申報；居民外幣紙鈔旅行配額每人每次上限350萬 CFA；居民返回攜外幣超過50萬 CFA須在8個工作日內售予授權中介；攜CFA紙鈔硬幣前往區外上限50萬 CFA。（1）之門檻含本數，（2）之門檻為嚴格超過。配額、售匯義務與攜帶上限不是另一張旅客表格；申報不代表無限額攜帶許可。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出入境時在出入境口岸海關辦理；居民售匯期限為入境後8個工作日。

procedures.name_en: Arrival traveller oral declaration; red/green double-circuit choice constitutes the declaration act only where customs operates it (National Customs Code 2018)
procedures.name_zh: 到达旅客口头申报；红/绿双通道选择仅在海关启用处构成申报行为（2018年国家海关法典）
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes du Niger (Ministère des Finances)
procedures.applicability_en: Under the National Customs Code (Loi n°2018-19 of 27 April 2018) two layers apply to arriving travellers. General layer: traveller and baggage inspection proceeds under cover of an oral declaration ('sous couvert d'une déclaration verbale') and only at places designated by the customs administration (Article 214); Articles 214–222 apply to travellers by any mode of transport (Article 223(1)); a Minister of Finance order may further specify traveller processing (Article 223(2)). Conditional layer: the 'double circuit' is the simplified customs control system whereby arriving travellers make an act of declaration by choosing between two circuits — green, for travellers carrying no goods exceeding the duty-free admissible quantities or values and nothing prohibited or restricted; red, for all others (Article 1(24)); customs uses the double-circuit system only when circumstances and installations permit (Article 218(2)(b)), so the channel-choice form of the declaration act exists only where the double circuit is actually operated — the Code does not state that any given airport or land border operates the two channels, and there is no official confirmation of the double circuit being operated at any specific port. Declaration in detail of goods is made in writing, by computer process, or orally where the customs administration so provides (Article 107) — the general goods-declaration regime, not a traveller paper form. Baggage duty-free amounts and values are not stated in those articles of the Code; separately, Article 219 lets returning residents re-import duty-free their previously exported personal effects and private means of transport, and Article 220 grants non-residents temporary admission of their private means of transport for up to one year, renewable, possibly against security. The channel scheme is defined for arrival only; no departure channel scheme is established in the Code, and exit cash reporting follows the regional rules above.
procedures.applicability_zh: 依据2018年4月27日第2018-19号国家海关法，到达旅客适用两层制度。一般层：旅客及行李查验以口头申报（"sous couvert d'une déclaration verbale"）为前提，且仅可在海关指定地点进行（第214条）；第214至222条适用于任何交通方式的旅客（第223条第1款）；财政部长令可另行细化旅客处理（第223条第2款）。条件层："双通道"（double circuit）是简化的海关监管制度，到达旅客通过在两类通道之间作出选择即完成申报行为——绿色通道供未携带超过免税可容纳数量或价值的货物、且无禁限物品的旅客，红色通道供其余旅客（第1条第24款）；但海关仅在情形与设施允许时使用双通道制度（第218条第2款b项），故"选择通道即申报"仅在海关实际启用双通道的口岸存在，本法未载明任一机场或陆路口岸实际设置双通道，该运营事实尚无官方确认。货物明细申报以书面、计算机或（在海关规定允许时）口头方式作出（第107条）——这是一般货物报关制度，不是旅客纸表。行李免税的数量与价值在法典相应条文中未载明；另，第219条允许回返居民免税复进口其先前出口的个人物品及私人交通工具，第220条给予非居民私人交通工具临时进口，最长一年、可续期，必要时可要求担保。通道制度仅就到达定义；本法未设离境通道制度，离境现金申报按上述区域规则办理。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, at places designated by customs and under cover of an oral declaration (Article 214); where the double circuit is operated — which the Code permits only when circumstances and installations allow (Article 218(2)(b)) — the traveller's choice between green and red circuit itself constitutes the declaration act.
procedures.timing_zh: 到达时在海关指定地点、以口头申报为前提办理（第214条）；仅在海关因情形与设施允许而实际启用双通道的口岸（第218条第2款b项），旅客选择绿或红通道本身即构成申报行为。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 到達旅客口頭申報；紅/綠雙通道選擇僅在海關啟用處構成申報行為（2018年國家海關法典）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 依據2018年4月27日第2018-19號國家海關法，到達旅客適用兩層制度。一般層：旅客及行李查驗以口頭申報（"sous couvert d'une déclaration verbale"）為前提，且僅可在海關指定地點進行（第214條）；第214至222條適用於任何交通方式的旅客（第223條第1款）；財政部長令可另行細化旅客處理（第223條第2款）。條件層："雙通道"（double circuit）是簡化的海關監管制度，到達旅客通過在兩類通道之間作出選擇即完成申報行為——綠色通道供未攜帶超過免稅可容納數量或價值的貨物、且無禁限物品的旅客，紅色通道供其餘旅客（第1條第24款）；但海關僅在情形與設施允許時使用雙通道制度（第218條第2款b項），故"選擇通道即申報"僅在海關實際啟用雙通道的口岸存在，本法未載明任一機場或陸路口岸實際設置雙通道，該營運事實尚無官方確認。貨物明細申報以書面、計算機或（在海關規定允許時）口頭方式作出（第107條）——這是一般貨物報關制度，不是旅客紙表。行李免稅的數量與價值在法典相應條文中未載明；另，第219條允許回返居民免稅復進口其先前出口的個人物品及私人交通工具，第220條給予非居民私人交通工具臨時進口，最長一年、可續期，必要時可要求擔保。通道制度僅就到達定義；本法未設離境通道制度，離境現金申報按上述區域規則辦理。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 到達時在海關指定地點、以口頭申報為前提辦理（第214條）；僅在海關因情形與設施允許而實際啟用雙通道的口岸（第218條第2款b項），旅客選擇綠或紅通道本身即構成申報行為。

procedures.name_en: Electronic Currency Declaration (E-CDF) — USD 10,000 threshold, inward and outward
procedures.name_zh: 电子货币申报（E-CDF）——1万美元门槛，入境与出境
procedures.agency: Nigeria Customs Service (NCS)
procedures.applicability_en: The live NCS Electronic Currency Declaration Form (E-CDF) applies to travellers carrying foreign currency or items of value of USD 10,000 or more (or equivalent), in both directions: the form offers an Inward/Outward direction choice and states that declaration is required before entering or leaving Nigeria. It asks for the entry or departure point, chosen from listed international airports, seaports and land borders, or 'Other'. It covers cash currencies, negotiable instruments (traveller's/bank cheques, money orders, promissory notes, bearer bonds, prepaid cards, etc.) and precious stones/metals or other high-value items — ordinary baggage is not declared through this form. Submit online before crossing the border; afterwards present yourself to a Nigeria Customs officer at the border for in-person validation. The declaration status remains Pending until validated by a proper officer, so a reference number alone is not a validated declaration. The form states that it is free of charge and cites as its legal basis the Money Laundering (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022, the Foreign Exchange (Monitoring and Miscellaneous) Provisions Act 1995 and the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023.
procedures.applicability_zh: 尼日利亚海关现行电子货币申报表（E-CDF）适用于携带达到或超过1万美元（或等值）外币或有价值物品的旅客，双向适用：表内可选“入境（Inward）/出境（Outward）”方向，并载明须在进入或离开尼日利亚之前申报。表格要求选择入境或离境地点，可从列表所列国际机场、海港、陆路口岸中选择，或选“其他”。申报范围是现金货币、可转让票据（旅行支票/银行支票、汇票、本票、无记名债券、预付卡等）及宝石/贵金属或其他高价值物品——普通行李不通过此表申报。过境前在线提交；随后须在边境向尼日利亚海关关员当面核验。经正式关员核验前，申报状态一直为“待定”，仅取得参考号不等于已核验申报。表格声明免费，并载明其法律依据为《2022年洗钱（预防与禁止）法》、《1995年外汇（监管与杂项）规定法》与《2023年尼日利亚海关法》。
procedures.timing_en: Submit online before crossing the border (both when entering and when leaving Nigeria); afterwards present yourself to a Nigeria Customs officer at the border for in-person validation — the declaration stays Pending until validated.
procedures.timing_zh: 在进入或离开尼日利亚过境前在线提交；随后须在边境向尼日利亚海关关员当面核验——核验前申报状态一直为待定。

fee.note: 表格原文：This form is free. Nigeria Customs does not charge for declarations.（本表免费，海关申报不收费）

procedures.name_zh_hant: 電子貨幣申報（E-CDF）——1萬美元門檻，入境與出境
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 尼日利亞海關現行電子貨幣申報表（E-CDF）適用於攜帶達到或超過1萬美元（或等值）外幣或有價值物品的旅客，雙向適用：表內可選“入境（Inward）/出境（Outward）”方向，並載明須在進入或離開尼日利亞之前申報。表格要求選擇入境或離境地點，可從列表所列國際機場、海港、陸路口岸中選擇，或選“其他”。申報範圍是現金貨幣、可轉讓票據（旅行支票/銀行支票、匯票、本票、無記名債券、預付卡等）及寶石/貴金屬或其他高價值物品——普通行李不通過此表申報。過境前線上提交；隨後須在邊境向尼日利亞海關關員當面核驗。經正式關員核驗前，申報狀態一直為“待定”，僅取得參考號不等於已核驗申報。表格聲明免費，並載明其法律依據為《2022年洗錢（預防與禁止）法》、《1995年外匯（監管與雜項）規定法》與《2023年尼日利亞海關法》。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在進入或離開尼日利亞過境前線上提交；隨後須在邊境向尼日利亞海關關員當面核驗——核驗前申報狀態一直為待定。

procedures.name_en: Arrival goods channel selection (green/red dual channel) — only where NCS operates the system
procedures.name_zh: 抵港行李红绿双通道选择——仅在海关实际设置该系统时适用
procedures.agency: Nigeria Customs Service (NCS)
procedures.applicability_en: The Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 (Part XXI) defines a dual channel system allowing travellers to make a declaration on arrival by choosing between two channels: green, for travellers carrying goods in quantities or value not exceeding those admissible duty-free and not subject to import prohibitions or restrictions, and red, for other travellers. Section 164(1)(b) directs that the dual channel system be used 'whenever possible' for the customs control of travellers and the clearance of their accompanying goods and means of transport for private use — so the channel choice arises only where the Nigeria Customs Service actually operates the system at the port of entry. This Part creates no paper or online goods form: oral declarations of personal effects may be accepted (s 164(1)(c)), and the Act itself sets no duty-free amount (admissible quantities or values are fixed elsewhere). Transit passengers who do not leave a designated, secured transit area may not be subject to any customs control (s 164(1)(d)). Ordinary baggage is not part of the separate E-CDF, which covers only foreign currency and items of value of USD 10,000 or more.
procedures.applicability_zh: 《2023年尼日利亚海关法》第XXI部分界定“双通道制”：旅客抵达时可通过在两条通道中选择其一作出申报——绿色通道供携带物品数量或价值不超过可免税放行额度且不受进口禁止或限制的旅客使用，红色通道供其他旅客使用。第164(1)(b)条规定该系统“尽可能”（whenever possible）用于旅客监管及其随行行李与私人交通工具的清关——因此只有在尼日利亚海关于该入境口岸实际设置双通道系统时才产生选道。该部分未设立任何纸质或在线货物申报表：个人用品可接受口头申报（第164(1)(c)条），且该法本身未规定免税额度（可免税数量或价值另由其他规定确定）。不离开指定安全过境区的过境旅客可不受任何海关监管（第164(1)(d)条）。普通行李不属于另行单独的 E-CDF，后者仅涵盖达到或超过1万美元的外币及有价值物品。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, where the dual channel system is operated: choose green if your goods are within the admissible duty-free quantity or value and not prohibited or restricted; otherwise choose red. Personal effects may be declared orally.
procedures.timing_zh: 在设有双通道系统的口岸抵达时：物品在可免税数量或价值以内且无禁止或限制的走绿色通道，否则走红色通道；个人用品可口头申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵港行李紅綠雙通道選擇——僅在海關實際設置該系統時適用
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 《2023年尼日利亞海關法》第XXI部分界定“雙通道制”：旅客抵達時可通過在兩條通道中選擇其一作出申報——綠色通道供攜帶物品數量或價值不超過可免稅放行額度且不受進口禁止或限制的旅客使用，紅色通道供其他旅客使用。第164(1)(b)條規定該系統“儘可能”（whenever possible）用於旅客監管及其隨行行李與私人交通工具的清關——因此只有在尼日利亞海關於該入境口岸實際設置雙通道系統時才產生選道。該部分未設立任何紙質或線上貨物申報表：個人用品可接受口頭申報（第164(1)(c)條），且該法本身未規定免稅額度（可免稅數量或價值另由其他規定確定）。不離開指定安全過境區的過境旅客可不受任何海關監管（第164(1)(d)條）。普通行李不屬於另行單獨的 E-CDF，後者僅涵蓋達到或超過1萬美元的外幣及有價值物品。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在設有雙通道系統的口岸抵達時：物品在可免稅數量或價值以內且無禁止或限制的走綠色通道，否則走紅色通道；個人用品可口頭申報。

procedures.name_en: Passenger entry declaration (Regulation 10(1) and Second Schedule, Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016; official consolidated PDF dated 2026-07-01)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客入境申报（规例第10(1)条及第二附表，《Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016》，2026-07-01官方合并版）
procedures.agency: HM Customs and Excise, St Helena
procedures.applicability_en: All passengers entering St Helena must complete a declaration in the form shown in the Second Schedule ("Every passenger or head of family MUST complete this form when entering St Helena") and submit it to Customs; the Collector may exempt a passenger under Regulation 10(2). If you do not have anything to declare then please state "NONE"; goods obtained outside St Helena that are not within duty-free allowances (not exempt from dues) must be listed — under s.30 of the Customs and Excise Ordinance, 1999, only goods not exempt from dues must be listed, so duty-free allowance items are not itemised. Territorial scope: St Helena island only; not extrapolated to Ascension or Tristan da Cunha.
procedures.applicability_zh: 所有入境圣赫勒拿的旅客（或家庭户主）均须填写第二附表所载表格（“Every passenger or head of family MUST complete this form when entering St Helena”）并交海关；依规例第10(2)条，Collector（海关负责人）可豁免特定旅客。如无任何须申报之物，请填写“NONE”；在圣赫勒拿以外取得、不属免税额度（即不享 dues 豁免）的物品须列明——依《Customs and Excise Ordinance, 1999》第30条，仅不享 dues 豁免的货物须列报，免税额度内物品无须逐项列报。地域范围：仅圣赫勒拿岛；不外推至阿森松（Ascension）与特里斯坦达库尼亚（Tristan da Cunha）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in St Helena, at the Customs hall.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达圣赫勒拿时，在入境海关大厅填写并提交。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客入境申報（規例第10(1)條及第二附表，《Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016》，2026-07-01官方合併版）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 所有入境聖赫勒拿的旅客（或家庭戶主）均須填寫第二附表所載表格（“Every passenger or head of family MUST complete this form when entering St Helena”）並交海關；依規例第10(2)條，Collector（海關負責人）可豁免特定旅客。如無任何須申報之物，請填寫“NONE”；在聖赫勒拿以外取得、不屬免稅額度（即不享 dues 豁免）的物品須列明——依《Customs and Excise Ordinance, 1999》第30條，僅不享 dues 豁免的貨物須列報，免稅額度內物品無須逐項列報。地域範圍：僅聖赫勒拿島；不外推至阿森松（Ascension）與特里斯坦達庫尼亞（Tristan da Cunha）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達聖赫勒拿時，在入境海關大廳填寫並提交。

procedures.name_en: Currency declaration strictly over £6,000 when entering or leaving St Helena (Regulation 12(1) and Fourth Schedule, Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016; official consolidated PDF dated 2026-07-01)
procedures.name_zh: 出入圣赫勒拿携严格超过6,000英镑货币申报（规例第12(1)条及第四附表，《Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016》，2026-07-01官方合并版）
procedures.agency: HM Customs and Excise, St Helena
procedures.applicability_en: Trigger: carrying currency, cheques or monetary instruments, or any combination of them, which in total exceeds £6,000 (strictly more than), or the equivalent of that amount in any currency or combination of currencies. Direction: both entering and departing St Helena. Obligations: (a) declare this fact in the form contained in the Fourth Schedule — the currency declaration form records personal data (name, date and country of birth, nationality, occupation, home address), whether entering or departing, the monetary value with a breakdown if required, and a signed certification that failure to make a full declaration is an offence and can result in seizure, fines and/or imprisonment; its notes state that monetary instruments include coins, currency, travellers cheques and bearer instruments such as personal cheques; (b) provide information on the origin of the currency, cheques or monetary instruments and their intended use as requested by the Customs Officer, who must record identification and other data and may provide it to the Money Laundering Reporting Authority established by s.9 of the Money Laundering Ordinance, 2008. Failure to make the declaration or provide the information is an offence: fine of £2,000 or imprisonment for 6 months, or both. Territorial scope: St Helena island only; not extrapolated to Ascension or Tristan da Cunha.
procedures.applicability_zh: 触发：携带货币、支票或货币票据，或其任何组合，总额严格超过6,000英镑，或以任何单一或组合币种计的等值金额。方向：进入或离开圣赫勒拿均适用。义务：(a) 以第四附表所载表格申报该事实——该现金申报表记录个人资料（姓名、出生日期与出生国、国籍、职业、家庭住址）、系入境或离境、货币金额（如需附明细），并签署证明：所有申报真实、准确、完整，且知悉未完整申报即属犯罪，可导致货物没收、罚款及/或监禁；附表注释载明货币票据包括硬币、货币、旅行支票及无记名票据（如个人支票）；(b) 按海关关员要求提供该货币、支票或票据来源及预期用途的信息；关员须记录身份识别及其他数据，并可将该信息提供给《2008年反洗钱条例》（Money Laundering Ordinance, 2008）第9条设立的反洗钱报告机构。不申报或不按要求提供信息即属犯罪：罚款2,000英镑或监禁6个月，或两者并罚。地域范围：仅圣赫勒拿岛；不外推至阿森松与特里斯坦达库尼亚。
procedures.timing_en: At the time of entering or departing St Helena, by completing the Fourth Schedule currency declaration form and providing origin and intended-use information as requested by the Customs Officer.
procedures.timing_zh: 于进入或离开圣赫勒拿时，填写第四附表现金申报表，并按海关关员要求提供来源与预期用途信息。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入聖赫勒拿攜嚴格超過6,000英鎊貨幣申報（規例第12(1)條及第四附表，《Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016》，2026-07-01官方合併版）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 觸發：攜帶貨幣、支票或貨幣票據，或其任何組合，總額嚴格超過6,000英鎊，或以任何單一或組合幣種計的等值金額。方向：進入或離開聖赫勒拿均適用。義務：(a) 以第四附表所載表格申報該事實——該現金申報表記錄個人資料（姓名、出生日期與出生國、國籍、職業、家庭住址）、系入境或離境、貨幣金額（如需附明細），並簽署證明：所有申報真實、準確、完整，且知悉未完整申報即屬犯罪，可導致貨物沒收、罰款及/或監禁；附表註釋載明貨幣票據包括硬幣、貨幣、旅行支票及無記名票據（如個人支票）；(b) 按海關關員要求提供該貨幣、支票或票據來源及預期用途的資訊；關員須記錄身份識別及其他資料，並可將該資訊提供給《2008年反洗錢條例》（Money Laundering Ordinance, 2008）第9條設立的反洗錢報告機構。不申報或不按要求提供資訊即屬犯罪：罰款2,000英鎊或監禁6個月，或兩者並罰。地域範圍：僅聖赫勒拿島；不外推至阿森松與特里斯坦達庫尼亞。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 於進入或離開聖赫勒拿時，填寫第四附表現金申報表，並按海關關員要求提供來源與預期用途資訊。

procedures.name_en: Arrival goods declaration
procedures.name_zh: 入境货物申报
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes du Sénégal (DGD)
procedures.applicability_en: On arrival the traveller must declare in detail the goods carried; relief from duties and taxes does not remove this declaration obligation. Accompanied personal effects are generally declared verbally. Where customs channels are in place, passing through the 'Nothing to declare' or 'Goods to declare' corridor itself counts as the declaration; per the DGD traveller guide this channel form exists, for now, only at certain customs offices (the guide cites Dakar-Yoff) and is not generalized to all border posts. Used personal effects showing no commercial intent are admitted duty-free, and the guide grants tolerances (personal gold or silver jewellery up to 50 g; 10 packets of cigarettes or 50 cigars or 250 g of tobacco, or a proportionate assortment up to 250 g; one bottle of spirits and one bottle of wine; tobacco and alcohol tolerances are excluded for persons under 18). These quantities are quoted from the old guide and whether they remain current is unconfirmed. Relief goods must not be sold or given away locally, and unconsumed goods must be re-exported at the end of the stay. These rules come from the DGD traveller guide published on the former douanes-senegal.com site; the same page is not found on the current douanes.sn main site, so current validity is unconfirmed. The guide's currency figures are superseded.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境旅客须就其携带的货物作详细申报；免税不免除申报义务。随行个人物品一般为口头申报。设有海关通道的口岸，走“无申报”或“有申报”通道本身即视同申报；据海关总署旅客指南，该通道形式目前仅存在于部分海关（指南举例达喀尔-约夫），不泛化到所有口岸。在用且无商业性质的个人物品免税，指南另列容忍量（个人金银首饰不超过50克；香烟10包或雪茄50支或烟草250克，或按比例混合不超过250克；烈酒1瓶、葡萄酒1瓶；未满18岁无烟酒容忍量）。上述数量引自旧指南，是否仍为现行未经确认。免税物品不得在塞内加尔当地出售或转让，未消耗品须在停留结束时复带出境。以上规则出自旧站douanes-senegal.com所载旅客指南，同一页面在现行douanes.sn主站未见，现行性未经当前主站证实。指南中的现金数字已被取代。
procedures.timing_en: At entry; relief goods that are unconsumed must be re-exported at the end of the stay.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时；未消耗的免税物品须在停留结束时复带出境。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境貨物申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境旅客須就其攜帶的貨物作詳細申報；免稅不免除申報義務。隨行個人物品一般為口頭申報。設有海關通道的口岸，走“無申報”或“有申報”通道本身即視同申報；據海關總署旅客指南，該通道形式目前僅存在於部分海關（指南舉例達喀爾-約夫），不泛化到所有口岸。在用且無商業性質的個人物品免稅，指南另列容忍量（個人金銀首飾不超過50克；香菸10包或雪茄50支或菸草250克，或按比例混合不超過250克；烈酒1瓶、葡萄酒1瓶；未滿18歲無煙酒容忍量）。上述數量引自舊指南，是否仍為現行未經確認。免稅物品不得在塞內加爾當地出售或轉讓，未消耗品須在停留結束時復帶出境。以上規則出自舊站douanes-senegal.com所載旅客指南，同一頁面在現行douanes.sn主站未見，現行性未經當前主站證實。指南中的現金數字已被取代。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時；未消耗的免稅物品須在停留結束時復帶出境。

procedures.name_en: Cross-border cash declaration
procedures.name_zh: 跨境现金申报
procedures.agency: BCEAO (instructions addressed to all UEMOA member states, including Senegal); declaration made to the customs office at the border
procedures.applicability_en: Any person who physically transports cash or bearer negotiable instruments into or out of Senegal must make a declaration to customs at the point of entry or exit when the amount reaches the applicable threshold. The threshold depends only on the route: between UEMOA member states, CFA 10,000,000 or more (BCEAO Instruction 002-03-2025 of 18 March 2025; the operative words 'le seuil à partir duquel' mean the duty applies from the threshold onwards, i.e. inclusive ≥); to or from a third state, CFA 5,000,000 or more (Instruction 231/07/2024 of 16 July 2024, which replaced the 2017 instruction; same inclusive wording). The duty applies symmetrically on entry and on exit and covers physical cash and bearer negotiable instruments whatever the traveller's residence status. It is separate from the 2025 traveller foreign-exchange declaration (see SN-fx-payment-means-declaration), which has a different legal basis, population and thresholds: article 4 of Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE states the resident foreign-exchange declaration is without prejudice to the declaration obligations for physical transports of cash, so both duties can apply to the same journey. No official text establishes that one form filed at a single border post satisfies both obligations; a traveller must not assume a single filing covers everything. The figures on the old DGD exchange-control page rest on Regulation 009/1998/CM/UEMOA, which was repealed at Council-of-Ministers level by Regulation 09/2010/CM/UEMOA (article 21), itself repealed by Regulation 06/2024/CM/UEMOA (article 35); they are not current law.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何人在塞内加尔出入境口岸以实物运输现金或无记名可转让票据，金额达到适用门槛即须向海关申报。门槛仅取决于路线：UEMOA成员国之间为1,000万CFA及以上（含本数，≥；BCEAO 002-03-2025号指令，2025年3月18日；«le seuil à partir duquel»意为达到门槛即触发）；往返第三国为500万CFA及以上（含本数，≥；231/07/2024号指令，2024年7月16日，取代2017年旧令，措辞相同）。本义务入出境对称适用，客体为实体现金与无记名可转让票据，与旅客居民身份无关。本申报与2025年旅客外汇申报（见SN-fx-payment-means-declaration）相互独立，二者法律依据、人群与门槛不同：06/07/2025/RFE第4条明文居民外汇申报不妨碍（sans préjudice）实体现金运输申报义务，同一次旅行两项义务可同时成立。任何官文均未确立在同一口岸提交一份表格即可同时满足两项义务；旅客不得假定一次申报覆盖全部义务。旧海关外汇管制页的数字以009/1998/CM/UEMOA号规章为据，该理事会规章先经09/2010/CM/UEMOA第21条、再经06/2024/CM/UEMOA第35条在理事会层级先后明文废止，已非现行法。
procedures.timing_en: At the customs point of entry or exit, at the moment of crossing with an amount at or above the threshold.
procedures.timing_zh: 于入出境海关办理，跨越边境携带金额达到门槛即触发。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境現金申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何人在塞內加爾出入境口岸以實物運輸現金或無記名可轉讓票據，金額達到適用門檻即須向海關申報。門檻僅取決於路線：UEMOA成員國之間為1,000萬CFA及以上（含本數，≥；BCEAO 002-03-2025號指令，2025年3月18日；«le seuil à partir duquel»意為達到門檻即觸發）；往返第三國為500萬CFA及以上（含本數，≥；231/07/2024號指令，2024年7月16日，取代2017年舊令，措辭相同）。本義務入出境對稱適用，客體為實體現金與無記名可轉讓票據，與旅客居民身份無關。本申報與2025年旅客外匯申報（見SN-fx-payment-means-declaration）相互獨立，二者法律依據、人群與門檻不同：06/07/2025/RFE第4條明文居民外匯申報不妨礙（sans préjudice）實體現金運輸申報義務，同一次旅行兩項義務可同時成立。任何官文均未確立在同一口岸提交一份表格即可同時滿足兩項義務；旅客不得假定一次申報覆蓋全部義務。舊海關外匯管制頁的數字以009/1998/CM/UEMOA號規章為據，該理事會規章先經09/2010/CM/UEMOA第21條、再經06/2024/CM/UEMOA第35條在理事會層級先後明文廢止，已非現行法。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 於入出境海關辦理，跨越邊境攜帶金額達到門檻即觸發。

procedures.name_en: Foreign-currency declaration
procedures.name_zh: 外币现金申报
procedures.agency: BCEAO (Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE addressed to all UEMOA member states, including Senegal); written declaration at the customs office
procedures.applicability_en: BCEAO Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE, effective 1 August 2025, applies to Senegal as a UEMOA member state; it is issued under Regulation 06/2024/CM/UEMOA of 20 December 2024, and its article 14 repeals all earlier instructions treating the same subject (notably 05-07-2011/RFE). Resident (article 4): on leaving for a state outside UEMOA, a resident must declare foreign-currency cash (foreign banknotes or any other form) whose countervalue exceeds CFA 3,000,000; 'excède' is strictly greater than (>). Article 4 prescribes no written form and does not refer to the annexed form for residents. Non-resident (articles 7-8): at entry and again at exit, a non-resident must declare in writing, on the form model annexed to the Instruction, foreign-currency cash held in foreign banknotes or any other form whose amount exceeds the countervalue of CFA 500,000 (>); to take out more than that amount, the non-resident must present at the exit customs office either the entry declaration or a qualifying purchase slip, and the amount taken out may not exceed the amount declared on entry or acquired locally. The same Instruction also sets boundary rules: a resident's allocation in foreign banknotes is capped at CFA 3,500,000 per person per trip (article 2); a resident re-entering with foreign means of payment whose countervalue exceeds CFA 500,000 must sell them to an authorised intermediary within eight working days (article 5, a surrender duty, not a border declaration); CFA notes and coins taken outside UEMOA are capped at CFA 500,000 per person (article 6). The annex (pages 5-6) is a paper form model and states no online submission channel. This regime is distinct from the cash and bearer-instrument customs declaration (see SN-cash-bni-customs-declaration); the two duties stack under article 4, and whether one form at one post satisfies both remains open. The old DGD exchange-control figures (non-resident entry above CFA 1,000,000; resident exit CFA 2,000,000; no intra-UEMOA formality) rest on the repealed 1998 Regulation and are not current law.
procedures.applicability_zh: BCEAO 06/07/2025/RFE号指令自2025年8月1日生效，作为UEMOA成员国适用于塞内加尔；该指令依据2024年12月20日06/2024/CM/UEMOA号规章作出，其第14条废止此前处理同一客体的所有旧指令（尤其05-07-2011/RFE）。居民（第4条）：前往UEMOA以外国家的居民，出境时须申报等值超过300万CFA（«excède»为严格大于，>）的外币现金（外国银行券或其他形式）；第4条未规定书面形式，也未援引附件表格。非居民（第7–8条）：非居民在入境和出境时均须按指令附件所载表格样式，就其以外国银行券或其他形式持有、金额超过50万CFA等值（>）的外币现金作书面申报；携出超过该金额，须在出境海关出示入境申报或合格的购汇凭据，且携出额不得超过入境申报额或本地取得额。同一指令另定的边界规则：居民外币纸钞配额每人每次不超过350万CFA（第2条）；居民入境持有外币等值超过50万CFA者须在8个工作日内售予授权中介（第5条，系售汇义务而非口岸申报）；本币纸钞硬币携往区外每人不超过50万CFA（第6条）。附件（页5–6）为纸质表样，无线上提交渠道表述。本制度与实体现金/无记名票据海关申报（见SN-cash-bni-customs-declaration）分立；第4条之下两项义务叠加，同一口岸一份表格能否同时满足仍属未决。旧海关外汇管制页的数字（非居民入境超过100万CFA、居民出境200万CFA、区内无限额/无需手续）以已废止的1998年规章为据，非现行法。
procedures.timing_en: Residents: at the exit customs office. Non-residents: at entry and again at exit; the entry declaration or purchase slip must be produced when leaving. A resident re-entering with foreign means of payment above CFA 500,000 countervalue must sell them to an authorised intermediary within eight working days.
procedures.timing_zh: 居民：于出境海关办理。非居民：入境与出境均办理；离境时须出示入境申报或购汇凭据。居民入境持有外币等值超过50万CFA的，须在8个工作日内售予授权中介。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 外幣現金申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: BCEAO 06/07/2025/RFE號指令自2025年8月1日生效，作為UEMOA成員國適用於塞內加爾；該指令依據2024年12月20日06/2024/CM/UEMOA號規章作出，其第14條廢止此前處理同一客體的所有舊指令（尤其05-07-2011/RFE）。居民（第4條）：前往UEMOA以外國家的居民，出境時須申報等值超過300萬CFA（«excède»為嚴格大於，>）的外幣現金（外國銀行券或其他形式）；第4條未規定書面形式，也未援引附件表格。非居民（第7–8條）：非居民在入境和出境時均須按指令附件所載表格樣式，就其以外國銀行券或其他形式持有、金額超過50萬CFA等值（>）的外幣現金作書面申報；攜出超過該金額，須在出境海關出示入境申報或合格的購匯憑據，且攜出額不得超過入境申報額或本地取得額。同一指令另定的邊界規則：居民外幣紙鈔配額每人每次不超過350萬CFA（第2條）；居民入境持有外幣等值超過50萬CFA者須在8個工作日內售予授權中介（第5條，系售匯義務而非口岸申報）；本幣紙鈔硬幣攜往區外每人不超過50萬CFA（第6條）。附件（頁5–6）為紙質表樣，無線上提交渠道表述。本制度與實體現金/無記名票據海關申報（見SN-cash-bni-customs-declaration）分立；第4條之下兩項義務疊加，同一口岸一份表格能否同時滿足仍屬未決。舊海關外匯管制頁的數字（非居民入境超過100萬CFA、居民出境200萬CFA、區內無限額/無需手續）以已廢止的1998年規章為據，非現行法。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 居民：於出境海關辦理。非居民：入境與出境均辦理；離境時須出示入境申報或購匯憑據。居民入境持有外幣等值超過50萬CFA的，須在8個工作日內售予授權中介。

procedures.name_en: Traveller personal-effects limits under section 27(c)
procedures.name_zh: 第27(c)条旅客个人物品额度
procedures.agency: National Revenue Authority, Sierra Leone
procedures.applicability_en: NRA’s explanation of Tax and Duty Exemption Act 2023 section 27(c) limits treatment as travellers’ personal effects to no more than 0.25 litre eau de toilette and 50 grams perfume. It concerns customs treatment of excess quantities, not a ban on carrying those products. The page does not cover a general baggage declaration form, cash threshold or precious-stone export licence; it does not state whether other rules apply to those.
procedures.applicability_zh: NRA对2023年税费豁免法第27(c)条的说明规定：作为旅客个人物品的花露水不超过0.25升、香水不超过50克。该条说明海关怎样处理超量，并非禁止携带这些产品。该说明不涉及一般行李申报表、现金申报门槛或宝石出口许可；这些事项是否另有规定，页面未作说明。
procedures.timing_en: When customs examines traveller baggage.
procedures.timing_zh: 海关查验旅客行李时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 第27(c)條旅客個人物品額度
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: NRA對2023年稅費豁免法第27(c)條的說明規定：作為旅客個人物品的花露水不超過0.25升、香水不超過50克。該條說明海關怎樣處理超量，並非禁止攜帶這些產品。該說明不涉及一般行李申報表、現金申報門檻或寶石出口許可；這些事項是否另有規定，頁面未作說明。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 海關查驗旅客行李時。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of cash and bearer instruments over USD 10,000 when arriving in or leaving Sierra Leone
procedures.name_zh: 入出塞拉利昂携带超过 1 万美元现金及无记名票据的申报
procedures.agency: Sierra Leone Police, customs officers of the National Revenue Authority, Financial Intelligence Agency
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: both. Under section 104 of the Anti-Money Laundering and Combating of Financing of Terrorism and Financing of Proliferation of Weapons of Mass Destruction Act, 2024, a person arriving in or leaving Sierra Leone with more than USD 10,000.00, or the equivalent in leones or another foreign currency, in cash or negotiable bearer instruments must declare it to a police officer, a customs officer or an officer of the Financial Intelligence Agency. This covers cash carried on the person, in luggage, or sent by mail or cargo. Not declaring, or declaring falsely, is an offence: on conviction the penalty is forfeiture of the whole amount, imprisonment of not less than 5 years, or both. The Act does not name a declaration form.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：双向。依据 2024 年《反洗钱、反恐融资及反大规模杀伤性武器扩散融资法》第 104 条，抵达或离开塞拉利昂时携带超过 10,000.00 美元（或等值利昂、其他外币）的现金或无记名可转让票据，须向警察、海关官员或金融情报机构人员申报。随身携带、放在行李中，或通过邮件、货运寄送的都包括在内。不申报或虚假申报属犯罪：定罪后可没收全部金额，或处不少于 5 年监禁，或两者并处。该法没有写明申报表格名称。
procedures.timing_en: When arriving in or leaving Sierra Leone.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达或离开塞拉利昂时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入出塞拉利昂攜帶超過 1 萬美元現金及無記名票據的申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：雙向。依據 2024 年《反洗錢、反恐融資及反大規模殺傷性武器擴散融資法》第 104 條，抵達或離開塞拉利昂時攜帶超過 10,000.00 美元（或等值利昂、其他外幣）的現金或無記名可轉讓票據，須向警察、海關官員或金融情報機構人員申報。隨身攜帶、放在行李中，或通過郵件、貨運寄送的都包括在內。不申報或虛假申報屬犯罪：定罪後可沒收全部金額，或處不少於 5 年監禁，或兩者並處。該法沒有寫明申報表格名稱。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達或離開塞拉利昂時。

procedures.name_en: Simplified definitive declaration for accompanied traveller baggage (Arrêté 118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI of 8 June 2020)
procedures.name_zh: 随行旅客行李简化最终申报（2020年6月8日第118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI号令）
procedures.agency: Office Togolais des Recettes (OTR) — Commissariat des Douanes et Droits Indirects
procedures.applicability_en: Article 2 of Arrêté 118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI (signed Lomé, 8 June 2020) lists baggage accompanying travellers as one class eligible for simplified definitive customs declarations, which customs may authorise; the same article's CFA 250,000 ceiling attaches only to a different class, goods in frontier traffic, and no value ceiling is stated for baggage. Article 5 allows the simplified and global declarations to be drawn up by the traveller personally or by approved customs brokers (commissionnaires en douane agréés). Article 3's minimum particulars still include the rate and amount of entry duties, so this is a clearance simplification, not an exemption from declaration or duties. The arrêté prescribes no form medium and no fee.
procedures.applicability_zh: 第118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI号令（2020年6月8日于洛美签署）第2条将旅客随行行李列为可适用简化最终海关申报的货物类别之一（须经海关授权）；同条250,000（25万）FCFA上限仅针对另一类别即边境贸易货物，条文未对行李设定价值上限。第5条允许简化申报及汇总申报由旅客本人或经认可的报关行（commissionnaires en douane agréés）编制。第3条所列最低申报要素仍包括进口关税税率与应收金额，故此系通关简化而非免申报或免税。该令未规定表格介质，亦未规定费用。
procedures.timing_en: When accompanied baggage is cleared through customs.
procedures.timing_zh: 随行行李办理海关通关时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 隨行旅客行李簡化最終申報（2020年6月8日第118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI號令）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 第118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI號令（2020年6月8日於洛美簽署）第2條將旅客隨行行李列為可適用簡化最終海關申報的貨物類別之一（須經海關授權）；同條250,000（25萬）FCFA上限僅針對另一類別即邊境貿易貨物，條文未對行李設定價值上限。第5條允許簡化申報及彙總申報由旅客本人或經認可的報關行（commissionnaires en douane agréés）編制。第3條所列最低申報要素仍包括進口關稅稅率與應收金額，故此係通關簡化而非免申報或免稅。該令未規定表格介質，亦未規定費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 隨行行李辦理海關通關時。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of physical transport of cash and bearer negotiable instruments (Instructions 002-03-2025 and 231/07/2024)
procedures.name_zh: 现金及无记名可转让票据实运申报（002-03-2025号及231/07/2024号指令）
procedures.agency: BCEAO (instructions applicable in TG as a UMOA member state); declared to the Customs administration at the entry or exit point
procedures.applicability_en: Togo is named among the eight UMOA member states, so these BCEAO instructions apply in Togo. Physical cash and bearer negotiable instruments transported from one member state to another must be declared to the Customs administration at the entry or exit point from CFA 10,000,000 (Instruction 002-03-2025, signed 18 March 2025 and in force on signature). When entering from or leaving for a third state, the same transport must be declared from CFA 5,000,000 (Instruction 231/07/2024, signed 16 July 2024 and in force on signature, expressly repealing Instruction 008-09-2017). Both thresholds are route-based comparators ('le seuil à partir duquel'), stated in CFA, with no aggregation rule in either text. This is a distinct legal family from the resident/non-resident traveller foreign-currency declaration under Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE, with a different population, direction and comparators, and no common Togo form may be assumed between the two. Neither instruction prescribes a form medium or a fee.
procedures.applicability_zh: 多哥被列为UMOA八个成员国之一，故下列BCEAO指令适用于多哥。在成员国之间运输现金及无记名可转让票据，自10,000,000（1,000万）FCFA起须在出入境点向海关申报（第002-03-2025号指令，2025年3月18日签署并于当日生效）。自第三国入境或前往第三国时，同类运输自5,000,000（500万）FCFA起须申报（第231/07/2024号指令，2024年7月16日签署并于当日生效，明确废止第008-09-2017号指令）。两项门槛均按路线区分（条文表述为“自该金额起的门槛”），以FCFA计，两文本均无累计规则。该项申报义务与第06/07/2025/RFE号指令下居民/非居民旅客外币申报属不同法律类别——适用人群、方向与比较标准均不同——不得假定两者共用同一多哥表格。两指令均未规定表格介质与费用。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of crossing the border point while transporting the cash or instruments.
procedures.timing_zh: 携带现金或票据经出入境点跨境之时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金及無記名可轉讓票據實運申報（002-03-2025號及231/07/2024號指令）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 多哥被列為UMOA八個成員國之一，故下列BCEAO指令適用於多哥。在成員國之間運輸現金及無記名可轉讓票據，自10,000,000（1,000萬）FCFA起須在出入境點向海關申報（第002-03-2025號指令，2025年3月18日簽署並於當日生效）。自第三國入境或前往第三國時，同類運輸自5,000,000（500萬）FCFA起須申報（第231/07/2024號指令，2024年7月16日簽署並於當日生效，明確廢止第008-09-2017號指令）。兩項門檻均按路線區分（條文表述為“自該金額起的門檻”），以FCFA計，兩文本均無累計規則。該項申報義務與第06/07/2025/RFE號指令下居民/非居民旅客外幣申報屬不同法律類別——適用人群、方向與比較標準均不同——不得假定兩者共用同一多哥表格。兩指令均未規定表格介質與費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 攜帶現金或票據經出入境點跨境之時。

procedures.name_en: Resident and non-resident traveller foreign-currency declaration (Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE)
procedures.name_zh: 居民及非居民旅客外币申报（第06/07/2025/RFE号指令）
procedures.agency: BCEAO / UEMOA Commission (instruction applicable in TG as a UEMOA member state)
procedures.applicability_en: Togo is named among the eight UMOA member states, so Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE (issued under Règlement 06/2024/CM/UEMOA of 20 December 2024; effective 1 August 2025, repealing the 2011 traveller-allocation instruction) applies in Togo. Its traveller declaration duties are: residents travelling to non-UEMOA states declare the foreign-currency cash they carry when its CFA countervalue exceeds CFA 3,000,000 (art. 4); non-residents declare in writing, on the model annexed to the instruction, at entry and at exit, foreign-currency cash payment means whose CFA countervalue exceeds CFA 500,000 (art. 7). Making such a declaration does not by itself authorise carrying foreign banknotes without limit: export of foreign banknotes above the CFA 500,000 ceiling remains subject to separate conditions (art. 8), which are not themselves a filing duty. Amounts are measured as CFA countervalue; 'excède' is strictly above. This is a distinct legal family from the route-based declaration of physical cash and bearer negotiable instruments under Instructions 002-03-2025 and 231/07/2024, with a different population, direction and comparators, and no common Togo form may be assumed between the two. The instruction's allocation-delivery, surrender and carry-limit provisions for residents are separate exchange controls, not declaration duties, and are not part of this declaration requirement.
procedures.applicability_zh: 多哥被列为UMOA八个成员国之一，故第06/07/2025/RFE号指令（依据2024年12月20日第06/2024/CM/UEMOA号条例发布；2025年8月1日生效，废止2011年旅客配额指令）适用于多哥。其旅客申报义务为：居民前往非UEMOA国家，随身携带外币现金折合超过3,000,000（300万）FCFA时须申报（第4条）；非居民出入境时须按指令附件所示格式书面申报折合超过500,000（50万）FCFA的外币现金支付工具（第7条）。作出该项申报本身并不授权无限额携带外币纸钞：携出超过500,000（50万）FCFA上限的外币纸钞仍须满足另行条件（第8条），该条件本身并非申报义务。金额按FCFA折合计算；“excède”（超过）指严格高于。该项申报义务与第002-03-2025号、第231/07/2024号指令下按路线区分的现金及无记名可转让票据申报属不同法律类别——适用人群、方向与比较标准均不同——不得假定两者共用同一多哥表格。指令中有关居民配额交付、售汇及携出限额的条款系另行外汇管制，非申报义务，不属于本项申报要求的内容。
procedures.timing_en: Non-residents: on entry and on exit (art. 7); residents: when carrying foreign-currency cash to a non-UEMOA state (art. 4).
procedures.timing_zh: 非居民：入境及出境时（第7条）；居民：携带外币现金前往非UEMOA国家时（第4条）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 居民及非居民旅客外幣申報（第06/07/2025/RFE號指令）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 多哥被列為UMOA八個成員國之一，故第06/07/2025/RFE號指令（依據2024年12月20日第06/2024/CM/UEMOA號條例發佈；2025年8月1日生效，廢止2011年旅客配額指令）適用於多哥。其旅客申報義務為：居民前往非UEMOA國家，隨身攜帶外幣現金摺合超過3,000,000（300萬）FCFA時須申報（第4條）；非居民出入境時須按指令附件所示格式書面申報摺合超過500,000（50萬）FCFA的外幣現金支付工具（第7條）。作出該項申報本身並不授權無限額攜帶外幣紙鈔：攜出超過500,000（50萬）FCFA上限的外幣紙鈔仍須滿足另行條件（第8條），該條件本身並非申報義務。金額按FCFA摺合計算；“excède”（超過）指嚴格高於。該項申報義務與第002-03-2025號、第231/07/2024號指令下按路線區分的現金及無記名可轉讓票據申報屬不同法律類別——適用人群、方向與比較標準均不同——不得假定兩者共用同一多哥表格。指令中有關居民配額交付、售匯及攜出限額的條款系另行外匯管制，非申報義務，不屬於本項申報要求的內容。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 非居民：入境及出境時（第7條）；居民：攜帶外幣現金前往非UEMOA國家時（第4條）。

procedures.name_en: Traveller customs declaration on entry (Customs Act s. 89(1); Customs (Declaration Form) Regulations C169-9)
procedures.name_zh: 入境旅客海关申报（Customs Act s89(1)；海关（申报表）条例 C169-9）
procedures.agency: Anguilla Customs Department
procedures.applicability_en: Every person entering Anguilla must make the declarations referred to in section 89(1) of the Customs Act by completing the form set out in the Schedule, or a form to like effect (Customs (Declaration Form) Regulations, R.R.A. C169-9, s. 1(1)). An entrant may make these declarations on behalf of an accompanying spouse or of a child who has not attained 18 years, and a person declared for need not declare again (s. 1(2)-(3)). Section 89(1) of the Customs Act determines what must be declared: anything in his baggage or carried with him that he obtained outside Anguilla, or dutiable or chargeable goods obtained in Anguilla without payment of duty, in respect of which he is not entitled to exemption from duty or tax by virtue of any enactment. The text is that of the Revised Edition of 15 December 2010; no official confirmation of any later amendment is available.
procedures.applicability_zh: 每名进入安圭拉的人均须填写《海关（申报表）条例》（R.R.A. C169-9）第1(1)条 Schedule 所列表格或同效表，以完成 Customs Act 第89(1) 条所指的申报。入境者可代同行配偶或未满18岁子女作出申报，被代报者无须重复申报（第1(2)-(3)条）。Customs Act 第89(1) 条决定须披露的货物范围：行李内或随身携带、在安圭拉境外取得之物，或在安圭拉境内未完税取得的应课税（dutiable）/应征税费（chargeable）货物，且无任何成文法豁免资格者。以上文本出自2010年12月15日修订版重编本，暂无官方信息确认其后是否修订。
procedures.timing_en: On entry to Anguilla, at such place and in such manner as the Comptroller may direct with the approval of the Governor in Council (Customs Act s. 89(1)).
procedures.timing_zh: 入境安圭拉时，于 Comptroller 经总督会同行政局批准所指示的地点与方式办理（Customs Act s89(1)）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境旅客海關申報（Customs Act s89(1)；海關（申報表）條例 C169-9）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 每名進入安圭拉的人均須填寫《海關（申報表）條例》（R.R.A. C169-9）第1(1)條 Schedule 所列表格或同效表，以完成 Customs Act 第89(1) 條所指的申報。入境者可代同行配偶或未滿18歲子女作出申報，被代報者無須重複申報（第1(2)-(3)條）。Customs Act 第89(1) 條決定須披露的貨物範圍：行李內或隨身攜帶、在安圭拉境外取得之物，或在安圭拉境內未完稅取得的應課稅（dutiable）/應徵稅費（chargeable）貨物，且無任何成文法豁免資格者。以上文本出自2010年12月15日修訂版重編本，暫無官方資訊確認其後是否修訂。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境安圭拉時，於 Comptroller 經總督會同行政局批准所指示的地點與方式辦理（Customs Act s89(1)）。

procedures.name_en: Currency and monetary instruments report on entry or departure (Customs Act s. 89(2)(a); Customs (Currency Report) Regulations C169-10)
procedures.name_zh: 出入境货币及货币票据报告（Customs Act s89(2)(a)；海关（货币报告）条例 C169-10）
procedures.agency: Anguilla Customs Department
procedures.applicability_en: A person entering or leaving Anguilla in possession of currency, cheques or monetary instruments, or any combination thereof, of or exceeding $27,000, or the equivalent in any currency or combination of currencies, must declare and make a report in such form and manner as the Comptroller directs (Customs Act s. 89(2)(a)). For entrants, the Customs (Currency Report) Regulations, R.R.A. C169-10, s. 1 require every person entering with currency or monetary instruments totalling over $27,000 to answer the questions contained in the scheduled form, or a form to like effect, in accordance with s. 89(2). The two texts differ on entry at exactly $27,000: the Act says 'of or exceeding' (inclusive, entry and departure) while the Regulations say 'over' (strictly exceeding, entry only); both wordings are given as written and the difference remains unresolved — the Regulations cannot be read as exempting departure or as narrowing the Act's inclusive threshold. The Regulations' wording also omits 'cheques'. The statute writes only '$27,000'; no official definition of the currency is available, so no conversion to US dollars or any other currency is made. This is the s. 89(2)/C169-10 currency report, not a duplicate field of the general baggage declaration. The text is that of the Revised Edition of 15 December 2010 (s. 89(2) amended by Act 15/2010, s. 19); no official confirmation of any later amendment is available.
procedures.applicability_zh: 出入安圭拉（入境或出境）的人，如持有现金（currency）、支票（cheques）或货币票据（monetary instruments）或其任何组合，达‘$27,000 或以上’（of or exceeding，含本数），或任何货币或货币组合的等值，须按 Comptroller 指示的表格与方式申报并作出报告（Customs Act s89(2)(a)）。就入境者，《海关（货币报告）条例》（R.R.A. C169-10）第1条规定：携现金或货币票据合计‘超过 $27,000’（over，严格超过）者，须按 s89(2) 回答 Schedule 表格（或同效表）中的问题。两文本在入境且恰为 $27,000 时不一致：主法为含本数、入出境双向；条例为严格超过、仅入境。两文本按原文并列、冲突未决——不得由条例推出出境免报，也不得以其严格超过收窄主法的含本数。条例措辞亦未列‘支票’。法条仅写 ‘$27,000’，官方未定义币种，故不作美元或其他换算。本项是 s89(2)/C169-10 项下的货币报告，并非一般行李申报表的重复字段。文本出自2010年12月15日修订版重编本（s89(2) 经 2010年第15号法令第19条修正），暂无官方信息确认其后是否修订。
procedures.timing_en: At entry or departure, in such form and manner and containing such particulars as the Comptroller may direct (Customs Act s. 89(2)(a)).
procedures.timing_zh: 出入境时，按 Comptroller 指示的表格、方式与内容要件办理（Customs Act s89(2)(a)）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入境貨幣及貨幣票據報告（Customs Act s89(2)(a)；海關（貨幣報告）條例 C169-10）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 出入安圭拉（入境或出境）的人，如持有現金（currency）、支票（cheques）或貨幣票據（monetary instruments）或其任何組合，達‘$27,000 或以上’（of or exceeding，含本數），或任何貨幣或貨幣組合的等值，須按 Comptroller 指示的表格與方式申報並作出報告（Customs Act s89(2)(a)）。就入境者，《海關（貨幣報告）條例》（R.R.A. C169-10）第1條規定：攜現金或貨幣票據合計‘超過 $27,000’（over，嚴格超過）者，須按 s89(2) 回答 Schedule 表格（或同效表）中的問題。兩文本在入境且恰為 $27,000 時不一致：主法為含本數、入出境雙向；條例為嚴格超過、僅入境。兩文本按原文並列、衝突未決——不得由條例推出出境免報，也不得以其嚴格超過收窄主法的含本數。條例措辭亦未列‘支票’。法條僅寫 ‘$27,000’，官方未定義幣種，故不作美元或其他換算。本項是 s89(2)/C169-10 項下的貨幣報告，並非一般行李申報表的重複欄位。文本出自2010年12月15日修訂版重編本（s89(2) 經 2010年第15號法令第19條修正），暫無官方資訊確認其後是否修訂。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出入境時，按 Comptroller 指示的表格、方式與內容要件辦理（Customs Act s89(2)(a)）。

procedures.name_en: Electronic Immigration and Customs form for airport arrivals (ArriveAntigua.com)
procedures.name_zh: 机场入境电子移民及海关表（ArriveAntigua.com）
procedures.agency: Antigua and Barbuda immigration/customs authorities (operator of ArriveAntigua.com not named on the airport page; passenger guidance published by V.C. Bird International Airport)
procedures.applicability_en: Passengers travelling to Antigua and Barbuda through V.C. Bird International Airport are encouraged to complete their Immigration and Customs declaration online before arrival at www.ArriveAntigua.com; the previous physical ED card has been replaced by this fully integrated electronic system. Once the form is completed a QR code is issued (save a screenshot, add it to iPhone Wallet, or keep the email confirmation available), and all passengers arriving at V.C. Bird International Airport will be asked to present the Arrive Antigua QR code at customs. Assistance is available on arrival for passengers who require support. No app download is required; the form can be completed using a mobile phone, tablet, or computer, and includes a short questionnaire with questions relating to the stay and customs declaration. The page lists faster arrival and departure processing as a use of the QR code, without creating a separate departure procedure. Answering customs questions and declaring goods obtained abroad or in excess of allowances are recorded separately under AG-arrival-customs-declaration and are not waived by the electronic form.
procedures.applicability_zh: 经V.C. Bird国际机场前往安提瓜和巴布达的旅客获鼓励在抵达前于 www.ArriveAntigua.com 在线填写移民及海关申报表；原纸质ED卡已被该一体化电子系统替代。完成后获发二维码（可截图保存、加入iPhone钱包或保留邮件确认），所有抵达V.C. Bird国际机场的旅客在海关处将被要求出示Arrive Antigua二维码。抵达现场为需要协助的旅客提供协助。无需下载App，可用手机、平板或电脑填写；表内含与停留及海关申报有关的简短问卷。页面另将“抵达与出境更快捷”列为出示二维码的用途，但未据此设立单独的出境程序。回答海关提问及申报境外取得物品、超额货物的义务另记于 AG-arrival-customs-declaration，不因电子表而免除。
procedures.timing_en: Within 72 hours of the scheduled flight, before arrival: the same day of travel, the day before travel, or up to three days before travel.
procedures.timing_zh: 预定航班时间前72小时内、抵达前填写：出行当天、前一天或最迟三天前均可。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 機場入境電子移民及海關表（ArriveAntigua.com）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 經V.C. Bird國際機場前往安提瓜和巴布達的旅客獲鼓勵在抵達前於 www.ArriveAntigua.com 線上填寫移民及海關申報表；原紙質ED卡已被該一體化電子系統替代。完成後獲發 QR Code（可截圖保存、加入iPhone錢包或保留郵件確認），所有抵達V.C. Bird國際機場的旅客在海關處將被要求出示Arrive AntiguaQR Code。抵達現場為需要協助的旅客提供協助。無需下載App，可用手機、平板或電腦填寫；表內含與停留及海關申報有關的簡短問卷。頁面另將“抵達與出境更快捷”列為出示 QR Code 的用途，但未據此設立單獨的出境程序。回答海關提問及申報境外取得物品、超額貨物的義務另記於 AG-arrival-customs-declaration，不因電子表而免除。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 預定航班時間前72小時內、抵達前填寫：出行當天、前一天或最遲三天前均可。

procedures.name_en: Arrival Customs Declaration (goods in excess of the duty-free allowance; cash and negotiable instruments over USD 10,000)
procedures.name_zh: 入境海关申报（超免税额货物；超过10,000美元的现金及可转让票据）
procedures.agency: Customs and Excise Division, Antigua and Barbuda (passenger guidance published by V.C. Bird International Airport)
procedures.applicability_en: At V.C. Bird International Airport, arriving passengers proceed to the designated Customs line — the "Nothing to Declare" line, or the "Declare" line if they have something to declare — and should have their Declaration form ready. Per the airport page, the Customs Declaration only needs to be completed by those arriving in Antigua and Barbuda if they have goods in excess of their duty-free allowance; when more than one member of the same household is travelling together, one household member may complete a combined Customs declaration. Cash and negotiable instruments of a value strictly greater than USD $10,000 must be declared to Customs — "cash" includes coins and banknotes in any currency, and "negotiable instruments" include cheques, travellers' cheques, promissory notes, and money orders; the page is arriving-passenger guidance and states no corresponding departure threshold. Separately, the Customs and Excise Division's Airport Baggage Section page states that all persons entering the country are required by law to declare to Customs anything contained in their baggage, or carried with them, which has been obtained outside of Antigua and Barbuda, and to answer all questions asked by the Customs Officer relating to their travels, baggage, contents and other items being imported; this is a general legal duty on all entrants to declare to Customs and answer the officer's questions, not a requirement that every entrant complete the excess-goods Customs Declaration. The same customs page describes the paper combined Immigration/Customs declaration forms distributed at ports of entry and exit, airline and ships agents, and their offices, and advises filling out the declaration in advance of arrival. Neither page states the relationship between the paper combined form and the ArriveAntigua electronic form, nor whether the excess-goods Customs Declaration is completed on paper or within the electronic form; these remain open under AG-audit-3.
procedures.applicability_zh: 在V.C. Bird国际机场，入境旅客前往指定海关队列——“Nothing to Declare”（无申报）队，或如物品须申报则改走“Declare”（申报）队——并应备妥Declaration form（申报表）。按机场页，只有携带超出免税额货物的抵安提瓜和巴布达者才需完成Customs Declaration；同户多名成员同行时，可由一名成员完成合并海关申报。价值严格大于（>）10,000美元（USD $10,000）的现金及可转让票据须向海关申报——“现金”含任何币种的硬币与纸币，“可转让票据”含支票、旅行支票、本票及汇票；该页属入境旅客指引，未陈述对应的出境申报门槛。另据海关及货物税局本域Airport Baggage Section页：所有入境人员依法须向海关申报其行李中或随身携带、在安提瓜和巴布达境外取得的物品，并须回答海关关员就其旅行、行李及内容物与其他进口物品提出的全部问题；此为加于全体入境者“向海关申报并回答关员询问”的一般法定义务，并非要求全体入境者填写超额货物的Customs Declaration。同一海关页述及纸质合并Immigration/Customs申报表于入出境口岸、航司与船舶代理及其办事处发放，并建议抵达前预先填妥。两页均未说明该纸质合并表与ArriveAntigua电子表的关系，亦未说明超额货物Customs Declaration的填写载体（纸质或在电子表内）；两项仍列为未知，记于AG-audit-3。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival customs; the Customs Division page advises completing the declaration in advance of arrival.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时在海关办理；海关及货物税局页建议抵达前预先填妥申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境海關申報（超免稅額貨物；超過10,000美元的現金及可轉讓票據）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 在V.C. Bird國際機場，入境旅客前往指定海關隊列——“Nothing to Declare”（無申報）隊，或如物品須申報則改走“Declare”（申報）隊——並應備妥Declaration form（申報表）。按機場頁，只有攜帶超出免稅額貨物的抵安提瓜和巴布達者才需完成Customs Declaration；同戶多名成員同行時，可由一名成員完成合並海關申報。價值嚴格大於（>）10,000美元（USD $10,000）的現金及可轉讓票據須向海關申報——“現金”含任何幣種的硬幣與紙幣，“可轉讓票據”含支票、旅行支票、本票及匯票；該頁屬入境旅客指引，未陳述對應的出境申報門檻。另據海關及貨物稅局本域Airport Baggage Section頁：所有入境人員依法須向海關申報其行李中或隨身攜帶、在安提瓜和巴布達境外取得的物品，並須回答海關關員就其旅行、行李及內容物與其他進口物品提出的全部問題；此為加於全體入境者“向海關申報並回答關員詢問”的一般法定義務，並非要求全體入境者填寫超額貨物的Customs Declaration。同一海關頁述及紙質合併Immigration/Customs申報表於入出境口岸、航司與船舶代理及其辦事處發放，並建議抵達前預先填妥。兩頁均未說明該紙質合併表與ArriveAntigua電子表的關係，亦未說明超額貨物Customs Declaration的填寫載體（紙質或在電子表內）；兩項仍列為未知，記於AG-audit-3。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時在海關辦理；海關及貨物稅局頁建議抵達前預先填妥申報。

procedures.name_en: Entry and exit money notification (MOT)
procedures.name_zh: 出入境资金通知（MOT）
procedures.agency: Departamento di Aduana (Customs Department), Aruba
procedures.applicability_en: Entering or leaving Aruba with strictly more than AWG 20,000 in cash or securities, including the equivalent in foreign currencies (to be converted into Aruban florins), must be notified to the Customs Department (Departamento di Aduana) with an MOT form (Unusual Transactions form) available at the Customs counter at the airport or harbor. Carrying exactly AWG 20,000 does not trigger the notification duty. You must also report cash or securities that you carry for someone else. The duty applies in both directions, at entry and at exit.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境或出境阿鲁巴时，携带现金或证券严格超过AWG 20,000（即多于20,000阿鲁巴弗罗林；恰为20,000不触发申报义务），含等值外币（须折算为阿鲁巴弗罗林后判断），须向海关部门（Departamento di Aduana）申报：在机场或港口的海关柜台领取并填写MOT表格（Unusual Transactions）。代他人携带的现金或证券同样必须申报。该义务在入境与出境两个方向均适用。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of entry or exit, at the Customs counter at the airport or harbor.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或出境时，在机场或港口的海关柜台办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入境資金通知（MOT）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境或出境阿魯巴時，攜帶現金或證券嚴格超過AWG 20,000（即多於20,000阿魯巴弗羅林；恰為20,000不觸發申報義務），含等值外幣（須折算為阿魯巴弗羅林後判斷），須向海關部門（Departamento di Aduana）申報：在機場或港口的海關櫃檯領取並填寫MOT表格（Unusual Transactions）。代他人攜帶的現金或證券同樣必須申報。該義務在入境與出境兩個方向均適用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或出境時，在機場或港口的海關櫃檯辦理。

procedures.name_en: Passenger goods customs declaration on arrival
procedures.name_zh: 抵境旅客货物海关申报
procedures.agency: Departamento di Aduana (Customs Department), Aruba
procedures.applicability_en: Travelers arriving in Aruba by plane or boat can declare goods orally or in writing at the Customs Department (Departamento di Aduana) counter at the airport or harbor. A written declaration is always required for commercial goods, temporary export goods, and goods for which conditional exemption can be granted. Allowance background only (no separate submission act; goods above the allowances are declared and taxed): used personal goods brought temporarily to Aruba (e.g. clothing or a camera) are free of customs duties; passengers aged 16 or older are entitled to exemption from import and excise duties on passenger luggage — 200 cigarettes or 25 cigars or 50 cigarillos (each weighing not more than 3 grams) or 250 g of tobacco; 1 liter of spirits or 2.25 liters of wine or 3 liters of beer; and other goods up to a total invoice value of AWG 900 (raised from AWG 400 with effect from 1 April 2024). The exemption covers only goods for personal use, not for trade or use in a business or profession; the goods must be in the passenger's own possession, and exemption cannot be claimed for goods brought in as a group. Quantities or values above these maxima incur import and excise duties; certain goods are prohibited or require a permit (e.g. drones, medicines, plants, meat).
procedures.applicability_zh: 乘飞机或船抵达阿鲁巴的旅客，可在机场或港口的海关部门（Departamento di Aduana）柜台以口头或书面方式申报所携货物；商用货物、临时出口货物以及可获有条件免税的货物必须始终书面申报。以下免税额度仅作申报适用背景（额度本身不是提交动作，超出者须申报并缴税）：临时带入阿鲁巴的自用旧物（如衣物、相机）免缴海关税；年满16岁的旅客可就行李获得进口税与消费税免税——烟草为200支香烟或25支雪茄或50支小雪茄（每支不超过3克）或250克烟草，酒类为1升烈酒或2.25升葡萄酒或3升啤酒，其他货物按发票总值最高AWG 900（自2024年4月1日起由AWG 400上调）。该免税仅限自用（非贸易、经营或职业用途）且货物须在旅客本人占有之下，不得多人合并申报免税；超过上述限量或限额须缴进口税及消费税；部分货物禁止携带入境或须许可证（如无人机、药品、植物、肉类）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in Aruba, at the Customs counter at the airport or harbor.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达阿鲁巴时，在机场或港口的海关柜台办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵境旅客貨物海關申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 乘飛機或船抵達阿魯巴的旅客，可在機場或港口的海關部門（Departamento di Aduana）櫃檯以口頭或書面方式申報所攜貨物；商用貨物、臨時出口貨物以及可獲有條件免稅的貨物必須始終書面申報。以下免稅額度僅作申報適用背景（額度本身不是提交動作，超出者須申報並繳稅）：臨時帶入阿魯巴的自用舊物（如衣物、相機）免繳海關稅；年滿16歲的旅客可就行李獲得進口稅與消費稅免稅——菸草為200支香菸或25支雪茄或50支小雪茄（每支不超過3克）或250克菸草，酒類為1升烈酒或2.25升葡萄酒或3升啤酒，其他貨物按發票總值最高AWG 900（自2024年4月1日起由AWG 400上調）。該免稅僅限自用（非貿易、經營或職業用途）且貨物須在旅客本人佔有之下，不得多人合併申報免稅；超過上述限量或限額須繳進口稅及消費稅；部分貨物禁止攜帶入境或須許可證（如無人機、藥品、植物、肉類）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達阿魯巴時，在機場或港口的海關櫃檯辦理。

procedures.name_en: Accompanied baggage declaration (Form C17)
procedures.name_zh: 随行行李申报（C17表）
procedures.agency: Bahamas Customs Department
procedures.applicability_en: For travellers entering The Bahamas. Disembarking passengers must make an oral declaration of all goods they are carrying or which are in their baggage, and complete this form in respect of any goods that are liable to duty; members of a family residing in the same household and travelling together may make a single declaration. A written declaration is required from persons carrying currency or monetary instruments of B$10,000 or more (threshold inclusive) or the foreign-currency equivalent; the reverse of the form defines currency to include cash, travellers cheques and drafts, and directs travellers carrying cash, negotiable instruments, precious metals or precious stones of a value equivalent to B$10,000 or more to read those notes before completing all items. Duty-free allowances: for adults only, alcoholic beverages up to one quart of spirits and one quart of wine, and tobacco up to one pound in weight or 200 cigarettes or 50 cigars; any other articles up to a value of $500.00, which is an allowance and not a filing threshold. The form warns that false or incorrect declarations and prohibited or restricted goods (including fruit or other plant materials, animals, birds, drugs, firearms) attract penalties and possible forfeiture. This 2018 Form C17 replaced the Form C17 in the First Schedule of the Customs Management Regulations 2013 with effect from 1 July 2018 (official Ministry of Finance scan). Based on the 2026 amendment regulations visible on the official yearly listing, this form is not altered; earlier amendment years (2019-2025) have not been individually checked. The form's separate instruction that 'each person or responsible family member travelling is required to complete this form' is broader than the dutiable-goods condition; this does not mean that every arriving traveller must complete a C17. No declaration requirement is established for departures. No form-handling fee is stated; duty paid on dutiable goods is tax, not a form fee.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于入境巴哈马的旅客。下机/下船旅客须就其携带或行李中的所有货物先作口头申报，并仅就应税货物完成本表；同住一户且同行的家庭成员可合并填报一份。携带现金或货币工具达 B$10,000 或以上（含本数）或等值外币者须作书面申报；表背面对 currency 的定义包括现金、旅行支票、汇票等，并提示携带现金、可流通票据、贵金属或宝石价值达 B$10,000 或以上者先读背面说明再填全表。免税优惠：仅限成人——酒精饮料不超过一夸脱烈酒及一夸脱葡萄酒，烟草不超过一磅或200支香烟或50支雪茄；其他物品价值不超过 $500.00，此为免税优惠额度而非填表门槛。表格警示虚假或错误申报及违禁/受限货物（含水果或其他植物材料、动物、鸟类、毒品、枪支）将受处罚并可没收。本2018年版 C17 表自2018年7月1日起替换《2013海关管理条例》第一附表的 C17 表（据财政部官方扫描件）。依据官方年度列表所见2026年修订条例，本表未作改动；2019-2025 年间的修订尚未逐项核对。表中另有”每位旅客或负责任的家庭成员须完成本表”的指示，较应税条件为宽；这并不意味着所有入境旅客一律须填表。未确立离境申报要求。表本身未规定办理手续费；应税货物所缴关税为税款而非表格费用。
procedures.timing_en: On entering The Bahamas (disembarking passengers).
procedures.timing_zh: 入境巴哈马时（下机/下船旅客）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 隨行行李申報（C17表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於入境巴哈馬的旅客。下機/下船旅客須就其攜帶或行李中的所有貨物先作口頭申報，並僅就應稅貨物完成本表；同住一戶且同行的家庭成員可合併填報一份。攜帶現金或貨幣工具達 B$10,000 或以上（含本數）或等值外幣者須作書面申報；表背面對 currency 的定義包括現金、旅行支票、匯票等，並提示攜帶現金、可流通票據、貴金屬或寶石價值達 B$10,000 或以上者先讀背面說明再填全表。免稅優惠：僅限成人——酒精飲料不超過一夸脫烈酒及一夸脫葡萄酒，菸草不超過一磅或200支香菸或50支雪茄；其他物品價值不超過 $500.00，此為免稅優惠額度而非填表門檻。表格警示虛假或錯誤申報及違禁/受限貨物（含水果或其他植物材料、動物、鳥類、毒品、槍支）將受處罰並可沒收。本2018年版 C17 表自2018年7月1日起替換《2013海關管理條例》第一附表的 C17 表（據財政部官方掃描件）。依據官方年度列表所見2026年修訂條例，本表未作改動；2019-2025 年間的修訂尚未逐項核對。表中另有”每位旅客或負責任的家庭成員須完成本表”的指示，較應稅條件為寬；這並不意味著所有入境旅客一律須填表。未確立離境申報要求。表本身未規定辦理手續費；應稅貨物所繳關稅為稅款而非表格費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境巴哈馬時（下機/下船旅客）。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of currency and monetary instruments of B$10,000 or more (Form C17 on arrival; Travellers Currency Declaration on departure)
procedures.name_zh: 携带现金及货币工具 B$10,000 及以上的申报（入境填 C17 表；离境旅客货币申报）
procedures.agency: Bahamas Customs Department
procedures.applicability_en: For travellers carrying currency or monetary instruments into or out of The Bahamas. Arriving: the 2018 Form C17 (Accompanied Baggage Declaration) requires a written declaration from any person carrying currency or a monetary instrument of B$10,000 or more, or the foreign-currency equivalent. The form defines currency as the currency of The Bahamas or of any foreign country, including cash, travellers cheques and drafts, and states that carrying currency or monetary instruments is legal regardless of the amount. Its first page also points travellers carrying cash, negotiable instruments, precious metals or precious stones of that value to the notes on the back. The Customs Department's arrival page says C17 forms are completed through its Exempt app. Departing: the Customs Department's departing page says each person or responsible family member travelling must declare if travelling with cash, negotiable instruments, precious metals or precious stones of a value equivalent to B$10,000. That page names no form and no filing point for departures. Customs says non-compliance can mean forfeiture of the cash plus a fine of up to $2,000. The 2018 form says B$10,000 or more; the departing page does not say whether exactly B$10,000 is included.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于携带现金或货币工具入境或离境巴哈马的旅客。入境：2018 年版 C17 表（随行行李申报表）要求，携带货币或货币工具达 B$10,000 或以上（含本数）或等值外币者须作书面申报。表中货币包括巴哈马或任何外国的货币、现金、旅行支票和汇票等，并说明携带货币或货币工具本身不论金额均合法。表格首页另提示：携带上述价值的现金、可流通票据、贵金属或宝石者，应先阅读表背面说明。海关入境页面称 C17 表通过海关的 Exempt 应用填报。离境：海关离境页面称，每位旅客或负责任的家庭成员若携带现金、可流通票据、贵金属或宝石，价值相当于 B$10,000，须申报；该页未写明离境所用表格或申报地点。海关称，违规者可能被没收现金，并另处最高 $2,000 罚款。2018 年表格写明“B$10,000 或以上”；离境页面未写明恰为 B$10,000 时是否包括在内。
procedures.timing_en: On entering The Bahamas, with the C17 declaration. On leaving, the departing page does not say at which point the declaration is made.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时随 C17 表申报；离境时，离境页面未写明在哪个环节申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 攜帶現金及貨幣工具 B$10,000 及以上的申報（入境填 C17 表；離境旅客貨幣申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於攜帶現金或貨幣工具入境或離境巴哈馬的旅客。入境：2018 年版 C17 表（隨行行李申報表）要求，攜帶貨幣或貨幣工具達 B$10,000 或以上（含本數）或等值外幣者須作書面申報。表中貨幣包括巴哈馬或任何外國的貨幣、現金、旅行支票和匯票等，並說明攜帶貨幣或貨幣工具本身不論金額均合法。表格首頁另提示：攜帶上述價值的現金、可流通票據、貴金屬或寶石者，應先閱讀表背面說明。海關入境頁面稱 C17 表通過海關的 Exempt 應用填報。離境：海關離境頁面稱，每位旅客或負責任的家庭成員若攜帶現金、可流通票據、貴金屬或寶石，價值相當於 B$10,000，須申報；該頁未寫明離境所用表格或申報地點。海關稱，違規者可能被沒收現金，並另處最高 $2,000 罰款。2018 年表格寫明“B$10,000 或以上”；離境頁面未寫明恰為 B$10,000 時是否包括在內。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時隨 C17 表申報；離境時，離境頁面未寫明在哪個環節申報。

procedures.name_en: Online Immigration and Customs Form (single combined submission, including passenger customs declaration Form C.23)
procedures.name_zh: 在线移民与海关合并表（一次提交，含C.23旅客海关申报）
procedures.agency: Barbados Immigration Department (online form portal) and Customs & Excise Department (Form C.23 under Customs Act Cap. 66)
procedures.applicability_en: All travellers to Barbados complete one online Immigration and Customs Form and, once completed, save or print the Immigration and Customs receipts for presentation on arrival — the two receipts belong to this single submission, not two procedures. The customs part is Form C.23 (Passenger Customs Declaration, Customs Act Cap. 66, as substituted by the Customs (Amendment) Regulations 2020): every traveller, or head of a family travelling with children under 18, must complete a Customs Form. Its Yes/No questions cover pieces of luggage; fruits, plants, cut flowers, vegetables, soil, meat, live animals and organisms, honey, wildlife products, plant material, food; pharmaceuticals; narcotics and other illicit drugs, biological substances, arms, ammunition, explosives and other weapons; commercial merchandise; and carrying currency or monetary instruments over BDS$10,000 or equivalent — a question inside the same submission, not a separate form. It also asks citizens/residents aged 18 or more whether they have claimed the duty exemption on goods up to BDS$500 per calendar year; all passengers aged 18 or more may bring wine or spirits not exceeding 1 litre.
procedures.applicability_zh: 所有赴巴巴多斯旅客须完成一份在线移民与海关合并表，完成后将移民与海关两份回执存入手机或打印、抵达时出示——两份回执同属一次提交，不拆成两个程序。海关部分即C.23旅客海关申报表（海关法Cap. 66，经2020年《海关（修订）条例》替换）：表载明每位旅客或携未满18岁子女同行的家长须完成海关表。是/否问项涵盖行李件数；水果、植物、切花、蔬菜、土壤、肉类、活体动物及生物、蜂蜜、野生动植物产品、植物材料、食品；药品；麻醉品及其他毒品、生物制品、枪械、弹药、爆炸物及其他武器；商业物品；以及携带超过10,000巴巴多斯元（BDS$10,000）等值的现金或票据——该现金点仅是同一份提交内的问项，不另立表格。表内另问18岁及以上公民/居民本年度是否已申报过每历年不超过500巴巴多斯元（BDS$500）的免税额；所有18岁及以上旅客可携葡萄酒或烈酒不超过1升。
procedures.timing_en: The online form will be available 72 hours prior to arrival in Barbados; travellers fill it in at a time and place convenient to them and present the two receipts to Immigration and Customs on arrival. The 72 hours marks when the online window opens, not a deadline to file 72 hours in advance; neither source states an advance-filing deadline. The 2020 regulation sets no time window for Form C.23.
procedures.timing_zh: 在线合并表自抵达巴巴多斯前72小时起开放可用；旅客可在方便的时间与地点填写，抵达时向移民与海关出示两份回执。72小时是在线窗口的开放时点，并非必须提前72小时提交；两源均未载提前提交截止时限。2020年条例对C.23表未设时间窗。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 線上移民與海關合並表（一次提交，含C.23旅客海關申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 所有赴巴巴多斯旅客須完成一份線上移民與海關合並表，完成後將移民與海關兩份回執存入手機或列印、抵達時出示——兩份回執同屬一次提交，不拆成兩個程序。海關部分即C.23旅客海關申報表（海關法Cap. 66，經2020年《海關（修訂）條例》替換）：表載明每位旅客或攜未滿18歲子女同行的家長鬚完成海關表。是/否問項涵蓋行李件數；水果、植物、切花、蔬菜、土壤、肉類、活體動物及生物、蜂蜜、野生動植物產品、植物材料、食品；藥品；麻醉品及其他毒品、生物製品、槍械、彈藥、爆炸物及其他武器；商業物品；以及攜帶超過10,000巴巴多斯元（BDS$10,000）等值的現金或票據——該現金點僅是同一份提交內的問項，不另立表格。表內另問18歲及以上公民/居民本年度是否已申報過每歷年不超過500巴巴多斯元（BDS$500）的免稅額；所有18歲及以上旅客可攜葡萄酒或烈酒不超過1升。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 線上合併表自抵達巴巴多斯前72小時起開放可用；旅客可在方便的時間與地點填寫，抵達時向移民與海關出示兩份回執。72小時是線上窗口的開放時點，並非必須提前72小時提交；兩源均未載提前提交截止時限。2020年條例對C.23表未設時間窗。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of currency and monetary instruments over BDS$10,000 (Customs Form C.23 question; report under the Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism Act, section 24)
procedures.name_zh: 携带现金及货币工具超过 BDS$10,000 的申报（海关 C.23 表问项；《反洗钱和反恐融资法》第24条报告）
procedures.agency: Barbados Customs and Excise Department
procedures.applicability_en: Applies to a traveller entering or leaving Barbados with currency or monetary instruments. Arriving: the passenger Customs declaration (Form C.23, Customs Act Cap. 66) completed in the online Immigration and Customs Form asks whether the traveller is carrying currency or monetary instruments over BDS$10,000 or equivalent. Every traveller, or head of a family travelling with children under 18, completes the Customs form, which is part of the same online submission. Under section 24 of the Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism (Prevention and Control) Act, 2011-23, a person who takes Barbadian or foreign currency into or out of Barbados in an amount of more than $10,000 in value must make a signed report in the form approved by the Anti-Money Laundering Authority, unless permission for the transfer was obtained under the Exchange Control Act. When the currency travels on the person, in luggage or as cargo, the report goes to the Comptroller of Customs at the time the currency is brought in or taken out. For a passenger leaving by aircraft or vessel, currency counts as taken out on reaching the customs area for embarking passengers, or otherwise the immigration officer who examines the passport. Failing to report is an offence punishable by a fine and imprisonment (up to $200,000 or five years on indictment). The Act speaks of 'currency'; the C.23 question also names monetary instruments. The Act does not name the departure form, and the C.23 form covers arrivals only.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于携带现金或货币工具入境或离开巴巴多斯的旅客。入境：在线移民与海关表中的旅客海关申报（C.23表，《海关法》第66章）询问旅客是否携带超过 BDS$10,000 或等值的货币或货币工具。每位旅客，或携 18 岁以下儿童同行的家长，均须填写海关表，因此该问项在同一次在线提交中作答。依据《反洗钱和反恐融资（预防和控制）法》2011-23 第24条，任何人将巴巴多斯货币或外币带入或带出巴巴多斯，金额超过 $10,000 的，须按反洗钱管理局核准的格式作出并签署报告，除非已依《外汇管制法》取得转移许可。货币随身、在行李中或作为货物携带时，报告在货币带入或带出时向海关总监提交。乘飞机或船离境者，在到达海关人员处理登机/登船旅客的区域时，或（无此区域时）到达查验护照的移民官处时，视为带出货币。不报告属犯罪：简易程序定罪可处 $10,000 罚款或两年监禁，公诉程序定罪可处 $200,000 罚款或五年监禁。商业承运人无须报告其乘客所携货币。法律条文用“货币”一词，C.23 问项另列货币工具。法律未写明出境所用表格，C.23 表只涉及入境。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, as part of the online Immigration and Customs Form. For the section 24 report, at the time the currency is brought into or taken out of Barbados.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时随在线移民与海关表作答；第24条报告须在货币带入或带出巴巴多斯时提交。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 攜帶現金及貨幣工具超過 BDS$10,000 的申報（海關 C.23 表問項；《反洗錢和反恐融資法》第24條報告）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於攜帶現金或貨幣工具入境或離開巴巴多斯的旅客。入境：線上移民與海關表中的旅客海關申報（C.23表，《海關法》第66章）詢問旅客是否攜帶超過 BDS$10,000 或等值的貨幣或貨幣工具。每位旅客，或攜 18 歲以下兒童同行的家長，均須填寫海關表，因此該問項在同一次線上提交中作答。依據《反洗錢和反恐融資（預防和控制）法》2011-23 第24條，任何人將巴巴多斯貨幣或外幣帶入或帶出巴巴多斯，金額超過 $10,000 的，須按反洗錢管理局核准的格式作出並簽署報告，除非已依《外匯管制法》取得轉移許可。貨幣隨身、在行李中或作為貨物攜帶時，報告在貨幣帶入或帶出時向海關總監提交。乘飛機或船離境者，在到達海關人員處理登機/登船旅客的區域時，或（無此區域時）到達查驗護照的移民官處時，視為帶出貨幣。不報告屬犯罪：簡易程序定罪可處 $10,000 罰款或兩年監禁，公訴程序定罪可處 $200,000 罰款或五年監禁。商業承運人無須報告其乘客所攜貨幣。法律條文用“貨幣”一詞，C.23 問項另列貨幣工具。法律未寫明出境所用表格，C.23 表只涉及入境。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時隨線上移民與海關表作答；第24條報告須在貨幣帶入或帶出巴巴多斯時提交。
