procedures.name_en: Immigration/Customs C5 Passenger Declaration (Electronic C5 via enterjamaica.gov.jm; physical card also accepted per PICA)
procedures.name_zh: 入境/海关C5旅客申报表（经enterjamaica.gov.jm电子C5；PICA亦接受实物卡）
procedures.agency: Jamaica Customs Agency (JCA) with Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency (PICA)
procedures.applicability_en: Since 1 September 2023 JCA mandates that all arriving passengers complete and submit an Electronic Passenger Declaration (C5) via enterjamaica.gov.jm for final clearance at its international airports, free of charge to visitors and residents (PICA helpdesk FAQ likewise states the online C5 is free). PICA's current travel-documents page requires every traveller entering Jamaica to present a completed and signed Immigration/Customs C5 form, either online or a physical form. The C5 itself asks whether the traveller carries currency or monetary instruments over US$10,000 or equivalent — a question on the same form, distinct from the separate POCA CTR filing — and whether goods exceed the personal duty-free allowance or include gifts/articles for resale. Duty-concession eligibility involves no separate submission: per the JCA Passenger Allowance page, passengers aged 18+ may receive an additional concession for other personal/household effects up to US$1,000 total value, not applicable to aircraft/ship crew; the 2020 paper C5 card instead prints a US$500 duty-free allowance plus duty-free tobacco/alcohol (200 cigarettes or 50 cigars or 230g tobacco; 1L spirits; 1L wine; 170ml perfumed spirits; 340ml toilet water) — the amount version skew is not reconciled here.
procedures.applicability_zh: JCA规定自2023年9月1日起所有入境旅客须经enterjamaica.gov.jm完成并提交电子C5以在国际机场完成通关，访客与居民均免费（PICA客服FAQ亦明示线上C5免费）。PICA现行旅行证件页要求所有入境牙买加旅客出示已完成并签署的入境/海关C5表，线上或实物表均可。C5表内即询问是否携带超过10,000美元或等值现金/货币工具——此为同表问项，有别于独立的POCA CTR报告——并询问物品是否超过个人免税额或含转售礼品。关税优惠属资格认定、无独立提交程序：JCA Passenger Allowance页载18岁及以上旅客对其他个人/家用物品可获总额不超过1,000美元的额外优惠，飞机/船舶机组不适用；2020版纸质C5卡则印US$500免税额及免税烟酒量（200支香烟或50支雪茄或230克烟草、1升烈酒、1升葡萄酒、170毫升香水酒精及340毫升花露水）——两额版本差异此处未调和。
procedures.timing_en: The online C5 may be completed up to 30 days before arrival; PICA also allows completing it on arrival at the airport (airport Wi-Fi, tablets and staff assistance available). No mandatory advance-filing window is stated.
procedures.timing_zh: 线上C5最早可于到达前30天内填写；PICA亦允许到达后在机场现场完成（提供Wi-Fi、平板与人员协助）。官方未规定必须提前提交的硬性时限。

fee.note: JCA页面明示访客与居民免费，PICA客服FAQ同证；free per JCA passenger page and PICA helpdesk FAQ.

procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境/海關C5旅客申報表（經enterjamaica.gov.jm電子C5；PICA亦接受實物卡）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: JCA規定自2023年9月1日起所有入境旅客須經enterjamaica.gov.jm完成並提交電子C5以在國際機場完成通關，訪客與居民均免費（PICA客服FAQ亦明示線上C5免費）。PICA現行旅行證件頁要求所有入境牙買加旅客出示已完成並簽署的入境/海關C5表，線上或實物表均可。C5表內即詢問是否攜帶超過10,000美元或等值現金/貨幣工具——此為同表問項，有別於獨立的POCA CTR報告——並詢問物品是否超過個人免稅額或含轉售禮品。關稅優惠屬資格認定、無獨立提交程序：JCA Passenger Allowance頁載18歲及以上旅客對其他個人/家用物品可獲總額不超過1,000美元的額外優惠，飛機/船舶機組不適用；2020版紙質C5卡則印US$500免稅額及免稅菸酒量（200支香菸或50支雪茄或230克菸草、1升烈酒、1升葡萄酒、170毫升香水酒精及340毫升花露水）——兩額版本差異此處未調和。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 線上C5最早可於到達前30天內填寫；PICA亦允許到達後在機場現場完成（提供Wi-Fi、平板與人員協助）。官方未規定必須提前提交的硬性時限。

procedures.name_en: POCA Section 101 CTR — Report of International Transportation of Currency or Bearer-Negotiable Instruments (traveller filing)
procedures.name_zh: POCA第101条CTR——跨境现金或无记名可转让票据国际运输报告（旅客提交）
procedures.agency: Financial Investigations Division (FID), Ministry of Finance and the Public Service; traveller CTR filed with the Customs Officer in charge of the port of entry or departure
procedures.applicability_en: Official FID form stating the report is required by Section 101(2) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2007: every person who transports or causes the transportation of cash into or out of Jamaica exceeding US$10,000 (or its equivalent in any other currency) must report. Header: 'Declaration of Cash or BNI Exceeding US$10,000 or its equivalent in any other currency'. Part II is completed by persons entering/departing Jamaica, and 'WHEN AND WHERE TO FILE' directs travellers to file the CTR with the Customs Officer in charge of the port of entry or departure — a separate filing from the C5's same-form currency question. FID (October 2025): carrying cash across borders is not illegal, but any amount over US$10,000 must be declared with clear proof of source and purpose. Whether exactly US$10,000 triggers the duty remains unresolved; the verified wording is 'exceeding'/'over'. The form's shipper/mailer and person-in-charge-of-conveyance parts are cargo procedures, not traveller steps.
procedures.applicability_zh: FID官方表载明本报告依据《2007年犯罪收益法》第101(2)条：任何人将超过10,000美元（或等值其他货币）现金运入或运出牙买加均须报告。表头为'DECLARATION OF CASH OR BNI EXCEEDING US$10,000 OR IT'S EQUIVALENT IN ANY OTHER CURRENCY'。第II部分由入/离牙买加人员填写，'WHEN AND WHERE TO FILE'指引旅客向入/出境港口主管海关官员提交CTR表——此为独立于C5同表现金问项的另一提交。FID（2025年10月）：跨境携带现金不违法，但超过10,000美元的任何金额均须申报并清楚证明来源与用途。恰好10,000美元是否触发义务仍未决（已核措辞为exceeding/over）。表的寄件人/货运及运输工具负责人部分属货运程序，非旅客步骤。
procedures.timing_en: Stated as the form's own two separate provisions, not merged into one step: WHO MUST REPORT quotes the statutory requirement to report 'before the transportation takes place' to the Chief Technical Director of the Financial Investigations Division; WHEN AND WHERE TO FILE (A) directs travellers entering or leaving Jamaica to file the CTR form with the Customs Officer in charge of the port of entry or departure. The same page does not state how these two timings reconcile for an inbound traveller, so no definite 'file with Jamaica port customs before transportation begins' step is asserted.
procedures.timing_zh: 仅按表内两项原文分别转述，不合并为单一确定步骤：WHO MUST REPORT引法定措辞，须在运输发生前（'before the transportation takes place'）向金融调查部总技术主任（Chief Technical Director, FID）报告；WHEN AND WHERE TO FILE (A)指引进/离牙买加旅客向入/离境港口主管海关官员提交CTR表。同页未说明入境旅客两项时点如何调和，故不把'赴牙买加运输开始前须向牙买加港口海关提交'写成确定步骤。
procedures.name_zh_hant: POCA第101條CTR——跨境現金或無記名可轉讓票據國際運輸報告（旅客提交）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: FID官方表載明本報告依據《2007年犯罪收益法》第101(2)條：任何人將超過10,000美元（或等值其他貨幣）現金運入或運出牙買加均須報告。表頭為'DECLARATION OF CASH OR BNI EXCEEDING US$10,000 OR IT'S EQUIVALENT IN ANY OTHER CURRENCY'。第II部分由入/離牙買加人員填寫，'WHEN AND WHERE TO FILE'指引旅客向入/出境港口主管海關官員提交CTR表——此為獨立於C5同表現金問項的另一提交。FID（2025年10月）：跨境攜帶現金不違法，但超過10,000美元的任何金額均須申報並清楚證明來源與用途。恰好10,000美元是否觸發義務仍未決（已核措辭為exceeding/over）。表的寄件人/貨運及運輸工具負責人部分屬貨運程序，非旅客步驟。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 僅按表內兩項原文分別轉述，不合併為單一確定步驟：WHO MUST REPORT引法定措辭，須在運輸發生前（'before the transportation takes place'）向金融調查部總技術主任（Chief Technical Director, FID）報告；WHEN AND WHERE TO FILE (A)指引進/離牙買加旅客向入/離境港口主管海關官員提交CTR表。同頁未說明入境旅客兩項時點如何調和，故不把'赴牙買加運輸開始前須向牙買加港口海關提交'寫成確定步驟。

procedures.name_en: Martinique arrival goods declaration above traveller allowances
procedures.name_zh: 马提尼克入境超额物品申报
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (French Customs) — Direction régionale de Martinique
procedures.applicability_en: Martinique is a French overseas department (DOM) inside the EU customs territory but a separate fiscal territory (treated as third territory fiscally, including towards metropolitan France). On arrival or return you must declare goods bought or received as gifts once their value or quantities exceed the allowances and pay the duties and taxes due. Arriving from metropolitan France or another EU country: no customs duty; TVA, octroi de mer and octroi de mer régional are due above the allowance, and no tax is due while the goods' value is EUR 1,000 or less. Arriving from a non-EU country: customs duty (flat-rate 2.5% option or product-specific taxation), TVA and octroi de mer / octroi de mer régional; no duty or tax while the value is EUR 150 or less for travellers under 15, or EUR 430 or less for travellers aged 15 or over. Octroi de mer rates are set locally (indicatively 7-15%, significantly higher up to 20/25/50% for some goods) and octroi de mer régional is 1.5% or 2.5%. Quantity franchises for both origins: 200 cigarettes, or 100 cigarillos, or 50 cigars, or 250 g smoking tobacco; 4 litres still wine and 16 litres beer; plus either 1 litre of beverages over 22 degrees or 2 litres at 22 degrees or below; proportional assortment allowed within one category. Travellers under 17 have no tobacco or alcohol franchise at all. Value allowances cannot be pooled across persons for a single item, and an item above the threshold is taxed on its full value. Allowance amounts are set by the EU and may change during the year. These duties and taxes are taxes on the goods, not a fee for making the declaration; the page states no service fee and names no specific traveller form or red/green channel.
procedures.applicability_zh: 马提尼克为法国海外省（DOM），属欧盟关税领土，但财政上为独立税区（对法国本土亦视同第三方财政领土）。抵达或返回时，自购或受赠物品超过相应价值或数量额度即须申报并缴纳税费。来自法国本土或其他欧盟成员国：无关税；超过额度部分需缴 TVA、octroi de mer 与 octroi de mer régional，物品总值不超过1,000欧元（含本数）免税。来自非欧盟国家：可能需缴关税（可选2.5%包税税率或按产品计税）、TVA 及 octroi de mer / octroi de mer régional；总值不超过150欧元（含本数，未满15岁）或不超过430欧元（含本数，满15岁及以上）免税。octroi de mer 税率由地方确定（指示性7–15%，部分商品显著更高，最高20/25/50%），octroi de mer régional 为1.5%或2.5%。数量额度（两种来源相同）：香烟200支，或小雪茄100支，或雪茄50支，或烟丝250克；静止葡萄酒（vins tranquilles）4升且啤酒16升；另加高于22度饮品1升或22度及以下2升；同类别内可按比例搭配。未满17岁完全不得免税进口烟草或酒精饮品。价值额度不可多人合并用于单件物品，超限物品按全部价值计税。额度金额由欧盟确定，年内可能调整。上述关税与税款属货物税费，并非申报本身的服务费；页面未载服务费，也未给出具体旅客申报表单或红绿通道。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival or return to Martinique (French Antilles); the page gives no advance-filing window and names no specific form or red/green channel.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达或返回马提尼克（法属安的列斯）时；页面未给出提前申报窗口，也未列具体表单或红绿通道。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 馬提尼克入境超額物品申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 馬提尼克為法國海外省（DOM），屬歐盟關稅領土，但財政上為獨立稅區（對法國本土亦視同第三方財政領土）。抵達或返回時，自購或受贈物品超過相應價值或數量額度即須申報並繳納稅費。來自法國本土或其他歐盟成員國：無關稅；超過額度部分需繳 TVA、octroi de mer 與 octroi de mer régional，物品總值不超過1,000歐元（含本數）免稅。來自非歐盟國家：可能需繳關稅（可選2.5%包稅稅率或按產品計稅）、TVA 及 octroi de mer / octroi de mer régional；總值不超過150歐元（含本數，未滿15歲）或不超過430歐元（含本數，滿15歲及以上）免稅。octroi de mer 稅率由地方確定（指示性7–15%，部分商品顯著更高，最高20/25/50%），octroi de mer régional 為1.5%或2.5%。數量額度（兩種來源相同）：香菸200支，或小雪茄100支，或雪茄50支，或菸絲250克；靜止葡萄酒（vins tranquilles）4升且啤酒16升；另加高於22度飲品1升或22度及以下2升；同類別內可按比例搭配。未滿17歲完全不得免稅進口菸草或酒精飲品。價值額度不可多人合併用於單件物品，超限物品按全部價值計稅。額度金額由歐盟確定，年內可能調整。上述關稅與稅款屬貨物稅費，並非申報本身的服務費；頁面未載服務費，也未給出具體旅客申報表單或紅綠通道。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達或返回馬提尼克（法屬安的列斯）時；頁面未給出提前申報窗口，也未列具體表單或紅綠通道。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of transported cash of EUR 10,000 or more to/from Martinique
procedures.name_zh: 马提尼克随身现金申报（等于或超过1万欧元）
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (French Customs) — DALIA teleservice
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers carrying cash of EUR 10,000 or more (or the equivalent in foreign currency) must declare it to French Customs: banknotes and coins, bearer-negotiable instruments (bearer cheques, travellers' cheques, money orders, promissory notes, etc.), gold, and — for intra-EU flows only — prepaid cards. It applies to any person, resident or not; transporting for a third party additionally requires identifying the owner; minors declare through their legal representatives. For Martinique (a DROM): cash transports between Martinique and a foreign country — another EU member state or a third country — must be declared; the extra-EU regime uses the harmonised EU form and the intra-EU regime the national FR form, and both expressly cover the DOM/DROM. Transports between metropolitan France and a DROM are outside the obligation; Martinique's separate fiscal-territory status for goods is not a cash border. DROM-to-DROM (e.g. Martinique-Guadeloupe) and DROM-to-COM movements are not addressed on these pages and are not asserted. Bank and interbank transfers are not covered. Non-declaration, false declaration or non-presentation: fine of up to 50% of the sum involved and temporary retention of the cash. No declaration may be filed a posteriori as regularisation.
procedures.applicability_zh: 随身携带等于或超过1万欧元（或等值外币）现金的旅客须向法国海关申报：范围包括纸币与硬币、无记名可转让票据（不记名支票、旅行支票、汇票、本票等）、黄金；预付卡仅限欧盟内部流动适用。任何人均适用（无论是否法国居民）；替他人携带须补充识别资金所有人；未成年人经法定代理人申报。就马提尼克（海外省 DROM）而言：马提尼克与外国（其他欧盟成员国或第三国）之间的现金运输须申报；非欧盟流动适用欧盟统一表格（EU 表），欧盟内部流动适用法国国家表格（FR 表），两者均明文覆盖 DOM/DROM。法国本土与 DROM 之间的现金运输不在申报义务范围；马提尼克的货物财政边界不是现金申报边界。DROM↔DROM（如马提尼克—瓜德罗普）及 DROM↔COM 流动未见两页明文，不予断言。银行转账与银行间转账不适用。未申报、虚假申报或不出示：可处涉案金额最高50%罚款并临时扣押现金。不得事后补报作正规化。
procedures.timing_en: Online via the DALIA teleservice: from 30 days before the transport date at the earliest, and at the latest before crossing the border on the day of travel; alternatively at the customs service at the moment of entry or exit; no filing a posteriori.
procedures.timing_zh: 经 DALIA 在线申报：最早为运输日期前30天，最迟为旅行当日越境前；亦可于入境或离境时在现场海关办理；不得事后补报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 馬提尼克隨身現金申報（等於或超過1萬歐元）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 隨身攜帶等於或超過1萬歐元（或等值外幣）現金的旅客須向法國海關申報：範圍包括紙幣與硬幣、無記名可轉讓票據（不記名支票、旅行支票、匯票、本票等）、黃金；預付卡僅限歐盟內部流動適用。任何人均適用（無論是否法國居民）；替他人攜帶須補充識別資金所有人；未成年人經法定代理人申報。就馬提尼克（海外省 DROM）而言：馬提尼克與外國（其他歐盟成員國或第三國）之間的現金運輸須申報；非歐盟流動適用歐盟統一表格（EU 表），歐盟內部流動適用法國國家表格（FR 表），兩者均明文覆蓋 DOM/DROM。法國本土與 DROM 之間的現金運輸不在申報義務範圍；馬提尼克的貨物財政邊界不是現金申報邊界。DROM↔DROM（如馬提尼克—瓜德羅普）及 DROM↔COM 流動未見兩頁明文，不予斷言。銀行轉賬與銀行間轉賬不適用。未申報、虛假申報或不出示：可處涉案金額最高50%罰款並臨時扣押現金。不得事後補報作正規化。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 經 DALIA 線上申報：最早為運輸日期前30天，最遲為旅行當日越境前；亦可於入境或離境時在現場海關辦理；不得事後補報。

procedures.name_en: Statutory IMMIGRATION/CUSTOMS FORM card (Schedule 5, Sections A-C), including currency over US$10,000
procedures.name_zh: 法定移民/海关联合卡（附表5，A-C部分，含超US$10,000现金申报）
procedures.agency: Montserrat Customs and Revenue Service / Immigration Department
procedures.applicability_en: Under CAP. 17.04 Customs and Excise (Control and Management), Revision 1 Jan 2025, the form prescribed in Schedule 5 (Sections 27, 85 and 87) is one combined IMMIGRATION/CUSTOMS FORM card: Section A Arrival Record, Section B Departure Record (retained by the passenger and presented on departure) and Section C Customs Declaration are completed on the same card, printed in black or blue ink - a single real arrival submission merging immigration and customs data, with no second statutory cash form. Section 87(2) requires every passenger entering Montserrat, or the head of a family travelling together with children under the age of 18, to complete Section C (the family rule covers only a head of family travelling with under-18 children on the same journey, not families generally); s. 87(1) requires each person entering to declare, as the Comptroller directs, anything in the baggage or carried with him obtained outside Montserrat or obtained locally without payment of duty, and this merges into the same Section C rather than a separate procedure. Section C covers accompanying spouse/children under 18, accompanied and unaccompanied luggage, prohibited categories (plants/food, pharmaceuticals/drugs, arms), commercial merchandise, and the general passenger allowances (wines/spirits up to 40 oz; tobacco up to half a pound, cigars up to 50 or cigarettes up to 200). Currency: s. 27(1) (inserted by Act 3 of 2010, amended by Acts 20 of 2010 and 12 of 2023) requires a person who enters Montserrat with currency or monetary instruments over US$10,000 or the equivalent to declare this fact by completing the same form prescribed in Schedule 5 - the question is item 5 of Section C ('over US$10,000.00 or equivalent'); the threshold is strictly 'over', so carrying exactly US$10,000 does not trigger s. 27. Under s. 27(2) the person must also provide a customs officer with information on the origin and intended use of the currency, which is recorded with identification data and submitted to the Financial Intelligence Unit; Schedule 5 defines monetary instruments as coins, currency, travellers cheques and bearer instruments such as personal or cashier cheques and stocks and bonds. The law states this cash declaration duty for entry only; its provisions name no matching exit-side cash declaration. Background powers inside the same arrival processing, not separate procedures: under s. 87(3) persons entering or leaving must answer Customs and Excise Unit questions and produce baggage for examination, and failure to declare under s. 87 is an offence punishable by a fine of $5,000 or three times the duty payable, whichever is greater (s. 87(4)). The online ED portal and kiosks announced in 2024 were announced as plans; whether they operate today has no official confirmation, so they are not treated here as a current channel.
procedures.applicability_zh: 依2025年1月1日修订版《海关与消费税（管制与管理）》法典CAP. 17.04（附表5适用于第27、85、87条），附表5规定的表格是一张移民/海关联合卡（IMMIGRATION/CUSTOMS FORM）：A部抵达记录、B部离境记录（旅客留存、离境时出示）与C部海关申报同在一张卡上，须以黑色或蓝色笔印刷体填写——一次真实到达提交即合并移民与海关资料，法律上不存在第二张单独现金表。第87(2)条规定每名入境旅客，或与未满18岁子女同行的一家之主，须完成C部（家庭规则仅覆盖同一次旅行中带未满18岁子女的一家之主，不泛化所有家庭）；第87(1)条要求每名入境者按税务总监指示申报行李中或随身携带的境外取得物品、或在本地未完税取得的应税物品，同样并入同一C部，而非另立程序。C部涵盖同行配偶/未满18岁子女、随身及非随身行李、禁限类别（植物/食品、药品/毒品、武器）、商业货物及一般旅客免税额（酒不超过40盎司；烟草不超过半磅、雪茄不超过50支或香烟不超过200支）。现金：第27(1)条（2010年第3号法插入，2010年第20号及2023年第12号法修订）规定入境蒙特塞拉特的人携带超过US$10,000或等值的现金或货币工具，须填写同一张附表5规定表格申报此事实——该问题即C部第5项（“over US$10,000.00 or equivalent”）；门槛为严格“超过”，恰好携带US$10,000不触发第27条。依第27(2)条，该人还须向海关关员提供现金来源及预期用途信息，由关员记录身份等数据并提交金融情报组（FIU）；附表5界定货币工具包括硬币、现金、旅行支票及不记名票据如个人/银行本票、股票与债券。该现金申报义务仅适用于入境；该法条款中未见对应的离境现金申报。同一抵达流程内的背景权力（非单独程序）：第87(3)条要求入境或离境者回答海关消费税单位询问并按需交验行李；违反第87条申报义务属犯罪，可处5,000美元或三倍应纳税款罚金，取其高者（第87(4)条）。2024年公告的在线ED门户与自助机属公告中的计划；其是否已实际运行尚无官方确认，故不作为现行渠道列出。
procedures.timing_en: The combined card is completed on arrival and submitted to the proper officer on duty at the port or airport (s. 27(1)); Section B (Departure Record) is retained by the passenger and presented on departure.
procedures.timing_zh: 联合卡于抵达时填写，并在港口或机场提交值班关员（第27(1)条）；B部（离境记录）由旅客留存，离境时出示。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 法定移民/海關聯合卡（附表5，A-C部分，含超US$10,000現金申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 依2025年1月1日修訂版《海關與消費稅（管制與管理）》法典CAP. 17.04（附表5適用於第27、85、87條），附表5規定的表格是一張移民/海關聯合卡（IMMIGRATION/CUSTOMS FORM）：A部抵達記錄、B部離境記錄（旅客留存、離境時出示）與C部海關申報同在一張卡上，須以黑色或藍色筆印刷體填寫——一次真實到達提交即合併移民與海關資料，法律上不存在第二張單獨現金錶。第87(2)條規定每名入境旅客，或與未滿18歲子女同行的一家之主，須完成C部（家庭規則僅覆蓋同一次旅行中帶未滿18歲子女的一家之主，不泛化所有家庭）；第87(1)條要求每名入境者按稅務總監指示申報行李中或隨身攜帶的境外取得物品、或在本地未完稅取得的應稅物品，同樣併入同一C部，而非另立程序。C部涵蓋同行配偶/未滿18歲子女、隨身及非隨身行李、禁限類別（植物/食品、藥品/毒品、武器）、商業貨物及一般旅客免稅額（酒不超過40盎司；菸草不超過半磅、雪茄不超過50支或香菸不超過200支）。現金：第27(1)條（2010年第3號法插入，2010年第20號及2023年第12號法修訂）規定入境蒙特塞拉特的人攜帶超過US$10,000或等值的現金或貨幣工具，須填寫同一張附表5規定表格申報此事實——該問題即C部第5項（“over US$10,000.00 or equivalent”）；門檻為嚴格“超過”，恰好攜帶US$10,000不觸發第27條。依第27(2)條，該人還須向海關關員提供現金來源及預期用途資訊，由關員記錄身份等資料並提交金融情報組（FIU）；附表5界定貨幣工具包括硬幣、現金、旅行支票及不記名票據如個人/銀行本票、股票與債券。該現金申報義務僅適用於入境；該法條款中未見對應的離境現金申報。同一抵達流程內的背景權力（非單獨程序）：第87(3)條要求入境或離境者回答海關消費稅單位詢問並按需交驗行李；違反第87條申報義務屬犯罪，可處5,000美元或三倍應納稅款罰金，取其高者（第87(4)條）。2024年公告的線上ED門戶與自助機屬公告中的計劃；其是否已實際運行尚無官方確認，故不作為現行渠道列出。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 聯合卡於抵達時填寫，並在港口或機場提交值班關員（第27(1)條）；B部（離境記錄）由旅客留存，離境時出示。

procedures.name_en: CBP declaration for articles entering Puerto Rico from outside the U.S. customs territory
procedures.name_zh: 物品自美国关税领土以外进入波多黎各的CBP申报
procedures.agency: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP)
procedures.applicability_en: Puerto Rico is inside the U.S. customs territory, so travel between Puerto Rico and the U.S. mainland raises no international customs declaration. Only articles brought into Puerto Rico from outside that customs territory must be declared to CBP at the port of first arrival, on an assigned conveyance, or at a CBP preclearance office. An oral declaration is accepted only under the conditions of 19 CFR 148.12; otherwise the arriving person completes a written Customs Form 6059-B under 148.13. Specific San Juan counters and kiosks are not identified in the official texts cited.
procedures.applicability_zh: 波多黎各位于美国关税领土内，PR与美国本土之间往来不产生国际海关申报。仅自该关税领土以外携入波多黎各的物品，须在首到口岸、配有CBP关员的运输工具或CBP预清关处向CBP申报；仅在符合19 CFR 148.12条件时接受口头申报，否则须按148.13填写6059-B书面申报。圣胡安具体柜台与自助机位置，所引官方文本未载明。
procedures.timing_en: At the port of first arrival, on the assigned conveyance, or at a CBP preclearance office.
procedures.timing_zh: 首到口岸、配有CBP关员的运输工具或CBP预清关处。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 物品自美國關稅領土以外進入波多黎各的CBP申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 波多黎各位於美國關稅領土內，PR與美國本土之間往來不產生國際海關申報。僅自該關稅領土以外攜入波多黎各的物品，須在首到口岸、配有CBP關員的運輸工具或CBP預清關處向CBP申報；僅在符合19 CFR 148.12條件時接受口頭申報，否則須按148.13填寫6059-B書面申報。聖胡安具體櫃檯與自助機位置，所引官方文本未載明。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 首到口岸、配有CBP關員的運輸工具或CBP預清關處。

procedures.name_en: FinCEN Form 105 (CMIR) report to customs for traveller-carried currency over US$10,000 between Puerto Rico and places outside the United States
procedures.name_zh: 波多黎各与美国境外之间旅客随身携带超1万美元现金/货币票据向海关提交的FinCEN 105（CMIR）报告
procedures.agency: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN); filed with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP)
procedures.applicability_en: Subject scope and direction: strictly limited to a traveller physically carrying currency or other monetary instruments in an aggregate amount exceeding US$10,000 at one time between Puerto Rico and any place outside the United States — person-carried cash across the international boundary only. For Title 31 the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico is part of the United States (31 CFR 1010.100); under 31 CFR 1010.340(a) each person who transports, mails or ships (or causes or attempts) such amounts from the United States to any place outside, or into the United States from any place outside, must report — the mail/ship limbs, the 1010.340(b) 15-day recipient filing and the 1010.340(c) bank/carrier exemptions are statutory background delimiting the rule's reach only. Consequently movement between Puerto Rico and the U.S. mainland alone lies inside one Title-31 'United States' and does not trigger this report. Type: the report is a Report of International Transportation of Currency or Monetary Instruments (CMIR) under 31 U.S.C. 5316 on FinCEN Form 105, to be filed with the Bureau of Customs and Border Protection — the form's traveler instruction reads that travelers carrying currency with them 'shall file FinCEN Form 105 at the time of entry into the United States or at the time of departure from the United States with the Customs officer in charge'. This currency report and the baggage (goods) declaration are two separate actions, each handled on its own. Any fee and any San Juan-specific filing counter remain unknown.
procedures.applicability_zh: 主体范围与方向：严格限定为旅客本人实际携带现金或其他货币工具、一次合计超过1万美元（US$10,000）、在波多黎各与美国境外任何地点之间跨境——即仅随身携带、仅跨国际边界。在Title 31下波多黎各（Commonwealth of Puerto Rico）属美国的一部分（31 CFR 1010.100）；依31 CFR 1010.340(a)，任何一次携带、邮寄、发运（或致使/试图运送）该超额款项自美国至境外或自境外进入美国者均须报告——其中邮寄/发运条款、1010.340(b)收件人15日申报及1010.340(c)银行/承运人豁免仅为划定规则范围的法定背景。因此仅波多黎各与美国本土之间的流动同属Title 31定义下同一个“United States”，不触发本报告。类型：该报告系31 U.S.C. 5316项下国际现金/货币工具运送报告（CMIR），使用FinCEN Form 105向美国海关与边境保护局（CBP）提交——表格旅客条目载明随身携带者“shall file FinCEN Form 105 at the time of entry into the United States or at the time of departure from the United States with the Customs officer in charge”。这项现金报告与行李物品申报是两项独立的手续，须分别办理。费用及圣胡安具体受理柜台仍未知。
procedures.timing_en: For the traveller physically carrying the currency: at the time of entry into the United States or at the time of departure from the United States, with the Customs officer in charge at any Customs port of entry or departure. The 15-day recipient filing and the by-mail filing for instruments not accompanying the person concern mailed or shipped currency and are legal background only, not part of the report a traveller carrying the currency files.
procedures.timing_zh: 旅客实际携带现金者：进入美国之时或离开美国之时，向任一海关出入境口岸的主管海关官员提交。收件人15日内申报及不随人货币工具的邮寄提交方式仅针对邮寄/发运情形，属法定背景，不属于随身携带旅客须办理的报告。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 波多黎各與美國境外之間旅客隨身攜帶超1萬美元現金/貨幣票據向海關提交的FinCEN 105（CMIR）報告
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 主體範圍與方向：嚴格限定為旅客本人實際攜帶現金或其他貨幣工具、一次合計超過1萬美元（US$10,000）、在波多黎各與美國境外任何地點之間跨境——即僅隨身攜帶、僅跨國際邊界。在Title 31下波多黎各（Commonwealth of Puerto Rico）屬美國的一部分（31 CFR 1010.100）；依31 CFR 1010.340(a)，任何一次攜帶、郵寄、發運（或致使/試圖運送）該超額款項自美國至境外或自境外進入美國者均須報告——其中郵寄/發運條款、1010.340(b)收件人15日申報及1010.340(c)銀行/承運人豁免僅為劃定規則範圍的法定背景。因此僅波多黎各與美國本土之間的流動同屬Title 31定義下同一個“United States”，不觸發本報告。類型：該報告系31 U.S.C. 5316項下國際現金/貨幣工具運送報告（CMIR），使用FinCEN Form 105向美國海關與邊境保護局（CBP）提交——表格旅客條目載明隨身攜帶者“shall file FinCEN Form 105 at the time of entry into the United States or at the time of departure from the United States with the Customs officer in charge”。這項現金報告與行李物品申報是兩項獨立的手續，須分別辦理。費用及聖胡安具體受理櫃檯仍未知。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 旅客實際攜帶現金者：進入美國之時或離開美國之時，向任一海關出入境口岸的主管海關官員提交。收件人15日內申報及不隨人貨幣工具的郵寄提交方式僅針對郵寄/發運情形，屬法定背景，不屬於隨身攜帶旅客須辦理的報告。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of cash of EUR 10,000 or more to or from abroad (DALIA online or COM paper form)
procedures.name_zh: 10,000欧元及以上现金出入国境申报（DALIA在线或COM纸质表）
procedures.agency: Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (DGDDI)
procedures.applicability_en: Single obligation with two filing channels; the duty arises only at or above the threshold. Any natural person transporting cash of EUR 10,000 or more, or the equivalent in other currencies, whether or not the owner of the cash (« qu'elle soit propriétaire ou non »), for movements in either direction between Saint-Barthélemy and a foreign country (DALIA's wording « en provenance ou à destination de l'étranger », articles L722-6 and L722-7 of the code monétaire et financier); the declaration is made by the person transporting the cash. The regular channel is the DALIA e-service, which expressly names Saint-Barthélemy; the paper form « Déclaration d'argent liquide - COM », applicable to Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, New Caledonia, French Polynesia, Wallis-et-Futuna and Saint-Barthélemy, is the alternative channel for the same obligation — one declaration per movement, not two filings. The COM form also carries an XPF 1,193,317 figure, which serves the territories whose local currency is the CFP franc; Saint-Barthélemy's local currency is the euro, so the threshold for Saint-Barthélemy is EUR 10,000 or more (or the equivalent in other currencies). Covered cash includes banknotes and coins, bearer-negotiable instruments and gold. For amounts of EUR 50,000 or more, documents justifying the provenance of the cash must accompany the declaration (article L771-1-2 of the code monétaire et financier for Saint-Barthélemy). Non-, false or non-presented declaration is punishable for Saint-Barthélemy under article L722-18, notably by a fine of up to 50% of the sum involved — a sanction, not a fee. The obligation described here covers only cash physically carried by the traveller; the same official texts also cover cash sent or shipped (« transports et envois »), which is a separate regime not described here. Saint-Martin is not on the COM/DALIA list and uses the EU/FR forms; those forms cover metropole/DOM/Saint-Martin movements and do not apply to Saint-Barthélemy.
procedures.applicability_zh: 同一义务、两种办理渠道；该义务仅在达到门槛时产生。任何实际运送10,000欧元及以上（或其他币种等值）现金的自然人（无论是否为该现金所有人，「qu'elle soit propriétaire ou non」），在圣巴泰勒米与外国之间双向流动（DALIA原文「en provenance ou à destination de l'étranger」，《货币与金融法典》L722-6、L722-7条）时适用；申报由实际运送现金之人提出。常规渠道为DALIA电子服务，其明确点名圣巴泰勒米；纸质表《Déclaration d'argent liquide - COM》（适用于圣皮埃尔和密克隆、新喀里多尼亚、法属波利尼西亚、瓦利斯和富图纳及圣巴泰勒米）为同一义务的另一渠道——每次流动申报一次，并非两次提交。COM表另载1,193,317太平洋法郎（XPF）一栏，该栏服务于当地货币为太平洋法郎的其他领地；圣巴泰勒米当地货币为欧元，故圣巴泰勒米适用的门槛仅为10,000欧元及以上（或其他币种等值）。现金范围包括纸币硬币、无记名可转让票据及黄金。金额达50,000欧元及以上时，申报须随附证明现金来源的单据（圣巴泰勒米适用《货币与金融法典》L771-1-2条）。未申报、虚假申报或不出示现金，圣巴泰勒米适用L722-18条，可处最高相当于涉案款项50%的罚款等制裁——此为制裁而非费用。此处所述义务仅指旅客本人随身运送的现金；同一官文亦覆盖寄送现金（「transports et envois」），该寄送情形属另一套制度，不在此处展开。圣马丁不在该名单内，适用EU/FR表格；EU表与FR表仅覆盖本土/海外省/圣马丁流动，不适用于圣巴泰勒米。
procedures.timing_en: Triggered by threshold and direction. DALIA online: filing opens at the earliest 30 days before the travel date and must be completed at the latest before the border is crossed on the day of travel; the DGDDI obligation page recommends DALIA preferably (« Utilisez de préférence le service de télédéclaration DALIA »). COM paper: filed with the customs service at the moment of entry into or exit from French territory (section 1 of the form is the choice between « J'entre en France » and « Je sors de France »; in case of transit through France, one declaration is required on entry and another on exit). Either channel discharges the single obligation for that movement; no declaration may be deposited a posteriori by way of regularization.
procedures.timing_zh: 由门槛与方向触发。DALIA在线：最早可在旅行日期前30天提出，最迟须在旅行当日越过边境前完成；DGDDI义务页建议优先使用DALIA（「Utilisez de préférence le service de télédéclaration DALIA」）。COM纸表：于进入或离开法国领土之时向海关部门递交（表格第1栏勾选「J'entre en France」或「Je sors de France」；如过境法国，入境、出境各需一次申报）。任一渠道即完成该次流动的唯一义务；事后不得补报作规范化处理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 10,000歐元及以上現金出入國境申報（DALIA線上或COM紙質表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 同一義務、兩種辦理渠道；該義務僅在達到門檻時產生。任何實際運送10,000歐元及以上（或其他幣種等值）現金的自然人（無論是否為該現金所有人，「qu'elle soit propriétaire ou non」），在聖巴泰勒米與外國之間雙向流動（DALIA原文「en provenance ou à destination de l'étranger」，《貨幣與金融法典》L722-6、L722-7條）時適用；申報由實際運送現金之人提出。常規渠道為DALIA電子服務，其明確點名聖巴泰勒米；紙質表《Déclaration d'argent liquide - COM》（適用於聖皮埃爾和密克隆、新喀里多尼亞、法屬波利尼西亞、瓦利斯和富圖納及聖巴泰勒米）為同一義務的另一渠道——每次流動申報一次，並非兩次提交。COM表另載1,193,317太平洋法郎（XPF）一欄，該欄服務於當地貨幣為太平洋法郎的其他領地；聖巴泰勒米當地貨幣為歐元，故聖巴泰勒米適用的門檻僅為10,000歐元及以上（或其他幣種等值）。現金範圍包括紙幣硬幣、無記名可轉讓票據及黃金。金額達50,000歐元及以上時，申報須隨附證明現金來源的單據（聖巴泰勒米適用《貨幣與金融法典》L771-1-2條）。未申報、虛假申報或不出示現金，聖巴泰勒米適用L722-18條，可處最高相當於涉案款項50%的罰款等制裁——此為制裁而非費用。此處所述義務僅指旅客本人隨身運送的現金；同一官文亦覆蓋寄送現金（「transports et envois」），該寄送情形屬另一套制度，不在此處展開。聖馬丁不在該名單內，適用EU/FR表格；EU表與FR表僅覆蓋本土/海外省/聖馬丁流動，不適用於聖巴泰勒米。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 由門檻與方向觸發。DALIA線上：最早可在旅行日期前30天提出，最遲須在旅行當日越過邊境前完成；DGDDI義務頁建議優先使用DALIA（「Utilisez de préférence le service de télédéclaration DALIA」）。COM紙表：於進入或離開法國領土之時向海關部門遞交（表格第1欄勾選「J'entre en France」或「Je sors de France」；如過境法國，入境、出境各需一次申報）。任一渠道即完成該次流動的唯一義務；事後不得補報作規範化處理。

procedures.name_en: Online Immigration and Customs ED Form (Enhanced, free of charge) for SKN citizens/residents and OECS nationals — Saint Kitts and Nevis e-Border
procedures.name_zh: 在线移民与海关ED表（加强版，免费）——圣基茨和尼维斯公民/居民及OECS国民适用（圣基茨和尼维斯e-Border）
procedures.agency: Ministry of National Security, Government of St. Kitts and Nevis
procedures.applicability_en: Under the 2025 e-Border regime one official portal and app deliver two distinct services. The enhanced biometric Immigration & Customs ED Form is required for SKN citizens, residents, and OECS nationals, including dual nationals, and is completed free of charge; other-passport travellers who do not qualify for the ED Form instead apply for an eTA. That eTA routing does not sweep in SKN citizens/residents, OECS nationals, or SKN/OECS dual nationals travelling on a non-SKN passport: dual nationals or OECS citizens travelling on a non-SKN passport may file the Enhanced ED Form free of charge by uploading proof of SKN/OECS status. Non-digital fallback: travellers without digital access may book an appointment at Immigration HQ, Stanford Building, Golden Rock (Mon-Fri 08:00-16:00) for on-site submission assistance.
procedures.applicability_zh: 2025年e-Border体制下，同一官方门户与App提供两项不同服务：加强版生物识别移民与海关ED表适用于圣基茨和尼维斯公民、居民及OECS成员国国民（含双重国籍者），免费填报；不具ED资格的其他护照旅客改申请eTA。该eTA表述不涵盖圣基茨和尼维斯公民/居民、OECS国民，或可上传身份证明的圣基茨和尼维斯/OECS双重国籍者——持非圣基茨和尼维斯护照出行的双重国籍者或OECS公民，可上传圣基茨和尼维斯/OECS身份证明，免费改填加强版ED表。非数字化兜底：无数字渠道的旅客可预约至Golden Rock斯坦福楼移民总局（周一至周五08:00–16:00）现场协助提交。
procedures.timing_en: The current ED Form must be completed before entry processing on arrival. The official 2025 e-Border announcements do not state how many days in advance the form may be submitted; the current submission window is unknown.
procedures.timing_zh: 当前ED表须在入境办理前完成；2025年e-Border官方公告未明示可提前几日提交，现行提交窗口未知。

fee.note: Free of charge for eligible filers: SKNIS (22 May 2025) — SKN citizens/residents and OECS nationals "must continue to complete the Online Immigration and Customs ED Form free of charge"; technology.gov.kn likewise states the Enhanced ED Form is free. The eTA service charge applies only to eTA applications.

procedures.name_zh_hant: 線上移民與海關ED表（加強版，免費）——聖基茨和尼維斯公民/居民及OECS國民適用（聖基茨和尼維斯e-Border）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 2025年e-Border體制下，同一官方門戶與App提供兩項不同服務：加強版生物識別移民與海關ED表適用於聖基茨和尼維斯公民、居民及OECS成員國國民（含雙重國籍者），免費填報；不具ED資格的其他護照旅客改申請eTA。該eTA表述不涵蓋聖基茨和尼維斯公民/居民、OECS國民，或可上傳身份證明的聖基茨和尼維斯/OECS雙重國籍者——持非聖基茨和尼維斯護照出行的雙重國籍者或OECS公民，可上傳聖基茨和尼維斯/OECS身份證明，免費改填加強版ED表。非數字化兜底：無數字渠道的旅客可預約至Golden Rock斯坦福樓移民總局（週一至週五08:00–16:00）現場協助提交。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 當前ED表須在入境辦理前完成；2025年e-Border官方公告未明示可提前幾日提交，現行提交窗口未知。

procedures.name_en: Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA) for non-SKN passport holders — Saint Kitts and Nevis e-Border, effective 26 May 2025
procedures.name_zh: 电子旅行授权（eTA）——持非圣基茨和尼维斯护照旅客适用（圣基茨和尼维斯e-Border，2025年5月26日生效）
procedures.agency: Ministry of National Security, Government of St. Kitts and Nevis
procedures.applicability_en: Per the 2025 e-Border regime, the eTA is required for travellers who do not qualify for the ED Form — generally other-passport visitors (technology.gov.kn: "All other passport" submits eTA); SKNIS (22 May 2025) states every visitor must present an approved eTA before departing the country of origin and on arrival. SKN citizens/residents and OECS citizens do not need an eTA; they instead complete the free ED Form. Service charge waived for: CARICOM nationals; accredited diplomats on official duty; children under 2; in-transit passengers; on-duty flight or vessel crew; active military or search-and-rescue personnel; and SKN dual-nationals who upload proof of SKN citizenship. These service-charge waivers cover the fee only and do not in themselves waive the eTA obligation. The service charge now in force is not confirmed by current official announcements: 2025 announcements set a discounted US$8.50 service charge until 1 September 2025 and a standard US$17 from 1 September 2025, but no official page confirms the rate applying today; urgent processing at the airport carries higher, unstated fees. Submission via the Saint Kitts and Nevis e-Border app (preferred) or www.knatravelform.kn; app users qualify for fast-track facial biometric arrival.
procedures.applicability_zh: 按2025年e-Border体制，不具ED资格的旅客须申请eTA——一般是持其他护照的访客（technology.gov.kn表列“所有其他护照”提交eTA）；SKNIS 2025-05-22载明每位访客须在离开原籍国前及抵达时出示获批eTA。圣基茨和尼维斯公民/居民与OECS公民无需eTA，改填免费ED表。服务费豁免：CARICOM成员国国民；执行公务的获认可外交人员；2岁以下儿童；过境旅客；当班飞行器/船舶机组人员；现役军人或搜救人员；上传圣基茨和尼维斯公民身份证明的圣基茨和尼维斯双重国籍者。上述费用豁免条件仅免服务费，不等于免除eTA义务本身。现行服务费率尚无官方确认：2025年公告设优惠服务费US$8.50（至2025年9月1日）、2025年9月1日起标准US$17，但现行适用费率尚无官方页面确认；机场紧急加急办理收费更高且数额未载。经“Saint Kitts and Nevis e-Border”App（首选）或www.knatravelform.kn提交；App用户可走快速面部生物识别通道抵达。
procedures.timing_en: The eTA application can be submitted up to 90 days before travel; the approved eTA is valid for 90 days or until the passport expires, whichever is sooner (SKNIS, 22 May 2025).
procedures.timing_zh: eTA申请最多可提前90天提交；获批eTA有效期90天或至护照到期为止，以先到者为准（SKNIS 2025-05-22）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 電子旅行授權（eTA）——持非聖基茨和尼維斯護照旅客適用（聖基茨和尼維斯e-Border，2025年5月26日生效）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 按2025年e-Border體制，不具ED資格的旅客須申請eTA——一般是持其他護照的訪客（technology.gov.kn表列“所有其他護照”提交eTA）；SKNIS 2025-05-22載明每位訪客須在離開原籍國前及抵達時出示獲批eTA。聖基茨和尼維斯公民/居民與OECS公民無需eTA，改填免費ED表。服務費豁免：CARICOM成員國國民；執行公務的獲認可外交人員；2歲以下兒童；過境旅客；當班飛行器/船舶機組人員；現役軍人或搜救人員；上傳聖基茨和尼維斯公民身份證明的聖基茨和尼維斯雙重國籍者。上述費用豁免條件僅免服務費，不等於免除eTA義務本身。現行服務費率尚無官方確認：2025年公告設優惠服務費US$8.50（至2025年9月1日）、2025年9月1日起標準US$17，但現行適用費率尚無官方頁面確認；機場緊急加急辦理收費更高且數額未載。經“Saint Kitts and Nevis e-Border”App（首選）或www.knatravelform.kn提交；App用戶可走快速麵部生物識別通道抵達。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: eTA申請最多可提前90天提交；獲批eTA有效期90天或至護照到期為止，以先到者為準（SKNIS 2025-05-22）。

procedures.name_en: Online Embarkation/Disembarkation (ED) form for air arrivals (introduced 30 Nov 2022, replacing the handwritten form)
procedures.name_zh: 航空入境在线出入境（ED）表（2022年11月30日启用，取代手写表）
procedures.agency: Immigration Department, Saint Lucia (Ministry of Home Affairs, Justice and National Security); announced by SLASPA; traveller guidance by Saint Lucia Tourism Authority
procedures.applicability_en: For air arrivals only. Since 30 Nov 2022 an online Embarkation/Disembarkation (ED) form has replaced the handwritten form, and its data goes to Immigration, Customs and Port Health in real time (Government of Saint Lucia announcement by SLASPA). The Saint Lucia Tourism Authority's entry page encourages all travellers arriving by air to complete the immigration form online before arrival. Complete one entry form per family; you receive a QR code by email and present it to the authorities on arrival. The form can be completed wherever internet is available: in the departure lounge, on a flight with internet, or on arrival at the Saint Lucia airport using the free wi-fi. Cruise passengers follow port authority and cruise line procedures. The pages give no fee. Whether a separate paper customs form is still handed out is not stated; see the customs declaration listed for Saint Lucia.
procedures.applicability_zh: 仅航空入境。自2022年11月30日起，在线出入境（ED）表取代手写表，数据实时传送给Immigration、Customs和Port Health（圣卢西亚政府网站SLASPA公告）。圣卢西亚旅游局入境页面鼓励所有航空抵达的旅客在抵达前于线上填写入境表。每个家庭填一份入境表，经电子邮件收到二维码，抵达时向官员出示。表格可在有网络的任何地方填写：出发机场候机厅、有网络的航班上，或抵达圣卢西亚机场后使用免费wi-fi。邮轮旅客按港务局与邮轮公司程序办理。页面未载明费用。是否仍另发纸质海关表未作说明，见圣卢西亚的海关申报事项。
procedures.timing_en: Complete and submit the form up to 3 days before travel to Saint Lucia, per the Tourism Authority's page; it can also be completed on board a flight with internet or on arrival at the airport.
procedures.timing_zh: 据旅游局页面，最早可在行前3天填写并提交；也可在有网络的航班上或抵达机场后填写。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 航空入境線上出入境（ED）表（2022年11月30日啟用，取代手寫表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 僅航空入境。自2022年11月30日起，線上出入境（ED）表取代手寫表，資料實時傳送給Immigration、Customs和Port Health（聖盧西亞政府網站SLASPA公告）。聖盧西亞旅遊局入境頁面鼓勵所有航空抵達的旅客在抵達前於線上填寫入境表。每個家庭填一份入境表，經電子郵件收到 QR Code，抵達時向官員出示。表格可在有網路的任何地方填寫：出發機場候機廳、有網路的航班上，或抵達聖盧西亞機場後使用免費wi-fi。郵輪旅客按港務局與郵輪公司程序辦理。頁面未載明費用。是否仍另發紙質海關表未作說明，見聖盧西亞的海關申報事項。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 據旅遊局頁面，最早可在行前3天填寫並提交；也可在有網路的航班上或抵達機場後填寫。

procedures.name_en: Customs declaration form for arriving passengers (family members, luggage pieces, restricted items and cash over USD 10,000)
procedures.name_zh: 入境旅客海关申报表（随行家属、行李件数、限制物品及超过1万美元现金）
procedures.agency: Customs and Excise Department, Government of Saint Lucia
procedures.applicability_en: The Customs and Excise Department's Information for Travellers page says arriving passengers must declare, on the customs declaration form, their spouse and children under 18, and state the number of accompanied and unaccompanied luggage pieces. They must also declare items such as fruits, plants, pharmaceuticals, arms, ammunition, explosives, and currency exceeding the USD equivalent of USD 10,000. Applies to arriving passengers only; the page does not describe a departure declaration. Duty-free allowances on the same page are not a declaration step and are not listed here. The page does not say whether the form is paper or electronic, and states no fee.
procedures.applicability_zh: 海关与消费税部门“旅客信息”页面称，入境旅客须在海关申报表上申报其配偶和18岁以下子女，并填明随行与非随行行李的件数；还须申报水果、植物、药品、武器、弹药、爆炸物等物品，以及超过1万美元等值的货币。仅适用于入境旅客，页面未述及出境申报。同一页面的免税额度不属于申报步骤，此处不列。页面未说明表格是纸质还是电子，也未载明费用。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in Saint Lucia, when presenting yourself and your baggage to Customs.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达圣卢西亚时，向海关出示本人和行李时办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境旅客海關申報表（隨行家屬、行李件數、限制物品及超過1萬美元現金）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 海關與消費稅部門“旅客資訊”頁面稱，入境旅客須在海關申報表上申報其配偶和18歲以下子女，並填明隨行與非隨行行李的件數；還須申報水果、植物、藥品、武器、彈藥、爆炸物等物品，以及超過1萬美元等值的貨幣。僅適用於入境旅客，頁面未述及出境申報。同一頁面的免稅額度不屬於申報步驟，此處不列。頁面未說明表格是紙質還是電子，也未載明費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達聖盧西亞時，向海關出示本人和行李時辦理。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration to French customs for cross-border transport of EUR 10,000 or more (EU form for extra-EU flows, FR form for intra-EU flows)
procedures.name_zh: 跨境运送现金达 10,000 欧元向法国海关申报（欧盟以外流向用 EU 表，欧盟内部流向用 FR 表）
procedures.agency: Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (DGDDI, French Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: One obligation, with the form selected by the direction of the flow: any person, French resident or not, physically transporting cash, bearer negotiable instruments (bearer cheques, traveller's cheques, money orders, bearer securities) or gold worth EUR 10,000 or more, or the equivalent in another currency, must declare it to French customs; for prepaid cards the EUR 10,000 declaration duty exists only for intra-EU flows. The DGDDI page updated 04/05/2026 names Saint-Martin in both form descriptions: the harmonised EU form covers movements of cash to or from a country outside the European Union, and the national FR form covers movements to or from a member state of the European Union; the COM form, which the same page reserves for Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Saint-Barthélemy, New Caledonia, French Polynesia and Wallis-et-Futuna, does not apply to Saint-Martin. The page does not itemise specific routes, so route-level form allocation remains unresolved: it says nothing on the Dutch side of Sint Maarten, and it assigns no form to direct flows between Saint-Martin and metropole or Guadeloupe, which are movements within France rather than movements to or from another member state; the page's wording does not subject them to either form, and this cannot be inferred from Saint-Martin's place inside the EU customs territory, so no such route is classified here (MF-cash-route-mapping-unknown). No declaration can be filed afterwards as a regularisation; non-declaration, false declaration or non-presentation is punishable by a fine of up to 50% of the sum concerned and temporary retention of the cash.
procedures.applicability_zh: 同一申报义务，按流动方向选表：任何人员（无论是否法国居民）本人运送现金、无记名可转让票据（不记名支票、旅行支票、汇票、无记名有价证券）或黄金，价值达 10,000 欧元或以上（或等值外币），须向法国海关申报；预付卡的 10,000 欧元申报义务仅覆盖欧盟内部流向。DGDDI 2026-05-04 更新页面在两处表别说明中均点名圣马丁：统一 EU 表适用于与欧盟以外国家之间的现金流动，国家 FR 表适用于与欧盟成员国之间的流动；同一页面保留给圣皮埃尔和密克隆、圣巴泰勒米、新喀里多尼亚、法属波利尼西亚及瓦利斯和富图纳的 COM 表不适用于圣马丁。该页未逐条列明具体路线，路线级表别归属保留未知：对荷属 Sint Maarten 一侧未置一词，对法属圣马丁与法国本土、瓜德罗普之间的直达流动也未指定表别——后者系法国境内的流动而非与另一成员国之间的流动，页面文字未将其纳入任一表别，亦不能由圣马丁地处欧盟关税领土推断其须作跨成员国申报；本文不为任何此类路线归类（MF-cash-route-mapping-unknown）。不得事后补报作正规化；未申报、虚假申报或不出示现金，可处相当于涉案金额最高 50% 的罚款并临时扣留现金。
procedures.timing_en: The duty applies only when the amount carried is EUR 10,000 or more (or the equivalent in another currency). Channels and windows: DALIA e-filing, recommended by DGDDI, open at the earliest 30 days before the date of transport of the cash and at the latest before the crossing of the border on the day of travel; or the paper form — EU form for extra-EU flows, FR form for intra-EU flows; or in person with the customs service at the moment of entry into or exit from French territory. No declaration may be filed afterwards as a regularisation.
procedures.timing_zh: 仅当携带金额达 10,000 欧元（或等值外币）时触发。渠道与时窗：DALIA 电子申报（DGDDI 推荐），最早可于现金运输日前 30 天、最迟须于旅行当日越过边境前提交；或纸质表——欧盟以外流向用 EU 表、欧盟内部流向用 FR 表；或在进入或离开法国领土之时向海关部门当面申报。不得事后补报作正规化。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境運送現金達 10,000 歐元向法國海關申報（歐盟以外流向用 EU 表，歐盟內部流向用 FR 表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 同一申報義務，按流動方向選表：任何人員（無論是否法國居民）本人運送現金、無記名可轉讓票據（不記名支票、旅行支票、匯票、無記名有價證券）或黃金，價值達 10,000 歐元或以上（或等值外幣），須向法國海關申報；預付卡的 10,000 歐元申報義務僅覆蓋歐盟內部流向。DGDDI 2026-05-04 更新頁面在兩處表別說明中均點名聖馬丁：統一 EU 表適用於與歐盟以外國家之間的現金流動，國家 FR 表適用於與歐盟成員國之間的流動；同一頁面保留給聖皮埃爾和密克隆、聖巴泰勒米、新喀里多尼亞、法屬波利尼西亞及瓦利斯和富圖納的 COM 表不適用於聖馬丁。該頁未逐條列明具體路線，路線級表別歸屬保留未知：對荷屬 Sint Maarten 一側未置一詞，對法屬聖馬丁與法國本土、瓜德羅普之間的直達流動也未指定表別——後者系法國境內的流動而非與另一成員國之間的流動，頁面文字未將其納入任一表別，亦不能由聖馬丁地處歐盟關稅領土推斷其須作跨成員國申報；本文不為任何此類路線歸類（MF-cash-route-mapping-unknown）。不得事後補報作正規化；未申報、虛假申報或不出示現金，可處相當於涉案金額最高 50% 的罰款並臨時扣留現金。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 僅當攜帶金額達 10,000 歐元（或等值外幣）時觸發。渠道與時窗：DALIA 電子申報（DGDDI 推薦），最早可於現金運輸日前 30 天、最遲須於旅行當日越過邊境前提交；或紙質表——歐盟以外流向用 EU 表、歐盟內部流向用 FR 表；或在進入或離開法國領土之時向海關部門當面申報。不得事後補報作正規化。

procedures.name_en: Arrival customs declaration (goods obtained abroad and currency exceeding EC$10,000)
procedures.name_zh: 抵达时向海关申报（境外取得物及超过1万东加勒比元现金）
procedures.agency: Customs and Excise Department, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
procedures.applicability_en: Applies to all persons entering Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (Customs AIA arrivals) and to passengers arriving from outside the country. On arrival, at baggage examination, a passenger must: declare to Customs anything in the baggage or carried with them that was obtained outside the country; make a verbal declaration of the items brought (whether purchased or not) and their prices, including gifts, articles carried for other persons, articles for sale, commercial samples and plant material, but not personal effects; and produce travel documents and baggage for examination and answer the officer's questions. Currency strictly exceeding EC$10,000.00, or its equivalent in any foreign currency, must also be declared to the proper Customs Officer at this arrival clearance; exactly EC$10,000.00 does not trigger it, and failure to declare such currency may result in its seizure.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于所有进入圣文森特和格林纳丁斯的人（Customs AIA 抵达页范围）及来自境外的抵达旅客。抵达后行李查验时，旅客须：向海关申报行李中或随身携带的在境外取得的任何物品；口头申报所携物品（无论是否购买）及价格，包括礼物、替他人携带的物品、待售物品、商业样品及植物材料，个人随用物品除外；出示旅行证件和行李受查，并回答官员问题。此外，严格超过10,000.00东加勒比元或其等值任何外币的现金，须在此抵港清关时一并向主管海关官员申报；恰为10,000.00东加元不触发，未申报该现金可致没收。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, during baggage examination: verbally declare the items and their prices, declare currency exceeding EC$10,000, produce travel documents and baggage, and answer the officer's questions.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达后在行李查验环节：口头申报所携物品及价格，申报超过1万东加勒比元的现金，出示旅行证件和行李，并回答官员问题。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵達時向海關申報（境外取得物及超過1萬東加勒比元現金）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於所有進入聖文森特和格林納丁斯的人（Customs AIA 抵達頁範圍）及來自境外的抵達旅客。抵達後行李查驗時，旅客須：向海關申報行李中或隨身攜帶的在境外取得的任何物品；口頭申報所攜物品（無論是否購買）及價格，包括禮物、替他人攜帶的物品、待售物品、商業樣品及植物材料，個人隨用物品除外；出示旅行證件和行李受查，並回答官員問題。此外，嚴格超過10,000.00東加勒比元或其等值任何外幣的現金，須在此抵港清關時一併向主管海關官員申報；恰為10,000.00東加元不觸發，未申報該現金可致沒收。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達後在行李查驗環節：口頭申報所攜物品及價格，申報超過1萬東加勒比元的現金，出示旅行證件和行李，並回答官員問題。

procedures.name_en: Money and valuables declaration (MOT)
procedures.name_zh: 资金及贵重物品申报（MOT）
procedures.agency: Sint Maarten Customs, Ministry of Justice; where no Customs officer is present, police officers of the Immigration and Border Protection Service (Art2(6))
procedures.applicability_en: Art2(1), first sentence, of the Landsverordening melding grensoverschrijdende geldtransporten (CVDR671733, in force 2019-07-31 to present): persons entering or leaving Sint Maarten must declare to Customs officials the money, precious metals, jewellery or other objects of a value of NAf 25,000 or more (inclusive) that they carry with them; 'money' (geld) includes domestic and foreign banknotes, coins and negotiable instruments to bearer (Art1(c)). Second sentence: where incoming or outgoing persons demonstrably travel together and jointly carry money of NAf 20,000 or more (inclusive), the obligations rest on each of them separately (Art2(1) second sentence, Art2(2)); this joint threshold covers only jointly carried money, not precious metals or jewellery, which stay under the individual NAf 25,000 condition. The declaration is made by submitting a form signed by the declarant under the model fixed by the minister (Art2(2)), stating identity and address of the declarant and the owner, the amount, origin and destination, and the reason for the chosen mode of transport (Art3); a ministerial regulation may exempt goods brought in or taken out solely for direct transit (Art2(7)). Currency: under the common Curaçao–Sint Maarten monetary system regulation (CVDR230646) Art18(1)–(2), from the moment of issuance of the Caribbean guilder, references to NAf in legal instruments existing at that moment are read as references to the Caribbean guilder at a one-to-one ratio, and the Sint Maarten Tax Administration confirmed XCG as the official currency from 2025-07-02; no Art18(3) nature-or-purpose exception is known for this law, so the thresholds read as XCG 25,000 per person and XCG 20,000 for money carried jointly by a genuinely co-travelling group — a reading of the law itself, not a dollar conversion. The currency wording printed on the current official form has not been officially confirmed. Art2(8) obliges the minister to make the form available in paper and electronic form and to enable electronic filing; the current government service page lists the MOT form and answers 'Is this service available online? No', which may refer only to the remote web service; whether the declaration can be filed remotely online, or only on paper or electronically at the border, has not been officially confirmed.
procedures.applicability_zh: 《跨境资金运送申报国家条例》（Landsverordening melding grensoverschrijdende geldtransporten，CVDR671733，2019-07-31生效至今）第2条第1款第一句：进入或离开Sint Maarten的人员，须就其随身携带、价值NAƒ25,000或以上（含本数）的钱、贵金属、珠宝或其他高价值物向海关官员申报；其中“钱”（geld）含境内外纸币、硬币及可转让无记名票据（第1条(c)）。第二句：入/出境人员如确实（可证明地）共同旅行并共同携带价值NAƒ20,000或以上（含本数）的钱，条例所设义务由该组各人分别承担（第2条第1款第二句、第2款）；该合计门槛仅覆盖共同携带的“钱”，不适用于贵金属或珠宝，贵金属/珠宝仍按个人NAƒ25,000条件判断。申报以提交由申报人签署、按部长核定格式制作的表格作出（第2条第2款），并须载明申报人与所有人的身份和住址、数额、来源与去向及选择该运输方式的理由（第3条）；部长规章可对以单纯直接过境为目的的物品豁免申报（第2条第7款）。货币：按Curaçao–Sint Maarten共同货币制度条例（CVDR230646）第18条第1–2款，自Caribbean guilder发行时点起，既存法律文件中的NAƒ金额按一比一视为Caribbean guilder金额；Sint Maarten税局公告确认自2025-07-02起仅官方货币XCG用于盾类交易。未见本法存在第18条第3款性质/目的例外，故两门槛依法等同于个人XCG25,000、确实同行组共同携带钱XCG20,000——此为依据法条本身的解读，不换算为美元；现行官方表格上印的币种措辞尚未获得官方确认。法第2条第8款要求部长以纸质与电子形式提供表格并使电子申报可行；现行政府服务页（部委：Justice；部门：Customs）列MOT表并回答“Is this service available online? No”，该答复可能仅指远程网页服务；申报能否在线远程办理，还是只能在口岸以纸质或电子方式提交，尚无官方确认。
procedures.timing_en: Incoming persons: at the latest at the moment the Customs officer can proceed to inspection of baggage brought by travellers; where the competent authority establishes a control zone, before entering the control zone; if no Customs officer is present on the spot, immediately after passage to the nearest Customs officer (Art2(4)). Outgoing persons: at the latest at the moment the Immigration and Border Protection Service police officer proceeds to passport control or, if no passport control takes place, at the latest at the moment Customs can proceed to inspection of travellers' baggage; if no Customs officer is present on the spot, before passage to the nearest Customs officer (Art2(5)). If no Customs officers are present, the declaration is made to the Immigration and Border Protection Service police (Art2(6)). Where transport is by a professional carrier that has not been enabled to declare, the sender declares to the Inspector of Customs at the latest at the moment of the actual entry or exit of the money, precious metals, jewellery or other objects (Art2(3)).
procedures.timing_zh: 入境人员：最迟于海关官员可开始查验旅客随身行李之时；如主管机关设立查验区，须在进入查验区之前；如现场无海关官员，则在通过后立即向最近的海关官员申报（第2条第4款）。出境人员：最迟于移民与边境保护署（Immigratie- en Grensbewakingsdienst）警务人员开始查验护照之时，如无护照查验，则最迟于海关可开始查验旅客行李之时；如现场无海关官员，则在通过之前向最近的海关官员申报（第2条第5款）。如无任何海关官员在场，向移民与边境保护署警务人员申报（第2条第6款）。如由职业承运人运输且其未能进行申报，由发送人最迟于钱、贵金属、珠宝或其他物品实际入境或出境之时向海关督察（Inspecteur der Douane）申报（第2条第3款）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 資金及貴重物品申報（MOT）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 《跨境資金運送申報國家條例》（Landsverordening melding grensoverschrijdende geldtransporten，CVDR671733，2019-07-31生效至今）第2條第1款第一句：進入或離開Sint Maarten的人員，須就其隨身攜帶、價值NAƒ25,000或以上（含本數）的錢、貴金屬、珠寶或其他高價值物向海關官員申報；其中“錢”（geld）含境內外紙幣、硬幣及可轉讓無記名票據（第1條(c)）。第二句：入/出境人員如確實（可證明地）共同旅行並共同攜帶價值NAƒ20,000或以上（含本數）的錢，條例所設義務由該組各人分別承擔（第2條第1款第二句、第2款）；該合計門檻僅覆蓋共同攜帶的“錢”，不適用於貴金屬或珠寶，貴金屬/珠寶仍按個人NAƒ25,000條件判斷。申報以提交由申報人簽署、按部長核定格式製作的表格作出（第2條第2款），並須載明申報人與所有人的身份和住址、數額、來源與去向及選擇該運輸方式的理由（第3條）；部長規章可對以單純直接過境為目的的物品豁免申報（第2條第7款）。貨幣：按Curaçao–Sint Maarten共同貨幣制度條例（CVDR230646）第18條第1–2款，自Caribbean guilder發行時點起，既存法律文件中的NAƒ金額按一比一視為Caribbean guilder金額；Sint Maarten稅局公告確認自2025-07-02起僅官方貨幣XCG用於盾類交易。未見本法存在第18條第3款性質/目的例外，故兩門檻依法等同於個人XCG25,000、確實同行組共同攜帶錢XCG20,000——此為依據法條本身的解讀，不換算為美元；現行官方表格上印的幣種措辭尚未獲得官方確認。法第2條第8款要求部長以紙質與電子形式提供表格並使電子申報可行；現行政府服務頁（部委：Justice；部門：Customs）列MOT表並回答“Is this service available online? No”，該答覆可能僅指遠程網頁服務；申報能否線上遠程辦理，還是隻能在口岸以紙質或電子方式提交，尚無官方確認。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境人員：最遲於海關官員可開始查驗旅客隨身行李之時；如主管機關設立查驗區，須在進入查驗區之前；如現場無海關官員，則在通過後立即向最近的海關官員申報（第2條第4款）。出境人員：最遲於移民與邊境保護署（Immigratie- en Grensbewakingsdienst）警務人員開始查驗護照之時，如無護照查驗，則最遲於海關可開始查驗旅客行李之時；如現場無海關官員，則在通過之前向最近的海關官員申報（第2條第5款）。如無任何海關官員在場，向移民與邊境保護署警務人員申報（第2條第6款）。如由職業承運人運輸且其未能進行申報，由發送人最遲於錢、貴金屬、珠寶或其他物品實際入境或出境之時向海關督察（Inspecteur der Douane）申報（第2條第3款）。

procedures.name_en: Arrival declaration on the Immigration/Customs Form (Form C15 revised)
procedures.name_zh: 到达时移民/海关申报表（C15修订版）申报
procedures.agency: Customs and Excise Division, Government of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving travellers carrying anything beyond defined personal effects - household items; foodstuff including meats, fruit and vegetables; gifts; alcohol; tobacco; commercial items - must declare it on the Immigration/Customs Form (Form C15 revised); personal effects are articles (new and used) which a traveller may reasonably require for personal use during the journey. The customs notice lists exemptions only as menu links (personal effects, household effects, spirits & tobacco, '$3000.00 TT allowance', etc.) and does not state their eligibility conditions or current amounts. The Airports Authority page corroborates the C15 requirement at airport scope only, and separately displays at airport scope a $3,000.00 TT goods allowance whose maximum a traveller may claim once every year and spirits/tobacco quantities for passengers 17 years and over; these allowance figures are context only, are not asserted as national rules from the customs notice, and are not listed as separate procedures.
procedures.applicability_zh: 到达旅客凡携带超出所界定个人随用物者——家用品；含肉、果蔬之食品；礼品；酒；烟；商用物——须在移民/海关申报表（C15修订版）上申报；个人随用物指旅客旅途中合理需用之新旧物品。海关告示仅以菜单链接列出各豁免（个人随用物、家用品、烟酒、"$3000.00 TT allowance"等），未载明资格条件或现行额度。机场管理局页面仅在机场范围佐证C15要求，并仅在机场范围另行载示3,000.00特多元货物免税额（旅客每年至多按该上限申领一次）及17岁及以上旅客的烟酒数量；上述额度数字仅作背景，不据此自海关告示推定全国规则，亦不单列程序。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival, in the Immigration/Customs clearance step (the notice is addressed to travellers; the airport page places the requirement under its arrival section). No separate deadline is stated.
procedures.timing_zh: 到达时于移民/海关通关环节（该告示面向旅客；机场页面将其列于到达栏目下）。官方未另设截止时限。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 到達時移民/海關申報表（C15修訂版）申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 到達旅客凡攜帶超出所界定個人隨用物者——家用品；含肉、果蔬之食品；禮品；酒；煙；商用物——須在移民/海關申報表（C15修訂版）上申報；個人隨用物指旅客旅途中合理需用之新舊物品。海關告示僅以菜單連結列出各豁免（個人隨用物、家用品、菸酒、"$3000.00 TT allowance"等），未載明資格條件或現行額度。機場管理局頁面僅在機場範圍佐證C15要求，並僅在機場範圍另行載示3,000.00特多元貨物免稅額（旅客每年至多按該上限申領一次）及17歲及以上旅客的菸酒數量；上述額度數字僅作背景，不據此自海關告示推定全國規則，亦不單列程序。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 到達時於移民/海關通關環節（該告示面向旅客；機場頁面將其列於到達欄目下）。官方未另設截止時限。

procedures.name_en: Unaccompanied baggage declaration on the Unaccompanied Baggage Declaration Form (C88)
procedures.name_zh: 非随行行李申报表（C88）申报
procedures.agency: Customs and Excise Division, Government of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago
procedures.applicability_en: For baggage that is unaccompanied: the customs notice names the Unaccompanied Baggage Declaration Form (C88) - a form distinct from the traveller's C15 - for goods that must be declared (household items, foodstuff including meats/fruit/vegetables, gifts, alcohol, tobacco, commercial items). The notice states no further eligibility conditions, numeric thresholds or amounts for the C88; its unaccompanied-baggage designation comes from the form's own title. The Airports Authority page repeats the same C15/C88 wording at airport scope only.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于非随行行李：海关告示点名非随行行李申报表（C88）——与旅客本人的C15为不同表格——用于须申报之物（家用品、含肉/果蔬之食品、礼品、酒、烟、商用物）。告示未另载C88的资格条件、数字门槛或额度；其"非随行行李"指向仅来自表名本身。机场管理局页面仅在机场范围重复同一C15/C88表述。
procedures.timing_en: Not separately stated; the notice gives no distinct filing window or deadline for the C88 beyond its designation for unaccompanied baggage.
procedures.timing_zh: 官方未单列C88的提交时间窗或期限，其指向仅来自表名所载之非随行行李。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 非隨行行李申報表（C88）申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於非隨行行李：海關告示點名非隨行行李申報表（C88）——與旅客本人的C15為不同表格——用於須申報之物（家用品、含肉/果蔬之食品、禮品、酒、煙、商用物）。告示未另載C88的資格條件、數字門檻或額度；其"非隨行行李"指向僅來自表名本身。機場管理局頁面僅在機場範圍重複同一C15/C88表述。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 官方未單列C88的提交時間窗或期限，其指向僅來自表名所載之非隨行行李。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of cash, currency and monetary instruments over US$5,000 or TT$20,000 to a Customs Officer (arriving and departing)
procedures.name_zh: 向海关人员申报携带超过 5,000 美元或 20,000 特元的现金、货币及货币工具（入境和离境）
procedures.agency: Customs and Excise Division, Ministry of Finance, Trinidad and Tobago
procedures.applicability_en: Applies to all arriving and departing passengers. The Customs and Excise Division's 'Declaration of Currency or Monetary Instruments' notice advises that passengers are required to declare to a Customs Officer on duty at the airport or sea port whether they are carrying cash, currency or monetary instruments in excess of US$5,000 or its equivalent in any currency, or TT$20,000. The notice defines bearer negotiable instruments as including travellers' cheques, promissory notes, bills of exchange and bank drafts. It warns that a false declaration of the amount of cash or the value of monetary instruments being carried may result in severe penalties. The notice is worded 'in excess of' the amounts and does not address an amount exactly equal to them. It names no form for this declaration and does not say whether the question is answered on Form C15.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于所有入境和离境旅客。海关和消费税司的《货币或货币工具申报》通告提醒：旅客须向机场或海港值班的海关人员申报，是否携带超过 5,000 美元（或任何货币的等值）或 20,000 特立尼达和多巴哥元（TT$）的现金、货币或货币工具。通告称无记名可转让票据包括旅行支票、本票、汇票和银行汇票。通告警告，就所携现金金额或货币工具价值作虚假申报，可能受到严厉处罚。通告的措辞为“超过”（in excess of）上述金额，未涉及恰等于该金额的情形。通告未指明此项申报所用表格，也未说明是否在 C15 表上作答。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival and on departure, at the airport or sea port, to the Customs Officer on duty.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境和离境时，在机场或海港向值班海关人员申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 向海關人員申報攜帶超過 5,000 美元或 20,000 特元的現金、貨幣及貨幣工具（入境和離境）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於所有入境和離境旅客。海關和消費稅司的《貨幣或貨幣工具申報》通告提醒：旅客須向機場或海港值班的海關人員申報，是否攜帶超過 5,000 美元（或任何貨幣的等值）或 20,000 特立尼達和多巴哥元（TT$）的現金、貨幣或貨幣工具。通告稱無記名可轉讓票據包括旅行支票、本票、匯票和銀行匯票。通告警告，就所攜現金金額或貨幣工具價值作虛假申報，可能受到嚴厲處罰。通告的措辭為“超過”（in excess of）上述金額，未涉及恰等於該金額的情形。通告未指明此項申報所用表格，也未說明是否在 C15 表上作答。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境和離境時，在機場或海港向值班海關人員申報。

procedures.name_en: Arrival customs declaration (Form C105) covering personal allowances and goods
procedures.name_zh: 抵达海关申报（C105表），涵盖个人免税额度与物品申报
procedures.agency: Turks and Caicos Islands Customs Department (Ministry of Immigration and Border Services)
procedures.applicability_en: Every arriving traveller (or the responsible family member) must complete the Customs Declaration Form C105, which must be signed and dated; only ONE written declaration per family is required. The official guide defines family as members residing in the same household related by blood, marriage, domestic relationship or adoption; where the household has more than 4 members, additional members are filled on a separate declaration form. Residents must declare all items acquired abroad and the price paid (receipts should be kept, gifts included); visitors must declare gifts brought for others and other items acquired with their purchase price. Guide answer-Yes thresholds: newly acquired items (incl. gifts) exceed USD 400 in value; spirits exceed 1 litre or wine exceed 2 litres (under 40% abv); tobacco exceeds 200 cigarettes / 100 cigarillos / 50 cigars / 250 g; perfume exceeds 50 g. The Travelling Public Info sheet grants travellers aged 17+ duty-free: 1 L spirits and 2 L wine; 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 125 g smoking tobacco; 50 g perfume or 0.25 L toilet water; other dutiable goods up to USD 400 total. Duty-free allowances do not apply to commercial-purpose goods; goods above allowance are declared with proof of purchase and duty is determined by Customs; untrue declarations risk penalties and forfeiture. Statutory basis: Customs Ordinance CAP 19.04 s.101(2) (entering persons declare goods or cash/negotiable instruments over USD 10,000 as the Collector directs); questioning and production of baggage for examination under s.101(4) form part of the same arrival declaration process and are not a separate procedure. Caveats: the two official documents give different smoking-tobacco allowances (250 g in the declaration guide, 125 g in the travelling-public information sheet) and carry no dates, so the exact current tobacco quota is not officially settled; the customs department's "what can I bring" page, which has shown a USD 600 allowance, currently does not display its content, so that figure cannot be confirmed and the USD 400 figures above are the ones stated in the two official PDFs.
procedures.applicability_zh: 每名抵达旅客（或负责任的家庭成员）须填写海关申报表C105并签名注明日期；同行同户家庭仅需一份书面申报。官方指南将家人定义为同户居住、有血缘、婚姻、伴侣（domestic relationship）或收养关系的成员；家庭成员超过4人时，追加成员另填一份申报表。居民须申报全部境外取得物品及所付价格（保留收据，含受赠礼品）；访客须申报带给他人的礼品及其他取得物品及购买价格。指南勾Yes门槛：新取得物品（含礼品）超过400美元；烈酒超过1升或葡萄酒超过2升（酒精含量低于40%）；烟草超过200支香烟/100支小雪茄/50支雪茄/250克；香水超过50克。《旅客公共信息》页授予17岁及以上旅客免税：烈酒1升、葡萄酒2升；200支香烟或100支小雪茄或50支雪茄或125克烟丝；香水50克或淡香水0.25升；其他应税物品总值不超过400美元。免税额度不适用于商业用途物品；超额度物品凭购买凭证申报、税费由海关确定；不实申报面临处罚与没收。法定依据：Customs Ordinance CAP 19.04第101(2)条（入境者按Collector指定方式申报超过10,000美元的物品或现金/可转让票据）；第101(4)条的答问与出示行李查验属同一入境申报流程的组成部分，不单列程序。注意：两份官方文件烟草额度不一致（申报指南写250克、旅客信息页写125克）且均未标注日期，现行精确额度尚无官方定论；海关官网“what can I bring”查询页过去显示600美元，当前页面不显示内容，该数字无法核实，上文400美元为两份官方PDF所载数字。
procedures.timing_en: Complete, sign and date on arrival; submit to Customs at entry control.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时填写、签名并注明日期，在入境监管环节交海关。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵達海關申報（C105表），涵蓋個人免稅額度與物品申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 每名抵達旅客（或負責任的家庭成員）須填寫海關申報表C105並簽名註明日期；同行同戶家庭僅需一份書面申報。官方指南將家人定義為同戶居住、有血緣、婚姻、伴侶（domestic relationship）或收養關係的成員；家庭成員超過4人時，追加成員另填一份申報表。居民須申報全部境外取得物品及所付價格（保留收據，含受贈禮品）；訪客須申報帶給他人的禮品及其他取得物品及購買價格。指南勾Yes門檻：新取得物品（含禮品）超過400美元；烈酒超過1升或葡萄酒超過2升（酒精含量低於40%）；菸草超過200支香菸/100支小雪茄/50支雪茄/250克；香水超過50克。《旅客公共資訊》頁授予17歲及以上旅客免稅：烈酒1升、葡萄酒2升；200支香菸或100支小雪茄或50支雪茄或125克菸絲；香水50克或淡香水0.25升；其他應稅物品總值不超過400美元。免稅額度不適用於商業用途物品；超額度物品憑購買憑證申報、稅費由海關確定；不實申報面臨處罰與沒收。法定依據：Customs Ordinance CAP 19.04第101(2)條（入境者按Collector指定方式申報超過10,000美元的物品或現金/可轉讓票據）；第101(4)條的答問與出示行李查驗屬同一入境申報流程的組成部分，不單列程序。注意：兩份官方文件菸草額度不一致（申報指南寫250克、旅客資訊頁寫125克）且均未標註日期，現行精確額度尚無官方定論；海關官網“what can I bring”查詢頁過去顯示600美元，當前頁面不顯示內容，該數字無法核實，上文400美元為兩份官方PDF所載數字。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時填寫、簽名並註明日期，在入境監管環節交海關。

procedures.name_en: Cross-border cash and negotiable instruments reporting (Report of International Transportation of Money)
procedures.name_zh: 跨境现金及可转让票据申报（国际资金运输报告表）
procedures.agency: Turks and Caicos Islands Customs Department / TCI Border Force (Ministry of Immigration and Border Services)
procedures.applicability_en: There is no limit on the amount of US or foreign cash that may be brought into or taken out of the Turks and Caicos Islands, but cash or negotiable instruments above the threshold must be declared to Customs by law. THRESHOLD CONFLICT PRESERVED: the Customs Ordinance CAP 19.04 (rev. 31 Dec 2014) s.101(2) and (5) require declaration of cash or negotiable instruments with a value OVER $10,000; the TCI Border Force page (last modified 25 Mar 2024) likewise says declare a value over USD 10,000.00; the 5 Sep 2018 official TCIG press release says cash over USD $10,000 in its title/body but, on the same page, requires a declaration for cash amounting to USD $10,000 OR MORE; and the current Border Force form header reads FOR AMOUNTS OF USD $10,000 OR MORE OR EQUIVALENT. Whether exactly USD 10,000 must be declared is therefore an explicit narrow unknown; amounts strictly above USD 10,000 are declarable under all sources. For above-threshold amounts (2018 official notice, procedure confirmed): the cash must FIRST be declared on the Customs Declaration form (C105), and additionally the details must be captured on the Report of International Transportation of Money; the form states information must be submitted to Customs immediately upon arrival and departure (a real second submission, both directions). The form (citing s.101, CAP 19.04 2014) records money type/currency/serial numbers/amounts, whether the declarant owns the money, origin, purpose of transport, owner/company and intended recipient details, is signed and dated, and Customs may retain a photocopy of identification. Scope of money: coins and notes of any currency; negotiable instruments such as personal or cashier's cheques, traveller's cheques, money orders, stocks and bonds (guide), drafts/bills of exchange and bearer instruments (ordinance); foreign equivalent or combinations count. The guide adds that once $10,000 is reached it does not matter if the amount is split among family members - it must still be declared. Postal cash follows the same C105-plus-report-form route; cash in cargo is declared through the ASYCUDA process using the form. The form's 'OR MORE' wording reflects the actual current form requirement but is not confirmed as the statutory boundary. Sanctions: failure to declare is an offence punishable by a fine of USD 10,000 or three times the value of the cash (whichever is greater), with seizure of the cash; scrutiny of those responsible for the cash.
procedures.applicability_zh: 带入或带出特克斯和凯科斯群岛的美元或外币现金金额不设上限，但超过门槛的现金或可转让票据依法须向海关申报。门槛冲突予以保留：Customs Ordinance CAP 19.04（2014年12月31日修订版）第101(2)、(5)条要求申报价值超过（over）10,000美元的现金或可转让票据；TCI Border Force页面（最后修改2024年3月25日）同样写申报价值超过（over）USD 10,000.00；2018年9月5日官方TCIG新闻稿标题与正文写超过（over）USD $10,000，但同页又要求对达到USD $10,000或以上（or more）的现金作出申报；现行Border Force现金表抬头写明FOR AMOUNTS OF USD $10,000 OR MORE OR EQUIVALENT。恰为10,000美元是否须申报因此为明确窄未知；所有来源一致要求申报严格超过10,000美元的金额。对超门槛金额（2018年官方公告明确的程序）：须先在海关申报表（C105）上申报现金，另外填写《国际资金运输报告表》（Report of International Transportation of Money）录入现金细节；表格写明信息须于入境和出境时立即提交海关（入境/出境真实第二提交）。该表（援引CAP 19.04 2014第101条）记录币种/现金类型/序列号/金额、申报人是否拥有该款项、来源、运输用途、所有者/公司及预期接收人信息，须签名注明日期，海关可留存身份证件复印件。资金范围：任何币种硬币与纸币；可转让票据含个人或银行本票、旅行支票、汇票、股票债券（指南）及汇票/交换票据与无记名票据（条例）；外币等值或合并计算。指南并说明：只要达到10,000美元，不论由一人携带或拆分由3或4名家庭成员分携，仍须申报。邮政现金同样走C105加报告表路径；货物中的现金经ASYCUDA程序用该表申报。表格的OR MORE措辞反映现行实际表单要求，但不确认为法定边界。罚则：不申报属犯罪，可处罚金USD 10,000或现金价值三倍（取较高者），现金可被扣押；对负责现金者施以进一步审查。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival and departure: the form states information must be submitted to Customs immediately upon arrival and departure; the C105 step is completed on arrival (or at mailing/cargo declaration for non-travellers).
procedures.timing_zh: 入境与出境时：表格写明信息须于入境和出境时立即提交海关；C105步骤在抵达时完成（非旅行者的邮寄/货运环节随相应申报完成）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境現金及可轉讓票據申報（國際資金運輸報告表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 帶入或帶出特克斯和凱科斯群島的美元或外幣現金金額不設上限，但超過門檻的現金或可轉讓票據依法須向海關申報。門檻衝突予以保留：Customs Ordinance CAP 19.04（2014年12月31日修訂版）第101(2)、(5)條要求申報價值超過（over）10,000美元的現金或可轉讓票據；TCI Border Force頁面（最後修改2024年3月25日）同樣寫申報價值超過（over）USD 10,000.00；2018年9月5日官方TCIG新聞稿標題與正文寫超過（over）USD $10,000，但同頁又要求對達到USD $10,000或以上（or more）的現金作出申報；現行Border Force現金錶抬頭寫明FOR AMOUNTS OF USD $10,000 OR MORE OR EQUIVALENT。恰為10,000美元是否須申報因此為明確窄未知；所有來源一致要求申報嚴格超過10,000美元的金額。對超門檻金額（2018年官方公告明確的程序）：須先在海關申報表（C105）上申報現金，另外填寫《國際資金運輸報告表》（Report of International Transportation of Money）錄入現金細節；表格寫明資訊須於入境和出境時立即提交海關（入境/出境真實第二提交）。該表（援引CAP 19.04 2014第101條）記錄幣種/現金類型/序列號/金額、申報人是否擁有該款項、來源、運輸用途、所有者/公司及預期接收人資訊，須簽名註明日期，海關可留存身份證件複印件。資金範圍：任何幣種硬幣與紙幣；可轉讓票據含個人或銀行本票、旅行支票、匯票、股票債券（指南）及匯票/交換票據與無記名票據（條例）；外幣等值或合併計算。指南並說明：只要達到10,000美元，不論由一人攜帶或拆分由3或4名家庭成員分攜，仍須申報。郵政現金同樣走C105加報告表路徑；貨物中的現金經ASYCUDA程序用該表申報。表格的OR MORE措辭反映現行實際表單要求，但不確認為法定邊界。罰則：不申報屬犯罪，可處罰金USD 10,000或現金價值三倍（取較高者），現金可被扣押；對負責現金者施以進一步審查。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境與出境時：表格寫明資訊須於入境和出境時立即提交海關；C105步驟在抵達時完成（非旅行者的郵寄/貨運環節隨相應申報完成）。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of articles to a CBP officer on entry into the United States (U.S. customs territory) from the U.S. Virgin Islands
procedures.name_zh: 自美属维尔京群岛入境美国（美国海关领土：本土各州/哥伦比亚特区/波多黎各）时向CBP关员申报携带物品
procedures.agency: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP)
procedures.applicability_en: Scope: the federal declaration duty when entering the United States from the U.S. Virgin Islands — not the local formalities for a person arriving INTO the USVI. Under 19 CFR 101.1, the customs territory of the United States includes only the States, the District of Columbia, and Puerto Rico; the customs ports in the Virgin Islands, although under the jurisdiction of the Secretary of the Treasury, have their own customs laws (48 U.S.C. 1406(i)), are outside the customs territory of the United States, and are not "ports of entry" within the meaning of these regulations. Under 48 U.S.C. 1406i the Secretary of the Treasury designates the several ports and sub-ports of entry in the USVI and administers the customs laws there; no new export duties may be levied in the Virgin Islands except by the Congress. Declaration duty: under 19 CFR 148.11, all articles brought into the United States by any individual must be declared to a CBP officer at the port of first arrival in the United States, on a conveyance en route to the United States on which a CBP officer is assigned for that purpose, or at a preclearance office in a foreign country. This therefore governs travelers proceeding from the USVI to a U.S. State, the District of Columbia, or Puerto Rico, and must NOT be generalized to every person arriving in the USVI. Form of declaration: under 19 CFR 148.12, returning residents and nonresidents arriving in the United States may make an oral declaration only under the stated conditions — a returning resident if the aggregate fair retail value in the country of acquisition of all accompanying articles acquired abroad (and of alterations and dutiable repairs made abroad) does not exceed the applicable ceiling, which for a direct or indirect arrival from the USVI (as from American Samoa, Guam, or the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands) is $1,600, not more than $800 of which must have been acquired elsewhere than in such locations, and if none of his accompanying articles are forwarded in bond or imported for the account of another person or for sale; a nonresident if all articles to declare are entitled to free entry under personal exemptions or under the administrative exemption for articles not exceeding $200 in aggregate value (19 U.S.C. 1321(a)(2)(B)). Written declarations may be required generally or in respect to particular types of traffic at any port, and even where an oral declaration is permitted, completion of the identifying information on CBP Form 6059-B may be required. Under 19 CFR 148.13, unless an oral declaration is accepted under § 148.12, the declaration required of a person arriving in the United States must be in writing on Customs Form 6059-B; the declarant must list all articles acquired abroad in his possession at the time of arrival (with the price paid or fair retail value per article, subject to the stated itemization rules), and each written declaration must be acknowledged before the Customs officer who examines the baggage. Not covered: local USVI entry forms, duty-free allowances, and cash-declaration rules for arrival into the USVI itself. Carrier and general-aviation preinspection and agricultural inspection are not separate passenger submissions. The $1,600 figure is the 19 CFR 148.12 oral-declaration value ceiling for returning residents arriving from the USVI, not a general duty-free allowance; the separate duty-free allowance mechanics of 19 CFR 148.33–148.35 (30-day use limits, family grouping, 48-hour rule) are not covered here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 范围：由美属维尔京群岛（USVI）入境美国时的联邦申报义务，不含抵达USVI本身的本地手续。19 CFR 101.1 界定“美国海关领土”仅含各州、哥伦比亚特区和波多黎各；维尔京群岛海关港口虽隶属财政部长管辖，但另具自身海关法（48 U.S.C. 1406(i)），在美国海关领土之外，且非上述规章意义下的“ports of entry”。48 U.S.C. 1406i 规定财政部长指定USVI各口岸与子口岸并管理当地海关法；除国会外不得在USVI新征出口税。申报义务：依19 CFR 148.11，任何个人带入美国的全部物品须在入美第一入境口岸（port of first arrival in the United States）向CBP关员申报，或在配有CBP关员的赴美运输工具上、或在美国关员驻外的预检办事处申报。故该申报义务适用于由USVI前往美国本土各州、哥伦比亚特区或波多黎各的旅客，不得概括为所有抵达USVI者。申报形式：依19 CFR 148.12，返程居民与非居民抵达美国仅在规定条件下可口头申报——返程居民须其在境外取得的全部随身物品（含境外改动及应税修理）按取得国公平零售价合计不超过适用上限：直接或间接自USVI抵达（如同自美属萨摩亚、关岛、北马里亚纳群岛联邦抵达）者为1,600美元，其中在上述地点以外取得的部分不得超过800美元，且无随身物品保税转运、亦非为他人账户或转售进口；非居民须其须申报的全部物品属个人免税或不超过200美元合计价值的行政小额免税（19 U.S.C. 1321(a)(2)(B)）。任何口岸仍可一般性或就特定交通类型要求书面申报；即使允许口头申报，也可能要求填写CBP Form 6059-B的识别信息。依19 CFR 148.13，凡口头申报未按§ 148.12被接受，抵达美国者的申报须以Customs Form 6059-B书面作出；须列明抵达时持有的全部境外取得物品（逐项填报实付价格或取得国公平零售价，并按列明豁免规则执行），每份书面申报须在查验行李的海关关员面前确认。未覆盖：入境USVI本身的本地入境表、免税额度与现金申报规则。承运人/通用航空预检与农检不属于旅客另行提交的独立申报。1,600美元是19 CFR 148.12对自USVI抵达返程居民口头申报的价值上限，并非一般免税额度；19 CFR 148.33–148.35的免税额机制（30天使用限制、家庭合并、48小时规则）此处不涉及。
procedures.timing_en: At the port of first arrival in the United States — or on a conveyance en route to the United States on which a CBP officer is assigned, or at a foreign preclearance office. Where a written declaration is required (oral declaration not accepted, or required by the port), Customs Form 6059-B is completed at that point, listing all articles acquired abroad, and is acknowledged before the Customs officer who examines the baggage.
procedures.timing_zh: 在入美第一入境口岸——或在配有CBP关员的赴美运输工具上、或在外国的预检办事处——办理。需书面申报时（口头申报未获接受，或该口岸要求书面），即场填写Customs Form 6059-B列明全部境外取得物品，并在查验行李的海关关员面前确认。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 自美屬維爾京群島入境美國（美國海關領土：本土各州/哥倫比亞特區/波多黎各）時向CBP關員申報攜帶物品
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 範圍：由美屬維爾京群島（USVI）入境美國時的聯邦申報義務，不含抵達USVI本身的本地手續。19 CFR 101.1 界定“美國海關領土”僅含各州、哥倫比亞特區和波多黎各；維爾京群島海關港口雖隸屬財政部長管轄，但另具自身海關法（48 U.S.C. 1406(i)），在美國海關領土之外，且非上述規章意義下的“ports of entry”。48 U.S.C. 1406i 規定財政部長指定USVI各口岸與子口岸並管理當地海關法；除國會外不得在USVI新徵出口稅。申報義務：依19 CFR 148.11，任何個人帶入美國的全部物品須在入美第一入境口岸（port of first arrival in the United States）向CBP關員申報，或在配有CBP關員的赴美運輸工具上、或在美國關員駐外的預檢辦事處申報。故該申報義務適用於由USVI前往美國本土各州、哥倫比亞特區或波多黎各的旅客，不得概括為所有抵達USVI者。申報形式：依19 CFR 148.12，返程居民與非居民抵達美國僅在規定條件下可口頭申報——返程居民須其在境外取得的全部隨身物品（含境外改動及應稅修理）按取得國公平零售價合計不超過適用上限：直接或間接自USVI抵達（如同自美屬薩摩亞、關島、北馬里亞納群島聯邦抵達）者為1,600美元，其中在上述地點以外取得的部分不得超過800美元，且無隨身物品保稅轉運、亦非為他人賬戶或轉售進口；非居民須其須申報的全部物品屬個人免稅或不超過200美元合計價值的行政小額免稅（19 U.S.C. 1321(a)(2)(B)）。任何口岸仍可一般性或就特定交通類型要求書面申報；即使允許口頭申報，也可能要求填寫CBP Form 6059-B的識別資訊。依19 CFR 148.13，凡口頭申報未按§ 148.12被接受，抵達美國者的申報須以Customs Form 6059-B書面作出；須列明抵達時持有的全部境外取得物品（逐項填報實付價格或取得國公平零售價，並按列明豁免規則執行），每份書面申報須在查驗行李的海關關員面前確認。未覆蓋：入境USVI本身的本地入境表、免稅額度與現金申報規則。承運人/通用航空預檢與農檢不屬於旅客另行提交的獨立申報。1,600美元是19 CFR 148.12對自USVI抵達返程居民口頭申報的價值上限，並非一般免稅額度；19 CFR 148.33–148.35的免稅額機制（30天使用限制、家庭合併、48小時規則）此處不涉及。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在入美第一入境口岸——或在配有CBP關員的赴美運輸工具上、或在外國的預檢辦事處——辦理。需書面申報時（口頭申報未獲接受，或該口岸要求書面），即場填寫Customs Form 6059-B列明全部境外取得物品，並在查驗行李的海關關員面前確認。

procedures.name_en: FinCEN Form 105 report of currency or monetary instruments over US$10,000 carried into or out of the United States (including the U.S. Virgin Islands)
procedures.name_zh: 携带超过 10,000 美元的货币或货币工具进出美国（含美属维尔京群岛）的 FinCEN 105 表报告
procedures.agency: U.S. Customs and Border Protection / FinCEN (U.S. Department of the Treasury)
procedures.applicability_en: Federal rule, 31 CFR 1010.340. Anyone who physically transports, mails or ships currency or other monetary instruments in an aggregate amount exceeding $10,000 at one time from the United States to any place outside the United States, or into the United States from any place outside it, must file a report. For this rule 'United States' includes the Territories and Insular Possessions, and the U.S. Virgin Islands are listed among them, so the rule applies to a traveller moving more than $10,000 between the U.S. Virgin Islands and a place outside the United States. A traveller carrying the currency or instruments files FinCEN Form 105 with the Customs officer in charge at the port of entry or departure, at the time of entry into or departure from the United States. A person who receives more than $10,000 in the United States that was sent from abroad without a report must also file one, within 15 days of receipt. The rule does not apply to reports by Federal Reserve banks, banks and securities brokers in some cases, and common carriers of passengers for currency in their passengers' possession. A transfer of funds through normal banking channels that involves no physical transport is not reportable. The regulation's threshold is 'exceeding $10,000'.
procedures.applicability_zh: 联邦规定，31 CFR 1010.340。任何人一次性亲自携带、邮寄或托运合计超过 $10,000 的货币或其他货币工具，从美国运往美国境外任何地点，或从境外运入美国，须提交报告。就该规定而言，“美国”包括各属地和海外领地，美属维尔京群岛列入其中，因此该规定适用于在美属维尔京群岛与美国境外之间携带超过 $10,000 的旅客。随身携带货币或工具的旅客，须在入境或出境美国时，向入境或离境口岸的主管海关官员提交 FinCEN 105 表。在美国境内收到来自境外的超过 $10,000 的货币或工具、且未曾有人提交报告的，收款人须在收款后 15 日内提交。联邦储备银行、部分情形下的银行和证券经纪商，以及旅客现金的客运承运人，不在报告义务之列。通过正常银行渠道转账而不涉及实物运输的，无须报告。条文的门槛为“超过 $10,000”。
procedures.timing_en: At the time of entry into or departure from the United States, with the Customs officer in charge at the port.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或出境美国时，向口岸主管海关官员提交。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 攜帶超過 10,000 美元的貨幣或貨幣工具進出美國（含美屬維爾京群島）的 FinCEN 105 表報告
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 聯邦規定，31 CFR 1010.340。任何人一次性親自攜帶、郵寄或託運合計超過 $10,000 的貨幣或其他貨幣工具，從美國運往美國境外任何地點，或從境外運入美國，須提交報告。就該規定而言，“美國”包括各屬地和海外領地，美屬維爾京群島列入其中，因此該規定適用於在美屬維爾京群島與美國境外之間攜帶超過 $10,000 的旅客。隨身攜帶貨幣或工具的旅客，須在入境或出境美國時，向入境或離境口岸的主管海關官員提交 FinCEN 105 表。在美國境內收到來自境外的超過 $10,000 的貨幣或工具、且未曾有人提交報告的，收款人須在收款後 15 日內提交。聯邦儲備銀行、部分情形下的銀行和證券經紀商，以及旅客現金的客運承運人，不在報告義務之列。通過正常銀行渠道轉賬而不涉及實物運輸的，無須報告。條文的門檻為“超過 $10,000”。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或出境美國時，向口岸主管海關官員提交。
