procedures.name_en: Written declaration of cash of at least EUR 10,000 (cash controls)
procedures.name_zh: 现金书面申报（至少1万欧元）
procedures.agency: Generální ředitelství cel (Czech Customs Administration)
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers entering Czechia from outside the EU or leaving Czechia for outside the EU must declare in writing to customs cash carried on the person, in luggage or in the vehicle with a total value of at least EUR 10,000 (AML Act No. 253/2008 Sb. § 41; Regulation (EU) 2018/1672). Cash covers banknotes and coins, bearer-negotiable instruments (cheques, travellers' cheques, promissory notes, money orders), highly liquid commodities (gold coins at least 90 % gold, bullion at least 99.5 %) and unnamed prepaid cards. The duty also applies once cash imported, exported or sent in shipments within any 12 consecutive months cumulatively reaches EUR 10,000. Carrying at least EUR 15,000 within Czechia (including intra-EU travel) creates only an information duty upon a customs request during checks (§ 41a), not a second advance declaration. Breach is an offence with a fine up to CZK 10,000,000 (on-the-spot fine up to CZK 10,000) and the cash may be seized.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自非欧盟地区入境捷克或自捷克出境前往非欧盟地区的旅客，随身、行李内或所乘车辆中携带总价值至少 10,000 欧元的现金，须向海关书面申报（第253/2008号反洗钱法第41条；欧盟条例 (EU) 2018/1672）。现金包括纸币与硬币、无记名可转让票据（支票、旅行支票、本票、汇票）、高流动性商品（含金量至少90%的金币、至少99.5%的金条）及无记名预付卡。任意12个连续月内进口、出口或以邮件运送的现金累计达到 10,000 欧元时亦产生申报义务。在捷克境内（含欧盟内部旅行）携带至少 15,000 欧元仅在海关查验要求时提供资料（第41a条），不构成第二个主动申报程序。违反义务属违法行为，罚款最高 10,000,000 捷克克朗（现场罚款最高 10,000 捷克克朗），现金可被扣押。
procedures.timing_en: On entering or leaving Czechia at the border, using the joint EU declaration form ("Ohlášení peněžní hotovosti"), available on the customs website and at any customs office; at international airports the forms are placed before the customs area in the departures zone and before the red exit marked "Zboží k proclení" in the arrivals zone. Filing in person, by data box or via the cPortál system is valid; the customs office stamps a copy on request. The 12-month aggregate duty arises when the person knows the EUR 10,000 threshold will be reached.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或出境捷克时在边境办理，使用欧盟统一申报表（"Ohlášení peněžní hotovosti"），表格可从海关网站或任一海关署领取；国际机场在出发区海关区之前及到达区标有"Zboží k proclení"（应税货物）的红色出口前备有表格。亲自递交、经数据信箱或通过 cPortál 系统提交均属有效；海关可应要求在副本上盖章。12个月累计义务自行为人知悉将达到 10,000 欧元门槛时产生。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金書面申報（至少1萬歐元）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自非歐盟地區入境捷克或自捷克出境前往非歐盟地區的旅客，隨身、行李內或所乘車輛中攜帶總價值至少 10,000 歐元的現金，須向海關書面申報（第253/2008號反洗錢法第41條；歐盟條例 (EU) 2018/1672）。現金包括紙幣與硬幣、無記名可轉讓票據（支票、旅行支票、本票、匯票）、高流動性商品（含金量至少90%的金幣、至少99.5%的金條）及無記名預付卡。任意12個連續月內進口、出口或以郵件運送的現金累計達到 10,000 歐元時亦產生申報義務。在捷克境內（含歐盟內部旅行）攜帶至少 15,000 歐元僅在海關查驗要求時提供資料（第41a條），不構成第二個主動申報程序。違反義務屬違法行為，罰款最高 10,000,000 捷克克朗（現場罰款最高 10,000 捷克克朗），現金可被扣押。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或出境捷克時在邊境辦理，使用歐盟統一申報表（"Ohlášení peněžní hotovosti"），表格可從海關網站或任一海關署領取；國際機場在出發區海關區之前及到達區標有"Zboží k proclení"（應稅貨物）的紅色出口前備有表格。親自遞交、經資料信箱或通過 cPortál 系統提交均屬有效；海關可應要求在副本上蓋章。12個月累計義務自行為人知悉將達到 10,000 歐元門檻時產生。

procedures.applicability_en: Arriving by air: tobacco up to 200 cigarettes (10 packets) or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 g tobacco or 125 g smokeless tobacco; alcohol 1 L over 22% or 2 L up to 22%, plus 4 L still wine and 16 L beer. procedures.name_en: Traveller customs declaration for non-EU goods (oral, by act, paper or electronic)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客非欧盟货物海关申报（口头、行为、纸质或电子）
procedures.agency: Ministerstwo Finansów — Krajowa Administracja Skarbowa (KAS)
procedures.applicability_en: Required when importing goods from outside the EU into Poland or exporting goods out of the EU; goods from EU countries brought to Poland need no customs declaration. Personal baggage is everything the traveller can present to customs (e.g. clothes, electronics, up to 10 L of fuel in a canister) — hand or checked luggage alike, so the earlier 'checked baggage' limitation no longer applies. In release for free circulation, non-commercial personal-baggage goods that qualify for relief may be declared by an act (walking the green channel or 'nothing to declare'); personal-baggage goods that do not qualify for relief must be declared orally to the customs officer, who issues a 'Dokument potwierdzający dokonanie zgłoszenia celnego' stating the customs duties and taxes to be paid. Paper (form JDA, BC EAD or KOMUNIKATOR+) or electronic declaration (AIS/IMPORT PLUS on import, AES/ECS2 PLUS on export, via PUESC) is required where prohibitions or restrictions apply, or for commercial-character goods whose value exceeds EUR 1,000 or whose net mass exceeds 1,000 kg. The relief ceilings are eligibility rules, not a separate form: relief up to a total value of EUR 300 (land travel) or EUR 430 (air or sea travel), excluding medicines, personal items to be re-exported or re-imported, tank fuel plus up to 10 L in a canister, and in-quota tobacco/alcohol; the tobacco and alcohol quotas (age 17+) are relief conditions, not a filing age.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自欧盟以外将货物运入波兰或将货物运出欧盟时须办理海关申报；自欧盟国家带入波兰的货物无需海关申报。“个人行李”指旅客能向海关出示的一切物品（如衣物、电子产品、桶装备用燃油不超过10升），手提与托运同样适用，旧记录的“托运行李”限缩不再成立。在放行流通程序中，属免税范围且无商业性质的个人行李物品可通过行为申报（走绿色通道或“无需申报”）；不属免税范围的个人行李物品必须口头向海关官员申报，官员出具载明应缴关税与税款的“Dokument potwierdzający dokonanie zgłoszenia celnego”（海关申报完成证明文件）。凡适用禁止或限制措施，或货物具有商业性质且价值超过1,000欧元或净重超过1,000公斤，须纸质（JDA统一行政文件、BC EAD或KOMUNIKATOR+）或电子申报（入境用AIS/IMPORT PLUS，出境用AES/ECS2 PLUS，均经PUESC）。免税额度（陆路合计300欧、空运或海运430欧；药品、将复运出境或复运入境的物品、油箱燃油及桶装至多10升、限额内烟酒不计入）与烟酒17岁年龄界限均为优惠资格条件，不是另一张表格，也不是申报年龄门槛。
procedures.timing_en: At the border crossing when entering or leaving the EU: the oral declaration or the green-channel act is made on the spot to the customs officer, who issues the confirmation document for non-relieved goods; paper JDA or electronic filing via the PUESC systems where required. Temporarily admitted goods must be re-exported when the traveller who brought them leaves the EU customs territory. No separate declaration fee is stated on the 2025-12-15 page; customs duties, VAT and excise on non-relieved goods are taxes, not a form fee.
procedures.timing_zh: 在进入或离开欧盟的口岸现场办理：口头申报或绿道行为当场向海关官员作出，超免税物品由官员出具证明文件；需要时经PUESC系统提交纸质JDA或电子申报。暂时入境物品在携带旅客离开欧盟关税区时须复运出境。2025-12-15页面未载明任何单独申报费用；超免税物品的关税、增值税与消费税属税款，不是表费。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客非歐盟貨物海關申報（口頭、行為、紙質或電子）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自歐盟以外將貨物運入波蘭或將貨物運出歐盟時須辦理海關申報；自歐盟國家帶入波蘭的貨物無需海關申報。“個人行李”指旅客能向海關出示的一切物品（如衣物、電子產品、桶裝備用燃油不超過10升），手提與託運同樣適用，舊記錄的“托運行李”限縮不再成立。在放行流通程序中，屬免稅範圍且無商業性質的個人行李物品可通過行為申報（走綠色通道或“無需申報”）；不屬免稅範圍的個人行李物品必須口頭向海關官員申報，官員出具載明應繳關稅與稅款的“Dokument potwierdzający dokonanie zgłoszenia celnego”（海關申報完成證明文件）。凡適用禁止或限制措施，或貨物具有商業性質且價值超過1,000歐元或淨重超過1,000公斤，須紙質（JDA統一行政文件、BC EAD或KOMUNIKATOR+）或電子申報（入境用AIS/IMPORT PLUS，出境用AES/ECS2 PLUS，均經PUESC）。免稅額度（陸路合計300歐、空運或海運430歐；藥品、將復運出境或復運入境的物品、油箱燃油及桶裝至多10升、限額內菸酒不計入）與菸酒17歲年齡界限均為優惠資格條件，不是另一張表格，也不是申報年齡門檻。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在進入或離開歐盟的口岸現場辦理：口頭申報或綠道行為當場向海關官員作出，超免稅物品由官員出具證明文件；需要時經PUESC系統提交紙質JDA或電子申報。暫時入境物品在攜帶旅客離開歐盟關稅區時須復運出境。2025-12-15頁面未載明任何單獨申報費用；超免稅物品的關稅、增值稅與消費稅屬稅款，不是表費。

procedures.name_en: Written declaration of cash and bearer funds on entering or leaving the EU (total value equal to or exceeding EUR 10,000, threshold inclusive)
procedures.name_zh: 进出欧盟现金等资金书面申报（总值达到或超过1万欧元，含本数）
procedures.agency: Ministerstwo Finansów — Krajowa Administracja Skarbowa (KAS), Służba Celno-Skarbowa
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers entering or leaving the European Union through its external border who carry funds whose total value is equal to or exceeds EUR 10,000 (threshold inclusive) — including the equivalent in other currencies — must declare them in writing. Funds cover cash, traveller's cheques, cheques, bills of exchange (weksle), bearer money orders, coins with at least 90% gold content and gold in bars, nuggets or lumps with at least 99.5% gold content, as well as non-personalised prepaid cards (border-portal list of 2021-08-06); the 2026-07-09 KAS reminder likewise names cheques, bills of exchange, money orders and gold bars. The means of transport is irrelevant (KAS, 2021-05-27). The duty falls on each person carrying such funds, both on entering and on leaving the EU.
procedures.applicability_zh: 经欧盟外部边境进入或离开欧盟的旅客，携带资金总值达到或超过1万欧元（含本数，恰好等于1万欧元亦须申报）或等值其它货币的，须书面申报。资金范围包括：现金、旅行支票、支票、票据（weksle）、来人抬头汇款单、含金量至少90%的金币以及呈金条、天然块或块料状且含金量至少99.5%的黄金，还有非记名预付卡（边境门户2021-08-06清单）；2026-07-09 KAS提醒同样列明支票、票据、汇款单与金条。交通工具不影响义务（KAS，2021-05-27）。义务由携带人承担，入境与出境分别触发。
procedures.timing_en: The completed written declaration (Annex I forms to Regulation (EU) 2018/1672, downloadable from granica.gov.pl) must be lodged while crossing the EU border with the competent authorities — in Poland the KAS customs organs; the 2021 KAS notice also names the Border Guard (Straż Graniczna) — and the declared funds must be presented for control. After logging in to PUESC a natural person may register and send KAS a pre-filled declaration which is then used for the official registration of the 'Deklaracja środków pieniężnych' during border clearance; the pre-fill shortens the check but is not by itself the completed statutory declaration — official registration still takes place at the border. KAS states that lodging the currency declaration carries no fees (gov.pl, 2023-01-05); failure to declare or false data may result in a fine.
procedures.timing_zh: 填妥的书面申报（欧盟2018/1672号条例附件I表格，可自granica.gov.pl下载）须在跨越欧盟边境时递交主管机关——在波兰为KAS海关；2021年KAS通知亦列边境警卫队（Straż Graniczna）——并须出示所申报资金以备查验。自然人可事先登录PUESC，登记并向KAS发送预填申报，供边境办理“Deklaracja środków pieniężnych”正式登记时使用；预填可缩短查验时间，但其本身不等于完成法定申报，正式登记仍在边境进行。KAS明示提交外汇申报不产生任何费用（gov.pl，2023-01-05）；不申报或填报不实数据可被罚款。

fee.note: Lodging the written currency declaration itself is free of charge: 'Złożenie deklaracji dewizowej nie wiąże się z żadnymi opłatami' (KAS, gov.pl, 2023-01-05). Scope is only the cash/bearer-funds declaration on crossing the EU external border; the 2026-07-09 KAS reminder restates the same duty with no mention of any fee. Not applicable to the goods customs declaration. Non-declaration or false data may result in a fine (mandat), which is a penalty, not a declaration fee.

procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出歐盟現金等資金書面申報（總值達到或超過1萬歐元，含本數）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 經歐盟外部邊境進入或離開歐盟的旅客，攜帶資金總值達到或超過1萬歐元（含本數，恰好等於1萬歐元亦須申報）或等值其它貨幣的，須書面申報。資金範圍包括：現金、旅行支票、支票、票據（weksle）、來人抬頭匯款單、含金量至少90%的金幣以及呈金條、天然塊或塊料狀且含金量至少99.5%的黃金，還有非記名預付卡（邊境門戶2021-08-06清單）；2026-07-09 KAS提醒同樣列明支票、票據、匯款單與金條。交通工具不影響義務（KAS，2021-05-27）。義務由攜帶人承擔，入境與出境分別觸發。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 填妥的書面申報（歐盟2018/1672號條例附件I表格，可自granica.gov.pl下載）須在跨越歐盟邊境時遞交主管機關——在波蘭為KAS海關；2021年KAS通知亦列邊境警衛隊（Straż Graniczna）——並須出示所申報資金以備查驗。自然人可事先登入PUESC，登記並向KAS發送預填申報，供邊境辦理“Deklaracja środków pieniężnych”正式登記時使用；預填可縮短查驗時間，但其本身不等於完成法定申報，正式登記仍在邊境進行。KAS明示提交外匯申報不產生任何費用（gov.pl，2023-01-05）；不申報或填報不實資料可被罰款。

procedures.name_en: Written declaration of currency values of EUR 10,000 or more (or equivalent) — Law No. 62/2008 Art. 33 / Customs Service of the Republic of Moldova
procedures.name_zh: 货币价值书面申报（1万欧元或等值及以上）——第62/2008号法第33条/摩尔多瓦海关署
procedures.agency: Customs Service of the Republic of Moldova (Serviciul Vamal al Republicii Moldova)
procedures.applicability_en: Natural persons, residents and non-residents of Moldova; BOTH directions — bringing into or taking out of Moldova. Written declaration to the customs authorities is OBLIGATORY when the total, per person per trip, of (a) cash in national currency plus foreign-currency cash and traveller's cheques, or (b) securities and payment instruments other than foreign-currency traveller's cheques, is EUR 10,000 (or equivalent) or more (Law No. 62/2008 on currency regulation, Art. 33(1), as amended by Law No. 124 of 29.05.2025, in force 12.07.2025). Below EUR 10,000 per person/trip, written declaration is a right, not a duty (Art. 33(2)). Per the Customs Service standing page: the mandatory case is handled on the 'Declarația valorilor valutare' form (Customs Service Order No. 516-O of 07.12.2023), the optional case on the traveller's customs declaration (Order No. 482-O/2023); the currency-values declaration covers the values regardless of who owns them, once the total starts from EUR 10,000 (or equivalent) per person/trip. The traveller informs the customs officer of the intent to declare and the officer provides the form (Romanian or English, completed manually in block capitals). The red channel must be used when carrying currency, goods or other values that must be declared; the green channel only when carrying nothing declarable. Cash in national or foreign currency and foreign-currency traveller's cheques may NOT be brought in/taken out in unaccompanied baggage. Age condition for declaration: not stated (unknown). Fee: not stated (unknown).
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于摩尔多瓦居民与非居民自然人；方向为双向——带入或带出摩尔多瓦。按《第62/2008号外汇调节法》第33条第(1)款（经2025年5月29日第124号法修订，2025年7月12日生效）：每人每次旅行，(a)本国货币现金及外币现金与旅行支票，或(b)有价证券及支付工具（外币旅行支票除外），总值达10,000欧元（或等值）及以上时，必须向海关书面申报；低于10,000欧元时，书面申报是权利而非义务（第(2)款）。据海关署常设页：强制情形使用《货币价值申报单》（海关署2023年12月7日第516-O号令），自愿情形使用《旅客海关申报单》（第482-O/2023号令）；货币价值申报单不论价值归属何人，总值自10,000欧元（或等值）/人/次起即适用。旅客须告知海关关员申报意向，由其提供表格（罗马尼亚语或英语，用深色笔以大写字母手工填写）。携带须申报的货币、物品或其他价值必须走红色通道，确无申报物方可走绿色通道。本外币现金及外币旅行支票不得放入非随身（分离）行李进出摩尔多瓦。申报的年龄条件未载明（unknown）；费用未载明（unknown）。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of crossing the state border, in either direction (entry into or exit from Moldova): the completed and signed currency-values declaration, with the transported currency values, is presented for customs control at the customs post through which the person enters or leaves the country, after informing the customs officer, who provides the form.
procedures.timing_zh: 跨越国境之时（入境或出境双向）：填妥并签名的《货币价值申报单》连同所携货币价值，在其入/出境的海关哨所交验；须先告知海关关员申报意向，由其提供表格。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 貨幣價值書面申報（1萬歐元或等值及以上）——第62/2008號法第33條/摩爾多瓦海關署
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於摩爾多瓦居民與非居民自然人；方向為雙向——帶入或帶出摩爾多瓦。按《第62/2008號外匯調節法》第33條第(1)款（經2025年5月29日第124號法修訂，2025年7月12日生效）：每人每次旅行，(a)本國貨幣現金及外幣現金與旅行支票，或(b)有價證券及支付工具（外幣旅行支票除外），總值達10,000歐元（或等值）及以上時，必須向海關書面申報；低於10,000歐元時，書面申報是權利而非義務（第(2)款）。據海關署常設頁：強制情形使用《貨幣價值申報單》（海關署2023年12月7日第516-O號令），自願情形使用《旅客海關申報單》（第482-O/2023號令）；貨幣價值申報單不論價值歸屬何人，總值自10,000歐元（或等值）/人/次起即適用。旅客須告知海關關員申報意向，由其提供表格（羅馬尼亞語或英語，用深色筆以大寫字母手工填寫）。攜帶須申報的貨幣、物品或其他價值必須走紅色通道，確無申報物方可走綠色通道。本外幣現金及外幣旅行支票不得放入非隨身（分離）行李進出摩爾多瓦。申報的年齡條件未載明（unknown）；費用未載明（unknown）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 跨越國境之時（入境或出境雙向）：填妥並簽名的《貨幣價值申報單》連同所攜貨幣價值，在其入/出境的海關哨所交驗；須先告知海關關員申報意向，由其提供表格。

procedures.name_en: Traveller's customs declaration for personal-baggage goods, with duty-free import allowances — Customs Service of the Republic of Moldova
procedures.name_zh: 旅客个人行李物品海关申报及进口免税额——摩尔多瓦海关署
procedures.agency: Customs Service of the Republic of Moldova (Serviciul Vamal al Republicii Moldova)
procedures.applicability_en: Natural persons (travellers) carrying goods in personal baggage, on entry, exit or transit of the Moldovan customs border: the traveller's customs declaration (form approved by Customs Service Order No. 482-O/2023) declares the goods in personal baggage. The written form is deposited for: commercial-character goods in personal baggage not exceeding EUR 1,000 or 1,000 kg net; goods whose cross-border transport is authorized by other control authorities; personal baggage under Customs Code art. 225; at the traveller's request; at the customs officer's requirement; and may be used for voluntary declaration of currency values below EUR 10,000. Goods may also be declared verbally, or via the green channel / 'nothing to declare' (or through a post without a two-channel system, without a self-initiated declaration) — BUT written declaration is mandatory in all cases for: arms, ammunition, explosive and radioactive materials; live animals; wild flora/fauna species, parts and derived products; movable cultural goods; prescription medicines; foodstuffs exceeding the Annex 5 quantities to Government Decision No. 938/2018; household-utility goods (appliances etc.); other goods at the traveller's choice or the officer's request. Duty-free import allowance (goods brought INTO Moldova in personal baggage, non-commercial purposes): intrinsic value not exceeding EUR 300 per person by land transport, or EUR 430 per person for air and maritime travellers; tobacco products (200 cigarettes; 200 heated-tobacco refills; 50 cigars; 50 cigarillos; 250 g smoking tobacco); fuel in the vehicle's standard tank; alcoholic beverages (1 L of spirits over 22% vol or undenatured ethyl alcohol of 80% vol and over, or 2 L of alcohol up to 22% vol, any combination not exceeding 100% of the individual permitted quantities, plus 2 L still wine and 5 L beer). Export: natural persons may export goods of any value if non-commercial, subject to the formalities of Government Decision No. 92/2023 (pct. 281, 286, 289); export declarations may be verbal for non-commercial goods, commercial goods up to EUR 1,000 or 1,000 kg, transport means registered on the customs territory for re-import plus their spare parts/accessories, and animal-accompanying fodder. Age or frequency conditions for the allowances: not stated (unknown). Fee: not stated (unknown).
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于以个人行李携运物品的自然人（旅客），方向为入境、出境或过境摩尔多瓦海关边界：填写《旅客海关申报单》（海关署第482-O/2023号令批准的表格），申报个人行李中的物品。书面提交情形：个人行李中价值不超过1,000欧元或净重1,000公斤的商业性质货物；跨境运输须经其他监管机关批准的物品；海关法典第225条所指个人行李；应旅客本人要求；应海关关员要求；亦可用于1万欧元以下货币价值的自愿申报。物品也可口头申报，或经绿色通道/'无申报'通过（或在未设双通道系统的哨所直接通过而无须自行申报）——但下列物品任何情形均须书面申报：武器、弹药、爆炸及放射性物质；活动物；野生动植物物种及其部分或衍生制品；可移动文物；凭处方发放的药品；超过第938/2018号政府决定附件5所定数量的食品；家庭日用物品（家电等）；旅客自选或应海关关员要求的其他物品。进口免税额（以个人行李带入摩尔多瓦、非商业用途）：陆路运输每人内在价值不超过300欧元，乘空运或海运旅客每人不超过430欧元；烟草制品（香烟200支；加热烟草装置烟弹200个；雪茄50支；小雪茄50支；吸烟用烟丝250克）；交通工具标准油箱内的燃料；酒精饮料（浓度超过22%的酒精饮料或80%及以上浓度未变性乙醇合计1升，或浓度不超过22%的酒精饮料合计2升，可任意组合但各单项允许量使用百分比之和不超过100%，另加静置葡萄酒2升、啤酒5升）。出口：自然人可出口任何价值的非商业性质物品，须办理第92/2023号政府决定（第281、286、289点）规定的手续；非商业性质货物、价值不超过1,000欧元或1,000公斤的商业性质货物、在关境内登记用于复进口的交通工具及其零配件、随动物出口的饲料，可口头申报出口。免税额的年龄或频次条件未载明（unknown）；费用未载明（unknown）。
procedures.timing_en: When crossing the Moldovan customs border on entry, exit or transit; the duty-free import allowances apply at the moment of bringing goods into Moldova in personal baggage.
procedures.timing_zh: 跨越摩尔多瓦海关边界入境、出境或过境之时；进口免税额适用于以个人行李将物品带入摩尔多瓦之时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客個人行李物品海關申報及進口免稅額——摩爾多瓦海關署
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於以個人行李攜運物品的自然人（旅客），方向為入境、出境或過境摩爾多瓦海關邊界：填寫《旅客海關申報單》（海關署第482-O/2023號令批准的表格），申報個人行李中的物品。書面提交情形：個人行李中價值不超過1,000歐元或淨重1,000公斤的商業性質貨物；跨境運輸須經其他監管機關批准的物品；海關法典第225條所指個人行李；應旅客本人要求；應海關關員要求；亦可用於1萬歐元以下貨幣價值的自願申報。物品也可口頭申報，或經綠色通道/'無申報'通過（或在未設雙通道系統的哨所直接通過而無須自行申報）——但下列物品任何情形均須書面申報：武器、彈藥、爆炸及放射性物質；活動物；野生動植物物種及其部分或衍生製品；可移動文物；憑處方發放的藥品；超過第938/2018號政府決定附件5所定數量的食品；家庭日用物品（家電等）；旅客自選或應海關關員要求的其他物品。進口免稅額（以個人行李帶入摩爾多瓦、非商業用途）：陸路運輸每人內在價值不超過300歐元，乘空運或海運旅客每人不超過430歐元；菸草製品（香菸200支；加熱菸草裝置煙彈200個；雪茄50支；小雪茄50支；吸菸用菸絲250克）；交通工具標準油箱內的燃料；酒精飲料（濃度超過22%的酒精飲料或80%及以上濃度未變性乙醇合計1升，或濃度不超過22%的酒精飲料合計2升，可任意組合但各單項允許量使用百分比之和不超過100%，另加靜置葡萄酒2升、啤酒5升）。出口：自然人可出口任何價值的非商業性質物品，須辦理第92/2023號政府決定（第281、286、289點）規定的手續；非商業性質貨物、價值不超過1,000歐元或1,000公斤的商業性質貨物、在關境內登記用於復進口的交通工具及其零配件、隨動物出口的飼料，可口頭申報出口。免稅額的年齡或頻次條件未載明（unknown）；費用未載明（unknown）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 跨越摩爾多瓦海關邊界入境、出境或過境之時；進口免稅額適用於以個人行李將物品帶入摩爾多瓦之時。

procedures.name_en: EU external-border cash declaration when entering or leaving the EU via Romania
procedures.name_zh: 欧盟外部边境现金申报（经罗马尼亚出入欧盟）
procedures.agency: Autoritatea Vamală Română (AVR) — Romanian customs authority, the Member State competent authority under Regulation (EU) 2018/1672
procedures.applicability_en: Natural persons (carriers) entering or leaving the European Union via Romania — i.e. crossing the EU external border — carrying cash of a value of EUR 10 000 or more, on their person, in their luggage or in their means of transport, must declare it to the Romanian customs authorities (the competent authorities of the Member State through which they are entering or leaving the Union) and make it available for control. Current legal basis: Regulation (EU) 2018/1672, applicable from 3 June 2021, which repealed Regulation (EC) No 1889/2005 (Article 20); the Romanian instruments HG 707/2006 and ANAF Order 2028/2012 are not confirmed by current official texts as still in force. Under Article 2 of the Regulation, 'cash' means: (i) currency (banknotes and coins in circulation as a medium of exchange, including out-of-circulation banknotes and coins that can still be exchanged at financial institutions or central banks); (ii) bearer-negotiable instruments (traveller's cheques, and cheques, promissory notes or money orders in bearer or equivalent form — instruments claimable upon presentation without having to prove identity or entitlement); (iii) commodities used as highly-liquid stores of value as listed in Annex I (per the Commission's current page: gold coins with at least 90% gold content, and gold bars, nuggets or clumps with at least 99.5% gold content); and (iv) prepaid cards as defined in point 2 of Annex I (non-nominal cards that store or provide access to funds not linked to a bank account) — not all payment cards. The threshold is value-based, so cash denominated in other currencies counts at equivalent value; ordinary registered (non-bearer) shares or bonds are not, as such, within this legal definition of 'cash'. The EUR 10 000 threshold applies per person — for a group, to each person individually. All EU countries use the harmonised EU Cash Declaration Form (templates in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776), to be completed in a language available in the country of entry or exit. A declaration with incorrect or incomplete information, or cash not made available for control, does not fulfil the obligation; penalties are set at national level ('effective, proportionate and dissuasive') and undeclared cash may be detained. Scope limits: this is the EU external-border rule only. Whether Romania applies any additional national rules to cash carried between EU countries or within Romania is not addressed by these EU rules and has not been officially confirmed; how the declaration is actually submitted at Romanian crossings (paper form at the border, electronic channel, or both), where the form is available, and the penalties applied in Romania are likewise not covered by the EU-level official texts. The duty is conditional on the threshold: it arises solely when a carrier enters or leaves the EU via Romania carrying cash of a value of EUR 10 000 or more (Article 3(1)). Which submission medium is available at Romanian crossings — a paper form at the border, an electronic channel, or both — has not been officially confirmed. Unaccompanied cash sent by post, freight or courier falls under a separate disclosure-on-request regime (Article 4), distinct from the traveller declaration described above.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自然人（携运人）经罗马尼亚出入欧盟——即跨越欧盟外部边境——随身、行李或所乘交通工具中携带价值 1 万欧元（EUR 10 000，含本数）或以上现金的，须向罗马尼亚海关（即其进入或离开联盟所经成员国的主管机关）申报并交由查验。现行法源：Regulation (EU) 2018/1672，自 2021-06-03 起适用，其 Article 20 已废止 Regulation (EC) No 1889/2005；罗马尼亚本国文书 HG 707/2006 与 ANAF Order 2028/2012 是否仍属现行，尚无现行官方文本确认。按该条例 Article 2，「现金」指：（一）通货——流通中作为交换媒介的钞币，含已退出流通但仍可在金融机构或中央银行兑换者；（二）不记名可转让票据——旅行支票，以及不记名或同等形式的支票、本票、汇票（出示票据即可索取款项，无须证明持有人身份或权利）；（三）附录 I 所列高流动性价值储藏商品——据欧盟委员会现行页：含金量至少 90% 的金币，含金量至少 99.5% 的金条、天然金块或金块；（四）附录 I 第 2 点定义的预付卡——不记名、存储或提供未关联银行账户之资金的卡，并非所有支付卡。门槛按价值计算，其他币种现金按等值折算计入；普通记名（非不记名）股票或债券本身不在该法定「现金」定义之内。EUR 10 000 门槛按人计算，团体出行对每人单独适用。各成员国统一使用欧盟现金申报表（模板见 Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776），以入/出境成员国提供的语言填写。信息不实、不全或未交验现金均不视为履行申报义务；处罚由成员国本国规定（须「有效、相称、具威慑力」），未申报现金可被扣留。范围限定：以上仅为欧盟外部边境规则——罗马尼亚是否另有关于成员国之间或境内携币的国家规定，不属该欧盟规则涵盖，尚无官方确认；罗方在边境的实际提交方式（边境纸质表、电子渠道或两者兼有）、表格获取途径与罗国罚则细则，欧盟层面官方文本均未涉及。申报义务以门槛为条件：仅当携运人经罗马尼亚进入或离开欧盟且携带现金价值达 EUR 10 000（含本数）或以上时才发生（Article 3(1)）；罗方具体提交载体（边境纸质表、电子渠道或两者兼有）何者可用，尚无官方确认。邮件/货运/快递寄送的不随行现金适用另行的应要求披露制度（Article 4），与上述旅客申报相互独立。
procedures.timing_en: At the EU external border when entering or leaving through Romania, declare the cash to the competent authorities and make it available for control. Regulation (EU) 2018/1672 Article 3(3) permits the declaration details in writing or electronically. Which submission medium is currently available at Romanian crossings has not been officially confirmed.
procedures.timing_zh: 经罗马尼亚跨越欧盟外部边境入境或出境时，向主管机关申报并交验现金。欧盟第2018/1672号条例第3(3)条允许以书面或电子方式提供申报明细；罗马尼亚各口岸当前实际可用的提交方式尚无官方确认。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 歐盟外部邊境現金申報（經羅馬尼亞出入歐盟）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自然人（攜運人）經羅馬尼亞出入歐盟——即跨越歐盟外部邊境——隨身、行李或所乘交通工具中攜帶價值 1 萬歐元（EUR 10 000，含本數）或以上現金的，須向羅馬尼亞海關（即其進入或離開聯盟所經成員國的主管機關）申報並交由查驗。現行法源：Regulation (EU) 2018/1672，自 2021-06-03 起適用，其 Article 20 已廢止 Regulation (EC) No 1889/2005；羅馬尼亞本國文書 HG 707/2006 與 ANAF Order 2028/2012 是否仍屬現行，尚無現行官方文本確認。按該條例 Article 2，「現金」指：（一）通貨——流通中作為交換媒介的鈔幣，含已退出流通但仍可在金融機構或中央銀行兌換者；（二）不記名可轉讓票據——旅行支票，以及不記名或同等形式的支票、本票、匯票（出示票據即可索取款項，無須證明持有人身份或權利）；（三）附錄 I 所列高流動性價值儲藏商品——據歐盟委員會現行頁：含金量至少 90% 的金幣，含金量至少 99.5% 的金條、天然金塊或金塊；（四）附錄 I 第 2 點定義的預付卡——不記名、儲存或提供未關聯銀行賬戶之資金的卡，並非所有支付卡。門檻按價值計算，其他幣種現金按等值折算計入；普通記名（非不記名）股票或債券本身不在該法定「現金」定義之內。EUR 10 000 門檻按人計算，團體出行對每人單獨適用。各成員國統一使用歐盟現金申報表（模板見 Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776），以入/出境成員國提供的語言填寫。資訊不實、不全或未交驗現金均不視為履行申報義務；處罰由成員國本國規定（須「有效、相稱、具威懾力」），未申報現金可被扣留。範圍限定：以上僅為歐盟外部邊境規則——羅馬尼亞是否另有關於成員國之間或境內攜幣的國家規定，不屬該歐盟規則涵蓋，尚無官方確認；羅方在邊境的實際提交方式（邊境紙質表、電子渠道或兩者兼有）、表格獲取途徑與羅國罰則細則，歐盟層面官方文本均未涉及。申報義務以門檻為條件：僅當攜運人經羅馬尼亞進入或離開歐盟且攜帶現金價值達 EUR 10 000（含本數）或以上時才發生（Article 3(1)）；羅方具體提交載體（邊境紙質表、電子渠道或兩者兼有）何者可用，尚無官方確認。郵件/貨運/快遞寄送的不隨行現金適用另行的應要求披露制度（Article 4），與上述旅客申報相互獨立。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 經羅馬尼亞跨越歐盟外部邊境入境或出境時，向主管機關申報並交驗現金。歐盟第2018/1672號條例第3(3)條允許以書面或電子方式提供申報明細；羅馬尼亞各口岸當前實際可用的提交方式尚無官方確認。

procedures.name_en: Cash over USD 10,000 equivalent — declare on the EAEU passenger customs declaration (entering Russia)
procedures.name_zh: 入境俄罗斯携带超过等值1万美元现金——填写欧亚经济联盟旅客海关申报单
procedures.agency: Federal Customs Service of Russia (FCS); rules set by the Customs Code of the Eurasian Economic Union
procedures.applicability_en: Russia applies the Customs Code of the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) at its border. Cash and/or traveller's cheques must be declared when their total, brought in at one time, exceeds the equivalent of USD 10,000 at the exchange rate on the day the passenger customs declaration is filed (Customs Code Article 260(1)(7)); the whole amount is declared, not only the part above the threshold. At or below the equivalent of USD 10,000, declaring is optional. Bills of exchange, bank cheques and securities must be declared whatever the amount. The declaration is made on the passenger customs declaration (Article 260(3)), completing its annex for cash and monetary instruments. If the total exceeds the equivalent of USD 100,000, documents showing where the money came from must be submitted with the declaration. Where a two-channel system operates, travellers with goods to declare use the red channel (Article 257). This item covers entering Russia; leaving Russia with cash is a separate item.
procedures.applicability_zh: 俄罗斯在边境适用《欧亚经济联盟海关法典》。一次性带入的现金和/或旅行支票合计超过按旅客海关申报单提交当日汇率折算的等值1万美元时，须申报（海关法典第260条第1款第7项），且申报全部金额，而非仅超出部分。等于或低于等值1万美元的，可自愿申报。本票、银行支票和有价证券不论金额都须申报。申报使用旅客海关申报单（第260条第3款），并填写其中现金和货币票据的附页。合计超过等值10万美元的，须随申报单提交资金来源证明文件。设有红绿双通道的口岸，有应申报物品的旅客走红色通道（第257条）。本条只涉及入境俄罗斯；携带现金出境另列一条。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, at customs control at the border crossing point: file the passenger customs declaration and use the red channel where one operates.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时在口岸海关监管处：提交旅客海关申报单，设有红色通道的走红色通道。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境俄羅斯攜帶超過等值1萬美元現金——填寫歐亞經濟聯盟旅客海關申報單
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 俄羅斯在邊境適用《歐亞經濟聯盟海關法典》。一次性帶入的現金和/或旅行支票合計超過按旅客海關申報單提交當日匯率折算的等值1萬美元時，須申報（海關法典第260條第1款第7項），且申報全部金額，而非僅超出部分。等於或低於等值1萬美元的，可自願申報。本票、銀行支票和有價證券不論金額都須申報。申報使用旅客海關申報單（第260條第3款），並填寫其中現金和貨幣票據的附頁。合計超過等值10萬美元的，須隨申報單提交資金來源證明文件。設有紅綠雙通道的口岸，有應申報物品的旅客走紅色通道（第257條）。本條只涉及入境俄羅斯；攜帶現金出境另列一條。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時在口岸海關監管處：提交旅客海關申報單，設有紅色通道的走紅色通道。

procedures.name_en: Leaving Russia with cash: foreign currency capped at USD 10,000 equivalent; declare cash over USD 10,000
procedures.name_zh: 携带现金离开俄罗斯：外币现金不得超过等值1万美元；超过1万美元的现金须申报
procedures.agency: Federal Customs Service of Russia (FCS); export limit set by Presidential Decree No. 81 and applied by the Bank of Russia
procedures.applicability_en: Presidential Decree No. 81 of 1 March 2022 (item 1, sub-item "zh") prohibits, from 2 March 2022, taking foreign cash and/or monetary instruments in foreign currency out of Russia in an amount exceeding the equivalent of USD 10,000, calculated at the Bank of Russia official rate on the day of export. The Bank of Russia navigator of restrictive measures (as of 1 May 2026, the version linked from its navigator page) lists this export as not permitted for both residents and non-residents, with no end date set, and lists foreign cash up to USD 10,000 inclusive as needing no permission. The exceptions it lists are for authorised banks and VEB.RF, not for travellers. The Eurasian Economic Union declaration duty also applies on exit: cash and/or traveller's cheques taken out at one time totalling more than the equivalent of USD 10,000 must be declared on the passenger customs declaration, stating the whole amount (Customs Code Article 260(1)(7), 260(3)); bills of exchange, bank cheques and securities must be declared whatever the amount. The sources do not say how the foreign-currency cap and the declaration duty combine when a traveller also carries roubles; ask customs before travelling with large sums.
procedures.applicability_zh: 2022年3月1日第81号总统令第1条“ж”项规定，自2022年3月2日起，禁止携带超过等值1万美元的外币现金和/或外币货币票据出境，按出境当日俄罗斯央行官方汇率折算。俄罗斯央行《限制措施导航》（截至2026年5月1日，为其导航页当前链接的版本）将这类出境列为居民与非居民均不允许、未设终止日期，并将1万美元以内（含）的外币现金列为无需许可。导航列出的例外只适用于授权银行和ВЭБ.РФ，不适用于旅客。欧亚经济联盟的申报义务在出境时同样适用：一次性带出的现金和/或旅行支票合计超过等值1万美元的，须在旅客海关申报单上申报全部金额（海关法典第260条第1款第7项、第3款）；本票、银行支票和有价证券不论金额都须申报。同时携带卢布时外币上限与申报义务如何合并计算，上述来源没有说明；携带大额现金出行前请向海关确认。
procedures.timing_en: At departure, at customs control at the border crossing point before leaving Russia: file the passenger customs declaration and use the red channel where one operates.
procedures.timing_zh: 出境时在口岸海关监管处、离开俄罗斯之前：提交旅客海关申报单，设有红色通道的走红色通道。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 攜帶現金離開俄羅斯：外幣現金不得超過等值1萬美元；超過1萬美元的現金須申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 2022年3月1日第81號總統令第1條“ж”項規定，自2022年3月2日起，禁止攜帶超過等值1萬美元的外幣現金和/或外幣貨幣票據出境，按出境當日俄羅斯央行官方匯率折算。俄羅斯央行《限制措施導航》（截至2026年5月1日，為其導航頁當前連結的版本）將這類出境列為居民與非居民均不允許、未設終止日期，並將1萬美元以內（含）的外幣現金列為無需許可。導航列出的例外只適用於授權銀行和ВЭБ.РФ，不適用於旅客。歐亞經濟聯盟的申報義務在出境時同樣適用：一次性帶出的現金和/或旅行支票合計超過等值1萬美元的，須在旅客海關申報單上申報全部金額（海關法典第260條第1款第7項、第3款）；本票、銀行支票和有價證券不論金額都須申報。同時攜帶盧布時外幣上限與申報義務如何合併計算，上述來源沒有說明；攜帶大額現金出行前請向海關確認。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出境時在口岸海關監管處、離開俄羅斯之前：提交旅客海關申報單，設有紅色通道的走紅色通道。

procedures.name_en: Written declaration of cash of EUR 10,000 or more carried by travellers (Formulár 1a)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客携带1万欧元及以上现金的书面申报（Formulár 1a）
procedures.agency: Finančná správa SR (Financial Administration of the Slovak Republic) — competent border customs offices (hraničné colné úrady)
procedures.applicability_en: Every natural person carrying cash means of at least EUR 10,000 (or the equivalent in another currency) — the page stresses that cash is not only currency — when entering or leaving the Union; the Financial Administration's traveller-cash section is headed 'Dovoz, vývoz a tranzit' (import, export, transit), but the operative duties are anchored to entering/leaving the Union (EU external frontier) and to the border customs office, as follows. National duty: under § 4(2) of the Customs Act (Law No. 199/2004 Z. z., Colný zákon), such person must declare the fact in writing, without being asked (bez vyzvania), to the competent border customs office on the prescribed form — Formulár 1a 'Oznámenie peňažných prostriedkov v hotovosti' (notification of cash carried with the traveller). EU dimension: under Article 3(1) of Regulation (EU) 2018/1672 on controls on cash entering or leaving the Union (repealing Regulation (EC) No 1889/2005), carriers carrying cash of EUR 10,000 or more must declare it to the competent authorities of the Member State through which they enter or leave the Union and make it available for inspection; under Article 2(1)(h) a 'carrier' is any natural person entering or leaving the Union with cash on their person, in their luggage or in their means of transport. Two boundaries, two comparison operators (Financial Administration's current cash FAQ, 'travelling to Turkey with EUR 30,000' answer): (i) EU external border — persons leaving or entering the Union carrying cash 's hodnotou 10 000 EUR alebo viac' (EUR 10,000 or more; >=, EUR 10,000 itself included) must declare it unprompted to the competent authority of the Member State through which they leave or enter the Union and make it available for inspection, the multilingual notification template standing in Part 1 of Annex I to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776; (ii) Slovakia's border with another EU Member State — an armed Financial Administration officer (ozbrojený príslušník finančnej správy) may require a person who is immediately crossing the state border of the Slovak Republic from or to another Member State, or a person from whom it is clear from all the circumstances that they intend to cross it, to state whether they carry cash 'v sume presahujúcej 10 000 EUR' (strictly exceeding EUR 10,000; >) — a duty to answer when asked under § 48a of Law No. 35/2019 Z. z. on the Financial Administration; the FAQ prescribes no separate proactive written form for this intra-EU situation and none is inferred here, so no separate procedure is created for it (the FAQ adds that some Member States extend cash controls to intra-EU movements and recommends checking with those States' authorities). Formulár 2a 'Hlásenie o peňažných prostriedkoch v hotovosti (bez sprievodu)' — unaccompanied cash sent e.g. by post, freight or courier — is a separate procedure and is excluded. Sanction: failure to declare accompanied cash constitutes a customs misdemeanour (colný priestupok) for natural persons within § 72(1)(n) of the Customs Act (Law No. 199/2004 Z. z.); the traveller-cash section itself states no fine amount for this breach, and no cash-specific or current fixed penalty figure is verified here — the concrete fine is unverified (fee = unknown).
procedures.applicability_zh: 携带现金支付手段最低 1 万欧元（含本数；或等值外币；页面提示现金不只是货币）的自然人，于进出联盟时适用；财政管理局旅客现金小节标题为“Dovoz, vývoz a tranzit（进口、出口、过境）”，但实体义务锚定于进出联盟（欧盟外边界）与边境海关，具体如下。本国义务：依《海关法》（第 199/2004 Z. z. 号法律，Colný zákon）第 4 条第 2 款，须“未经催告即以书面”（bez vyzvania písomne）向主管边境海关（príslušný hraničný colný úrad）按规定表格申报，即 Formulár 1a《现金通知书》（Oznámenie peňažných prostriedkov v hotovosti，随旅行人携带的现金）。欧盟层面：依 (EU) 2018/1672 号条例（进出联盟现金管制，废止 (EC) 1889/2005）第 3 条第 1 款，携带 1 万欧元及以上现金的运输人须向其进入或离开联盟所经成员国的主管机关申报并供查验；该条例第 2 条第 1 款 h) 项界定“运输人”为随身、行李或交通工具中携带现金进出联盟的任何自然人。两套边界、两种比较符（财政管理局现行现金 FAQ“带 3 万欧元赴土耳其”答复）：（一）欧盟外部边界——离开或进入联盟时携带“s hodnotou 10 000 EUR alebo viac”（1 万欧元或以上，≥，含 1 万欧元本数）现金者，须主动向其离盟/入盟所经成员国主管机关申报并供查验，多语种通知书模板载于 (EU) 2021/776 号执行条例附件 I 第 1 部分；（二）斯洛伐克与另一欧盟成员国的边界——武装财政管理局人员（ozbrojený príslušník finančnej správy）可要求正即时从另一成员国领土进入或离开斯洛伐克国境之人、或依全部情况明显意图跨境之人，说明其是否携带“v sume presahujúcej 10 000 EUR”（严格超过 1 万欧元，＞）的现金——此系第 35/2019 Z. z. 号《财政管理局法》第 48a 条的应要求告知义务；FAQ 未对该欧盟内部情形另设主动书面表格，本文亦不作此推断，故不为此另建程序（FAQ 另提示部分成员国将现金管制扩展至欧盟内部移动，建议向相关成员国主管机关了解）。Formulár 2a《非随行现金申报》（bez sprievodu，如经邮寄、货运、快递寄送）属另一程序，已排除。罚则：不申报随身现金构成海关违规（colný priestupok，自然人），见《海关法》（第 199/2004 Z. z. 号法律）第 72 条第 1 款 n) 项；旅客现金小节本身未列该违规的罚款数额，亦未核实到现金专属或现行定额——具体罚款未核实（fee = unknown）。
procedures.timing_en: EU external border, unprompted: entering or leaving the Union carrying EUR 10,000 or more in cash (>=, EUR 10,000 itself included) → submit completed Formulár 1a in writing to the competent border customs office and make the cash available for inspection; the form (.docx) is downloadable from the same page, which also carries information/infographic PDFs and Russian- and Hungarian-language versions of the cash declaration, and the FAQ locates the multilingual notification template in Part 1 of Annex I to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776. Slovakia's border with another EU Member State: no unprompted formality — where an armed Financial Administration officer calls on a person who is immediately crossing that border, or from whom it is clear from all the circumstances that they intend to cross it, the person states on request whether they carry strictly more than EUR 10,000 (>) in cash (§ 48a of Law No. 35/2019 Z. z.).
procedures.timing_zh: 欧盟外部边界主动办理：进出联盟携带 1 万欧元及以上（≥，含本数）现金时，填写 Formulár 1a 书面向主管边境海关申报并供查验；表格（.docx）可在同页下载，页面另附说明/信息图 PDF 及俄语、匈牙利语版现金申报文件，FAQ 并指明多语种通知书模板载于 (EU) 2021/776 号执行条例附件 I 第 1 部分。斯洛伐克与另一欧盟成员国的边界：无主动手续——武装财政管理局人员对正即时跨境、或依全部情况明显意图跨境之人查问是否携带严格超过（＞）1 万欧元现金时，应要求说明即可（第 35/2019 Z. z. 号法律第 48a 条）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客攜帶1萬歐元及以上現金的書面申報（Formulár 1a）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 攜帶現金支付手段最低 1 萬歐元（含本數；或等值外幣；頁面提示現金不只是貨幣）的自然人，於進出聯盟時適用；財政管理局旅客現金小節標題為“Dovoz, vývoz a tranzit（進口、出口、過境）”，但實體義務錨定於進出聯盟（歐盟外邊界）與邊境海關，具體如下。本國義務：依《海關法》（第 199/2004 Z. z. 號法律，Colný zákon）第 4 條第 2 款，須“未經催告即以書面”（bez vyzvania písomne）向主管邊境海關（príslušný hraničný colný úrad）按規定表格申報，即 Formulár 1a《現金通知書》（Oznámenie peňažných prostriedkov v hotovosti，隨旅行人攜帶的現金）。歐盟層面：依 (EU) 2018/1672 號條例（進出聯盟現金管制，廢止 (EC) 1889/2005）第 3 條第 1 款，攜帶 1 萬歐元及以上現金的運輸人須向其進入或離開聯盟所經成員國的主管機關申報並供查驗；該條例第 2 條第 1 款 h) 項界定“運輸人”為隨身、行李或交通工具中攜帶現金進出聯盟的任何自然人。兩套邊界、兩種比較符（財政管理局現行現金 FAQ“帶 3 萬歐元赴土耳其”答覆）：（一）歐盟外部邊界——離開或進入聯盟時攜帶“s hodnotou 10 000 EUR alebo viac”（1 萬歐元或以上，≥，含 1 萬歐元本數）現金者，須主動向其離盟/入盟所經成員國主管機關申報並供查驗，多語種通知書模板載於 (EU) 2021/776 號執行條例附件 I 第 1 部分；（二）斯洛伐克與另一歐盟成員國的邊界——武裝財政管理局人員（ozbrojený príslušník finančnej správy）可要求正即時從另一成員國領土進入或離開斯洛伐克國境之人、或依全部情況明顯意圖跨境之人，說明其是否攜帶“v sume presahujúcej 10 000 EUR”（嚴格超過 1 萬歐元，＞）的現金——此係第 35/2019 Z. z. 號《財政管理局法》第 48a 條的應要求告知義務；FAQ 未對該歐盟內部情形另設主動書面表格，本文亦不作此推斷，故不為此另建程序（FAQ 另提示部分成員國將現金管制擴展至歐盟內部移動，建議向相關成員國主管機關了解）。Formulár 2a《非隨行現金申報》（bez sprievodu，如經郵寄、貨運、快遞寄送）屬另一程序，已排除。罰則：不申報隨身現金構成海關違規（colný priestupok，自然人），見《海關法》（第 199/2004 Z. z. 號法律）第 72 條第 1 款 n) 項；旅客現金小節本身未列該違規的罰款數額，亦未核實到現金專屬或現行定額——具體罰款未核實（fee = unknown）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 歐盟外部邊界主動辦理：進出聯盟攜帶 1 萬歐元及以上（≥，含本數）現金時，填寫 Formulár 1a 書面向主管邊境海關申報並供查驗；表格（.docx）可在同頁下載，頁面另附說明/資訊圖 PDF 及俄語、匈牙利語版現金申報文件，FAQ 並指明多語種通知書模板載於 (EU) 2021/776 號執行條例附件 I 第 1 部分。斯洛伐克與另一歐盟成員國的邊界：無主動手續——武裝財政管理局人員對正即時跨境、或依全部情況明顯意圖跨境之人查問是否攜帶嚴格超過（＞）1 萬歐元現金時，應要求說明即可（第 35/2019 Z. z. 號法律第 48a 條）。

procedures.name_en: Presentation and declaration of goods in travellers' baggage (oral, paper or red/green-channel act)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客行李商品的呈报与申报（口头、纸质或红绿通道行为）
procedures.agency: Financial Directorate of the Slovak Republic — Finančná správa (border customs offices)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: goods carried in travellers' personal baggage into the Union customs territory. Presentation: such goods must be presented to the border customs office at the place where the traveller enters the Union customs territory; a customs declaration is then filed orally, in writing (paper) or by another act. Traveller acts verified on the page: (1) oral customs declaration under Article 135(1)(a) of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/2446 — non-commercial goods only, for release into free circulation and not subject to prohibitions or restrictions; oral declaration is also available for commercial goods carried in personal baggage if the value does not exceed EUR 1,000 or the net mass 1,000 kg; (2) paper import declaration — exceptionally allowed for travellers (otherwise only in a declared 'emergency state', e.g. unavailability of the electronic systems); (3) declaration by another act at border crossings operating the two-channel system (road, airport): joining the red lane declares goods for clearance, walking the green lane declares nothing to clear; where no two-channel system exists, a 'nič na preclenie' sticker (nothing to declare) or a customs declaration affixed to the windscreen substitutes. The standard electronic declaration via cep.financnasprava.sk requires an eID card and qualified electronic signature and is not the traveller path. Postal consignments (Slovenská pošta), courier services and the e-commerce portal for low-value consignments (≤ EUR 150) are separate channels and are excluded here. Relief thresholds (conditional evidence — goods beyond them are taxed/cleared): VAT exemption under § 48a of Law No. 222/2004 Z. z. for non-commercial imports in travellers' baggage from third countries where the value does not exceed EUR 300 per person by non-air transport, EUR 430 per person by air, or EUR 150 per person younger than 15 regardless of transport mode; tobacco per person by air 200 cigarettes / 100 cigarillos / 50 cigars / 250 g smoking tobacco (excise section adds 10 consumer packages of smokeless tobacco), other modes 40 / 20 / 10 / 50 g (2 packages smokeless), proportional combinations up to 100 %; alcohol per person 1 L over 22 % vol. or 2 L at 22 % vol. and below, plus 4 L still wine and 16 L beer (the excise subsection additionally covers 2 L sparkling wine/fermented/intermediate products); quantities above the limits are taxed on the excess, and packaged spirits/tobacco need Slovak control stamps for release into free circulation; excise relief for tobacco and alcohol requires import by a person older than 17, while the VAT baggage exemptions do not apply to a traveller younger than 17; customs-duty relief for baggage goods applies where the goods are VAT-exempt (Council Regulation (EC) No 1186/2009 framework); fuel relief covers the standard tank plus a portable tank of up to 10 L. Cash carried in baggage is a separate written declaration — see sk-cash-declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：以随身行李运入欧盟关境的商品。呈报：须在进入欧盟关境之地向边境海关（pohraničný colný úrad）呈报商品，随后以口头、书面（纸质）或其他行为申报。本页核实的旅客申报动作：(1) 口头海关申报——依 (EU) 2015/2446 号授权条例第 135 条第 1 款 a) 项，仅限非商用商品投自由流通且不涉禁限；随行李携带的商用商品价值不超过 1,000 欧元或净重不超过 1,000 公斤时亦可口头申报；(2) 纸质进口报关单——例外允许旅客使用（其余仅在“紧急状态”如电子系统不可用时）；(3) 其他行为申报——在实行双通道的边境口岸（公路、机场）：走红道即申报有需清关商品，走绿道即申报无申报物；无双通道系统时以粘贴“nič na preclenie（无申报物）”标签或将报关单贴于前挡风玻璃替代。标准电子报关经 cep.financnasprava.sk，需电子身份证件及合格电子签名，非旅客路径。邮寄（Slovenská pošta）、快递及低值货物电商门户申报（≤150 欧元）为另行渠道，本条已排除。免税额度（条件证据，超出即征税/清关）：依第 222/2004 Z. z. 号法律第 48a 条，自第三国随身行李非商用进口价值不超过——非空运每人 300 欧元、空运每人 430 欧元、不满 15 岁者每人 150 欧元（不限交通方式）；烟草每人空运 200 支香烟/100 支小雪茄/50 支雪茄/250 克吸烟烟丝（消费税段另含 10 包无烟烟草制品），非空运 40/20/10/50 克（2 包无烟制品），可按比例组合至 100%；酒精每人 >22% vol. 1 升或 ≤22% vol. 2 升，另加静止葡萄酒 4 升、啤酒 16 升（消费税段另含起泡酒/发酵饮/中间产品 2 升）；超限部分就超出量征税，预包装烈酒/烟草须加贴斯洛伐克税标方可投放自由流通；烟草与酒精的消费税免征须由年满 17 岁以上（staršou ako 17 rokov，即严格大于 17 岁）之人进口，而 VAT 行李免税对不满 17 岁（mladšia ako 17 rokov）之旅客不适用；行李商品关税免征以其免征 VAT 为前提（(EC) 1186/2009 号理事会条例框架）；燃料免征涵盖标准油箱及不超过 10 升便携油箱。行李中现金为另行的书面申报事项，见 sk-cash-declaration。
procedures.timing_en: At the point of entering the Union customs territory: present baggage goods to the border customs office and declare there — red lane (or green lane if nothing to declare), orally or on paper; where relief does not apply, the goods are cleared under the legislation in force. The English /en/pages/for-travellers path returned 404 in the 2026-09-10 check; the current official pages are Slovak under /sk/obcania/clo/ (re-captured live 2026-09-27, HTTP 200).
procedures.timing_zh: 在进入欧盟关境之地：向边境海关呈报行李商品并就地申报——走红道（无可申报物则走绿道）、口头或纸质申报；不适用免税时按现行法律清关。英文 /en/pages/for-travellers 路径在 2026-09-10 检查时已 404；现行官方页面为斯洛伐克语 /sk/obcania/clo/（2026-09-27 重新直取，HTTP 200）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客行李商品的呈報與申報（口頭、紙質或紅綠通道行為）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：以隨身行李運入歐盟關境的商品。呈報：須在進入歐盟關境之地向邊境海關（pohraničný colný úrad）呈報商品，隨後以口頭、書面（紙質）或其他行為申報。本頁核實的旅客申報動作：(1) 口頭海關申報——依 (EU) 2015/2446 號授權條例第 135 條第 1 款 a) 項，僅限非商用商品投自由流通且不涉禁限；隨行李攜帶的商用商品價值不超過 1,000 歐元或淨重不超過 1,000 公斤時亦可口頭申報；(2) 紙質進口報關單——例外允許旅客使用（其餘僅在“緊急狀態”如電子系統不可用時）；(3) 其他行為申報——在實行雙通道的邊境口岸（公路、機場）：走紅道即申報有需清關商品，走綠道即申報無申報物；無雙通道系統時以貼上“nič na preclenie（無申報物）”標籤或將報關單貼於前擋風玻璃替代。標準電子報關經 cep.financnasprava.sk，需電子身份證件及合格電子簽名，非旅客路徑。郵寄（Slovenská pošta）、快遞及低值貨物電商門戶申報（≤150 歐元）為另行渠道，本條已排除。免稅額度（條件證據，超出即徵稅/清關）：依第 222/2004 Z. z. 號法律第 48a 條，自第三國隨身行李非商用進口價值不超過——非空運每人 300 歐元、空運每人 430 歐元、不滿 15 歲者每人 150 歐元（不限交通方式）；菸草每人空運 200 支香菸/100 支小雪茄/50 支雪茄/250 克吸菸菸絲（消費稅段另含 10 包無煙菸草製品），非空運 40/20/10/50 克（2 包無煙製品），可按比例組合至 100%；酒精每人 >22% vol. 1 升或 ≤22% vol. 2 升，另加靜止葡萄酒 4 升、啤酒 16 升（消費稅段另含起泡酒/發酵飲/中間產品 2 升）；超限部分就超出量徵稅，預包裝烈酒/菸草須加貼斯洛伐克稅標方可投放自由流通；菸草與酒精的消費稅免徵須由年滿 17 歲以上（staršou ako 17 rokov，即嚴格大於 17 歲）之人進口，而 VAT 行李免稅對不滿 17 歲（mladšia ako 17 rokov）之旅客不適用；行李商品關稅免徵以其免徵 VAT 為前提（(EC) 1186/2009 號理事會條例框架）；燃料免徵涵蓋標準油箱及不超過 10 升便攜油箱。行李中現金為另行的書面申報事項，見 sk-cash-declaration。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在進入歐盟關境之地：向邊境海關呈報行李商品並就地申報——走紅道（無可申報物則走綠道）、口頭或紙質申報；不適用免稅時按現行法律清關。英文 /en/pages/for-travellers 路徑在 2026-09-10 檢查時已 404；現行官方頁面為斯洛伐克語 /sk/obcania/clo/（2026-09-27 重新直取，HTTP 200）。

procedures.name_en: Passenger green/red corridor customs declaration — goods, cash and norms (State Customs Service of Ukraine)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客绿/红通道海关申报——物品、现金与限额（乌克兰国家海关署）
procedures.agency: State Customs Service of Ukraine (Державна митна служба України)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering or leaving Ukraine. Per the State Customs Service (SCS) guidance page "Як проходить 'червоний' коридор": the green corridor is a simplified customs control channel where the traveller does not declare goods, and starting to cross the customs zone through the green corridor counts as the traveller's tacit confirmation that nothing prohibited or declarable is carried; passing customs control through the green corridor releases the citizen from filling a customs declaration. Green-corridor limits as stated by the SCS: personal items (two mobile phones, one video camera, one still camera, two portable personal computers, sports equipment, used personal jewellery and clothing, 500 ml of toilet water or 100 ml of perfume); goods with total value not exceeding EUR 1,000 for air crossings and EUR 500/50 kg for other checkpoints; cash in Ukrainian or foreign currency strictly below EUR 10,000 equivalent per person; alcohol — spirits 1 litre, wine 2 litres, beer 5 litres; tobacco — 200 cigarettes or 50 cigars or 250 g of tobacco (or 250 g combined); food for own consumption up to EUR 200 (per-manufacturer-packaged: one package or max 2 kg per item name; unpackaged: up to 2 kg per item; indivisible ready product: 1 piece per item); medicines up to 5 packages per item name per person (excluding narcotics/psychotropics, unless per a certified prescription). These green-corridor norms apply once per 24 hours. The red corridor requires a written customs declaration of the property carried (with receipts, labels and other documents; absent documents, customs values the goods by identical/similar prices); red-corridor goods include goods requiring permits, cultural values, securities and bank metals, medicines containing narcotics/psychotropics or precursors, other goods defined by Ukrainian laws, goods over EUR 1,000 (air) / EUR 500-50 kg (other checkpoints) imported more than once within one day, cash in Ukrainian or foreign currency strictly above EUR 10,000 equivalent per person, and pet animals with original international veterinary certificates; exceeding the norms also triggers tax payment. The SCS travellers hub page maintains separate entry ('В'їзд в Україну') and exit ('Виїзд з України') guidance sections, links the customs declaration forms (including the passenger declaration) and cites the underlying legislation — Customs Code of Ukraine (No. 4495-VI), Law of Ukraine No. 2473-VIII 'On Currency and Currency Operations', CMU resolutions No. 450 (2012), No. 203 (2019), No. 434 (2012), No. 458 (2012), and NBU Board resolutions No. 3 (2019) and No. 5 (2019). In cash terms: carrying cash in Ukrainian or foreign currency worth strictly less than EUR 10,000 equivalent per person requires no written customs declaration; carrying cash worth strictly more than EUR 10,000 equivalent per person requires a full written declaration through the red corridor. For cash worth exactly EUR 10,000 equivalent per person, the official texts do not give a consistent answer, so neither the green-corridor exemption from declaration nor a written-declaration obligation can be stated as certain for that amount.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：进出乌克兰的旅客。据乌克兰国家海关署（ДМС）指引页《如何通过“红色”通道》：“绿色”通道为简化海关监管通道，旅客不申报所携物品；开始经绿色通道穿越海关区即视为旅客以默示方式确认未携带禁止或须申报物品；经绿色通道过关免填海关申报单。绿色通道限额（据海关署）：个人物品（两部手机、一台摄像机、一台照相机、两台便携式电脑、运动器材、已使用的个人饰品和衣物、500 毫升淡香水或 100 毫升香水）；物品总值航空口岸不超 1,000 欧元、其他口岸不超 500 欧元/50 公斤；乌克兰或外国现金货币严格低于每人 10,000 欧元等值；酒类——烈酒 1 升、葡萄酒 2 升、啤酒 5 升；烟草——200 支卷烟或 50 支雪茄或 250 克烟草（或合计 250 克）；自用食品不超 200 欧元（厂商零售包装：每种一件包装或每种不超 2 公斤；无包装：每种不超 2 公斤；不可分即食产品：每种 1 件）；药品每人每种不超 5 包装（含麻醉/精神药物成分者除外，须凭经盖章处方的除外）。绿色通道限额每 24 小时适用一次。“红色”通道须书面申报所携财产（须出示发票、标签等凭证；无凭证时海关按相同或类似商品价格估价）；红色通道物品包括：须许可文件方可放行的物品、文化珍品、有价证券与银行贵金属、含麻醉/精神药物或前体的药品、乌克兰法律规定的其他物品、一日内多次入境且总值超 1,000 欧元（航空）/500 欧元-50 公斤（其他口岸）的物品、严格高于每人 10,000 欧元等值的乌克兰或外国现金货币、以及持有原产国国际兽医证书的家养宠物；超限额还须缴税。海关署旅客信息枢纽页分设入境/出境指引栏目，链接海关申报表（含旅客申报单），并列明依据立法——《乌克兰海关法典》（第 4495-VI 号）、《乌克兰货币与货币业务法》（第 2473-VIII 号）、部长会议第 450(2012)、203(2019)、434(2012)、458(2012) 号决议及国家银行董事会第 3(2019)、5(2019) 号决议。就现金而言：携带严格低于每人 10,000 欧元等值的乌克兰或外国现金，无须书面申报；携带严格高于每人 10,000 欧元等值的现金，须经红色通道全额书面申报。恰为每人 10,000 欧元等值时，官方文本口径不一致，对该金额既不能确定可免书面申报，也不能确定必须书面申报。
procedures.timing_en: At entry into and exit from Ukraine: use the green corridor (no declaration) within the stated norms, which apply once per 24 hours — for cash this means strictly below EUR 10,000 equivalent per person; file a written customs declaration through the red corridor when carrying declarable property, including cash strictly above EUR 10,000 equivalent per person (declared in full). For cash worth exactly EUR 10,000 equivalent per person, the official texts do not settle whether the green-corridor exemption or a written-declaration obligation applies.
procedures.timing_zh: 进出乌克兰时：限额内走绿色通道（免申报），限额每 24 小时适用一次——就现金而言，即严格低于每人 10,000 欧元等值；携带须申报财产（包括严格高于每人 10,000 欧元等值的现金，须全额申报）时经红色通道书面申报。恰为每人 10,000 欧元等值时，官方文本未确定该金额可免申报还是须书面申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客綠/紅通道海關申報——物品、現金與限額（烏克蘭國家海關署）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：進出烏克蘭的旅客。據烏克蘭國家海關署（ДМС）指引頁《如何通過“紅色”通道》：“綠色”通道為簡化海關監管通道，旅客不申報所攜物品；開始經綠色通道穿越海關區即視為旅客以默示方式確認未攜帶禁止或須申報物品；經綠色通道過關免填海關申報單。綠色通道限額（據海關署）：個人物品（兩部手機、一臺攝像機、一臺照相機、兩臺便攜式電腦、運動器材、已使用的個人飾品和衣物、500 毫升淡香水或 100 毫升香水）；物品總值航空口岸不超 1,000 歐元、其他口岸不超 500 歐元/50 公斤；烏克蘭或外國現金貨幣嚴格低於每人 10,000 歐元等值；酒類——烈酒 1 升、葡萄酒 2 升、啤酒 5 升；菸草——200 支捲菸或 50 支雪茄或 250 克菸草（或合計 250 克）；自用食品不超 200 歐元（廠商零售包裝：每種一件包裝或每種不超 2 公斤；無包裝：每種不超 2 公斤；不可分即食產品：每種 1 件）；藥品每人每種不超 5 包裝（含麻醉/精神藥物成分者除外，須憑經蓋章處方的除外）。綠色通道限額每 24 小時適用一次。“紅色”通道須書面申報所攜財產（須出示發票、標籤等憑證；無憑證時海關按相同或類似商品價格估價）；紅色通道物品包括：須許可文件方可放行的物品、文化珍品、有價證券與銀行貴金屬、含麻醉/精神藥物或前體的藥品、烏克蘭法律規定的其他物品、一日內多次入境且總值超 1,000 歐元（航空）/500 歐元-50 公斤（其他口岸）的物品、嚴格高於每人 10,000 歐元等值的烏克蘭或外國現金貨幣、以及持有原產國國際獸醫證書的家養寵物；超限額還須繳稅。海關署旅客資訊樞紐頁分設入境/出境指引欄目，連結海關申報表（含旅客申報單），並列明依據立法——《烏克蘭海關法典》（第 4495-VI 號）、《烏克蘭貨幣與貨幣業務法》（第 2473-VIII 號）、部長會議第 450(2012)、203(2019)、434(2012)、458(2012) 號決議及國家銀行董事會第 3(2019)、5(2019) 號決議。就現金而言：攜帶嚴格低於每人 10,000 歐元等值的烏克蘭或外國現金，無須書面申報；攜帶嚴格高於每人 10,000 歐元等值的現金，須經紅色通道全額書面申報。恰為每人 10,000 歐元等值時，官方文本口徑不一致，對該金額既不能確定可免書面申報，也不能確定必須書面申報。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 進出烏克蘭時：限額內走綠色通道（免申報），限額每 24 小時適用一次——就現金而言，即嚴格低於每人 10,000 歐元等值；攜帶須申報財產（包括嚴格高於每人 10,000 歐元等值的現金，須全額申報）時經紅色通道書面申報。恰為每人 10,000 歐元等值時，官方文本未確定該金額可免申報還是須書面申報。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration of EUR 10,000 or more when entering or leaving the EU through Åland (Regulation (EU) 2018/1672; Finnish Act 432/2021)
procedures.name_zh: 经奥兰群岛入出欧盟携带1万欧元及以上现金须申报（欧盟第2018/1672号条例；芬兰第432/2021号法）
procedures.agency: Finnish Customs (Tulli)
procedures.applicability_en: Åland is part of the EU customs territory and the EU customs union, although it is outside the EU VAT and excise area. A traveller who arrives in Åland from a non-EU country, or leaves Åland for a non-EU country, carrying cash worth EUR 10,000 or more (or the equivalent in other currencies) must declare it to the competent authority, which under Finnish law is Finnish Customs (Tulli); the police and the Border Guard are also competent when they perform customs duties. Cash means banknotes and coins, bearer negotiable instruments such as cheques, traveller’s cheques, promissory notes and money orders, gold coins with a gold content of at least 90%, and gold bars, nuggets or clumps with a gold content of at least 99.5%. The declaration is made in writing or electronically on the EU cash declaration form and covers the carrier, the owner and the intended recipient, the nature and amount of the cash, its economic provenance, its intended use, the transport route and the means of transport. Finnish Customs may issue more detailed instructions on where a written declaration is given and how an electronic one must be submitted. The EUR 10,000 limit applies to each person individually. Incorrect or incomplete information counts as not declaring; failing to declare, or declaring incorrectly or incompletely, on purpose or through carelessness, is punishable by a fine under Finnish law, and undeclared cash can be seized temporarily. Travel between Åland and mainland Finland or another EU country does not trigger this declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 奥兰群岛属于欧盟关税领土和关税同盟，但处于欧盟增值税和消费税区之外。旅客从非欧盟国家抵达奥兰，或从奥兰前往非欧盟国家，携带价值1万欧元或以上现金（或等值的其他货币）时，须向主管机关申报；按芬兰法律，主管机关是芬兰海关（Tulli），警察和边防队在执行海关职责时也有权限。“现金”指纸币和硬币、可无记名转让的票据（如支票、旅行支票、本票、汇票）、含金量不低于90%的金币，以及含金量不低于99.5%的金条、金块。申报须以书面或电子方式，使用欧盟统一的现金申报表，内容包括携带人、所有人和预定收款人的信息，现金的性质和金额，经济来源，预定用途，运输路线和运输工具。芬兰海关可就书面申报的提交地点和电子申报的提交方式另行发布细则。1万欧元的限额按每个人单独计算。信息不实或不完整视为未申报；故意或疏忽未申报、或申报不实、不完整，依芬兰法律可处罚金，未申报的现金可被临时扣留。奥兰与芬兰本土或其他欧盟国家之间往来，不触发这项申报。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in Åland from a non-EU country, or before leaving Åland for a non-EU country.
procedures.timing_zh: 从非欧盟国家抵达奥兰时，或离开奥兰前往非欧盟国家之前。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 經奧蘭群島入出歐盟攜帶1萬歐元及以上現金須申報（歐盟第2018/1672號條例；芬蘭第432/2021號法）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 奧蘭群島屬於歐盟關稅領土和關稅同盟，但處於歐盟增值稅和消費稅區之外。旅客從非歐盟國家抵達奧蘭，或從奧蘭前往非歐盟國家，攜帶價值1萬歐元或以上現金（或等值的其他貨幣）時，須向主管機關申報；按芬蘭法律，主管機關是芬蘭海關（Tulli），警察和邊防隊在執行海關職責時也有權限。“現金”指紙幣和硬幣、可無記名轉讓的票據（如支票、旅行支票、本票、匯票）、含金量不低於90%的金幣，以及含金量不低於99.5%的金條、金塊。申報須以書面或電子方式，使用歐盟統一的現金申報表，內容包括攜帶人、所有人和預定收款人的資訊，現金的性質和金額，經濟來源，預定用途，運輸路線和運輸工具。芬蘭海關可就書面申報的提交地點和電子申報的提交方式另行發佈細則。1萬歐元的限額按每個人單獨計算。資訊不實或不完整視為未申報；故意或疏忽未申報、或申報不實、不完整，依芬蘭法律可處罰金，未申報的現金可被臨時扣留。奧蘭與芬蘭本土或其他歐盟國家之間往來，不觸發這項申報。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 從非歐盟國家抵達奧蘭時，或離開奧蘭前往非歐盟國家之前。

procedures.name_en: Red-lane customs declaration on arrival from outside the EU (goods value thresholds; alcohol and tobacco quantity limits)
procedures.name_zh: 自非欧盟国家入境丹麦的红通道海关申报（商品货值限额；烟酒数量额度）
procedures.agency: Toldstyrelsen (Danish Customs Agency)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering Denmark from a country outside the EU (per the official page, the Faroe Islands, Greenland, the Canary Islands, the Åland Islands, the French overseas departments and territories, and the northern part of Cyprus are not regarded as EU countries). Per the Toldstyrelsen page 'Travelling outside the EU' captured live from toldst.dk on 2026-09-27 (HTTP 200): you must pay customs duties, VAT and excise duties if you have bought goods for a value of more than DKK 3,250 (arrival by plane or ship) or DKK 2,250 (arrival by other means of transport); you may be asked to show receipts, so keep them. An item exceeding the threshold is dutiable even when it consists of multiple parts functioning together (e.g. a camera and a lens); the liability cannot be avoided by bringing the parts separately or letting several persons bring different parts in. Special quantity limits apply to alcohol and tobacco, and alcohol and tobacco do not count towards the DKK 3,250/2,250 goods threshold (page example: arriving by plane with 1 litre of whisky priced DKK 1,500, you may also bring other goods worth DKK 3,250 duty-free within the limits). You must be 17 years old to bring alcohol and tobacco into Denmark. Tobacco quantity (alternatives as listed): 200 cigarettes, or 100 cigarillos (max. 3 g each), or 50 cigars, or 250 g of smoking tobacco. Alcohol quantity: 1 litre of spirits (above 22% alcohol and beverages to which alcohol has been added), or 2 litres of fortified wine (22% alcohol or less, e.g. Port, Sherry and Madeira, as well as sparkling wine such as Champagne), and 4 litres of table wine (e.g. red, white and rosé wine and cider-based wine), and 16 litres of beer (and beer-based cider). Motor fuel: 10 litres in spare cans in addition to the vehicle's normal tank. If you bought goods outside the EU and have a flight layover in an EU country, the outside-EU rules still apply. The rules only apply to goods physically brought with you, not to goods sent by mail (the online-shopping rules apply instead). Violations are fined — as a general rule at two times the duties payable (for goods such as tobacco, spirits, gold and silverware and jewellery the fine equals twice the duties; for clothing, electronics, bags and sportswear it equals once the duties), in addition to the duties; a page example prices 400 excess cigarettes at DKK 1,208 total via the red lane versus DKK 3,608 via the green lane including a DKK 2,400 fine.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：自非欧盟国家入境丹麦的旅客（据所抓取页面，法罗群岛、格陵兰、加那利群岛、奥兰群岛、法国海外省与领地、塞浦路斯北部不视为欧盟国家）。据 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的 Toldstyrelsen 页面《Travelling outside the EU》：购货价值超过 DKK 3,250（乘飞机或船舶入境）或 DKK 2,250（其他交通方式入境）即须缴纳关税、增值税与消费税；海关可能要求出示收据，应予留存。超限物品即使由多个协同部件组成（如相机与镜头）也须整体计税，不能拆分携带或由多人分携规避。烟酒另设数量限额，且不计入 DKK 3,250/2,250 货值限额（页面示例：乘飞机携 1 升价 DKK 1,500 的威士忌，仍可另带价值 DKK 3,250 的其他货物免税入境）。携酒精和烟草入境丹麦须年满 17 岁。烟草数量（页面所列择一）：卷烟 200 支，或小雪茄（每支不超 3 克）100 支，或雪茄 50 支，或吸用烟草 250 克。酒精数量：烈酒（酒精含量高于 22% 及添加酒精的饮料）1 升，或强化酒（酒精含量不超 22%，如波特、雪莉、马德拉，以及香槟等起泡酒）2 升，并且餐酒（如红、白、桃红葡萄酒及苹果酒基酒）4 升，并且啤酒（及啤酒基苹果酒）16 升。机动车燃料：除车辆正常油箱外可另携 10 升备用罐装燃油。在非欧盟国家购物后经欧盟国家中转返回的，仍适用非欧盟规则。本规则仅适用于随身携带的货物，邮寄不适用（另适用欧盟外网购规则）。违规将被罚款，一般规则为应缴税款的两倍（烟草、烈酒、金银器与珠宝类罚款为两倍，服装、电子产品、箱包与运动服装类为一倍），税款另缴；页面示例：400 支超额卷烟走红道合计 DKK 1,208，走绿道含 DKK 2,400 罚款合计 DKK 3,608。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in Denmark (by plane, at some points of entry): select the green exit if you carry no goods on which you have to pay customs duty, VAT and excise duties; if you carry such goods — or are in doubt about whether you comply — go through the red exit and declare to the Danish Customs Agency; if there is no red exit, contact the airport's customs clearance office instead.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达丹麦时（乘飞机入境于部分入境点）：无应缴关税、增值税与消费税物品者走绿色出口；携带此类物品或对是否符合规则有疑问者，走红色出口向丹麦海关署申报；如无红色出口，改联系机场清关办公室。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 自非歐盟國家入境丹麥的紅通道海關申報（商品貨值限額；菸酒數量額度）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：自非歐盟國家入境丹麥的旅客（據所抓取頁面，法羅群島、格陵蘭、加那利群島、奧蘭群島、法國海外省與領地、塞浦路斯北部不視為歐盟國家）。據 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的 Toldstyrelsen 頁面《Travelling outside the EU》：購貨價值超過 DKK 3,250（乘飛機或船舶入境）或 DKK 2,250（其他交通方式入境）即須繳納關稅、增值稅與消費稅；海關可能要求出示收據，應予留存。超限物品即使由多個協同部件組成（如相機與鏡頭）也須整體計稅，不能拆分攜帶或由多人分攜規避。菸酒另設數量限額，且不計入 DKK 3,250/2,250 貨值限額（頁面示例：乘飛機攜 1 升價 DKK 1,500 的威士忌，仍可另帶價值 DKK 3,250 的其他貨物免稅入境）。攜酒精和菸草入境丹麥須年滿 17 歲。菸草數量（頁面所列擇一）：捲菸 200 支，或小雪茄（每支不超 3 克）100 支，或雪茄 50 支，或吸用菸草 250 克。酒精數量：烈酒（酒精含量高於 22% 及添加酒精的飲料）1 升，或強化酒（酒精含量不超 22%，如波特、雪莉、馬德拉，以及香檳等起泡酒）2 升，並且餐酒（如紅、白、桃紅葡萄酒及蘋果酒基酒）4 升，並且啤酒（及啤酒基蘋果酒）16 升。機動車燃料：除車輛正常油箱外可另攜 10 升備用罐裝燃油。在非歐盟國家購物後經歐盟國家中轉返回的，仍適用非歐盟規則。本規則僅適用於隨身攜帶的貨物，郵寄不適用（另適用歐盟外網購規則）。違規將被罰款，一般規則為應繳稅款的兩倍（菸草、烈酒、金銀器與珠寶類罰款為兩倍，服裝、電子產品、箱包與運動服裝類為一倍），稅款另繳；頁面示例：400 支超額捲菸走紅道合計 DKK 1,208，走綠道含 DKK 2,400 罰款合計 DKK 3,608。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達丹麥時（乘飛機入境於部分入境點）：無應繳關稅、增值稅與消費稅物品者走綠色出口；攜帶此類物品或對是否符合規則有疑問者，走紅色出口向丹麥海關署申報；如無紅色出口，改聯繫機場清關辦公室。

procedures.name_en: Entry from another EU country: own-personal-use allowances and green/red exit (alcohol and tobacco quantity limits; 18+ and 16–17 rules)
procedures.name_zh: 自其他欧盟国家入境：自用限额与绿/红通道（烟酒数量限额；18 岁及以上与 16–17 岁规则）
procedures.agency: Toldstyrelsen (Danish Customs Agency)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering Denmark from another EU country. The non-EU-route DKK 3,250/2,250 goods value thresholds do not apply on this route; instead, per the Toldstyrelsen page 'Travelling within the EU' captured live from toldst.dk on 2026-09-27 (HTTP 200), goods may be brought in free of customs duties, VAT and excise duties only if they are for your own personal use — meaning that only you, persons in your household or your private guests use the goods. Selling the goods (e.g. in your local sports club or at work) or bringing in goods for other persons who are not travelling with you is not own personal use and requires payment of excise duties (and possibly a deposit for certain types of packaging). Quantity limits for alcohol and tobacco. When you are 18 years old: cigarettes 800 pcs; cigarillos (max. 3 g each) 400 pcs; cigars 200 pcs; smoking tobacco 1 kg; spirits (above 22% alcohol and beverages to which alcohol has been added) 10 litres; fortified wine (22% alcohol or less, e.g. Port, Sherry and Madeira) 20 litres; table wine (e.g. red, white and rosé wine and cider-based wine) 90 litres, of which maximum 60 litres of sparkling wine such as champagne; beer (and beer-based cider) 110 litres. If you are 16 or 17 years old: you are not allowed to bring tobacco into Denmark from another EU country; you are allowed to bring beer and wine of a strength of up to and including 16.4% — the page lists table wine 90 litres (of which maximum 60 litres sparkling) and beer 110 litres — while anything stronger is fortified wine or spirits, which you may not bring into Denmark if you are under 18. Some items require a permit, while others are completely forbidden from being brought into Denmark (see the separate special-items page for details). For further legal information the page refers to Toldstyrelsen's legal guide (in Danish).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：自其他欧盟国家入境丹麦的旅客。本路线不适用非欧盟路线的 DKK 3,250/2,250 货值限额；据 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的 Toldstyrelsen 页面《Travelling within the EU》，货物仅限自用方可免关税、增值税与消费税入境——自用指仅本人、同家庭成员或私人客人使用。在当地体育俱乐部或工作场所出售，或为未同行他人携带货物，均不属自用，须缴消费税（某些包装还可能须缴押金）。烟酒数量限额：年满 18 岁——卷烟 800 支；小雪茄（每支不超 3 克）400 支；雪茄 200 支；吸用烟草 1 公斤；烈酒（酒精含量高于 22% 及添加酒精的饮料）10 升；强化酒（酒精含量不超 22%，如波特、雪莉、马德拉）20 升；餐酒（如红、白、桃红葡萄酒及苹果酒基酒）90 升，其中起泡酒（如香槟）不超 60 升；啤酒（及啤酒基苹果酒）110 升。16 或 17 岁：不得自其他欧盟国家携带烟草入境丹麦；可携带酒精浓度不超过（含）16.4% 的啤酒与葡萄酒——页面列出餐酒 90 升（其中起泡酒不超 60 升）与啤酒 110 升——浓度更高者属强化酒或烈酒，未满 18 岁不得携带入境。部分物品须许可，部分物品完全禁止携带入境（详见另行专页）。进一步法律信息见 Toldstyrelsen 法律指南（丹麦语）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in Denmark by plane (at some points of entry): go through the green exit if you do not carry goods subject to customs duties, VAT and excise duties; if you carry such goods — or are in doubt about compliance — contact the Danish Customs Agency by going through the red exit; if there is no red exit, contact the airport's customs clearance office. Excise duties (and possibly a packaging deposit) are payable for goods that are not for own personal use.
procedures.timing_zh: 乘飞机抵达丹麦时（部分入境点）：未携带应缴关税、增值税与消费税物品者走绿色出口；携带此类物品或对合规有疑问者走红色出口联系丹麦海关署；如无红色出口，联系机场清关办公室。非自用货物须缴消费税（某些包装或须押金）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 自其他歐盟國家入境：自用限額與綠/紅通道（菸酒數量限額；18 歲及以上與 16–17 歲規則）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：自其他歐盟國家入境丹麥的旅客。本路線不適用非歐盟路線的 DKK 3,250/2,250 貨值限額；據 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的 Toldstyrelsen 頁面《Travelling within the EU》，貨物僅限自用方可免關稅、增值稅與消費稅入境——自用指僅本人、同家庭成員或私人客人使用。在當地體育俱樂部或工作場所出售，或為未同行他人攜帶貨物，均不屬自用，須繳消費稅（某些包裝還可能須繳押金）。菸酒數量限額：年滿 18 歲——捲菸 800 支；小雪茄（每支不超 3 克）400 支；雪茄 200 支；吸用菸草 1 公斤；烈酒（酒精含量高於 22% 及添加酒精的飲料）10 升；強化酒（酒精含量不超 22%，如波特、雪莉、馬德拉）20 升；餐酒（如紅、白、桃紅葡萄酒及蘋果酒基酒）90 升，其中起泡酒（如香檳）不超 60 升；啤酒（及啤酒基蘋果酒）110 升。16 或 17 歲：不得自其他歐盟國家攜帶菸草入境丹麥；可攜帶酒精濃度不超過（含）16.4% 的啤酒與葡萄酒——頁面列出餐酒 90 升（其中起泡酒不超 60 升）與啤酒 110 升——濃度更高者屬強化酒或烈酒，未滿 18 歲不得攜帶入境。部分物品須許可，部分物品完全禁止攜帶入境（詳見另行專頁）。進一步法律資訊見 Toldstyrelsen 法律指南（丹麥語）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 乘飛機抵達丹麥時（部分入境點）：未攜帶應繳關稅、增值稅與消費稅物品者走綠色出口；攜帶此類物品或對合規有疑問者走紅色出口聯繫丹麥海關署；如無紅色出口，聯繫機場清關辦公室。非自用貨物須繳消費稅（某些包裝或須押金）。

procedures.name_en: Cash and monetary instruments declaration (EUR 10,000 or more) when entering or leaving Denmark
procedures.name_zh: 进出丹麦现金及货币工具申报（1 万欧元及以上）
procedures.agency: Toldstyrelsen (Danish Customs Agency)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction and trigger: when you enter or leave Denmark with cash or other liquid funds ('monetary instruments') equal to a value of EUR 10,000 (approx. DKK 75,000) or more, you must declare to the Danish Customs Agency the monetary instruments you are bringing. Per the page 'If you are travelling with large amounts of valuables' captured live from toldst.dk on 2026-09-27 (HTTP 200), this is stated for entering or leaving Denmark — not restricted to the EU external border as the v25 baseline record asserted — and applies regardless of the type of currency and regardless of whether you are travelling as a private individual or on company business. You must also declare even if you are only in transit, for example when travelling by car or train, or if you go ashore from a ship and travel onwards to another country right away. Monetary instruments are cash, bearer securities (for example traveller's cheques and cheques) and certain types of gold: gold coins with a gold content of minimum 90%, and gold bullion or nuggets with a gold content of minimum 99.5%. This traveller procedure does not cover monetary instruments sent by mail, freight or courier, which follow other rules (Danish-language page). If you do not declare your monetary instruments and all the information required in the declaration form, you risk being fined and having your valuables seized; the Danish Customs Agency also has the right to examine and seize amounts both below and above EUR 10,000 if there are indications that they are connected with criminal activities.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向与触发：入境或离开丹麦时携带价值 EUR 10,000（约合 DKK 75,000）及以上（含本数）的现金或其他流动性资金（“货币工具”），须向丹麦海关署申报所携货币工具。据 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的页面《If you are travelling with large amounts of valuables》，原文即为“进入或离开丹麦”，并未如 v25 基线记录所述限于跨越欧盟外部边境；且不论币种、不论私人出行或公务出行均适用。仅过境（如乘汽车或火车）或下船后随即前往他国时同样必须申报。货币工具包括现金、不记名有价证券（如旅行支票与支票）及特定黄金：金含量不低于 90% 的金币，以及金含量不低于 99.5% 的金条或天然金块。本随身旅客程序不适用于经邮寄、货运或快递寄送货币工具，该情形适用其他规则（丹麦语页面）。不申报货币工具及申报单所要求全部信息的，将被罚款并可能没收财物；若有犯罪活动迹象，丹麦海关署对低于或高于 EUR 10,000 的款项均有权查验和扣押。
procedures.timing_en: When entering or leaving Denmark: fill in the declaration form (in Danish or English; with MitID login or without MitID) in advance or at a customs office when travelling, and save your reference number; even if you fill in the form in advance, you must always go to the customs office at the airport or where you enter or leave Denmark, quote the reference number — the Danish Customs Agency will process the declaration and can give you a physical receipt — and bring the receipt with you when entering and/or leaving Denmark as necessary.
procedures.timing_zh: 进出丹麦时：提前或在旅途中的海关办公室填写申报表（丹麦语或英语；可用 MitID 登录或免登录），并保存参考号；即使提前填报，仍必须前往机场或出入境地点的海关办公室报出参考号——丹麦海关署处理申报后可出具纸质收据——进出丹麦时按需随身携带收据。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出丹麥現金及貨幣工具申報（1 萬歐元及以上）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向與觸發：入境或離開丹麥時攜帶價值 EUR 10,000（約合 DKK 75,000）及以上（含本數）的現金或其他流動性資金（“貨幣工具”），須向丹麥海關署申報所攜貨幣工具。據 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的頁面《If you are travelling with large amounts of valuables》，原文即為“進入或離開丹麥”，並未如 v25 基線記錄所述限於跨越歐盟外部邊境；且不論幣種、不論私人出行或公務出行均適用。僅過境（如乘汽車或火車）或下船後隨即前往他國時同樣必須申報。貨幣工具包括現金、不記名有價證券（如旅行支票與支票）及特定黃金：金含量不低於 90% 的金幣，以及金含量不低於 99.5% 的金條或天然金塊。本隨身旅客程序不適用於經郵寄、貨運或快遞寄送貨幣工具，該情形適用其他規則（丹麥語頁面）。不申報貨幣工具及申報單所要求全部資訊的，將被罰款並可能沒收財物；若有犯罪活動跡象，丹麥海關署對低於或高於 EUR 10,000 的款項均有權查驗和扣押。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 進出丹麥時：提前或在旅途中的海關辦公室填寫申報表（丹麥語或英語；可用 MitID 登入或免登入），並保存參考號；即使提前填報，仍必須前往機場或出入境地點的海關辦公室報出參考號——丹麥海關署處理申報後可出具紙質收據——進出丹麥時按需隨身攜帶收據。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding traveller allowances
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报
procedures.agency: Estonian Tax and Customs Board (EMTA)
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving in Estonia from a third (non-EU) country: non-commercial goods up to a customs value of EUR 300 are duty-exempt (air and sea travellers up to EUR 430). Tobacco and alcohol relief requires age 18+. Tobacco relief applies at the first and second entry within a calendar month: 40 cigarettes, 100 cigarillos, 50 cigars or 50 g of smoking tobacco (an air passenger up to 200 cigarettes or 250 g). Alcohol relief applies in principle at the first entry within a calendar month: wine up to 4 L, beer up to 16 L, plus 2 L of beverages up to 22% alcohol or 1 L above 22% (asterisked amounts may be combined up to 100% of the total allowance); at the second entry within a calendar month, the Estonian Tax and Customs Board may apply an additional exemption only if the traveller proves that the import of alcohol was of an occasional nature. Travellers arriving by air, train or sea are not limited by border-crossing frequency. Motor-vehicle arrivals may bring standard-tank fuel plus up to 10 L in a portable container duty-free at the first entry per month. Tobacco, alcohol and motor fuel produced in or brought from Russia are prohibited (Council Regulation (EU) 2022/1904). Goods exceeding the duty-exempt value or quantitative limits, or requiring special permits, are subject to declaration: choose the red channel; if unsure whether goods are declarable, also choose the red channel; where a border point has no channel system, address a customs official to present the goods.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自第三国（非欧盟国家）入境爱沙尼亚：非商用货物按海关价值免税限额 300 欧（航空与海路旅客 430 欧）。烟草与酒类豁免均须年满 18 岁。烟草豁免限于每个日历月第一、二次入境：40 支香烟、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄或 50 克吸烟烟草（航空旅客最多 200 支香烟或 250 克）。酒类原则上仅为每个日历月首次入境：葡萄酒最多 4 升、啤酒最多 16 升，另加 ≤22% 酒精饮料 2 升或 >22% 1 升（带 * 的数量可按总限额 100% 比例合并）；每个日历月第二次入境时，仅在旅客证明携带酒类属偶然性质的情况下，爱沙尼亚税务与海关局方可酌情给予附加豁免。乘飞机、火车或海路抵达的旅客不受入境频率限制。乘机动车辆入境者每个日历月首次入境可免税携带油箱标准容量燃料及最多 10 升便携燃料。俄产或自俄罗斯带来的烟草、酒类及燃料依 (EU) 2022/1904 禁止入境。超出免税价值或数量限额、或需特别许可的物品须申报：走红道；不确定物品是否须申报同样走红道；口岸无红绿通道系统时找海关官员呈报物品。
procedures.timing_en: Declaration is made to customs at the border on arrival: choose the red channel when crossing; where a border crossing point has no channel system, present the goods to a customs official. Page last updated 17.06.2026; URL verified accessible on 2026-09-27.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时在边境向海关申报：过境走红道；口岸无红绿通道系统时向海关官员呈报物品。页面最后更新于 2026-06-17；该网址已于 2026-09-27 验证可访问。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自第三國（非歐盟國家）入境愛沙尼亞：非商用貨物按海關價值免稅限額 300 歐（航空與海路旅客 430 歐）。菸草與酒類豁免均須年滿 18 歲。菸草豁免限於每個日曆月第一、二次入境：40 支香菸、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄或 50 克吸菸菸草（航空旅客最多 200 支香菸或 250 克）。酒類原則上僅為每個日曆月首次入境：葡萄酒最多 4 升、啤酒最多 16 升，另加 ≤22% 酒精飲料 2 升或 >22% 1 升（帶 * 的數量可按總限額 100% 比例合併）；每個日曆月第二次入境時，僅在旅客證明攜帶酒類屬偶然性質的情況下，愛沙尼亞稅務與海關局方可酌情給予附加豁免。乘飛機、火車或海路抵達的旅客不受入境頻率限制。乘機動車輛入境者每個日曆月首次入境可免稅攜帶油箱標準容量燃料及最多 10 升便攜燃料。俄產或自俄羅斯帶來的菸草、酒類及燃料依 (EU) 2022/1904 禁止入境。超出免稅價值或數量限額、或需特別許可的物品須申報：走紅道；不確定物品是否須申報同樣走紅道；口岸無紅綠通道系統時找海關官員呈報物品。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時在邊境向海關申報：過境走紅道；口岸無紅綠通道系統時向海關官員呈報物品。頁面最後更新於 2026-06-17；該網址已於 2026-09-27 驗證可訪問。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration when entering or leaving the EU with EUR 10,000 or more
procedures.name_zh: 进出欧盟随身携带 1 万欧元及以上现金申报
procedures.agency: Estonian Tax and Customs Board (EMTA)
procedures.applicability_en: Required when entering or leaving the European Union through Estonia's external border carrying cash of at least EUR 10,000 (threshold inclusive), or the equivalent in another currency or bearer-negotiable instrument. Cash means banknotes and coins in any currency (including currencies no longer in circulation), bearer-negotiable instruments such as travellers' cheques and promissory notes, coins with a gold content of not less than 90%, and gold in nuggets or clumps with a gold content of not less than 99.5%. For amounts below EUR 10,000 customs may carry out checks only where there is information that the cash is related to criminal activity — a separate checking power, not a routine declaration threshold. Sanctions additionally prohibit exporting euro and Member State banknotes to Russia or Belarus (narrow personal-use exemption with no fixed amount threshold) and importing gold from Russia.
procedures.applicability_zh: 经爱沙尼亚外部边界进入或离开欧盟时，随身携带至少 1 万欧元（含本数）现金——或等值其他货币、无记名可转让票据——须申报。现金指任何货币的纸币和硬币（含已停止流通货币）、旅行支票及本票等无记名可转让票据、含金量不低于 90% 的金币、以及含金量不低于 99.5% 的金块或天然金块。低于 1 万欧元时，仅在有信息显示现金涉及犯罪活动的情况下海关方可查验——这是独立查验权，并非常规申报门槛。制裁另禁止向俄罗斯或白俄罗斯出口欧元及成员国货币纸币（个人自用豁免极窄且无固定金额门槛），并禁止自俄罗斯进口黄金。
procedures.timing_en: Electronic declaration in e-MTA (log in, then Customs – Simplified declarations – Cash declaration – New declaration) may be submitted up to three days before crossing the border; once submitted, the traveller must still choose the red lane at the border customs office and inform the customs official of lodging the declaration. Travellers without access to the e-services environment can submit a cash declaration on the 'Cash declaration / disclosure' webpage. Currency equivalents use the exchange rate of the day before submission (ECB rate; the declaration information system applies Estonian Master Tariff System rates). Page last updated 16.06.2026.
procedures.timing_zh: 通过 e-MTA 电子服务（登录后依次选择 海关 – 简化申报 – 现金申报 – New declaration）可于越过边境前最早 3 天提交电子申报；提交后过境时仍须在边境海关走红道并告知海关官员已提交申报。无法使用电子服务环境者，可在“Cash declaration / disclosure”网页提交现金申报。外币折算采用提交前一日汇率（欧洲央行汇率；现金申报信息系统采用爱沙尼亚主关税系统汇率）。页面最后更新于 2026-06-16。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出歐盟隨身攜帶 1 萬歐元及以上現金申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 經愛沙尼亞外部邊界進入或離開歐盟時，隨身攜帶至少 1 萬歐元（含本數）現金——或等值其他貨幣、無記名可轉讓票據——須申報。現金指任何貨幣的紙幣和硬幣（含已停止流通貨幣）、旅行支票及本票等無記名可轉讓票據、含金量不低於 90% 的金幣、以及含金量不低於 99.5% 的金塊或天然金塊。低於 1 萬歐元時，僅在有資訊顯示現金涉及犯罪活動的情況下海關方可查驗——這是獨立查驗權，並非常規申報門檻。制裁另禁止向俄羅斯或白俄羅斯出口歐元及成員國貨幣紙幣（個人自用豁免極窄且無固定金額門檻），並禁止自俄羅斯進口黃金。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 通過 e-MTA 電子服務（登入後依次選擇 海關 – 簡化申報 – 現金申報 – New declaration）可於越過邊境前最早 3 天提交電子申報；提交後過境時仍須在邊境海關走紅道並告知海關官員已提交申報。無法使用電子服務環境者，可在“Cash declaration / disclosure”網頁提交現金申報。外幣折算採用提交前一日匯率（歐洲央行匯率；現金申報資訊系統採用愛沙尼亞主關稅系統匯率）。頁面最後更新於 2026-06-16。
