procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding allowances
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报
procedures.agency: State Revenue Service / Valsts ieņēmumu dienests (VID)
procedures.applicability_en: Entering Latvia from a country outside the EU (or named special EU territories such as the Canary Islands or Aland Islands, treated as non-EU): goods for personal use or gifts are duty-free per person up to EUR 300 by land and EUR 430 by air or sea; children under 15 are capped at a flat EUR 285 regardless of travel mode. Personal medicines and tobacco, alcohol and fuel within the quantitative limits are excluded from the value calculation. Excise goods are duty-free at most once every 30 days: tobacco — 40 cigarettes, 20 cigarillos, 10 cigars or 50 g of smoking tobacco by road/rail/sea and 200 cigarettes, 100 cigarillos, 50 cigars or 250 g by air (combinations allowed up to a 100% total of the individual percentages); alcohol — 1 L above 22% vol. or 2 L up to 22% vol., plus 4 L of still wine and 16 L of beer (same 100% combination rule); no alcohol allowance below age 18, and persons under 20 may not bring tobacco products, tobacco substitutes, herbal smoking products, electronic smoking devices or refill containers. EU sanctions prohibit importing spirit drinks, cigarettes, cigarillos and cigars from Russia and Belarus (naturally fermented wine and beer without artificial flavours or additives excepted) and importing fuel from Russia or Belarus in portable tanks. Goods exceeding the value or quantity allowances, or excise goods imported more often than once per 30 days, must be declared with excise tax, VAT and customs duty paid — travellers carrying goods to be declared must select the "red channel" at the border (the "green channel" only where there is nothing to declare). Entering Latvia by land from Russia or Belarus, a Statement on the Transport of Excise Goods must additionally be completed at the border in defined cases: entering more than once per 30 days, exceeding the duty-free quantities, claiming the standard-fuel-tank relief when planning to return within 30 days in the same vehicle, or upon an official's request.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自欧盟外国家（或名单内特殊欧盟领地，如加那利群岛、奥兰群岛，按非欧盟待遇）入境拉脱维亚：自用或馈赠商品按人免税——陆路 300 欧、空运或海运 430 欧；15 岁以下儿童无论何种旅行方式一律上限 285 欧。个人自用药品及数量限额内的烟草、酒类、燃料不计入货值计算。消费税商品每 30 天至多免税一次：烟草——公路/铁路/海路 40 支香烟、20 支小雪茄、10 支雪茄或 50 克吸用烟草，空运 200 支香烟、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄或 250 克（可按各项百分比合并至 100%）；酒类——>22% 酒精度 1 升或 ≤22% 2 升，另加 4 升静止葡萄酒与 16 升啤酒（同样适用 100% 合并规则）；18 岁以下无酒类免税额，20 岁以下禁止携带烟草制品、烟草替代品、草本吸烟制品、电子吸烟装置及烟弹。欧盟制裁禁止自俄罗斯、白俄罗斯进口烈性酒、香烟、小雪茄及雪茄（无人工添加的自然发酵葡萄酒与啤酒除外），并禁止以便携油箱自俄、白进口燃料。超出货值或数量限额的商品、或每 30 天内多次进口的消费税商品须申报并缴纳消费税、增值税与关税——携带须申报商品的旅客过境必须选"红通道"（无可申报物品方可行绿道）。自俄罗斯或白俄罗斯陆路入境拉脱维亚者，在规定情形还须在边境填写《消费税商品运输声明》：每 30 天内多次入境、超过免税数量、拟 30 天内同车返程并主张油箱标准燃料豁免、或应官员要求。
procedures.timing_en: Declare to customs at the border when crossing: select the "red channel" when carrying goods to be declared. Personal luggage above the value allowance with a total value not exceeding EUR 700 may use the unified 2.5% customs duty rate (not applicable to tobacco or alcohol). At border crossing sites without customs controls, the Statement on the Transport of Excise Goods is submitted to State Border Guard officials. Excise page updated 22.04.2025; luggage page published 20.10.2022; both read 2026-09-27.
procedures.timing_zh: 过境时向海关申报：携带须申报商品走红通道。超货值但总值不超过 700 欧的个人行李可适用 2.5% 统一关税率（烟草、酒类不适用）。无海关监管的过境点，《消费税商品运输声明》向国家边防警卫队官员提交。消费税页更新于 2025-04-22；行李页发布于 2022-10-20；两页均于 2026-09-27 实读。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自歐盟外國家（或名單內特殊歐盟領地，如加那利群島、奧蘭群島，按非歐盟待遇）入境拉脫維亞：自用或饋贈商品按人免稅——陸路 300 歐、空運或海運 430 歐；15 歲以下兒童無論何種旅行方式一律上限 285 歐。個人自用藥品及數量限額內的菸草、酒類、燃料不計入貨值計算。消費稅商品每 30 天至多免稅一次：菸草——公路/鐵路/海路 40 支香菸、20 支小雪茄、10 支雪茄或 50 克吸用菸草，空運 200 支香菸、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄或 250 克（可按各項百分比合並至 100%）；酒類——>22% 酒精度 1 升或 ≤22% 2 升，另加 4 升靜止葡萄酒與 16 升啤酒（同樣適用 100% 合併規則）；18 歲以下無酒類免稅額，20 歲以下禁止攜帶菸草製品、菸草替代品、草本吸菸製品、電子吸菸裝置及煙彈。歐盟制裁禁止自俄羅斯、白俄羅斯進口烈性酒、香菸、小雪茄及雪茄（無人工添加的自然發酵葡萄酒與啤酒除外），並禁止以便攜油箱自俄、白進口燃料。超出貨值或數量限額的商品、或每 30 天內多次進口的消費稅商品須申報並繳納消費稅、增值稅與關稅——攜帶須申報商品的旅客過境必須選"紅通道"（無可申報物品方可行綠道）。自俄羅斯或白俄羅斯陸路入境拉脫維亞者，在規定情形還須在邊境填寫《消費稅商品運輸聲明》：每 30 天內多次入境、超過免稅數量、擬 30 天內同車返程並主張油箱標準燃料豁免、或應官員要求。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 過境時向海關申報：攜帶須申報商品走紅通道。超貨值但總值不超過 700 歐的個人行李可適用 2.5% 統一關稅率（菸草、酒類不適用）。無海關監管的過境點，《消費稅商品運輸聲明》向國家邊防警衛隊官員提交。消費稅頁更新於 2025-04-22；行李頁發佈於 2022-10-20；兩頁均於 2026-09-27 實讀。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration at EU external borders (≥EUR 10,000); intra-EU border checks upon official request
procedures.name_zh: 欧盟外部边界现金申报（≥1万欧元）；欧盟内部边界检查中仅应官员要求申报
procedures.agency: State Revenue Service / Valsts ieņēmumu dienests (VID)
procedures.applicability_en: (1) EU external border: when entering or leaving Latvia at places that are also the external border of the EU, natural persons must declare cash equivalent to or exceeding EUR 10,000 (threshold inclusive; other currencies converted at the ECB reference rate published on the penultimate Wednesday of each month and used for the following month). The obligation binds every person transporting the cash regardless of ownership and is computed per person — cash is not pooled between fellow travellers (official example: a wife carrying EUR 14,000 through Latvia must declare even though splitting the couple's cash would leave each below EUR 10,000). Where the external border is first crossed in another Member State, the declaration is lodged in that first country (official example: Turkey→Latvia with a transfer in Germany — declare in Germany). At border points with a two-channel customs control system, individuals required to declare must cross via the "red channel". For cash below EUR 10,000 the competent authority (SRS; the State Border Guard where no customs control point exists) may require a declaration only where there are indications that the cash is linked to criminal activity — an officer-initiated control power, not a routine threshold. (2) EU internal border checks, including Latvia–Lithuania and Latvia–Estonia: since 1 July 2019 the SRS Tax and Customs Police Board has controlled cash movement there; a written declaration is filled in on a paper form only upon request of an official of that Board and only for cash of EUR 10,000 and more — the law does not provide that every traveller be controlled, and there is no proactive advance filing. Cash covers banknotes and coins, blank cheques, traveller's cheques, promissory notes and money orders, coins with at least 90% gold content and bullion with at least 99.5% gold. Unaccompanied cash sent by post, freight or courier (EUR 10,000 or more, or below that upon customs request) follows a separate cash-disclosure regime and is outside this accompanied-traveller procedure. EU sanctions additionally permit exporting banknotes of EU Member State currencies to Russia and Belarus only in reasonable amounts for personal travel needs.
procedures.applicability_zh: （1）欧盟外部边界：在同为欧盟外部边界的拉脱维亚口岸入境或出境时，自然人携带等值或超过 1 万欧元（含本数；其他货币按欧洲央行每月倒数第二个周三公布、次月适用的参考汇率折算）的现金须申报。义务约束所有运送现金的人，无论是否为现金所有人；现金按人单独计算，不与同行人合并（官网例：夫妇乘车过境拉脱维亚，妻子携带 1.4 万欧元即须申报，即便两人平摊各不足 1 万欧）。首次跨越欧盟外部边界发生在其他成员国时，在该首个国家申报（官网例：土耳其→拉脱维亚、德国转机——在德国申报）。设双通道海关监管系统的口岸，须申报者必须走红通道。低于 1 万欧元时，主管机关（VID；无海关监管点处为国家边防警卫队）仅在发现现金涉嫌犯罪活动的迹象时方可要求申报——系官员发起的查验权，并非常规门槛。（2）欧盟内部边界检查，包括拉脱维亚—立陶宛、拉脱维亚—爱沙尼亚边界：自 2019 年 7 月 1 日起由 VID 税务与海关警察局管控现金流动；仅应该局官员要求、且仅对 ≥1 万欧元现金以纸表填写书面申报——法律并未规定查验每位旅客，也不存在主动预申报。现金包括纸币与硬币、空白支票、旅行支票、本票及汇票、含金量 ≥90% 的金币及 ≥99.5% 的金条。以邮寄、货运或快递发送的无随行现金（≥1 万欧元，或应海关要求的更低金额）适用单独的现金披露制度，不在本随行旅客程序内。欧盟制裁另仅允许出于个人旅行需要以合理数量向俄罗斯、白俄罗斯出口成员国货币纸币。
procedures.timing_en: The completed declaration is submitted to the official of the competent authority at the border crossing point ("red channel" at two-channel points); intra-EU declarations use a paper form provided by the requesting official, and downloadable EN/LV/RU forms are also on the SRS website. The SRS border "Cash statement" service page lists the price as Free, and forms are supplied free of charge. Non-declaration or false declaration can draw an administrative fine of up to 20% of the amount to be declared and criminal liability for large amounts. Cash page updated 03.12.2024; internal-EU page published 31.10.2022; form files refreshed through 10.02.2026; read 2026-09-27.
procedures.timing_zh: 填妥的申报表在边境口岸向主管机关官员提交（双通道口岸走红通道）；欧盟内部申报使用应要求官员提供的纸表，SRS 网站另提供英/拉/俄文表格下载。VID 边境"现金申报"服务页标价 Free，表格免费提供。未申报或虚假申报可处最高达应申报金额 20% 的行政罚款，数额巨大者负刑事责任。现金页更新于 2024-12-03；欧盟内部页发布于 2022-10-31；表格文件更新至 2026-02-10；2026-09-27 实读。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 歐盟外部邊界現金申報（≥1萬歐元）；歐盟內部邊界檢查中僅應官員要求申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: （1）歐盟外部邊界：在同為歐盟外部邊界的拉脫維亞口岸入境或出境時，自然人攜帶等值或超過 1 萬歐元（含本數；其他貨幣按歐洲央行每月倒數第二個週三公佈、次月適用的參考匯率折算）的現金須申報。義務約束所有運送現金的人，無論是否為現金所有人；現金按人單獨計算，不與同行人合併（官網例：夫婦乘車過境拉脫維亞，妻子攜帶 1.4 萬歐元即須申報，即便兩人平攤各不足 1 萬歐）。首次跨越歐盟外部邊界發生在其他成員國時，在該首個國家申報（官網例：土耳其→拉脫維亞、德國轉機——在德國申報）。設雙通道海關監管系統的口岸，須申報者必須走紅通道。低於 1 萬歐元時，主管機關（VID；無海關監管點處為國家邊防警衛隊）僅在發現現金涉嫌犯罪活動的跡象時方可要求申報——系官員發起的查驗權，並非常規門檻。（2）歐盟內部邊界檢查，包括拉脫維亞—立陶宛、拉脫維亞—愛沙尼亞邊界：自 2019 年 7 月 1 日起由 VID 稅務與海關警察局管控現金流動；僅應該局官員要求、且僅對 ≥1 萬歐元現金以紙表填寫書面申報——法律並未規定查驗每位旅客，也不存在主動預申報。現金包括紙幣與硬幣、空白支票、旅行支票、本票及匯票、含金量 ≥90% 的金幣及 ≥99.5% 的金條。以郵寄、貨運或快遞發送的無隨行現金（≥1 萬歐元，或應海關要求的更低金額）適用單獨的現金披露制度，不在本隨行旅客程序內。歐盟制裁另僅允許出於個人旅行需要以合理數量向俄羅斯、白俄羅斯出口成員國貨幣紙幣。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 填妥的申報表在邊境口岸向主管機關官員提交（雙通道口岸走紅通道）；歐盟內部申報使用應要求官員提供的紙表，SRS 網站另提供英/拉/俄文表格下載。VID 邊境"現金申報"服務頁標價 Free，表格免費提供。未申報或虛假申報可處最高達應申報金額 20% 的行政罰款，數額巨大者負刑事責任。現金頁更新於 2024-12-03；歐盟內部頁發佈於 2022-10-31；表格文件更新至 2026-02-10；2026-09-27 實讀。

procedures.name_en: Cash Declaration Form at the border (≥EUR 10,000 third-country travel; >EUR 10,000 intra-EU, on request)
procedures.name_zh: 边境现金申报表（第三国行程≥1万欧元；欧盟内部>1万欧元且应要求）
procedures.agency: Muitinės departamentas prie Lietuvos Respublikos finansų ministerijos (Customs of Lithuania)
procedures.applicability_en: Two distinct obligations on the same Cash Declaration Form, as stated on the official Customs of Lithuania page for passengers. (1) External border: any person entering Lithuania from a third country, or travelling from Lithuania to a third country, carrying cash of a value of EUR 10 000 or more (threshold inclusive, or the equivalent in another currency) must declare that sum on the Cash Declaration Form at the customs office operating in the state border control point, and is obliged to submit the form without being asked to do so by a customs officer. (2) Intra-EU: travelling between Lithuania and other EU Member States (the page's example: from Lithuania to Spain), the duty arises only for cash of a value strictly more than EUR 10 000, and the form is declared when asked to do so by the customs officer — not a proactive declaration. Cash is defined to include banknotes and coins, bearer instruments, gold coins of at least 90% gold, and bars, nuggets or clumps of at least 99.5% gold. Copies of documents proving the origin of the cash must accompany the declaration (the page lists inheritance, transfer/sale contracts, lottery, cultural and gambling vouchers, owner documents and bank statements as examples). Unaccompanied cash sent in postal packages, courier shipments, unaccompanied luggage or container cargo may fall under a separate Cash Disclosure Declaration within 30 days at customs request and is separate from the accompanied-traveller declaration described above; a routine customs check is not a second declaration procedure.
procedures.applicability_zh: 同一份现金申报表（Cash Declaration Form）上的两套不同义务，载于立陶宛海关官方旅客页。（1）外部边界：自第三国入境立陶宛、或自立陶宛前往第三国，携带价值 ≥10 000 欧元（含本数，或等值其他货币）现金者，必须在入境/出境所经边境检查站的海关机构以现金申报表申报，且有义务在海关官员未催告的情况下主动提交该表。（2）欧盟内部：在立陶宛与其他欧盟成员国之间旅行（页面举例：立陶宛至西班牙），仅当携带现金价值 严格 >10 000 欧元时产生义务，且仅应海关官员要求时申报——不是主动申报。现金定义包括纸币与硬币、无记名票据、含金量至少 90% 的金币、以及含金量至少 99.5% 的金条/金块/天然金块。申报须附证明现金来源的文件副本（页面列举继承、转让/出售合同、彩票/文化/赌博券、所有权文件与银行对账单为例）。以邮寄包裹、快递、无人随身行李或集装箱货运发送的无随行现金可能适用独立的现金披露申报（应海关要求 30 日内），与上述随行携带现金的申报分开；常规查验也不是另一个申报程序。
procedures.timing_en: Submitted at the border: to the customs office operating in the state border control point through which the person enters or leaves Lithuania. The form is completed in Lithuanian or English, either as the printed version available at the customs offices or online via the Passenger Portal. A person entering Lithuania by plane must submit the form to the customs office in the red channel area (the green channel must not be used); cash of a value of EUR 10 000 or more carried in hold baggage must be declared before checking in the hold baggage. Page footer: last updated 12-07-2024.
procedures.timing_zh: 在边境提交：向旅客入境或离境所经边境检查站的海关机构提交。表格以立陶宛语或英语填写，可用海关机构领取的纸质版，或经 Passenger Portal 在线填写。乘飞机入境立陶宛者必须向红色通道区域的海关机构提交（不得使用绿色通道）；托运行李中携带价值 ≥10 000 欧元现金的，必须在托运行李前先行申报。页面页脚：最后更新 2024-07-12。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 邊境現金申報表（第三國行程≥1萬歐元；歐盟內部>1萬歐元且應要求）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 同一份現金申報表（Cash Declaration Form）上的兩套不同義務，載於立陶宛海關官方旅客頁。（1）外部邊界：自第三國入境立陶宛、或自立陶宛前往第三國，攜帶價值 ≥10 000 歐元（含本數，或等值其他貨幣）現金者，必須在入境/出境所經邊境檢查站的海關機構以現金申報表申報，且有義務在海關官員未催告的情況下主動提交該表。（2）歐盟內部：在立陶宛與其他歐盟成員國之間旅行（頁面舉例：立陶宛至西班牙），僅當攜帶現金價值 嚴格 >10 000 歐元時產生義務，且僅應海關官員要求時申報——不是主動申報。現金定義包括紙幣與硬幣、無記名票據、含金量至少 90% 的金幣、以及含金量至少 99.5% 的金條/金塊/天然金塊。申報須附證明現金來源的文件副本（頁面列舉繼承、轉讓/出售合同、彩票/文化/賭博券、所有權文件與銀行對賬單為例）。以郵寄包裹、快遞、無人隨身行李或集裝箱貨運發送的無隨行現金可能適用獨立的現金披露申報（應海關要求 30 日內），與上述隨行攜帶現金的申報分開；常規查驗也不是另一個申報程序。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在邊境提交：向旅客入境或離境所經邊境檢查站的海關機構提交。表格以立陶宛語或英語填寫，可用海關機構領取的紙質版，或經 Passenger Portal 線上填寫。乘飛機入境立陶宛者必須向紅色通道區域的海關機構提交（不得使用綠色通道）；托運行李中攜帶價值 ≥10 000 歐元現金的，必須在托運行李前先行申報。頁面頁腳：最後更新 2024-07-12。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of currency to Norwegian Customs
procedures.name_zh: 向挪威海关申报货币
procedures.agency: Tolletaten (Norwegian Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Both directions: if you are bringing currency with a value corresponding to more than NOK 25,000 to or from Norway, you must notify Norwegian Customs. The trigger is amounts above 25,000, not 25,000 itself. The rule covers Norwegian and foreign notes, coins and other means of payment, e.g. gift cards; it is permitted to bring such amounts, but they must be declared before travelling, and there is no tax on the amount. Money transferred through banks, financial institutions and payment companies need not be reported to Customs (such transfers are reported to The Currency Register). Penalty for failure to notify: 20 per cent of the entire amount carried — for example, a failure to report NOK 26,000 results in a NOK 5,200 penalty — or a police report; if criminal activity is suspected, the entire amount is confiscated until the investigation is complete.
procedures.applicability_zh: 双向适用：携带价值超过 25,000 挪威克朗（触发线为“超过”，恰为 25,000 本身不触发）的货币前往或离开挪威，必须通知挪威海关。规则涵盖挪威及外国纸币、硬币和其他支付工具（如礼品卡）；允许携带此类金额，但须在出行前申报，且金额本身不征税。通过银行、金融机构和支付公司的跨境转账无须向海关申报（此类转账由机构向挪威货币登记册（The Currency Register）报告）。未通知的处罚：按携带的全部金额课以 20% 罚款——例如未申报 26,000 克朗将被罚 5,200 克朗——或移送警方；涉嫌犯罪时整笔金额被没收，直至调查结束。
procedures.timing_en: Fill in two copies of the form 'Declaration of cash and cash equivalents' (RD-0026; English version RD-0026E) and submit both copies to Norwegian Customs before crossing the border. Travelling to Norway: go through the red channel upon arrival and submit the two copies there. Leaving Norway: submit the two copies to the nearest customs office from where you are travelling, for instance at the airport before departure. Information Centre: +47 22 86 03 12.
procedures.timing_zh: 填写两份《现金及现金等价物申报表》（RD-0026，英文版编号 RD-0026E），过境前将两份均提交挪威海关。前往挪威：抵达时走红通道，当场提交两份表。离开挪威：向距出发地最近的海关办事处提交两份表，例如出发前在机场提交。咨询电话 +47 22 86 03 12。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 向挪威海關申報貨幣
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 雙向適用：攜帶價值超過 25,000 挪威克朗（觸發線為“超過”，恰為 25,000 本身不觸發）的貨幣前往或離開挪威，必須通知挪威海關。規則涵蓋挪威及外國紙幣、硬幣和其他支付工具（如禮品卡）；允許攜帶此類金額，但須在出行前申報，且金額本身不徵稅。通過銀行、金融機構和支付公司的跨境轉賬無須向海關申報（此類轉賬由機構向挪威貨幣登記冊（The Currency Register）報告）。未通知的處罰：按攜帶的全部金額課以 20% 罰款——例如未申報 26,000 克朗將被罰 5,200 克朗——或移送警方；涉嫌犯罪時整筆金額被沒收，直至調查結束。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 填寫兩份《現金及現金等價物申報表》（RD-0026，英文版編號 RD-0026E），過境前將兩份均提交挪威海關。前往挪威：抵達時走紅通道，當場提交兩份表。離開挪威：向距出發地最近的海關辦事處提交兩份表，例如出發前在機場提交。諮詢電話 +47 22 86 03 12。

procedures.name_en: Traveller declaration of goods exceeding the value limit or quota (red channel, release for free circulation)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客超价值限额或配额商品申报（红通道，流通放行程序）
procedures.agency: Tolletaten (Norwegian Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Entering Norway after travelling abroad. Value limit: outside Norway more than 24 hours — goods up to NOK 6,000 duty-free; shorter trips — once within a 24-hour period goods up to NOK 3,000 free of charge. The limit applies to the total sum of the items purchased, excluding alcohol and tobacco products (separate quotas), and you choose which items to place within it. A single item above the limit is dutiable on its entire value; items that constitute a whole (e.g. a kitchen) cannot be divided across trips or individuals. Tourists not resident in Norway: temporary personal belongings used during the stay and taken back out (clothing, laptops, mobile phones, jewellery) are not subject to the value limit; goods that will remain in Norway, such as items to give away or use up, cannot exceed the NOK 6,000 limit. Alcohol and tobacco: per-person quotas exempt from the value limit; minimum age 18 for beer, wine and tobacco products, 20 for beverages over 22% alcohol. Residents' quota: spirits over 22% up to and including 60% — 1 litre; wine etc. over 2.5% up to and including 22% — 1.5 litres (2 bottles); beer above 2.5%, or alcopops/cider etc. above 2.5% up to and including 4.7% — 2 litres; 100 cigarettes or 125 grams of other tobacco products; 100 sheets of cigarette paper. The spirits quota may be exchanged for 1.5 litres of wine or beer/alcopops/cider, the wine quota for equal amounts of beer/alcopops/cider; wine and beer may not be exchanged for stronger beverages, nor tobacco for beer or wine. Tourists residing outside Norway: 200 cigarettes or 250 grams of tobacco and 200 cigarette papers, alcohol quota as for residents. Stay abroad under 24 hours: alcohol and tobacco only once in that period and only with documentation that local taxes were paid in an EEA country. Food: from the EEA area, a total quota of 10 kilograms of meat, meat products, cheese and animal feed products per person over 12 (the 10-kilogram limit does not apply to dog and cat food, only other animal feed); beyond this quota the value limit determines how much food you may bring without paying Norwegian taxes. Meat and dairy products from outside the EEA require a special permit from the Norwegian Food Safety Authority (Mattilsynet); no permit is needed from Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Iceland, Andorra or San Marino. Potatoes may not be imported without special permission; children may bring only soft drinks, chocolate and sugar products duty-free, otherwise they must be 12 years of age. Beverages over 60% alcohol and unapproved nicotine products (nicotine pouches, heated tobacco products, waterpipe tobacco, e-cigarettes with nicotine without a medical certificate) are prohibited; different quotas apply to transport personnel in international traffic. These thresholds trigger one and the same declaration: goods exceeding the value limit must be declared for the release for free circulation procedure (25% VAT on most items, plus customs duties mainly on clothing and food), the amount of alcohol and tobacco exceeding the quota must be declared, and goods requiring a special permit go through the red channel.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自国外旅行入境挪威。价值限额：在挪威境外停留超过 24 小时——可免税携带价值最高 6,000 挪威克朗的商品；不足 24 小时的短途旅行——每 24 小时期间可一次携带价值最高 3,000 克朗的免税商品。限额按所购商品总额计，不含酒精和烟草制品（另有配额），且由旅客自行选择哪些商品计入限额。单件商品超过限额的，须按其全部价值纳税；构成整体的商品（如整套厨房）不得跨行程或跨人拆分携带。非挪威居民游客：停留期间使用并带离的暂用个人物品（衣物、笔记本电脑、手机、珠宝等）不受价值限额约束；将留在挪威的商品（如拟赠出或耗用的物品）不得超过 6,000 克朗限额。烟酒：配额按每人计，不占价值限额；携带啤酒、葡萄酒和烟草制品须年满 18 岁，携带酒精含量超过 22% 的饮料须年满 20 岁。居民配额：酒精含量超过 22% 至 60%（含）的烈酒等 1 升；超过 2.5% 至 22%（含）的葡萄酒等 1.5 升（2 瓶）；2.5% 以上的啤酒（含烈性啤酒），或 2.5% 至 4.7%（含）的即饮酒/苹果酒等 2 升；100 支香烟或 125 克其他烟草制品（鼻烟、雪茄和小雪茄按克计）；100 张卷烟纸。烈酒配额可兑换 1.5 升葡萄酒或啤酒/即饮酒/苹果酒，葡萄酒配额可兑换等量啤酒/即饮酒/苹果酒；葡萄酒和啤酒不得兑换更烈酒类，烟草配额亦不得兑换啤酒或葡萄酒。居住在挪威境外的游客：烟草配额为 200 支香烟或 250 克烟草及 200 张卷烟纸，酒精配额与居民相同。在境外停留不足 24 小时：该期间仅可一次携带烟酒，且须能证明已在某一 EEA 国家缴纳当地税款。食品：自 EEA 地区入境，按年满 12 岁的每人计，可携带总计 10 公斤的肉、肉制品、奶酪和动物饲料产品（10 公斤上限不适用于猫狗食品，仅适用于其他动物饲料）；超出该配额后，由价值限额决定可免缴挪威税款携带的食品数量。来自 EEA 以外国家的肉及乳制品须持挪威食品安全局（Mattilsynet）特别许可方可携带；自瑞士、列支敦士登、冰岛、安道尔、圣马力诺携带肉、肉制品、牛奶、奶酪及其他乳制品无需许可。马铃薯未经特别许可不得进口；儿童仅可免税携带软饮料、巧克力和糖类制品，携带其他产品须年满 12 岁。酒精含量超过 60% 的饮料及未获批准的含尼古丁产品（尼古丁袋、加热烟草制品、水烟烟草、无戒烟医疗证明的含尼古丁电子烟）禁止入境；国际交通运输人员适用不同配额。上述门槛触发的是同一项申报义务：超过价值限额的商品须按“流通放行”程序申报（多数商品按 25% 增值税征收，部分商品另有关税，主要为服装和食品）；超过配额的烟酒数量必须申报；需特别许可的商品走红通道。
procedures.timing_en: Go through the red channel on arrival. Goods exceeding the value limit are declared for the release for free circulation procedure, and you can pay the duties when you cross the red zone at the border — make sure to choose a border crossing with a staffed customs office; not all crossings have one before you enter Norway (some are located on the Swedish or Finnish side and handle clearance tasks for Norway; check the toll.no map of customs offices). The same red channel applies to alcohol and tobacco amounts exceeding the quota and to goods that require special permits, e.g. meat and dairy products from outside the EEA; if in doubt, go through the red channel and ask a Norwegian Customs officer. The green channel may be used only when you only have goods not liable for duties and taxes within the permitted quota and value limit, the goods are not for sale (personal use or a private gift), and you transport them yourself so they can be presented at a customs control point. If your luggage has been delayed and will arrive later, you must pass through the red channel and state what is in your hand luggage and your other luggage. The Norwegian Customs app can check whether you are within the quota, calculate quota combinations and be used to declare goods. If you cross without declaring and are stopped in a customs control, the items may be confiscated and you could be reported for smuggling.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时走红通道。超过价值限额的商品按“流通放行”程序申报，可在过境时走红区（红通道）缴纳税款——务必选择设有海关办事处的口岸；并非所有口岸在入境挪威前设有办事处（部分位于瑞典或芬兰一侧，代挪威办理清关，可在 toll.no 海关办事处地图查询）。超过配额的烟酒数量以及需特别许可的商品（如来自 EEA 以外的肉及乳制品）同样走红通道；有疑问时走红通道询问挪威海关关员。只有在配额与价值限额内、无需缴税、非售卖用途（自用或私人馈赠）且由本人随身携带以便在海关查验点出示的商品，方可走绿通道。如行李延误稍后到达，必须走红通道，说明手提行李与其他行李中的物品。可用“挪威海关”应用核对是否超额、计算配额组合并申报商品。不申报入境而被海关查获的，商品可能被没收，并可能被以走私报案。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客超價值限額或配額商品申報（紅通道，流通放行程序）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自國外旅行入境挪威。價值限額：在挪威境外停留超過 24 小時——可免稅攜帶價值最高 6,000 挪威克朗的商品；不足 24 小時的短途旅行——每 24 小時期間可一次攜帶價值最高 3,000 克朗的免稅商品。限額按所購商品總額計，不含酒精和菸草製品（另有配額），且由旅客自行選擇哪些商品計入限額。單件商品超過限額的，須按其全部價值納稅；構成整體的商品（如整套廚房）不得跨行程或跨人拆分攜帶。非挪威居民遊客：停留期間使用並帶離的暫用個人物品（衣物、筆電電腦、手機、珠寶等）不受價值限額約束；將留在挪威的商品（如擬贈出或耗用的物品）不得超過 6,000 克朗限額。菸酒：配額按每人計，不佔價值限額；攜帶啤酒、葡萄酒和菸草製品須年滿 18 歲，攜帶酒精含量超過 22% 的飲料須年滿 20 歲。居民配額：酒精含量超過 22% 至 60%（含）的烈酒等 1 升；超過 2.5% 至 22%（含）的葡萄酒等 1.5 升（2 瓶）；2.5% 以上的啤酒（含烈性啤酒），或 2.5% 至 4.7%（含）的即飲酒/蘋果酒等 2 升；100 支香菸或 125 克其他菸草製品（鼻菸、雪茄和小雪茄按克計）；100 張捲菸紙。烈酒配額可兌換 1.5 升葡萄酒或啤酒/即飲酒/蘋果酒，葡萄酒配額可兌換等量啤酒/即飲酒/蘋果酒；葡萄酒和啤酒不得兌換更烈酒類，菸草配額亦不得兌換啤酒或葡萄酒。居住在挪威境外的遊客：菸草配額為 200 支香菸或 250 克菸草及 200 張捲菸紙，酒精配額與居民相同。在境外停留不足 24 小時：該期間僅可一次攜帶菸酒，且須能證明已在某一 EEA 國家繳納當地稅款。食品：自 EEA 地區入境，按年滿 12 歲的每人計，可攜帶總計 10 公斤的肉、肉製品、奶酪和動物飼料產品（10 公斤上限不適用於貓狗食品，僅適用於其他動物飼料）；超出該配額後，由價值限額決定可免繳挪威稅款攜帶的食品數量。來自 EEA 以外國家的肉及乳製品須持挪威食品安全局（Mattilsynet）特別許可方可攜帶；自瑞士、列支敦士登、冰島、安道爾、聖馬力諾攜帶肉、肉製品、牛奶、奶酪及其他乳製品無需許可。馬鈴薯未經特別許可不得進口；兒童僅可免稅攜帶軟飲料、巧克力和糖類製品，攜帶其他產品須年滿 12 歲。酒精含量超過 60% 的飲料及未獲批准的含尼古丁產品（尼古丁袋、加熱菸草製品、水煙菸草、無戒菸醫療證明的含尼古丁電子煙）禁止入境；國際交通運輸人員適用不同配額。上述門檻觸發的是同一項申報義務：超過價值限額的商品須按“流通放行”程序申報（多數商品按 25% 增值稅徵收，部分商品另有關稅，主要為服裝和食品）；超過配額的菸酒數量必須申報；需特別許可的商品走紅通道。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時走紅通道。超過價值限額的商品按“流通放行”程序申報，可在過境時走紅區（紅通道）繳納稅款——務必選擇設有海關辦事處的口岸；並非所有口岸在入境挪威前設有辦事處（部分位於瑞典或芬蘭一側，代挪威辦理清關，可在 toll.no 海關辦事處地圖查詢）。超過配額的菸酒數量以及需特別許可的商品（如來自 EEA 以外的肉及乳製品）同樣走紅通道；有疑問時走紅通道詢問挪威海關關員。只有在配額與價值限額內、無需繳稅、非售賣用途（自用或私人饋贈）且由本人隨身攜帶以便在海關查驗點出示的商品，方可走綠通道。如行李延誤稍後到達，必須走紅通道，說明手提行李與其他行李中的物品。可用“挪威海關”應用核對是否超額、計算配額組合並申報商品。不申報入境而被海關查獲的，商品可能被沒收，並可能被以走私報案。

procedures.name_en: Svalbard goods-movement customs control — no customs or import duties in the Svalbard customs territory (Norwegian Customs)
procedures.name_zh: 斯瓦尔巴货物流动海关监管——斯瓦尔巴关境内不征收关税或进口税费（挪威海关）
procedures.agency: Norwegian Customs (Tolletaten)
procedures.applicability_en: Territorial scope: Svalbard only; the page speaks of the 'Svalbard customs territory' and does not extend its statements to Jan Mayen. Per the Norwegian Customs page 'Norwegian Customs in Svalbard' (updated 27.11.2025): at the request of the Ministry of Finance, Norwegian Customs established a physical presence and control of the movement of goods in Svalbard from May 2022, and Customs is able to control the movement of goods to and from Svalbard (to prevent cross-border crime, ensure Norway fulfils its international obligations, and prevent Svalbard being used to circumvent sanctions and export controls). Norwegian Customs currently has a customs office in Longyearbyen city centre handling the control. The page states that no customs or import duties will be imposed on goods imported into the Svalbard customs territory, and that formal obligations involving advance notice, notification and presentation have as of yet not been imposed. Policy is to develop the control further so that it becomes as similar to the control on the mainland as possible, local considerations taken into account, meaning additional obligations will over time apply to goods moving to and from Svalbard. Legal basis cited on the page: Proposition to the Storting 70 L (2021–2022) amending the Customs Act, and the Norwegian Customs allocation letter for 2024 (regjeringen.no links). Boundary notes: the Norwegian Customs Svalbard page publishes no passenger allowance table, cash-declaration threshold or passenger customs declaration form applicable to Svalbard; it does not state that mainland Norway passenger allowances apply in Svalbard, and no allowance amounts for Svalbard are given here. Jan Mayen is not covered by this page.
procedures.applicability_zh: 领土范围：仅斯瓦尔巴；该页面使用“斯瓦尔巴关境”（Svalbard customs territory）表述，且未将其内容延伸至扬马延。据挪威海关《挪威海关在斯瓦尔巴》页（2025-11-27 更新）：应财政部要求，挪威海关自 2022 年 5 月起在斯瓦尔巴设立实体机构并监管货物流动，可对进出斯瓦尔巴的货物实施监管（目的包括防止跨境犯罪、确保挪威履行国际义务、防止斯瓦尔巴被用于规避制裁和出口管制）；海关现已在朗伊尔城市中心设有海关办事处负责监管。页面载明：进口至斯瓦尔巴关境的货物不征收关税或进口税费；涉及事前通知、报备和交验的正式义务目前尚未实施。政策方向是将监管逐步发展到尽可能接近本土水平（考虑当地实际），即进出斯瓦尔巴货物今后将承担更多义务。页面引用的法律依据：第 70 L 号（2021–2022 会期）财政提案（对《海关法》的修正）及 2024 年挪威海关任务委托书（regjeringen.no 链接）。边界说明：挪威海关斯瓦尔巴页面未提供适用于斯瓦尔巴的旅客免税额度表、现金申报门槛或旅客报关单；该页面并未声明挪威本土旅客额度适用于斯瓦尔巴，此处亦不列出斯瓦尔巴的任何额度。扬马延不在该页面覆盖范围内。
procedures.timing_en: Goods movement to and from Svalbard is subject to Norwegian Customs control since May 2022; as of the page updated 27.11.2025 no customs/import duties are levied on goods imported into the Svalbard customs territory and no advance-notice/notification/presentation obligations are imposed yet.
procedures.timing_zh: 自 2022 年 5 月起，进出斯瓦尔巴的货物流动受挪威海关监管；截至页面更新时（2025-11-27），进口至斯瓦尔巴关境的货物不征关税/进口税费，亦未实施事前通知/报备/交验义务。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 斯瓦爾巴貨物流動海關監管——斯瓦爾巴關境內不徵收關稅或進口稅費（挪威海關）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 領土範圍：僅斯瓦爾巴；該頁面使用“斯瓦爾巴關境”（Svalbard customs territory）表述，且未將其內容延伸至揚馬延。據挪威海關《挪威海關在斯瓦爾巴》頁（2025-11-27 更新）：應財政部要求，挪威海關自 2022 年 5 月起在斯瓦爾巴設立實體機構並監管貨物流動，可對進出斯瓦爾巴的貨物實施監管（目的包括防止跨境犯罪、確保挪威履行國際義務、防止斯瓦爾巴被用於規避制裁和出口管制）；海關現已在朗伊爾城市中心設有海關辦事處負責監管。頁面載明：進口至斯瓦爾巴關境的貨物不徵收關稅或進口稅費；涉及事前通知、報備和交驗的正式義務目前尚未實施。政策方向是將監管逐步發展到儘可能接近本土水平（考慮當地實際），即進出斯瓦爾巴貨物今後將承擔更多義務。頁面引用的法律依據：第 70 L 號（2021–2022 會期）財政提案（對《海關法》的修正）及 2024 年挪威海關任務委託書（regjeringen.no 連結）。邊界說明：挪威海關斯瓦爾巴頁面未提供適用於斯瓦爾巴的旅客免稅額度表、現金申報門檻或旅客報關單；該頁面並未聲明挪威本土旅客額度適用於斯瓦爾巴，此處亦不列出斯瓦爾巴的任何額度。揚馬延不在該頁面覆蓋範圍內。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 自 2022 年 5 月起，進出斯瓦爾巴的貨物流動受挪威海關監管；截至頁面更新時（2025-11-27），進口至斯瓦爾巴關境的貨物不徵關稅/進口稅費，亦未實施事前通知/報備/交驗義務。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods beyond duty-free allowances
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报
procedures.agency: Tullverket — Swedish Customs
procedures.applicability_en: Entering Sweden: goods within your duty-free allowances and not subject to special rules go through the green 'Nothing to declare' channel (blue channel for direct EU arrivals with nothing to declare); choosing green or blue while carrying goods in excess of the allowances constitutes smuggling. Arriving from outside the EU, you must proactively declare at the red 'Goods to declare' channel when goods exceed the allowances or are subject to special rules; if unsure, always choose red. General goods value threshold (calculated separately from alcohol/tobacco excise rules, which have their own quotas): from 1 July 2026, per Tullverket TFS 2026:6, SEK 5,000 for air and sea travellers (EUR 430) and SEK 3,500 for other travellers (EUR 300), replacing TFS 2023:6; above the threshold a single item's whole price is taxed, and with multiple items the items that push the total past the threshold are taxed; the charge is customs duty and tax assessed on the goods rather than a fixed declaration fee, and its amount varies with the goods. Tullverket's traveller guidance gives the SEK 5,000 rate for travel 'by air and ferry (in commercial traffic)'; it does not state that private aircraft or pleasure craft qualify, so such travellers should not assume the higher rate. Alcohol, minimum age 20, carried by the traveller for own/family use: from outside the EU duty-free 1 L spirits or 2 L fortified wine (incl. sparkling), plus 4 L wine and 16 L beer (guidance conditions the non-EU allowance for Swedish residents on ≥20 hours abroad or a commercial flight); from inside the EU, 10 L spirits / 20 L fortified wine / 90 L wine (incl. up to 60 L sparkling) / 110 L beer are personal-use assessment reference figures, not automatic hard import maxima. Tobacco and other nicotine products, minimum age 18, own/family use: from outside the EU duty-free 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 g smoking tobacco or 250 g other tobacco, or a proportional combination; Swedish residents abroad less than 20 hours (unless commercial flight per guidance) are limited to 40 cigarettes or 20 cigars/cigarillos or 100 g other tobacco products incl. snus; from inside the EU, 800 cigarettes / 400 cigarillos / 200 cigars / 1 kg smoking tobacco are personal-use assessment references, not automatic hard maxima; e-liquid and other nicotine products from outside the EU instead follow the SEK 5,000 / 3,500 traveller value thresholds.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境瑞典：在免税额度内且不涉特殊规定的货物走绿色“Nothing to declare”通道（自欧盟直接抵达且无申报物走蓝色通道）；携超额货物走绿/蓝通道即构成走私。自欧盟外入境，货物超过免税额度或受特殊规定约束时，必须主动走红“Goods to declare”通道申报；不确定时一律走红通道。普通货物价值免税额（与烟酒消费税规则分开计算，后者另有数量额度）：自 2026 年 7 月 1 日起按 Tullverket TFS 2026:6，航空/海路旅客 SEK 5,000（430 欧元）、其他旅客 SEK 3,500（300 欧元），取代 TFS 2023:6；超额时单件商品按整体价格计税，多件商品则对使总额超过限额的商品计税；该支出为按商品计征的关税与税款，并非固定申报费，金额随商品而异。消费指引将 SEK 5,000 额度表述为适用“乘飞机或渡轮（商业运营）”的旅客，未表明私人飞机/私人游艇适用，此类旅客不应径直套用高档额度。酒精（须满 20 岁，自行携带、自用/家用）：自欧盟外免税额为 1 升烈酒或 2 升加强型葡萄酒（含起泡），另加 4 升葡萄酒与 16 升啤酒（指引对瑞典居民的非欧盟额度附加离境≥20 小时或搭乘商业航班条件）；自欧盟入境 10 升烈酒/20 升加强酒/90 升葡萄酒（含至多 60 升起泡）/110 升啤酒为个人用途评估参考值，非自动硬性进口上限。烟草及含尼古丁产品（须满 18 岁，自用/家用）：自欧盟外免税额为 200 支香烟或 100 支 cigariller 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克烟丝或 250 克其他烟草，可按比例组合；瑞典居民离境不足 20 小时（指引另列商业航班条件）降至 40 支香烟或 20 支雪茄/cigariller 或 100 克其他烟草制品（含口含烟）；自欧盟入境 800 支香烟/400 支 cigariller/200 支雪茄/1 公斤烟丝为个人用途评估参考，非自动硬性上限；自欧盟外携带烟油等尼古丁产品改按旅客价值额度 SEK 5,000/3,500 计算。
procedures.timing_en: At the border: select the red channel marked 'Goods to declare' and present your goods to the customs officer; some goods can be declared online. If there is no surveillance area or no officer present, use the telephone in the red channel (number on its poster) or go to the nearest customs office; on direct Denmark–Sweden trains, seek a uniformed officer or call the Command Centre. If unsure, always choose the red channel.
procedures.timing_zh: 在边境：选择红色“Goods to declare”通道并向海关关员出示货物；部分商品可在线申报。若无监管区或无关员在场，使用红通道内的电话（拨打海报上的号码）或前往最近的海关办事处；丹麦—瑞典直达列车旅客应寻找制服关员或致电指挥中心。不确定时一律走红通道。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境瑞典：在免稅額度內且不涉特殊規定的貨物走綠色“Nothing to declare”通道（自歐盟直接抵達且無申報物走藍色通道）；攜超額貨物走綠/藍通道即構成走私。自歐盟外入境，貨物超過免稅額度或受特殊規定約束時，必須主動走紅“Goods to declare”通道申報；不確定時一律走紅通道。普通貨物價值免稅額（與菸酒消費稅規則分開計算，後者另有數量額度）：自 2026 年 7 月 1 日起按 Tullverket TFS 2026:6，航空/海路旅客 SEK 5,000（430 歐元）、其他旅客 SEK 3,500（300 歐元），取代 TFS 2023:6；超額時單件商品按整體價格計稅，多件商品則對使總額超過限額的商品計稅；該支出為按商品計徵的關稅與稅款，並非固定申報費，金額隨商品而異。消費指引將 SEK 5,000 額度表述為適用“乘飛機或渡輪（商業營運）”的旅客，未表明私人飛機/私人遊艇適用，此類旅客不應徑直套用高檔額度。酒精（須滿 20 歲，自行攜帶、自用/家用）：自歐盟外免稅額為 1 升烈酒或 2 升加強型葡萄酒（含起泡），另加 4 升葡萄酒與 16 升啤酒（指引對瑞典居民的非歐盟額度附加離境≥20 小時或搭乘商業航班條件）；自歐盟入境 10 升烈酒/20 升加強酒/90 升葡萄酒（含至多 60 升起泡）/110 升啤酒為個人用途評估參考值，非自動硬性進口上限。菸草及含尼古丁產品（須滿 18 歲，自用/家用）：自歐盟外免稅額為 200 支香菸或 100 支 cigariller 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克菸絲或 250 克其他菸草，可按比例組合；瑞典居民離境不足 20 小時（指引另列商業航班條件）降至 40 支香菸或 20 支雪茄/cigariller 或 100 克其他菸草製品（含口含煙）；自歐盟入境 800 支香菸/400 支 cigariller/200 支雪茄/1 公斤菸絲為個人用途評估參考，非自動硬性上限；自歐盟外攜帶煙油等尼古丁產品改按旅客價值額度 SEK 5,000/3,500 計算。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在邊境：選擇紅色“Goods to declare”通道並向海關關員出示貨物；部分商品可線上申報。若無監管區或無關員在場，使用紅通道內的電話（撥打海報上的號碼）或前往最近的海關辦事處；丹麥—瑞典直達列車旅客應尋找制服關員或致電指揮中心。不確定時一律走紅通道。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of cash of EUR 10,000 or more when entering or leaving Sweden
procedures.name_zh: 进出瑞典携带现金 1 万欧元及以上申报
procedures.agency: Tullverket (Swedish Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: both. A person carrying cash worth EUR 10,000 or more (or the equivalent in another currency) into or out of Sweden must declare it to Swedish Customs (Tullverket) and make it available for control. Two legal bases cover the two kinds of border. For travel into or out of the EU, Article 3 of Regulation (EU) 2018/1672 sets the duty. For travel between Sweden and another EU country, section 3 a of the Swedish Border Act (inregränslagen, 1996:701, in the version through SFS 2026:415) sets the same threshold and the same duty. Under the Swedish Act, cash means banknotes and coins, bearer negotiable instruments and commodities used as highly liquid stores of value; the EU Regulation also lists prepaid cards. The declaration counts as not made if the information given is incorrect or incomplete or the cash is not made available for control. Cash sent as part of a consignment without a traveller (unaccompanied cash) is a separate matter: Customs may ask the sender or recipient for a disclosure within 30 days, and that is not covered here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：双向。携带价值 1 万欧元及以上（或等值外币）现金进入或离开瑞典的人员，须向瑞典海关（Tullverket）申报，并将现金交由检查。两类边境分别有法律依据：往来欧盟境外，依欧盟第 2018/1672 号条例第 3 条；往来瑞典与其他欧盟国家之间，依瑞典《内部边境法》（inregränslagen，1996:701，含至 SFS 2026:415 的修订）第 3 a 条，门槛和义务相同。按瑞典该法，现金指纸币和硬币、无记名可转让票据以及用作高流动性价值储存的商品；欧盟条例还列入预付卡。若所提供信息不实或不全，或现金未交由检查，不视为已申报。随货物发送、无旅客随行的现金属另一事项：海关可要求发送方或收件方在 30 天内披露，不在此列。
procedures.timing_en: The Swedish Act says to declare immediately (genast) to Tullverket. According to the government bill, the declaration for the EU external border is filed either in the notification service on the Tullverket website or on a special form, which is available on the Tullverket website and at customs lanes and customs offices. The bill does not say which route to use when travelling to or from another EU country.
procedures.timing_zh: 瑞典法规定应立即（genast）向海关申报。据政府议案，对欧盟外部边境的申报，可通过海关网站上的申报服务办理，或使用专用表格；表格可在海关网站、海关通道和海关办事处取得。往来其他欧盟国家时用哪种途径，议案没有说明。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出瑞典攜帶現金 1 萬歐元及以上申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：雙向。攜帶價值 1 萬歐元及以上（或等值外幣）現金進入或離開瑞典的人員，須向瑞典海關（Tullverket）申報，並將現金交由檢查。兩類邊境分別有法律依據：往來歐盟境外，依歐盟第 2018/1672 號條例第 3 條；往來瑞典與其他歐盟國家之間，依瑞典《內部邊境法》（inregränslagen，1996:701，含至 SFS 2026:415 的修訂）第 3 a 條，門檻和義務相同。按瑞典該法，現金指紙幣和硬幣、無記名可轉讓票據以及用作高流動性價值儲存的商品；歐盟條例還列入預付卡。若所提供資訊不實或不全，或現金未交由檢查，不視為已申報。隨貨物發送、無旅客隨行的現金屬另一事項：海關可要求發送方或收件方在 30 天內披露，不在此列。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 瑞典法規定應立即（genast）向海關申報。據政府議案，對歐盟外部邊境的申報，可通過海關網站上的申報服務辦理，或使用專用表格；表格可在海關網站、海關通道和海關辦事處取得。往來其他歐盟國家時用哪種途徑，議案沒有說明。

procedures.name_en: Passenger goods declaration and cash declarations (Great Britain £10,000; Northern Ireland €10,000) — HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客物品申报与现金申报（大不列颠1万英镑；北爱尔兰1万欧元）——英国皇家税务与海关总署（HMRC）
procedures.agency: HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers bringing goods into the UK for personal use. Per HMRC: the goods you can bring without paying UK tax or duty are your ‘personal allowance’; you must declare all commercial goods (no personal allowances for goods to sell or use in business); before crossing the UK border you must declare goods where you go over your allowances, and goods that are banned or restricted; if you go over an allowance you pay tax and duty on all the goods in that category; goods can be declared online from 5 days (120 hours) before arrival; goods and vehicles may be seized, and travellers fined or prosecuted for breaking the rules. Allowance rules differ depending on whether you arrive in Great Britain or Northern Ireland. Personal allowance amounts (captured for travellers to Great Britain (England, Wales or Scotland) from outside the UK; you must transport the goods yourself and use them yourself or give them away as gifts): alcohol — you can bring in both beer 42 litres and still wine 18 litres, plus either 4 litres of spirits and other liquors over 22% alcohol or 9 litres of other alcoholic drinks up to 22% alcohol (not including beer or still wine, e.g. sparkling wine, fortified wine, cider), and this either/or allowance can be split between the two; tobacco — one of 200 cigarettes, 100 cigarillos, 50 cigars, 250g tobacco or 200 sticks of tobacco for electronic heated tobacco devices, and this allowance can be split; there is no alcohol or tobacco allowance if you are under 17 (you can still bring alcohol and tobacco for your own use but you must declare it and pay tax and duty on the full amount); other goods up to £390, or up to £270 if you arrive by private plane or boat. You cannot combine your personal allowance with anyone else’s. These amounts are tax-free allowances, not a stand-alone declaration duty: a duty to declare arises only for commercial goods, goods over your allowances (tax and duty then apply to all the goods in that category — for other goods, to the total value of the goods, not just the value above the allowance) and banned or restricted goods. The amounts above are captured for arrivals in Great Britain from outside the UK only and must not be applied to Northern Ireland. Northern Ireland (Arriving in Northern Ireland page; the rules and allowances depend on whether you are travelling from the EU or another country). Arriving in Northern Ireland from the EU: you do not need to declare or pay tax or duty on any goods you bring into Northern Ireland from the EU as long as you transport them yourself, will use them yourself or give them away as a gift, and have paid tax and duty in the country where you bought them; these rules are the same as before 1 January 2021; if you are bringing in goods from the Canary Islands, the north of Cyprus, Gibraltar or the Channel Islands you must follow the rules for countries outside the EU. If a customs officer thinks you may be bringing in goods to sell, they may check your goods and ask questions to find out if the goods are for personal use. Although there are no limits to the alcohol and tobacco you can bring in from EU countries, you are more likely to be asked questions if you have more than the following indicative amounts, which are questioning guidance only — not legal allowances and not by themselves a duty to declare: cigarettes 800, cigars 200, cigarillos 400, tobacco 1kg, 800 sticks of tobacco for electronic heated tobacco devices, beer 110 litres, wine 90 litres, spirits 10 litres, fortified wine (for example sherry, port) 20 litres. Arriving in Northern Ireland from outside the EU (you must transport the goods yourself and use them yourself or give them away as a gift; you cannot combine your personal allowance with anyone else’s): alcohol — you can bring in both beer 16 litres and still wine 4 litres, plus either 1 litre of spirits and other liquors over 22% alcohol or 2 litres of other alcoholic drinks up to 22% alcohol (not including beer or still wine, e.g. sparkling wine, fortified wine, cider), and this either/or allowance can be split; tobacco — one of 200 cigarettes, 100 cigarillos, 50 cigars, 250g tobacco or 200 sticks of tobacco for electronic heated tobacco devices, and this allowance can be split; there is no alcohol or tobacco allowance if you are under 17 (you can still bring alcohol and tobacco for your own use, but you must pay tax and duty on them before you arrive in the UK); other goods up to £390, or up to £270 if you arrive by private plane or boat. If you go over your allowances you must declare all your goods and pay tax and duty on all the goods in that category, and for other goods you pay tax and duty on the total value of the goods, not just the value above your allowance; you may also have to pay customs duty if you exceed your allowance, and import VAT may apply on the total value of the goods plus duty at the current UK VAT rate; your goods could be seized if you do not declare them. Travelling from Great Britain to Northern Ireland is governed by separate rules and the arrival allowances above must not be applied mechanically to that route: you do not need to declare your goods if both of the following apply — you are a UK resident, and you have already paid both VAT and excise duty (alcohol and tobacco only) on the goods in Great Britain; you may need to declare your goods if you are not a UK resident, if you are taking in alcohol or tobacco over your allowances for Northern Ireland on which excise duty has not been paid in Great Britain, or if you are taking in goods worth more than £390 and you have not paid VAT on them in Great Britain. If you are taking a vehicle into Northern Ireland from Great Britain you will need to declare the vehicle if all of the following apply: you are taking it to Northern Ireland permanently (for example, you live there and you are taking the vehicle back with you); you bought it in Great Britain for your own personal use or to give as a gift; the value of the vehicle, together with any other goods you are bringing in, exceeds £390; it is already registered with DVLA; and you have not paid VAT on it in Great Britain (for example, you bought the vehicle from a person or dealer not registered for VAT). Travelling from Northern Ireland to Great Britain (England, Wales or Scotland) you do not have to declare any goods, but you will need to pay Import VAT on any goods you buy in Northern Ireland from shops that offer tax-free shopping under the VAT Retail Export Scheme. Cash: separately, you must declare cash of £10,000 or more to UK customs when carrying it between Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) and a country outside the UK; for families/groups the £10,000 is aggregated even if individuals carry less; the earliest you can make a declaration is 72 hours before you plan to travel (this timing line sits in the page's Great Britain section). Cash (Northern Ireland, per the same page's Taking cash in and out of Northern Ireland section): you must declare cash of €10,000 or more if you carry it between Northern Ireland and any non-EU country (either direction); you must also declare cash of €10,000 or more if you're arriving in Northern Ireland from Great Britain, while you do not need to declare any amount of cash when travelling the other way, from Northern Ireland to Great Britain; the Great Britain section of the page adds that if you're travelling to Northern Ireland and carrying €10,000 or more (or equivalent) you must follow the rules for taking cash into Northern Ireland; for families/groups under the Northern Ireland rules, €10,000 or more in total still requires a declaration even if individuals carry less; customs authorities may ask you to fill in a cash disclosure form if you send cash by freight, post or parcel between Northern Ireland and any non-EU country — this includes if you send cash from Great Britain to Northern Ireland. Types of cash (same page): you must declare notes and coins, bearer bonds, travellers' cheques, and cheques (including travellers' cheques) that are signed but not made out to a person or organisation; if you are carrying cash in or out of Northern Ireland you must also declare money orders, gold coins, bullion or nuggets, and prepaid cards. Method (page-level How to declare cash section): if you're leaving the UK you must declare cash before you go; if you're coming to the UK you must declare either before you travel or at customs when you arrive (follow 'goods to declare' or 'red channel' signs); you can declare online or by phone and will get a reference number — the online service covers cash you're carrying into or out of Great Britain and cash you're carrying into or out of Northern Ireland, the latter including cash carried from Great Britain into Northern Ireland; if you cannot use the online service you can phone the Customs and International Trade Helpline on 0300 322 9434 (24-hour service). Penalties (page-level): if you do not declare cash that you should have, all the cash you are carrying can be seized by a Border Force officer and you may have to pay a penalty of up to £5,000 to get it back; any cash can be seized if customs authorities have reasonable grounds to suspect a crime and kept for 48 hours, after which they need a court order. Boundary notes: the Northern Ireland obligation runs to any non-EU country, not to a country outside the UK as the Great Britain obligation does; the page does not address cash carried between Northern Ireland and EU countries (for example Ireland), and the 72-hours earliest-declaration window it gives is stated for Great Britain only, not separately for Northern Ireland.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：携物品进入英国的个人自用旅客。据 HMRC：可免税携入的物品即“个人额度”；所有商业物品必须申报（销售或营业用物品无个人额度）；过境前须申报超出额度以及禁限物品；超出额度须按该类全部物品缴税；可在抵达前 5 天（120 小时）在线申报；违规可致物品/车辆没收并罚款或起诉。额度规则因抵达大不列颠或北爱尔兰而不同。个人额度金额（仅针对从英国以外前往大不列颠（英格兰、威尔士或苏格兰）的旅客采集；须本人运送物品，且自用或作为礼物赠送）：酒类——可同时携带啤酒 42 升和静止葡萄酒 18 升，另可携带以下两者之一：超过 22% 酒精的烈酒及其他酒类 4 升，或 22% 及以下酒精的其他酒类（不含啤酒和静止葡萄酒，如起泡酒、加强酒、苹果酒）9 升，该项“二选一”额度可在两类之间拆分；烟草——以下之一：200 支香烟、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄、250 克烟草或 200 支电子加热烟草设备用烟草棒，该额度可拆分；未满 17 岁无烟酒额度（仍可为自用携入，但须申报并按全额缴税）；其他物品不超过 390 英镑，乘私人飞机或游船抵达则不超过 270 英镑。个人额度不可与他人合并。上述金额只是免税额度，本身并非独立的申报义务；申报义务仅产生于：商业物品、超出额度的物品（届时须按该类全部物品缴税——其他物品按物品总价值计，而不仅是超出部分）以及禁限物品。以上额度金额仅针对从英国以外抵达大不列颠的情形采集，不得适用于北爱尔兰。北爱尔兰（“抵达北爱尔兰”页；规则与额度取决于旅客来自欧盟还是其他国家）。从欧盟抵达北爱尔兰：只要本人运送、自用或作为礼物赠送、且已在购买国缴纳税款和关税，从欧盟携入北爱尔兰的任何货物均无需申报、无需缴纳英国税款或关税；该部分规则与 2021 年 1 月 1 日之前相同；来自加那利群岛、塞浦路斯北部、直布罗陀或海峡群岛的货物须按欧盟以外国家的规则办理。海关官员如认为旅客可能携带货物前来出售，可查验货物并提问以判断是否自用。从欧盟国家携入的酒类和烟草没有数量上限，但超过下列指示性数量时更可能被问询；该数量仅为问询指引，不是法定额度，本身亦不构成申报义务：香烟 800 支、雪茄 200 支、小雪茄 400 支、烟草 1 公斤、电子加热烟草设备用烟草棒 800 支、啤酒 110 升、葡萄酒 90 升、烈酒 10 升、加强酒（例如雪莉酒、波特酒）20 升。从欧盟以外抵达北爱尔兰（须本人运送物品，且自用或作为礼物赠送；个人额度不可与他人合并）：酒类——可同时携带啤酒 16 升和静止葡萄酒 4 升，另可携带以下两者之一：超过 22% 酒精的烈酒及其他酒类 1 升，或 22% 及以下酒精的其他酒类（不含啤酒和静止葡萄酒，如起泡酒、加强酒、苹果酒）2 升，该项“二选一”额度可在两类之间拆分；烟草——以下之一：200 支香烟、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄、250 克烟草或 200 支电子加热烟草设备用烟草棒，该额度可拆分；未满 17 岁无烟酒额度（仍可为自用携入，但须在抵达英国前就该等物品缴纳税款和关税）；其他物品不超过 390 英镑，乘私人飞机或游船抵达则不超过 270 英镑。超出额度须申报全部物品并按该类全部物品缴纳税款和关税，其他物品按物品总价值计征而不仅是超出部分；超额还可能须缴关税，进口增值税可能按物品总价值加关税、以现行英国增值税税率计征；未申报超额物品可被没收。从大不列颠前往北爱尔兰适用单独规则，不得将上述抵达额度机械套用于该路线：同时满足以下两项则无需申报——旅客为英国居民；已在大不列颠就物品缴纳增值税及消费税（仅限酒类和烟草）。出现下列情形可能需要申报：非英国居民；携入超过北爱尔兰额度的酒类或烟草且未在大不列颠缴纳消费税；携入价值超过 390 英镑的物品且未在大不列颠缴纳增值税。将车辆从大不列颠携入北爱尔兰，若下列条件全部满足则须申报该车辆：永久携入北爱尔兰（例如在当地居住并将车辆带回）；在大不列颠购买用于自用或作为礼物赠送；车辆价值连同其他携入物品合计超过 390 英镑；已在 DVLA 登记；未在大不列颠缴纳增值税（例如从不在增值税登记范围内的个人或经销商处购买）。从北爱尔兰前往大不列颠（英格兰、威尔士或苏格兰）无需申报任何货物，但在北爱尔兰提供免税购物的商店（增值税零售出口计划 VAT Retail Export Scheme 项下）所购货物须缴纳进口增值税。现金：另据规定，携带 **10,000 英镑或以上**现金往返大不列颠（英格兰、苏格兰、威尔士）与英国以外国家时须向海关申报；家庭/团体合计达 10,000 英镑即须申报（即使个人携带不足）；申报最早可于计划出行前 72 小时办理（该时限句位于页面大不列颠段内）。现金（北爱尔兰，依同一官页“Taking cash in and out of Northern Ireland”段）：在北爱尔兰与任何非欧盟国家之间携带 10,000 欧元或以上现金须申报（双向）；从大不列颠抵达北爱尔兰时携带 10,000 欧元或以上亦须申报，反方向从北爱尔兰前往大不列颠则任何金额均无需申报；页面大不列颠段另载明：前往北爱尔兰且携带 10,000 欧元或以上（或等值）现金时，须遵循将现金携入北爱尔兰的规则；按北爱尔兰规则出行的家庭/团体合计达 10,000 欧元即须申报（即使个人携带不足）；通过货运、邮寄或包裹在北爱尔兰与任何非欧盟国家之间寄送现金时，海关当局可要求填写现金披露表——包括从大不列颠寄往北爱尔兰的情形。须申报的现金类型（同一页面）：纸币与硬币、不记名债券、旅行支票、已签署但未填具收款人（个人或机构）的支票（含旅行支票）；携现金进出北爱尔兰时还须申报：汇票、金币/金条/天然金块、预付卡。申报方式（页面级“How to declare cash”段）：离开英国须在出行前申报现金；前来英国须在出行前或抵达时在海关申报（按“goods to declare”或红色通道指示）；可在线或电话申报并获参考号——在线服务覆盖携入/携出大不列颠与携入/携出北爱尔兰的现金，后者包括从大不列颠携入北爱尔兰；无法在线办理时可致电海关与国际贸易热线 0300 322 9434（24 小时服务）。处罚（页面级）：未申报应报现金的，所携全部现金可被边境执法官员扣押，且可能须缴最高 5,000 英镑罚款方可取回；海关当局如有合理根据怀疑犯罪，可扣押任何现金并扣留 48 小时，其后须有法院命令。边界说明：北爱尔兰申报义务的边界为“任何非欧盟国家”，不同于大不列颠条文的“英国以外国家”；页面未述北爱尔兰与欧盟国家（例如爱尔兰）之间的现金携带，其给出的 72 小时最早申报时限也仅就大不列颠载明，未就北爱尔兰单独载明。
procedures.timing_en: Goods: declare online from 120 hours before arrival and at the UK border. Cash (Great Britain): declare on entry to or exit from Great Britain when carrying £10,000 or more; the earliest you can make a declaration is 72 hours before you plan to travel (this line sits in the page's Great Britain section). Cash (Northern Ireland): declare €10,000 or more when carrying it between Northern Ireland and any non-EU country and when arriving in Northern Ireland from Great Britain — if leaving the UK, declare before you go; if coming to the UK, declare before you travel or at customs when you arrive; no declaration is required when travelling from Northern Ireland to Great Britain; the page states no separate earliest-declaration window for Northern Ireland. Northern Ireland, travelling from outside the EU: if you go over your allowances you must declare your goods online before you travel or at the border when you arrive, and if you are under 17 you must pay tax and duty on alcohol and tobacco before you arrive in the UK.
procedures.timing_zh: 物品：抵达前 120 小时内可在线申报，并在边境办理。现金（大不列颠）：进出大不列颠携带 10,000 英镑或以上现金时申报；申报最早可于计划出行前 72 小时办理（该时限句位于页面大不列颠段内）。现金（北爱尔兰）：在北爱尔兰与任何非欧盟国家之间携带 10,000 欧元或以上、以及从大不列颠抵达北爱尔兰携带 10,000 欧元或以上时申报——离开英国须在出行前申报，前来英国须在出行前或抵达时在海关申报；从北爱尔兰前往大不列颠无需申报任何金额；官页未给北爱尔兰申报单独的最早时点。北爱尔兰（从欧盟以外抵达）：超出额度时须在出行前在线申报物品或抵达时在边境申报；未满 17 岁携入烟酒须在抵达英国前缴纳税款和关税。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客物品申報與現金申報（大不列顛1萬英鎊；北愛爾蘭1萬歐元）——英國皇家稅務與海關總署（HMRC）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：攜物品進入英國的個人自用旅客。據 HMRC：可免稅攜入的物品即“個人額度”；所有商業物品必須申報（銷售或營業用物品無個人額度）；過境前須申報超出額度以及禁限物品；超出額度須按該類全部物品繳稅；可在抵達前 5 天（120 小時）線上申報；違規可致物品/車輛沒收並罰款或起訴。額度規則因抵達大不列顛或北愛爾蘭而不同。個人額度金額（僅針對從英國以外前往大不列顛（英格蘭、威爾士或蘇格蘭）的旅客採集；須本人運送物品，且自用或作為禮物贈送）：酒類——可同時攜帶啤酒 42 升和靜止葡萄酒 18 升，另可攜帶以下兩者之一：超過 22% 酒精的烈酒及其他酒類 4 升，或 22% 及以下酒精的其他酒類（不含啤酒和靜止葡萄酒，如起泡酒、加強酒、蘋果酒）9 升，該項“二選一”額度可在兩類之間拆分；菸草——以下之一：200 支香菸、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄、250 克菸草或 200 支電子加熱菸草設備用菸草棒，該額度可拆分；未滿 17 歲無煙酒額度（仍可為自用攜入，但須申報並按全額繳稅）；其他物品不超過 390 英鎊，乘私人飛機或遊船抵達則不超過 270 英鎊。個人額度不可與他人合併。上述金額只是免稅額度，本身並非獨立的申報義務；申報義務僅產生於：商業物品、超出額度的物品（屆時須按該類全部物品繳稅——其他物品按物品總價值計，而不僅是超出部分）以及禁限物品。以上額度金額僅針對從英國以外抵達大不列顛的情形採集，不得適用於北愛爾蘭。北愛爾蘭（“抵達北愛爾蘭”頁；規則與額度取決於旅客來自歐盟還是其他國家）。從歐盟抵達北愛爾蘭：只要本人運送、自用或作為禮物贈送、且已在購買國繳納稅款和關稅，從歐盟攜入北愛爾蘭的任何貨物均無需申報、無需繳納英國稅款或關稅；該部分規則與 2021 年 1 月 1 日之前相同；來自加那利群島、塞浦路斯北部、直布羅陀或海峽群島的貨物須按歐盟以外國家的規則辦理。海關官員如認為旅客可能攜帶貨物前來出售，可查驗貨物並提問以判斷是否自用。從歐盟國家攜入的酒類和菸草沒有數量上限，但超過下列指示性數量時更可能被問詢；該數量僅為問詢指引，不是法定額度，本身亦不構成申報義務：香菸 800 支、雪茄 200 支、小雪茄 400 支、菸草 1 公斤、電子加熱菸草設備用菸草棒 800 支、啤酒 110 升、葡萄酒 90 升、烈酒 10 升、加強酒（例如雪莉酒、波特酒）20 升。從歐盟以外抵達北愛爾蘭（須本人運送物品，且自用或作為禮物贈送；個人額度不可與他人合併）：酒類——可同時攜帶啤酒 16 升和靜止葡萄酒 4 升，另可攜帶以下兩者之一：超過 22% 酒精的烈酒及其他酒類 1 升，或 22% 及以下酒精的其他酒類（不含啤酒和靜止葡萄酒，如起泡酒、加強酒、蘋果酒）2 升，該項“二選一”額度可在兩類之間拆分；菸草——以下之一：200 支香菸、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄、250 克菸草或 200 支電子加熱菸草設備用菸草棒，該額度可拆分；未滿 17 歲無煙酒額度（仍可為自用攜入，但須在抵達英國前就該等物品繳納稅款和關稅）；其他物品不超過 390 英鎊，乘私人飛機或遊船抵達則不超過 270 英鎊。超出額度須申報全部物品並按該類全部物品繳納稅款和關稅，其他物品按物品總價值計徵而不僅是超出部分；超額還可能須繳關稅，進口增值稅可能按物品總價值加關稅、以現行英國增值稅稅率計徵；未申報超額物品可被沒收。從大不列顛前往北愛爾蘭適用單獨規則，不得將上述抵達額度機械套用於該路線：同時滿足以下兩項則無需申報——旅客為英國居民；已在大不列顛就物品繳納增值稅及消費稅（僅限酒類和菸草）。出現下列情形可能需要申報：非英國居民；攜入超過北愛爾蘭額度的酒類或菸草且未在大不列顛繳納消費稅；攜入價值超過 390 英鎊的物品且未在大不列顛繳納增值稅。將車輛從大不列顛攜入北愛爾蘭，若下列條件全部滿足則須申報該車輛：永久攜入北愛爾蘭（例如在當地居住並將車輛帶回）；在大不列顛購買用於自用或作為禮物贈送；車輛價值連同其他攜入物品合計超過 390 英鎊；已在 DVLA 登記；未在大不列顛繳納增值稅（例如從不在增值稅登記範圍內的個人或經銷商處購買）。從北愛爾蘭前往大不列顛（英格蘭、威爾士或蘇格蘭）無需申報任何貨物，但在北愛爾蘭提供免稅購物的商店（增值稅零售出口計劃 VAT Retail Export Scheme 項下）所購貨物須繳納進口增值稅。現金：另據規定，攜帶 **10,000 英鎊或以上**現金往返大不列顛（英格蘭、蘇格蘭、威爾士）與英國以外國家時須向海關申報；家庭/團體合計達 10,000 英鎊即須申報（即使個人攜帶不足）；申報最早可於計劃出行前 72 小時辦理（該時限句位於頁面大不列顛段內）。現金（北愛爾蘭，依同一官頁“Taking cash in and out of Northern Ireland”段）：在北愛爾蘭與任何非歐盟國家之間攜帶 10,000 歐元或以上現金須申報（雙向）；從大不列顛抵達北愛爾蘭時攜帶 10,000 歐元或以上亦須申報，反方向從北愛爾蘭前往大不列顛則任何金額均無需申報；頁面大不列顛段另載明：前往北愛爾蘭且攜帶 10,000 歐元或以上（或等值）現金時，須遵循將現金攜入北愛爾蘭的規則；按北愛爾蘭規則出行的家庭/團體合計達 10,000 歐元即須申報（即使個人攜帶不足）；通過貨運、郵寄或包裹在北愛爾蘭與任何非歐盟國家之間寄送現金時，海關當局可要求填寫現金披露表——包括從大不列顛寄往北愛爾蘭的情形。須申報的現金類型（同一頁面）：紙幣與硬幣、不記名債券、旅行支票、已簽署但未填具收款人（個人或機構）的支票（含旅行支票）；攜現金進出北愛爾蘭時還須申報：匯票、金幣/金條/天然金塊、預付卡。申報方式（頁面級“How to declare cash”段）：離開英國須在出行前申報現金；前來英國須在出行前或抵達時在海關申報（按“goods to declare”或紅色通道指示）；可線上或電話申報並獲參考號——線上服務覆蓋攜入/攜出大不列顛與攜入/攜出北愛爾蘭的現金，後者包括從大不列顛攜入北愛爾蘭；無法線上辦理時可致電海關與國際貿易熱線 0300 322 9434（24 小時服務）。處罰（頁面級）：未申報應報現金的，所攜全部現金可被邊境執法官員扣押，且可能須繳最高 5,000 英鎊罰款方可取回；海關當局如有合理根據懷疑犯罪，可扣押任何現金並扣留 48 小時，其後須有法院命令。邊界說明：北愛爾蘭申報義務的邊界為“任何非歐盟國家”，不同於大不列顛條文的“英國以外國家”；頁面未述北愛爾蘭與歐盟國家（例如愛爾蘭）之間的現金攜帶，其給出的 72 小時最早申報時限也僅就大不列顛載明，未就北愛爾蘭單獨載明。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 物品：抵達前 120 小時內可線上申報，並在邊境辦理。現金（大不列顛）：進出大不列顛攜帶 10,000 英鎊或以上現金時申報；申報最早可於計劃出行前 72 小時辦理（該時限句位於頁面大不列顛段內）。現金（北愛爾蘭）：在北愛爾蘭與任何非歐盟國家之間攜帶 10,000 歐元或以上、以及從大不列顛抵達北愛爾蘭攜帶 10,000 歐元或以上時申報——離開英國須在出行前申報，前來英國須在出行前或抵達時在海關申報；從北愛爾蘭前往大不列顛無需申報任何金額；官頁未給北愛爾蘭申報單獨的最早時點。北愛爾蘭（從歐盟以外抵達）：超出額度時須在出行前線上申報物品或抵達時在邊境申報；未滿 17 歲攜入菸酒須在抵達英國前繳納稅款和關稅。

procedures.name_en: Leaving the UK with £10,000 or more in cash (Northern Ireland: €10,000) — declare online or by phone before you go
procedures.name_zh: 携带1万英镑或以上现金离开英国（北爱尔兰为1万欧元）——出发前在线或电话申报
procedures.agency: HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC) and Border Force
procedures.applicability_en: You must declare cash of £10,000 or more to UK customs if you carry it between Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) and a country outside the UK. For Northern Ireland the threshold is €10,000 or more, for travel between Northern Ireland and any non-EU country; no declaration is needed for any amount when travelling from Northern Ireland to Great Britain. A family or group carrying the threshold amount in total must declare, even if each person carries less. Cash includes notes and coins, bearer bonds, travellers' cheques, and cheques that are signed but not made out to a person or organisation; for Northern Ireland it also includes money orders, gold coins, bullion or nuggets, and prepaid cards. If you are leaving the UK, you must declare before you go, online or by phone (Customs and International Trade Helpline, 0300 322 9434). You get a reference number that you may need to show at customs. If you do not declare cash you should have, all of it can be seized, and you may have to pay a penalty of up to £5,000 to get it back.
procedures.applicability_zh: 在大不列颠（英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士）与英国以外国家之间携带1万英镑或以上现金的，必须向英国海关申报。北爱尔兰的门槛是1万欧元或以上，适用于北爱尔兰与任何非欧盟国家之间的往来；从北爱尔兰前往大不列颠，任何金额都无需申报。家庭或团体合计达到门槛的，即使每人携带的金额都低于门槛，也必须申报。现金包括纸币和硬币、不记名债券、旅行支票，以及已签名但未写明收款人或机构的支票；进出北爱尔兰的还包括汇票、金币、金条或金块以及预付卡。离开英国的，必须在出发前申报，可在线申报或拨打海关与国际贸易咨询热线0300 322 9434。申报后会得到一个参考编号，海关可能要求出示。应申报而未申报的现金可能被全部扣押，取回时可能需缴纳最高5,000英镑的罚款。
procedures.timing_en: Before you leave the UK. For Great Britain, the earliest you can make a declaration is 72 hours before you plan to travel.
procedures.timing_zh: 离开英国之前。大不列颠方向最早可在计划出行前72小时申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 攜帶1萬英鎊或以上現金離開英國（北愛爾蘭為1萬歐元）——出發前線上或電話申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 在大不列顛（英格蘭、蘇格蘭和威爾士）與英國以外國家之間攜帶1萬英鎊或以上現金的，必須向英國海關申報。北愛爾蘭的門檻是1萬歐元或以上，適用於北愛爾蘭與任何非歐盟國家之間的往來；從北愛爾蘭前往大不列顛，任何金額都無需申報。家庭或團體合計達到門檻的，即使每人攜帶的金額都低於門檻，也必須申報。現金包括紙幣和硬幣、不記名債券、旅行支票，以及已簽名但未寫明收款人或機構的支票；進出北愛爾蘭的還包括匯票、金幣、金條或金塊以及預付卡。離開英國的，必須在出發前申報，可線上申報或撥打海關與國際貿易諮詢熱線0300 322 9434。申報後會得到一個參考編號，海關可能要求出示。應申報而未申報的現金可能被全部扣押，取回時可能需繳納最高5,000英鎊的罰款。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 離開英國之前。大不列顛方向最早可在計劃出行前72小時申報。

procedures.name_en: Traveller goods declaration — duty-free value threshold, tobacco/alcohol/coffee quantities, simplified declaration for excess — Albanian Customs
procedures.name_zh: 旅客物品申报——免税价值门槛、烟酒咖啡自用数量与超额简化申报——阿尔巴尼亚海关
procedures.agency: Drejtoria e Përgjithshme e Doganave (General Directorate of Customs), Republic of Albania
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: the duty-free exemption applies to travellers arriving in the Republic of Albania from another country, while the declaration duty applies both on entry into and on exit from the Republic of Albania. Per the Albanian Customs traveller pages (dogana.gov.al) captured live on 2026-09-27. Travellers coming from another country to the Republic of Albania are exempted from import duties for the goods found in their personal baggage; goods qualify if, by their kind and quantity, they are not intended for trade (travellers' personal-use goods or gifts). Exempted value (not including tobacco and alcohol products; applied at the equivalent value in lekë): land route EUR 300 per traveller; air or sea route EUR 430 per traveller; travellers under 15 years EUR 150. During entry into or exit from the Republic of Albania the traveller must declare goods whose value is higher than the respective threshold above, as well as goods intended for commercial purposes; customs authorities may require the traveller to show all goods transported. For non-commercial goods in travellers' baggage that exceed the duty-free threshold from import customs duties, the customs declaration is carried out through the simplified declaration procedure (page's supporting documents: Customs Code articles 44-71 and 152-154; Instruction No. 01 dated 07.03.2017 on the simplified declaration of travellers' goods; simplified-declaration user manual). Personal-consumption quantities exempt from payment on import, per the tobacco/alcohol/coffee page — travellers under 17 years of age receive no exemption for tobacco and alcohol products: a) tobacco products for personal consumption, quantities: 200 cigarettes; 100 cigarillos; 50 cigars; 250 grams of tobacco; b) alcohol and alcoholic beverages for personal consumption, quantities: 1 litre of alcohol and alcoholic beverages with an alcoholic strength higher than 22% by volume, or undenatured ethyl alcohol of 80% by volume and above; or 2 litres of alcohol and distilled beverages with an alcoholic strength not exceeding 22% by volume (the page states that each quantity specified under letters 'a' and 'b' constitutes 100% of the total exemption for alcohol products and alcoholic beverages, and that for one traveller the exemption may apply to any combination provided the total quantity (percentage) used does not exceed 100%); in addition, 2 litres of non-sparkling wine and 10 litres of beer; c) coffee for personal consumption, quantity: 3 kg. Distinct exit regime, not part of the above entry allowances: excise goods handled by 'Duty free shops' (goods sold on board an aircraft during an international journey are also considered duty-free-shop goods) and taken into personal baggage by travellers leaving Albanian territory by air or sea are exempted from excise payment. Currency corroboration: a customs news item published 17.07.2025 republishes the same thresholds, personal-use quantities, the under-17 exclusion and the simplified-declaration warning; no claim is made beyond the official page text (the underlying statutes are cited only as the page itself lists them).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：免税待遇适用于自另一国抵达阿尔巴尼亚共和国的旅客；申报义务在进入或离开阿尔巴尼亚共和国时均适用。依据 2026-09-27 实时取得的阿尔巴尼亚海关旅客栏目页（dogana.gov.al）。自另一国来阿尔巴尼亚共和国的旅客，其个人行李中的物品免征进口税费；物品须按种类和数量非供贸易用途（旅客自用品或礼品）方可豁免。免税价值（不含烟草和酒精制品，按列克等值计算）：陆路旅客每人 300 欧元；航空或海路旅客每人 430 欧元；15 岁以下旅客 150 欧元。进入或离开阿尔巴尼亚共和国时，旅客须申报价值超过上述相应门槛的物品以及供商业用途的物品；海关当局可要求旅客出示其运输的全部物品。对旅客行李中超过进口海关免税门槛的非商业性质物品，通过简化申报程序（Deklarimi i thjeshtuar）办理海关申报（页面附支撑文件：海关法典第 44-71 条、第 152-154 条；2017 年 3 月 7 日第 01 号关于旅客物品简化申报的指令；简化申报使用手册）。个人消费数量免征进口环节支付（据烟、酒、咖啡专页）——未满 17 周岁旅客不享受烟草和酒精制品豁免：a) 个人消费烟草制品，数量为：卷烟 200 支；小雪茄（cigarillo）100 支；雪茄 50 支；烟草 250 克；b) 个人消费酒精及酒精饮料，数量为：酒精浓度高于 22%（体积比）的酒精及酒精饮料 1 升，或浓度 80%（体积比）及以上的未变性乙醇；或浓度不超过 22%（体积比）的酒精及蒸馏饮料 2 升（页面载明 a、b 两项所列数量各构成酒精及酒精饮料豁免总额的 100%，且对同一名旅客可适用任意组合，条件是其使用的总量（百分比）不超过 100%）；此外另有无气泡葡萄酒 2 升和啤酒 10 升；c) 个人消费咖啡，数量为：3 公斤。另列出境制度，不属于上述入境额度：由 “Duty free shops” 经手的应征消费税商品（国际航程中在飞机上销售的商品亦视为免税店商品），由乘航空或海路离开阿尔巴尼亚领土的旅客携入个人行李的，免缴消费税。时效佐证：海关 2025 年 7 月 17 日发布的新闻重申同样的门槛、自用数量、未满 17 周岁排除及简化申报警示；以上仅引用海关页面原文所列法条，未在该范围之外另作断言。
procedures.timing_en: On entering or leaving the Republic of Albania, at the border crossing point: declare there goods whose value exceeds the applicable threshold (EUR 300 land / EUR 430 air or sea / EUR 150 under 15; tobacco and alcohol follow the quantity quotas instead of the value threshold) and goods intended for commercial purposes; above-threshold non-commercial goods are covered by a customs declaration through the simplified declaration procedure.
procedures.timing_zh: 在进入或离开阿尔巴尼亚共和国时，于边境检查站办理：价值超过适用门槛（陆路 300 欧元／空、海路 430 欧元／15 岁以下 150 欧元；烟酒适用数量限额而非价值门槛）或属商业用途的物品须当场申报；超出门槛的非商业物品通过简化申报程序（Deklarimi i thjeshtuar）办理海关申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客物品申報——免稅價值門檻、菸酒咖啡自用數量與超額簡化申報——阿爾巴尼亞海關
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：免稅待遇適用於自另一國抵達阿爾巴尼亞共和國的旅客；申報義務在進入或離開阿爾巴尼亞共和國時均適用。依據 2026-09-27 實時取得的阿爾巴尼亞海關旅客欄目頁（dogana.gov.al）。自另一國來阿爾巴尼亞共和國的旅客，其個人行李中的物品免徵進口稅費；物品須按種類和數量非供貿易用途（旅客自用品或禮品）方可豁免。免稅價值（不含菸草和酒精製品，按列克等值計算）：陸路旅客每人 300 歐元；航空或海路旅客每人 430 歐元；15 歲以下旅客 150 歐元。進入或離開阿爾巴尼亞共和國時，旅客須申報價值超過上述相應門檻的物品以及供商業用途的物品；海關當局可要求旅客出示其運輸的全部物品。對旅客行李中超過進口海關免稅門檻的非商業性質物品，通過簡化申報程序（Deklarimi i thjeshtuar）辦理海關申報（頁面附支撐文件：海關法典第 44-71 條、第 152-154 條；2017 年 3 月 7 日第 01 號關於旅客物品簡化申報的指令；簡化申報使用手冊）。個人消費數量免徵進口環節支付（據煙、酒、咖啡專頁）——未滿 17 週歲旅客不享受菸草和酒精製品豁免：a) 個人消費菸草製品，數量為：捲菸 200 支；小雪茄（cigarillo）100 支；雪茄 50 支；菸草 250 克；b) 個人消費酒精及酒精飲料，數量為：酒精濃度高於 22%（體積比）的酒精及酒精飲料 1 升，或濃度 80%（體積比）及以上的未變性乙醇；或濃度不超過 22%（體積比）的酒精及蒸餾飲料 2 升（頁面載明 a、b 兩項所列數量各構成酒精及酒精飲料豁免總額的 100%，且對同一名旅客可適用任意組合，條件是其使用的總量（百分比）不超過 100%）；此外另有無氣泡葡萄酒 2 升和啤酒 10 升；c) 個人消費咖啡，數量為：3 公斤。另列出境制度，不屬於上述入境額度：由 “Duty free shops” 經手的應徵消費稅商品（國際航程中在飛機上銷售的商品亦視為免稅店商品），由乘航空或海路離開阿爾巴尼亞領土的旅客攜入個人行李的，免繳消費稅。時效佐證：海關 2025 年 7 月 17 日發佈的新聞重申同樣的門檻、自用數量、未滿 17 週歲排除及簡化申報警示；以上僅引用海關頁面原文所列法條，未在該範圍之外另作斷言。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在進入或離開阿爾巴尼亞共和國時，於邊境檢查站辦理：價值超過適用門檻（陸路 300 歐元／空、海路 430 歐元／15 歲以下 150 歐元；菸酒適用數量限額而非價值門檻）或屬商業用途的物品須當場申報；超出門檻的非商業物品通過簡化申報程序（Deklarimi i thjeshtuar）辦理海關申報。

procedures.name_en: Cash and valuables border declaration (RTVK) from EUR 10,000 — Albanian Customs
procedures.name_zh: 现金及有价物边境申报（RTVK），自 10,000 欧元起——阿尔巴尼亚海关
procedures.agency: Drejtoria e Përgjithshme e Doganave (General Directorate of Customs), Republic of Albania
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: persons who enter into and/or leave the territory of the Republic of Albania. Per the Albanian Customs money-declaration page (dogana.gov.al) captured live on 2026-09-27, based as the page states on Law No. 9917 of 19.5.2008, as amended. Obligation: all persons entering or leaving Albania are obliged to declare cash sums, any kind of bearer negotiable instrument, precious metals or stones, items of value and antique objects, starting from the amount of EUR 10,000 (inclusive, 'duke filluar nga shuma 10 000 euro') or its equivalent in other currencies; they must also state the purpose of holding the values and present the relevant justifying documents (the page's warning notice adds: appear before the Customs Authorities to complete the RTVK form, presenting supporting documents justifying the source of the funds declared). Where/how: the declaration is made at the Customs Administration offices at the border crossing point, on entry or exit, through the form for reporting the transport of values across the border (RTVK), which is completed online at the customs offices at the border crossing points. Timing: the declaration is made before passport control by the Police and Security authorities; it does not matter how you travel (plane, ship, car, motorbike, bicycle, on foot), where you keep the monetary values (hand luggage, baggage, the vehicle you travel in), or that the monetary means are not your property. Penalties (not a fee): for a false, inaccurate or missing declaration the Customs Administration has the right to impose a fine under article 17/1 of the said law, and in parallel the case is handled under the Criminal Code and the Criminal Procedure Code; fine bands: a) amounts EUR 10,000-19,999 or their equivalent in foreign currency: ALL 20,000 the first time, 10% of the undeclared value the second time, 30% of the undeclared value in other cases; b) EUR 20,000-49,999: ALL 40,000 the first time, 20% the second time, 40% in other cases; c) over EUR 50,000: ALL 60,000 the first time, 30% the second time, 50% in other cases. Fee: no charge is paid for completing the monetary-values declaration form (RTVK).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：进入和/或离开阿尔巴尼亚共和国领土的人员。依据 2026-09-27 实时取得的阿尔巴尼亚海关现金申报页（dogana.gov.al），页面载明其依据为经修订的 2008 年 5 月 19 日第 9917 号法。义务：所有进入或离开阿尔巴尼亚的人员均有义务申报现金款项、任何种类的不记名可转让票据、贵金属或宝石、有价物品及古董，起点为 10,000 欧元（含本数，原文 duke filluar nga shuma 10 000 euro）或其他货币等值；还须说明持有上述财物的目的并出示相应证明文件（页内警示提示补充：前往海关当局填报 RTVK 表格时，须出示能证明所申报资金来源的辅助文件）。地点/方式：申报在边境检查站的海关总署办公室办理，入境或出境均适用；通过跨境价值运输报告表（RTVK）办理，该表在边境检查站海关办公室在线填报。时点：申报在警察及安全当局进行护照检查之前办理；旅行方式（飞机、轮船、汽车、摩托车、自行车、步行）无关紧要，财物存放位置（手提行李、行李、所乘交通工具）无关紧要，即使款项不属本人所有亦须申报。处罚（非费用）：虚假、不准确申报或未申报的，海关总署有权依上述法律第 17/1 条处以罚款，并同时按《刑法典》和《刑事诉讼法典》处理；罚款档次：a) 10,000-19,999 欧元或等值外币：首次 20,000 列克，第二次按未申报价值的 10%，其余情形按 30%；b) 20,000-49,999 欧元：首次 40,000 列克，第二次 20%，其余 40%；c) 50,000 欧元以上：首次 60,000 列克，第二次 30%，其余 50%。费用：填报货币价值申报表（RTVK）不缴任何税费。
procedures.timing_en: Before passport control by the Police/Security authorities at the border crossing point, on both entry into and exit from Albania: persons carrying cash, bearer negotiable instruments, precious metals or stones, items of value or antique objects from EUR 10,000 (inclusive) or the equivalent in other currencies complete the RTVK form online at the customs offices at the border crossing point and present justifying documents; the mode of travel, the place where the values are kept and the ownership of the money are irrelevant.
procedures.timing_zh: 无论入境还是出境阿尔巴尼亚，均须在边境检查站由警察／安全当局进行护照检查之前办理：携带 10,000 欧元（含本数）或其他货币等值起现金、不记名可转让票据、贵金属或宝石、有价物品或古董的人员，在边境检查站海关办公室在线填报 RTVK 表格并出示证明文件；交通方式、财物存放位置及款项是否归本人所有均不影响该义务。

fee.note: 仅限 RTVK 表格填报本身免费：官网原文 Nuk paguani taksë për plotësimin formularit të deklarimit të vlerave monetare (RTVK)（填报货币价值申报表 RTVK 不缴税费）。虚假／不准确／未申报依第 9917/2008 号法（经修订）第 17/1 条所课罚款属行政罚款，不是费用；本字段亦不涵盖货物申报可能产生的进口税费。

procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金及有價物邊境申報（RTVK），自 10,000 歐元起——阿爾巴尼亞海關
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：進入和/或離開阿爾巴尼亞共和國領土的人員。依據 2026-09-27 實時取得的阿爾巴尼亞海關現金申報頁（dogana.gov.al），頁面載明其依據為經修訂的 2008 年 5 月 19 日第 9917 號法。義務：所有進入或離開阿爾巴尼亞的人員均有義務申報現金款項、任何種類的不記名可轉讓票據、貴金屬或寶石、有價物品及古董，起點為 10,000 歐元（含本數，原文 duke filluar nga shuma 10 000 euro）或其他貨幣等值；還須說明持有上述財物的目的並出示相應證明文件（頁內警示提示補充：前往海關當局填報 RTVK 表格時，須出示能證明所申報資金來源的輔助文件）。地點/方式：申報在邊境檢查站的海關總署辦公室辦理，入境或出境均適用；通過跨境價值運輸報告表（RTVK）辦理，該表在邊境檢查站海關辦公室線上填報。時點：申報在警察及安全當局進行護照檢查之前辦理；旅行方式（飛機、輪船、汽車、摩托車、自行車、步行）無關緊要，財物存放位置（手提行李、行李、所乘交通工具）無關緊要，即使款項不屬本人所有亦須申報。處罰（非費用）：虛假、不準確申報或未申報的，海關總署有權依上述法律第 17/1 條處以罰款，並同時按《刑法典》和《刑事訴訟法典》處理；罰款檔次：a) 10,000-19,999 歐元或等值外幣：首次 20,000 列克，第二次按未申報價值的 10%，其餘情形按 30%；b) 20,000-49,999 歐元：首次 40,000 列克，第二次 20%，其餘 40%；c) 50,000 歐元以上：首次 60,000 列克，第二次 30%，其餘 50%。費用：填報貨幣價值申報表（RTVK）不繳任何稅費。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 無論入境還是出境阿爾巴尼亞，均須在邊境檢查站由警察／安全當局進行護照檢查之前辦理：攜帶 10,000 歐元（含本數）或其他貨幣等值起現金、不記名可轉讓票據、貴金屬或寶石、有價物品或古董的人員，在邊境檢查站海關辦公室線上填報 RTVK 表格並出示證明文件；交通方式、財物存放位置及款項是否歸本人所有均不影響該義務。

procedures.name_en: Exit declaration of works of art / cultural-heritage objects, with permit and object passport — Albanian Customs
procedures.name_zh: 艺术品／文化遗产物品出境申报（附许可与物品护照）——阿尔巴尼亚海关
procedures.agency: Drejtoria e Përgjithshme e Doganave (General Directorate of Customs), Republic of Albania
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: exit only. Per the Albanian Customs traveller page 'Objektet e Trashëgimisë Kulturore dhe Veprat e Artit' (dogana.gov.al) captured live on 2026-09-27. Narrow duty as printed: any individual who wishes to export out of the territory of the Republic of Albania an object that is a work of art or an object constituting cultural heritage must declare it to the Customs Authorities and present the relevant permits for it, accompanied by the object's passport, issued by the National Centre for the Inventory of Cultural Properties (Qendra Kombëtare e Inventarizimit të Pasurieve Kulturore, QKIPK) or the Ministry of Culture ('Ministri i Kulturës' as printed); the page refers to www.qkipk.gov.al for further information. Context of the term on the page: cultural heritage comprises material and immaterial, movable and immovable cultural property as a whole of cultural values carrying historical memory and national identity and of scientific or cultural importance; some movable cultural-property examples listed: paintings, photographs, various collections; books, manuscripts, historical documents, stamps; archaeological objects, statues; items of artisanal, ethnographic or historical value. Scope limits as printed on the page: the page imposes this duty only on the EXPORT of such objects by an individual; it states no import rule for antiques or for goods in general, so nothing here is generalised to imports or to all antiques; no value threshold, age rule, quantity limit, form name, stage relative to passport control or penalty is stated; fee unknown; the page neither states nor implies a charge for the customs declaration or for the QKIPK/Ministry-of-Culture permit itself (permit-issuance terms lie outside this page). Relation to the other captured AL regimes: distinct from the traveller value-threshold declaration (AL-goods-declaration) and from the RTVK EUR 10,000 rule (AL-cash-declaration), which separately counts antique objects among items of value; as printed the cultural-heritage export duty carries no value threshold and the page cross-references neither regime, so the three are kept unmerged.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：仅出境。依据 2026-09-27 实时取得的阿尔巴尼亚海关旅客栏目页 “Objektet e Trashëgimisë Kulturore dhe Veprat e Artit”（dogana.gov.al）。页面原述的狭窄义务：任何个人欲将一件艺术品或构成文化遗产的物品携出阿尔巴尼亚共和国领土之外，均须向海关当局（Autoriteteve Doganore）申报，并出示相应许可（随附物品护照 pasaporta e objektit），该许可由国家文化财产清查中心（Qendra Kombëtare e Inventarizimit të Pasurieve Kulturore，QKIPK）或文化部（原文 Ministri i Kulturës）签发；页面另指引 www.qkipk.gov.al 获取更多信息。术语在页面中的语境：文化遗产涵盖物质与非物质、可移动与不可移动的文化财产，作为承载历史记忆与民族认同、具科学或文化重要性的一整套文化价值；页面列举的部分可移动文化财产示例：绘画、照片、各类收藏；书籍、手稿、历史文献、邮票；考古物品、雕像；具有手工艺、民族学或历史价值的物品。页面原文所示的适用边界：页面仅就个人出口此类物项设定义务，未就古董或一般物品的进口另设规则，故此处不概括进口情形、亦不概括一切古董；页面未载明价值门槛、年龄规则、数量限制、指定表格、相对护照检查的办理阶段或罚则；fee unknown；页面既未载明亦未暗示海关申报本身或 QKIPK／文化部许可本身收取费用（许可签发条件在本页范围之外）。与另两条已取得的 AL 制度的关系：有别于旅客超价值门槛申报（AL-goods-declaration）与 RTVK 一万欧元规则（AL-cash-declaration，该页将古董另计为有价物品）；按页面原文，本文化遗产出境义务不设价值门槛，且未交叉援引上述任一制度，故三者保持不合并。
procedures.timing_en: On exit from the Republic of Albania: an individual exporting a work of art or a cultural-heritage object out of Albanian territory declares it to the Customs Authorities and presents the relevant permit, accompanied by the object's passport, issued by QKIPK or the Ministry of Culture; the page states no stage relative to passport control, no time limit and no place for obtaining the permit.
procedures.timing_zh: 在离开阿尔巴尼亚共和国时：出口艺术品或构成文化遗产的物品的个人向海关当局申报，并出示 QKIPK 或文化部签发的相应许可（随附物品护照）；页面未载明相对护照检查的办理阶段、时限或许可取得地点。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 藝術品／文化遺產物品出境申報（附許可與物品護照）——阿爾巴尼亞海關
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：僅出境。依據 2026-09-27 實時取得的阿爾巴尼亞海關旅客欄目頁 “Objektet e Trashëgimisë Kulturore dhe Veprat e Artit”（dogana.gov.al）。頁面原述的狹窄義務：任何個人欲將一件藝術品或構成文化遺產的物品攜出阿爾巴尼亞共和國領土之外，均須向海關當局（Autoriteteve Doganore）申報，並出示相應許可（隨附物品護照 pasaporta e objektit），該許可由國家文化財產清查中心（Qendra Kombëtare e Inventarizimit të Pasurieve Kulturore，QKIPK）或文化部（原文 Ministri i Kulturës）簽發；頁面另指引 www.qkipk.gov.al 獲取更多資訊。術語在頁面中的語境：文化遺產涵蓋物質與非物質、可移動與不可移動的文化財產，作為承載歷史記憶與民族認同、具科學或文化重要性的一整套文化價值；頁面列舉的部分可移動文化財產示例：繪畫、照片、各類收藏；書籍、手稿、歷史文獻、郵票；考古物品、雕像；具有手工藝、民族學或歷史價值的物品。頁面原文所示的適用邊界：頁面僅就個人出口此類物項設定義務，未就古董或一般物品的進口另設規則，故此處不概括進口情形、亦不概括一切古董；頁面未載明價值門檻、年齡規則、數量限制、指定表格、相對護照檢查的辦理階段或罰則；fee unknown；頁面既未載明亦未暗示海關申報本身或 QKIPK／文化部許可本身收取費用（許可簽發條件在本頁範圍之外）。與另兩條已取得的 AL 制度的關係：有別於旅客超價值門檻申報（AL-goods-declaration）與 RTVK 一萬歐元規則（AL-cash-declaration，該頁將古董另計為有價物品）；按頁面原文，本文化遺產出境義務不設價值門檻，且未交叉援引上述任一制度，故三者保持不合並。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在離開阿爾巴尼亞共和國時：出口藝術品或構成文化遺產的物品的個人向海關當局申報，並出示 QKIPK 或文化部簽發的相應許可（隨附物品護照）；頁面未載明相對護照檢查的辦理階段、時限或許可取得地點。
