procedures.name_en: Cross-border cash transport declaration (EUR 10,000 or more) on entering or leaving Andorra — Andorran Customs (Duana Andorrana)
procedures.name_zh: 跨境现金运输申报（入境或离开安道尔携现金达 10,000 欧元及以上）——安道尔海关（Duana Andorrana）
procedures.agency: Andorran Customs (Duana Andorrana), Departament de Tributs i Fronteres, Govern d'Andorra
procedures.applicability_en: Who and threshold: any natural person ('portador') entering or leaving the Principality of Andorra carrying cash — on their person, in their luggage or in their means of transport — to a value equal to or greater than EUR 10,000 (or its equivalent in other currencies) must complete the official cross-border cash transport declaration; the form's general instructions ground this obligation in article 43 of Llei 14/2017, of 22 June, on prevention of and the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, and title the form under article 3 of the regulation of the cross-border cash transport declaration; the official customs legislation index lists that regulation as Decret 377/2022, of 21 September 2022, and Llei 14/2017 as amended by Llei 26/2022. Covered 'cash': (i) banknotes and coins in circulation or still exchangeable; (ii) bearer-negotiable instruments (traveller's cheques; cheques, promissory notes or payment orders made out to bearer, signed with the payee omitted, endorsed without restriction, or with a fictitious payee); (iii) raw material used as a high-liquidity store of value (coins of at least 90% gold content; uncoined gold such as ingots or grains of at least 99.5% gold). Directions and transit: the declaration is required both on entering and on leaving Andorra; transit through Andorra additionally requires both an entry and an exit declaration. Age and capacity: no age threshold is stated for the cash declaration; where the carrier lacks the legal capacity to sign, the declaration is presented by their legal representative. Means of transport (recorded on the form): air (commercial flight / private aircraft), maritime-fluvial (commercial ship / cruise / yacht), rail, road (truck / coach / car) and other (e.g. pedestrian or bicycle transit); the 'Número de referència' field carries the flight number, aircraft registration, train number, or the country code and registration plate of the vehicle; for road transport the land border crossing used is also recorded. Steps: complete the official form 'Declaració de transport transfronterer de diners en efectiu — Full principal' (main sheet), using 'Full adicional' sheets where the space is insufficient — every additional sheet is numbered and signed and all sheets together form a single declaration — stating: (1) direction (entry to / exit from Andorra); (2) carrier's data as shown in the identity document (passport, DNI or other, with issuing country and date); (3) transport data (country of first departure, final destination country, departure/arrival/transit dates, itinerary of departure/arrival/transit airports, ports or stations); (4) the cash, broken down by value and currency for each category; (5) economic origin and intended use of the cash (several options may be ticked); (6) the owner(s) of the cash and (7) the intended recipient(s) — where there is more than one owner or recipient, the total number is stated and one additional sheet is completed per person with their data, amount, origin and use; (8) signature with date and place, stating the total number of additional sheets used (0 if none); the carrier may request a certified copy ('còpia compulsada'). Completion rules: all fields are mandatory; asterisked fields are completed if applicable or available, otherwise 'N/P' or 'N/D'; unknown information is marked 'Desconeguda'; the form is completed in the official language of Andorra, in block capitals and dark ink, without crossings-out or amendments; fields reserved for the Administration remain blank. Presentation and control: the form carries an Administration box for the signature and stamp of the Duana Andorrana, a 'Declaració en duana: Sí/No' field and the customs office that carried out the control; presenting false or incomplete information, or failing to present the cash for control, means the declaration obligation is not fulfilled and the carrier may be sanctioned under applicable national law. Data handling: the Duana registers and processes the data and makes it available to the Financial Intelligence Unit of Andorra (UIFAND), and under articles 45 and 46 of Llei 14/2017 to the authorities there mentioned, solely for the prevention of and fight against criminal activities. A separate 'Declaració prèvia de transport transfronterer de diners en efectiu' (prior declaration) main sheet and additional sheet are also listed on the official customs forms page.
procedures.applicability_zh: 对象与门槛：任何自然人（“携带人/portador”）进入或离开安道尔公国时，随身、随行李或随其交通工具携带价值达到或超过 10,000 欧元（或等值外币）现金的，必须填写官方跨境现金运输申报表。该义务的依据为：表内总说明援引 2017 年 6 月 22 日第 14/2017 号法（预防和打击洗钱及恐怖融资法）第 43 条，表头标注依据“跨境现金运输申报条例”第 3 条；官方海关立法索引列明该条例为 2022 年 9 月 21 日第 377/2022 号令（Decret 377/2022），并列明 Llei 14/2017 经 2022 年 7 月 14 日第 26/2022 号法修改。所涉“现金”：(一) 流通中或仍可兑换的纸币与硬币；(二) 不记名可转让票据（旅行支票；见票即付的无记名支票、本票或付款指令、漏填收款人并已签署的票据、无限制背书票据、虚构收款人票据等）；(三) 作为高流动性价值储藏的原材料（含金量至少 90% 的金币；金条、金粒等未铸造金，含金量至少 99.5%）。方向与过境：进入和离开安道尔两个方向均须申报；过境安道尔时还须分别作出入境申报和离境申报。年龄与行为能力：现金申报未设年龄门槛；携带人欠缺签署申报所需行为能力的，由其法定代理人提交。交通工具（表内分列）：航空（商业航班／私人飞机）、海河（商船／游轮／游艇）、铁路、公路（卡车／大客车／汽车）及其他（如步行、自行车过境）；“编号/Número de referència”栏填写航班号、私人飞机注册号、车次号或车辆国籍代码加牌照号；公路运输还须填写所经陆路边境口岸。步骤：填写官方表格《跨境现金运输申报——主表（Declaració de transport transfronterer de diners en efectiu — Full principal）》，空间不足时使用“附页（Full adicional）”——每张附页须编号并签署，全部附页与主表构成同一份申报——依次填写：(1) 方向（进入／离开安道尔）；(2) 携带人身份证件所载信息（护照、身份证或其他证件，及签发国与签发日期）；(3) 运输信息（首次出发国、最终目的地国、出发／到达／过境日期，出发、到达、中转机场／港口／车站）；(4) 现金按类别分列币种与金额；(5) 现金的经济来源与用途（可多选）；(6) 现金所有人；(7) 预期收款人——所有人或收款人多于一人时填写总人数，并就每人各用一张附页填其资料、金额、来源与用途；(8) 签名并填日期、地点及所用附页总数（未用填 0）；携带人可请求盖章认证副本（còpia compulsada）。填表规则：所有栏目必填；带星号（*）栏目在适用或有数据时填写，否则填“N/P”或“N/D”；不知情的填“Desconeguda”；以安道尔官方语言填写，大写字母、深色墨水，不得涂改；标注“留给行政当局”的栏目留空。递交与查验：表格设行政栏，供安道尔海关（Duana Andorrana）签字盖章、填写“是否海关申报：是／否”及实施查验的海关；提供不实或不完整信息、或不出示现金接受查验的，视为未履行申报义务，可依适用的国内法受罚。数据处理：海关负责登记和处理相关信息，并依 Llei 14/2017 向安道尔金融情报局（UIFAND）及该法第 45、46 条所指机关提供，仅用于预防和打击犯罪活动。同一官方表单页另列有《跨境现金运输预先申报（Declaració prèvia de transport transfronterer de diners en efectiu）》主表与附表。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of entering or leaving Andorra when carrying cash of EUR 10,000 or more (or its equivalent): the form must be completed on entry to or exit from Andorra, and in the case of transit through Andorra both an entry and an exit declaration are required. The completed form is presented to Andorran Customs at the control (the form carries the customs signature, stamp and control fields). The form itself states no separate advance-filing deadline.
procedures.timing_zh: 携现金达 10,000 欧元（或等值）进入或离开安道尔时：须在入境或出境时填写该表；过境安道尔的，须分别完成入境申报与出境申报。填妥的表格在查验时向安道尔海关递交（表内设海关签署、盖章与查验栏）。该表本身未载任何单独的事前申报期限。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境現金運輸申報（入境或離開安道爾攜現金達 10,000 歐元及以上）——安道爾海關（Duana Andorrana）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 對象與門檻：任何自然人（“攜帶人/portador”）進入或離開安道爾公國時，隨身、隨行李或隨其交通工具攜帶價值達到或超過 10,000 歐元（或等值外幣）現金的，必須填寫官方跨境現金運輸申報表。該義務的依據為：表內總說明援引 2017 年 6 月 22 日第 14/2017 號法（預防和打擊洗錢及恐怖融資法）第 43 條，表頭標註依據“跨境現金運輸申報條例”第 3 條；官方海關立法索引列明該條例為 2022 年 9 月 21 日第 377/2022 號令（Decret 377/2022），並列明 Llei 14/2017 經 2022 年 7 月 14 日第 26/2022 號法修改。所涉“現金”：(一) 流通中或仍可兌換的紙幣與硬幣；(二) 不記名可轉讓票據（旅行支票；見票即付的無記名支票、本票或付款指令、漏填收款人並已簽署的票據、無限制背書票據、虛構收款人票據等）；(三) 作為高流動性價值儲藏的原材料（含金量至少 90% 的金幣；金條、金粒等未鑄造金，含金量至少 99.5%）。方向與過境：進入和離開安道爾兩個方向均須申報；過境安道爾時還須分別作出入境申報和離境申報。年齡與行為能力：現金申報未設年齡門檻；攜帶人欠缺簽署申報所需行為能力的，由其法定代理人提交。交通工具（表內分列）：航空（商業航班／私人飛機）、海河（商船／遊輪／遊艇）、鐵路、公路（卡車／大客車／汽車）及其他（如步行、自行車過境）；“編號/Número de referència”欄填寫航班號、私人飛機註冊號、車次號或車輛國籍代碼加牌照號；公路運輸還須填寫所經陸路邊境口岸。步驟：填寫官方表格《跨境現金運輸申報——主表（Declaració de transport transfronterer de diners en efectiu — Full principal）》，空間不足時使用“附頁（Full adicional）”——每張附頁須編號並簽署，全部附頁與主表構成同一份申報——依次填寫：(1) 方向（進入／離開安道爾）；(2) 攜帶人身份證件所載資訊（護照、身份證或其他證件，及簽發國與簽發日期）；(3) 運輸資訊（首次出發國、最終目的地國、出發／到達／過境日期，出發、到達、中轉機場／港口／車站）；(4) 現金按類別分列幣種與金額；(5) 現金的經濟來源與用途（可多選）；(6) 現金所有人；(7) 預期收款人——所有人或收款人多於一人時填寫總人數，並就每人各用一張附頁填其資料、金額、來源與用途；(8) 簽名並填日期、地點及所用附頁總數（未用填 0）；攜帶人可請求蓋章認證副本（còpia compulsada）。填表規則：所有欄目必填；帶星號（*）欄目在適用或有資料時填寫，否則填“N/P”或“N/D”；不知情的填“Desconeguda”；以安道爾官方語言填寫，大寫字母、深色墨水，不得塗改；標註“留給行政當局”的欄目留空。遞交與查驗：表格設行政欄，供安道爾海關（Duana Andorrana）簽字蓋章、填寫“是否海關申報：是／否”及實施查驗的海關；提供不實或不完整資訊、或不出示現金接受查驗的，視為未履行申報義務，可依適用的國內法受罰。資料處理：海關負責登記和處理相關資訊，並依 Llei 14/2017 向安道爾金融情報局（UIFAND）及該法第 45、46 條所指機關提供，僅用於預防和打擊犯罪活動。同一官方表單頁另列有《跨境現金運輸預先申報（Declaració prèvia de transport transfronterer de diners en efectiu）》主表與附表。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 攜現金達 10,000 歐元（或等值）進入或離開安道爾時：須在入境或出境時填寫該表；過境安道爾的，須分別完成入境申報與出境申報。填妥的表格在查驗時向安道爾海關遞交（表內設海關簽署、蓋章與查驗欄）。該表本身未載任何單獨的事前申報期限。

procedures.name_en: Cash and securities declaration on the currency declaration form (strictly more than EUR 10,000, bringing in and taking out) — UIO BiH customs
procedures.name_zh: 现金及有价证券申报（货币申报单，严格超过 10,000 欧元，入出境均适用）——波黑间接税务局海关
procedures.agency: Indirect Taxation Authority of Bosnia and Herzegovina (Uprava za indirektno oporezivanje, UIO) — customs authorities at international border crossings
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: both bringing into and taking out of Bosnia and Herzegovina, and the duty applies at every border crossing in BiH. Per the UIO 'Information for citizens and travelers' page captured live on 2026-09-27. Trigger (strict threshold): all travellers bringing in or taking out cash or securities 'in the amount valued more than 10,000 euros' — strictly more than EUR 10,000, not EUR 10,000 or more — shall declare it to the customs authority on every border crossing in BiH; the page notes the limit was 'increased … to 10 000 euros' for FATF-harmonization purposes. Instruments in scope (per the same page): in addition to effective foreign money, also convertible marks and cheques, securities and any other physically portable instruments of payment under the regulations governing prevention of money laundering and financing of terrorist activities. Traveller act (a genuine traveller-submitted declaration): the bringing in and taking out of cash, cheques or securities is declared on a currency declaration form which can be obtained from customs officers on all international border crossings, or downloaded from www.uino.gov.ba; a detailed instruction on completing the form is given on its back; after completing it, the form is handed to a customs officer, who shall, upon the request of the traveller, return a certified copy to the traveller who declared the cash, cheques or other securities. Entity-level regimes, recorded separately and NOT merged into one national rule: the Government of the Republic of Srpska adopted the Decree on amendments to the Decree on bringing in and taking out effective foreign money, convertible marks, cheques and securities ('Official Gazette of the Republic of Srpska', 46/17), in force 24 May 2017, with its form published by the RS Ministry of Finance (vladars.net); the Government of the Federation of BiH adopted the Decision on amendments to the Decision on taking out foreign cash and cheques ('Official Gazette of the Federation of BiH', 38/17), in force 25 May 2017, with its form published by the FBiH Government (fbihvlada.gov.ba) and the FBiH Ministry of Finance (fmf.gov.ba). Per the UIO instruction for form completion: in passenger traffic with foreign countries natural persons may transport more than 10,000 euros in cash provided that they demonstrate an approval by the Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Srpska OR the Ministry of Finance of the Federation of BiH — two distinct entity approval tracks alongside the state-level declaration duty; the page does not state which entity's approval applies to a given traveller (flagged as unresolved, not merged). Other sections of the same UIO page (pets, plants, medications, animal products, unreconciled baggage, postal consignments, vehicle imports) are separate regimes and do not form part of this cash declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：带入与带出波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那均适用，且须在波黑每一边境检查站履行。依据 2026-09-27 实时取得的 UIO「公民与旅客信息」页。触发门槛（严格界限）：带入或带出现金或有价证券价值「超过 10,000 欧元」（more than 10,000 euros，严格大于；并非 10,000 欧元及以上）的所有旅客，须在波黑每个边境检查站向海关申报；页面并载明该限额为配合 FATF 建议「提高至 10 000 欧元」。范围（同页）：除有效外币外，还包括可兑换马克、支票、有价证券及按反洗钱与反恐融资法规规定的其他一切可随身携带的支付工具。旅客动作（真实存在的旅客提交申报）：现金、支票或有价证券的带入与带出以货币申报单（currency declaration form）申报，该表可向所有国际边境检查站的海关人员领取，或自 www.uino.gov.ba 下载；表背面附详细填报说明；填妥后交海关人员，海关人员应旅客请求向申报现金、支票或其他有价证券的旅客返还一份经认证的副本。实体层面制度，单列记载、未合并为一条全国统一规则：塞族共和国政府通过《关于携带有效外币、可兑换马克、支票及有价证券出入境法令的修订法令》（《塞族共和国官报》46/17），2017 年 5 月 24 日生效，其表格由塞族共和国财政部网站（vladars.net）发布；波黑联邦政府通过《关于携带外币现金及支票出境决定的修订决定》（《波黑联邦官报》38/17），2017 年 5 月 25 日生效，其表格由波黑联邦政府网站（fbihvlada.gov.ba）及联邦财政部网站（fmf.gov.ba）发布。按 UIO 表格填报说明：在与外国的旅客运输中，自然人可携带超过 10,000 欧元现金，但须出示塞族共和国财政部**或**波黑联邦财政部的批准——此为国家层面申报义务之外的两条互不相同的实体批准轨道；页面未说明对特定旅客适用哪个实体的批准（列为未决项，不合并）。同一 UIO 页面的其他板块（宠物、植物、药品、动物源性产品、未到达行李、邮寄、车辆进口）为另行制度，不属本项。
procedures.timing_en: On entering AND leaving BiH, at every border crossing / at all international border crossings, whenever the value of cash or securities carried is strictly more than EUR 10,000: obtain the currency declaration form from the customs officer (or download it), complete it per the instructions on its back, and hand it to the customs officer; a certified copy is returned on request. Carrying more than EUR 10,000 additionally requires, per the entity-level instruction, demonstrating an approval of the RS or FBiH Ministry of Finance.
procedures.timing_zh: 进入或离开波黑时，凡携带现金或有价证券价值严格超过 10,000 欧元，须在每一边境检查站／所有国际边境检查站办理：向海关人员领取（或下载）货币申报单，按背面说明填妥后交海关人员；可请求返还经认证副本。另按实体层面说明，携带超过 10,000 欧元还须出示塞族共和国或波黑联邦财政部的批准。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金及有價證券申報（貨幣申報單，嚴格超過 10,000 歐元，入出境均適用）——波黑間接稅務局海關
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：帶入與帶出波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那均適用，且須在波黑每一邊境檢查站履行。依據 2026-09-27 實時取得的 UIO「公民與旅客資訊」頁。觸發門檻（嚴格界限）：帶入或帶出現金或有價證券價值「超過 10,000 歐元」（more than 10,000 euros，嚴格大於；並非 10,000 歐元及以上）的所有旅客，須在波黑每個邊境檢查站向海關申報；頁面並載明該限額為配合 FATF 建議「提高至 10 000 歐元」。範圍（同頁）：除有效外幣外，還包括可兌換馬克、支票、有價證券及按反洗錢與反恐融資法規規定的其他一切可隨身攜帶的支付工具。旅客動作（真實存在的旅客提交申報）：現金、支票或有價證券的帶入與帶出以貨幣申報單（currency declaration form）申報，該表可向所有國際邊境檢查站的海關人員領取，或自 www.uino.gov.ba 下載；表背面附詳細填報說明；填妥後交海關人員，海關人員應旅客請求向申報現金、支票或其他有價證券的旅客返還一份經認證的副本。實體層面制度，單列記載、未合併為一條全國統一規則：塞族共和國政府通過《關於攜帶有效外幣、可兌換馬克、支票及有價證券出入境法令的修訂法令》（《塞族共和國官報》46/17），2017 年 5 月 24 日生效，其表格由塞族共和國財政部網站（vladars.net）發佈；波黑聯邦政府通過《關於攜帶外幣現金及支票出境決定的修訂決定》（《波黑聯邦官報》38/17），2017 年 5 月 25 日生效，其表格由波黑聯邦政府網站（fbihvlada.gov.ba）及聯邦財政部網站（fmf.gov.ba）發佈。按 UIO 表格填報說明：在與外國的旅客運輸中，自然人可攜帶超過 10,000 歐元現金，但須出示塞族共和國財政部**或**波黑聯邦財政部的批准——此為國家層面申報義務之外的兩條互不相同的實體批准軌道；頁面未說明對特定旅客適用哪個實體的批准（列為未決項，不合並）。同一 UIO 頁面的其他板塊（寵物、植物、藥品、動物源性產品、未到達行李、郵寄、車輛進口）為另行制度，不屬本項。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 進入或離開波黑時，凡攜帶現金或有價證券價值嚴格超過 10,000 歐元，須在每一邊境檢查站／所有國際邊境檢查站辦理：向海關人員領取（或下載）貨幣申報單，按背面說明填妥後交海關人員；可請求返還經認證副本。另按實體層面說明，攜帶超過 10,000 歐元還須出示塞族共和國或波黑聯邦財政部的批准。

procedures.name_en: Oral customs declaration of non-commercial goods in personal luggage on entry from a third country (usmena carinska deklaracija)
procedures.name_zh: 自第三国入境非商业个人行李的口头报关（usmena carinska deklaracija）
procedures.agency: Carina — Carinska uprava (Croatian Customs Administration, Ministry of Finance)
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers entering Croatia from third countries (outside the Union) bring in non-commercial goods in personal luggage by orally reporting the goods to customs at the border crossing, i.e. lodging an oral customs declaration. Relief from customs duty, VAT and excise applies while total value does not exceed EUR 430.00 (sea and air passengers), EUR 300.00 per passenger (other modes) or EUR 150.00 (travellers under 15, any mode); the value of an item above the limit may not be split, nor may relief be pooled between travellers. Tobacco (17+ only): air 200 cigarettes / 100 cigarillos (up to 3 g each) / 50 cigars / 250 g smoking tobacco; road, rail and other surface modes only 40 cigarettes / 20 cigarillos / 10 cigars / 50 g; separately 50 g heated tobacco products, 10 mL e-liquid and 50 g new tobacco products (Excise Act Art. 94(2)). Alcohol (17+ only): 1 L of beverages over 22% vol or non-denatured ethanol of 80% vol and above, or up to 2 L at 22% vol and below, plus 4 L still wine and 16 L beer; excise quantities are not counted into the value caps. Excise goods in quantities above the exempted amounts may still be imported against assessment of all import duties only if they are declared to a customs officer, are imported in person by a natural person older than 17 (>17), and are intended for personal needs - an over-quota age condition of 'older than 17' distinct from the exemption context, where travellers under 17 simply do not enjoy the tobacco/alcohol exemption (i.e. 17-year-olds do). Fuel in standard tanks plus up to 10 L in portable containers is relieved. Border-zone residents, frontier workers and transport crews may bring in daily, duty-free, goods up to EUR 40.00 plus 25 cigarettes / 10 cigarillos / 5 cigars / 25 g smoking tobacco, 0.25 L spirits, 1 L still wine, 1.5 L beer, 25 g heated tobacco and 4 mL e-liquid (limits disapplied on proof of travel beyond the border zone). Goods exceeding the limits are subject to import duties (customs, VAT, excise): a shortened assessment at the border is available if the goods qualify for oral declaration, are worth up to EUR 10,000.00 and require no registration, with a uniform 2.5% customs rate only where value does not exceed EUR 700.00, or preferential FTA rates up to EUR 1,200.00 without EUR.1; a disputed assessment goes to the regular procedure with a standard customs declaration. Goods carried in the cargo space of goods vehicles are not personal luggage and follow the standard procedure. Separate veterinary restrictions govern animal-origin food from third countries (meat and dairy prohibited; fishery products up to 20 kg per person; other animal products 2 kg), excess requiring inspection at a border control post.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自第三国（欧盟以外）入境克罗地亚的旅客，以在边境口岸向海关口头报告商品、即递交口头海关申报的方式携入个人行李中的非商业商品。关税、VAT 与消费税的免除以总额不超限为条件：海运/空运旅客 430.00 欧、其他交通方式每客 300.00 欧、15 岁以下旅客不论交通方式 150.00 欧；超限单件的价值不得拆分，免税额亦不得在两名或以上旅客间合并。烟草（仅 17 岁以上）：空运 200 支香烟／100 支 cigarillos（每支净重 ≤3 克）／50 支雪茄／250 克烟丝；公路、铁路等陆路方式仅 40 支香烟／20 支 cigarillos／10 支雪茄／50 克烟丝；另计 50 克加热烟草制品、10 毫升烟液及 50 克新烟草制品（消费税法第 94(2) 条）。酒精（仅 17 岁以上）：1 升 22% vol 以上酒类或 80% vol 及以上非变性乙醇，或最多 2 升 22% vol 及以下，另加 4 升静止葡萄酒与 16 升啤酒；消费税限量不计入价值上限。超出免税数量的消费税品仍可在计征全部进口税费的前提下携入，但仅当：已向海关官员申报、由大于 17 岁（>17，即年满 18 周岁）的自然人本人自行运输、且以个人自用为目的——该“大于 17 岁”是超量计征语境的条件，与“未满 17 岁不适用烟酒豁免”（≥17 即享豁免）属两个不同语境的年龄口径，不得混同为一。标准油箱燃油外加最多 10 升便携备用燃油免税。边境区居民、跨境工作者与运输工具机组每日可免税带入最高 40.00 欧商品及 25 支香烟／10 支 cigarillos／5 支雪茄／25 克烟丝、0.25 升烈酒、1 升静止葡萄酒、1.5 升啤酒、25 克加热烟草、4 毫升烟液（如能证明前往边境区以外，则不适用上述限量）。超限额商品须计征进口税费（关税、VAT、消费税）：符合口头申报条件、价值不超过 10,000.00 欧且无需注册的商品可在边境办理简化计征；统一关税率 2.5% 仅适用于价值不超过 700.00 欧者；自贸协定优惠原产地最高 1,200.00 欧可免 EUR.1 证书；对简化计征结果有异议即转入提交标准报关单的常规程序。货运车辆货厢内运输的商品不属个人行李，适用标准程序。第三国动物源性食品另有兽医限制（肉奶禁止入境；渔产品每人 20 公斤；其他动物源产品 2 公斤），超量须经边境检查站查验。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival at the border crossing point, report the goods orally to customs; where allowances are exceeded, import duties are assessed at the border under the shortened procedure (Form for calculation of import duties in passenger traffic); a traveller disputing the assessment is directed to the regular procedure with a standard customs declaration.
procedures.timing_zh: 到达边境口岸时向海关口头申报商品；超免税额的进口税费在边境按简化程序计征（使用旅客交通进口税费计算表）；旅客对计征结果有异议的，转入提交标准报关单的常规程序。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 自第三國入境非商業個人行李的口頭報關（usmena carinska deklaracija）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自第三國（歐盟以外）入境克羅地亞的旅客，以在邊境口岸向海關口頭報告商品、即遞交口頭海關申報的方式攜入個人行李中的非商業商品。關稅、VAT 與消費稅的免除以總額不超限為條件：海運/空運旅客 430.00 歐、其他交通方式每客 300.00 歐、15 歲以下旅客不論交通方式 150.00 歐；超限單件的價值不得拆分，免稅額亦不得在兩名或以上旅客間合併。菸草（僅 17 歲以上）：空運 200 支香菸／100 支 cigarillos（每支淨重 ≤3 克）／50 支雪茄／250 克菸絲；公路、鐵路等陸路方式僅 40 支香菸／20 支 cigarillos／10 支雪茄／50 克菸絲；另計 50 克加熱菸草製品、10 毫升煙液及 50 克新菸草製品（消費稅法第 94(2) 條）。酒精（僅 17 歲以上）：1 升 22% vol 以上酒類或 80% vol 及以上非變性乙醇，或最多 2 升 22% vol 及以下，另加 4 升靜止葡萄酒與 16 升啤酒；消費稅限量不計入價值上限。超出免稅數量的消費稅品仍可在計徵全部進口稅費的前提下攜入，但僅當：已向海關官員申報、由大於 17 歲（>17，即年滿 18 週歲）的自然人本人自行運輸、且以個人自用為目的——該“大於 17 歲”是超量計徵語境的條件，與“未滿 17 歲不適用菸酒豁免”（≥17 即享豁免）屬兩個不同語境的年齡口徑，不得混同為一。標準油箱燃油外加最多 10 升便攜備用燃油免稅。邊境區居民、跨境工作者與運輸工具機組每日可免稅帶入最高 40.00 歐商品及 25 支香菸／10 支 cigarillos／5 支雪茄／25 克菸絲、0.25 升烈酒、1 升靜止葡萄酒、1.5 升啤酒、25 克加熱菸草、4 毫升煙液（如能證明前往邊境區以外，則不適用上述限量）。超限額商品須計徵進口稅費（關稅、VAT、消費稅）：符合口頭申報條件、價值不超過 10,000.00 歐且無需註冊的商品可在邊境辦理簡化計徵；統一關稅率 2.5% 僅適用於價值不超過 700.00 歐者；自貿協定優惠原產地最高 1,200.00 歐可免 EUR.1 證書；對簡化計徵結果有異議即轉入提交標準報關單的常規程序。貨運車輛貨廂內運輸的商品不屬個人行李，適用標準程序。第三國動物源性食品另有獸醫限制（肉奶禁止入境；漁產品每人 20 公斤；其他動物源產品 2 公斤），超量須經邊境檢查站查驗。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 到達邊境口岸時向海關口頭申報商品；超免稅額的進口稅費在邊境按簡化程序計徵（使用旅客交通進口稅費計算表）；旅客對計徵結果有異議的，轉入提交標準報關單的常規程序。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration when entering or leaving the EU carrying EUR 10,000 or more (new rules from 26 March 2026)
procedures.name_zh: 进出欧盟携带 1 万欧元及以上现金的申报（2026-03-26 新规则）
procedures.agency: Carina — Carinska uprava (Croatian Customs Administration, Ministry of Finance)
procedures.applicability_en: Every natural person entering or leaving the territory of the EU (across the external border) carrying cash of EUR 10,000.00 or more, or the equivalent in other currencies or other payment instruments, is obliged to declare the amount to a customs officer at the border customs office (new rules from 26 March 2026; forms under Regulation (EU) 2018/1672). Carrying cash is otherwise free and unlimited in amount. Cash includes banknotes and coins in circulation or still exchangeable, bearer instruments (cheques, travellers' cheques, money orders without a named payee), gold coins of at least 90% gold, gold bars, grains or nuggets of at least 99.5% gold, and prepaid cards. The Cash Declaration form (Obrazac - prijava gotovine) may be filled in electronically and sent to operativno@carina.hr, printed and handed to the customs officer, or completed at the border office itself, in Croatian or English, with an additional sheet if needed. Unaccompanied cash of EUR 10,000 or more sent by post, courier or cargo shipments is disclosed only at a customs officer's request by the sender, recipient or their representative within 30 days - not a traveller border action.
procedures.applicability_zh: 每名自然人进出欧盟领域（跨外部边境）携带 10,000.00 欧及以上现金，或等值其他货币或其他支付工具的，有义务在边境海关向海关官员申报该金额（2026-03-26 新规则；表格适用 (EU) 2018/1672 号条例）。携带现金本身自由且不受金额限制。现金包括流通中或仍可兑换的钞票与铸币、不记名票据（支票、旅行支票、未载明收款人姓名的汇票/本票）、含金量至少 90% 的金币、含金量至少 99.5% 的金条/金粒/金块以及预付卡。现金申报表（Obrazac - prijava gotovine）可电子填写后发送至 operativno@carina.hr，或打印后递交海关官员，亦可在边境办理处当场填写，可用克罗地亚语或英语，空间不足可加附页。以邮政、快递或货运寄送的价值 1 万欧及以上的非随行现金，仅在海关官员要求时由寄件人、收件人或其代理在 30 天内披露——非旅客边境动作。
procedures.timing_en: When entering or leaving the EU with EUR 10,000 or more in cash, lodge the Cash Declaration with the customs officer at the border customs office - electronically by e-mail, in print, or completed on the spot at the border office.
procedures.timing_zh: 进出欧盟携带 1 万欧及以上现金时，向边境海关的海关官员递交现金申报表——可电子邮件发送、纸质递交，或在边境办理处当场填写。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出歐盟攜帶 1 萬歐元及以上現金的申報（2026-03-26 新規則）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 每名自然人進出歐盟領域（跨外部邊境）攜帶 10,000.00 歐及以上現金，或等值其他貨幣或其他支付工具的，有義務在邊境海關向海關官員申報該金額（2026-03-26 新規則；表格適用 (EU) 2018/1672 號條例）。攜帶現金本身自由且不受金額限制。現金包括流通中或仍可兌換的鈔票與鑄幣、不記名票據（支票、旅行支票、未載明收款人姓名的匯票/本票）、含金量至少 90% 的金幣、含金量至少 99.5% 的金條/金粒/金塊以及預付卡。現金申報表（Obrazac - prijava gotovine）可電子填寫後發送至 operativno@carina.hr，或列印後遞交海關官員，亦可在邊境辦理處當場填寫，可用克羅地亞語或英語，空間不足可加附頁。以郵政、快遞或貨運寄送的價值 1 萬歐及以上的非隨行現金，僅在海關官員要求時由寄件人、收件人或其代理在 30 天內披露——非旅客邊境動作。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 進出歐盟攜帶 1 萬歐及以上現金時，向邊境海關的海關官員遞交現金申報表——可電子郵件發送、紙質遞交，或在邊境辦理處當場填寫。

procedures.name_en: Written cash declaration upon request (Article 24, Foreign Exchange Act) for travel between Croatia and other EU member states
procedures.name_zh: 应要求书面现金申报（外汇业务法第 24 条）：克罗地亚与其他欧盟成员国之间旅行
procedures.agency: Carina — Carinska uprava (Croatian Customs Administration) and border police officers (Ministry of the Interior)
procedures.applicability_en: National cash controls under the Zakon o deviznom poslovanju (Foreign Exchange Act, Official Gazette NN 27/2026, published 18 March 2026, in force from the eighth day after publication, i.e. 26 March 2026, per its Article 57): natural persons entering Croatia from another EU member state, leaving Croatia to another member state, or having entered Croatia from another member state, who carry cash of EUR 10,000.00 or more, must declare it in writing on the form 'Obrazac za prijavu gotovine - članak 24.' (Cash Declaration Form - Article 24; EN5; new forms from 26 March 2026), which carries the data set of Article 3(2) of Regulation (EU) 2018/1672, in Croatian or English, with an additional sheet if needed - but only at the request of an authorized customs officer or police officer (Article 24(1) of the Act: 'ovlaštenog carinskog službenika ili policijskog službenika'; the Carina page renders the latter as border police officer), who hold control powers under the Act. The form is completed by the person personally, by hand. Under Article 24(2) of the Act the declaration obligation is not fulfilled if the data given is inaccurate or incomplete or if the cash is not made available for control; failure to declare upon request is a misdemeanour fined EUR 660.00 to 13,260.00 for a natural person (Article 43), and the cash may be temporarily retained (Article 26). This is a written declaration on request for movement between member states inside the EU; it is not an independent proactive obligation and must not be generalized into the EU external-border cash declaration duty, which uses the separate EN1 Cash Declaration under Article 3 of Regulation (EU) 2018/1672.
procedures.applicability_zh: 依《外汇业务法》（Zakon o deviznom poslovanju，官方公报 NN 27/2026，2026-03-18 刊布，依其第 57 条自刊布后第 8 日即 2026-03-26 生效）设立的国家现金管制：自另一欧盟成员国进入克罗地亚、从克罗地亚前往另一成员国、或已从另一成员国入境克罗地亚的自然人，携带 10,000.00 欧及以上现金的，须以“现金申报表——第 24 条”（Obrazac za prijavu gotovine - članak 24.；EN5；2026-03-26 新表格）书面申报，表格数据项为 (EU) 2018/1672 号条例第 3(2) 条所列，可用克罗地亚语或英语，空间不足可加附页——但仅在授权海关官员或警察官员（法第 24(1) 条原文 “ovlaštenog carinskog službenika ili policijskog službenika”，海关页表述为边境警察官员）提出要求时进行（两者依该法享有管制职权），表格由本人亲手填写。依第 24(2) 条，所给数据不实、不全或未将现金交由查验的，申报义务视为未履行；应要求而不申报属违法，自然人可处 660.00 至 13,260.00 欧罚款（第 43 条），现金并可被暂扣（第 26 条）。这是欧盟内部成员国之间移动的“应要求书面申报”，不是独立的主动申报义务，不得泛化为进出欧盟外部边境的现金申报义务（后者适用 (EU) 2018/1672 第 3 条的另一张 EN1 现金申报表）。
procedures.timing_en: Only upon request of an authorized customs officer or police officer (Article 24(1) of the Act; the Carina page words it as border police officer), when entering Croatia from another member state or leaving Croatia to another member state (or having so entered); the traveller then completes the Article 24 form personally, by hand. The Act was published in Narodne novine on 18 March 2026 and entered into force on 26 March 2026 (Article 57: the eighth day from publication).
procedures.timing_zh: 仅在授权海关官员或警察官员（法第 24(1) 条；海关页表述为边境警察官员）提出要求时办理：自另一成员国进入克罗地亚、从克罗地亚前往另一成员国（或已如此入境）之际，由旅客本人亲手填写第 24 条表格。该法 2026-03-18 刊布于官方公报、2026-03-26 生效（第 57 条：刊布后第 8 日）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 應要求書面現金申報（外匯業務法第 24 條）：克羅地亞與其他歐盟成員國之間旅行
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 依《外匯業務法》（Zakon o deviznom poslovanju，官方公報 NN 27/2026，2026-03-18 刊佈，依其第 57 條自刊佈後第 8 日即 2026-03-26 生效）設立的國家現金管制：自另一歐盟成員國進入克羅地亞、從克羅地亞前往另一成員國、或已從另一成員國入境克羅地亞的自然人，攜帶 10,000.00 歐及以上現金的，須以“現金申報表——第 24 條”（Obrazac za prijavu gotovine - članak 24.；EN5；2026-03-26 新表格）書面申報，表格資料項為 (EU) 2018/1672 號條例第 3(2) 條所列，可用克羅地亞語或英語，空間不足可加附頁——但僅在授權海關官員或警察官員（法第 24(1) 條原文 “ovlaštenog carinskog službenika ili policijskog službenika”，海關頁表述為邊境警察官員）提出要求時進行（兩者依該法享有管制職權），表格由本人親手填寫。依第 24(2) 條，所給資料不實、不全或未將現金交由查驗的，申報義務視為未履行；應要求而不申報屬違法，自然人可處 660.00 至 13,260.00 歐罰款（第 43 條），現金並可被暫扣（第 26 條）。這是歐盟內部成員國之間移動的“應要求書面申報”，不是獨立的主動申報義務，不得泛化為進出歐盟外部邊境的現金申報義務（後者適用 (EU) 2018/1672 第 3 條的另一張 EN1 現金申報表）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 僅在授權海關官員或警察官員（法第 24(1) 條；海關頁表述為邊境警察官員）提出要求時辦理：自另一成員國進入克羅地亞、從克羅地亞前往另一成員國（或已如此入境）之際，由旅客本人親手填寫第 24 條表格。該法 2026-03-18 刊佈於官方公報、2026-03-26 生效（第 57 條：刊佈後第 8 日）。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding traveller allowances on entering Gibraltar — UK-EU Gibraltar Treaty applied provisionally since 15 July 2026 (declare to the competent customs authority; Spain-UK agreement routing conditional)
procedures.name_zh: 进入直布罗陀超额物品申报——英欧直布罗陀条约自2026年7月15日起临时适用（向主管海关申报；西英协议路由系条件性规则）
procedures.agency: Current: the competent customs authority at the point of entry — the live HM Customs page requires travellers entering Gibraltar to go through a Red or Green Channel and to declare everything in excess of the duty free allowances obtained outside Gibraltar; the page does not expressly state that excess goods on every land/sea/air route are submitted to HM Customs Gibraltar, and directs travellers in doubt to the customs inquiry point (Custom House, Waterport — HM Customs Gibraltar; tel. 20078879). Conditional (Spain-UK travellers administrative agreement, BOE-A-2026-15670, para 3.3, applicable only from the UK-EU Treaty's entry into force): excess-goods declarations to the Spanish customs authorities, except travellers entering Gibraltar by land — to the UK customs authorities with respect to Gibraltar
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering Gibraltar by land, sea or air with goods in their personal luggage. Status of the legal basis (verified 2026-09-27): the UK-EU Treaty on Gibraltar applies provisionally since 15 July 2026 (HMGoG press release 705/2026); the Treaty on Gibraltar and the European Union Act 2026 is in force, with s.114 and Schedule 2 commenced on 15.7.2026 (LN.2026/148), and s.6(2) of that Act treating the Art. 336(2) Provisional Implementation Date as an 'Implementation Date'. Under s.114(2), goods carried by travellers in their personal luggage (as well as pets and cash) are subject to Annexes 22 and 23. Only goods in 'personal luggage' of 'non-commercial character' enter without the customs import processes and without transaction tax/excise, within the 'allowance' thresholds which HMGoG's consolidated FAQ states are applied as the GBP equivalents of: general goods EUR 430 by air/sea or EUR 300 by land (EUR 175 for travellers under 15 either way); tobacco 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 g of tobacco; alcohol 1 litre of spirits (>22%) or 2 litres of fortified/other alcohol (≤22%), plus 4 litres of still wine or 16 litres of beer. Goods in EXCESS of these thresholds, even if non-commercial, become subject to customs declaration and payment of transaction tax/excise (Treaty Act Sch.2 para 1(1)(f)); amounts within the thresholds do not trigger a declaration. The live HM Customs page (captured 2026-09-27) instructs travellers entering Gibraltar to go through a Red or Green Channel and to 'declare everything in excess of the duty free allowances', with selective checks in both channels for prohibited or restricted goods — drugs, firearms, ammunition, offensive weapons, explosives, fireworks, indecent or obscene material, fast motor launches, raw and worked ivory, rigid inflatable boats of six metres or more, cigarettes in commercial quantities — and directs travellers in doubt to the customs inquiry point (Custom House, Waterport; tel. 20078879). The page does not itself designate the authority that receives excess-goods declarations on each land/sea/air route; the currently verified obligation is only: on entering, go through the Red or Green Channel, declare goods in excess of the allowances to the competent customs authority, and ask customs on-site if in doubt (the page: 'If you are in any doubt, go to the customs inquiry point.'). Applicability caveat — Spain-UK administrative agreement on travellers (BOE-A-2026-15670): it entered into force on the date of the last signature (25 June 2026), but by its final provisions it is 'aplicable desde la fecha de entrada en vigor del acuerdo' — applicable only from the UK-EU Treaty's entry into force. Whether that point has been reached is not confirmed by any official statement: no official statement announces the Treaty's entry into force or the agreement's application (the 25 September 2026 release still speaks of 'provisional application'). Article 336(2) of the treaty required the Parties, before provisional application started, to notify each other that the administrative arrangements of Articles 251, 260 and 265 (among others) were 'in effect and have been fully implemented', so the provisional application running since 15 July 2026 — together with the 25 September 2026 statement that the new arrangements are in day-to-day operation — strongly indicates that those arrangements, including the Art. 265/Annex 22 travellers arrangements this agreement implements, operate in practice. The routing below is the agreement's agreed text; it appears to be operating in practice, but its application has not been officially confirmed: under the agreement, excess-goods declarations are presented, in all cases where necessary, to the Spanish customs authorities, EXCEPT travellers entering Gibraltar by land, who present them to the UK customs authorities with respect to Gibraltar, i.e. HM Customs Gibraltar (para 3.3). Spanish customs calculate and collect any EU customs duties due; other indirect taxes are settled by destination — VAT if the traveller is going to Spain, transaction tax if entering Gibraltar (paras 3.4, 4.3.1). For air/sea arrivals in Gibraltar from outside the EU customs territory, Union thresholds (Directive 2007/74/EC) apply where the traveller's destination is Spain and Gibraltar thresholds where it is Gibraltar (para 4.1.1). Declarations and payment of duties/taxes are handled at the two customs counters standing side by side in the airport Second Line Inspection Area (paras 6.2, 6.5-6.6); payment by electronic means is preferred (para 4.3.3). Airport/port flows are segregated with green and red channels (para 6.8). Above-threshold non-commercial goods may still be brought in: the traveller declares and pays, and tax paid at the place of purchase (transaction tax or VAT) can be refunded for above-threshold goods (para 4.4.1). Goods of commercial character carried by travellers entering or leaving by sea or air may be seized and subject to re-export, abandonment or destruction (para 4.3.1(b)(ii)); land-border travellers with commercial goods are informed of the Annex 19/21 procedures but given no assistance with them (para 4.3.1(b)(i)). The thresholds apply during the first 3 years of the treaty's application for EU-Gibraltar movements and then cease for movements from the EU into Gibraltar (FAQ; Technical Notice 86/2026). Caution: the HM Customs page's own quantitative allowance conditions (absence of at least 24 hours, not more than once in any calendar month, GBP 32 for other goods, no relief under 17 for tobacco/alcohol/perfume) are pre-treaty legacy wording and do not override the 2026 treaty thresholds; UK or EU mainland allowances must not be substituted for Gibraltar.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：经陆路、海路或空路进入直布罗陀并携带个人行李物品的旅客。法律依据状态（2026-09-27核定）：英欧直布罗陀条约自2026年7月15日起临时适用（直政府新闻稿705/2026）；《2026年直布罗陀与欧盟条约法》现行，第114条及附表2经LN.2026/148于2026年7月15日生效，该法第6(2)条将第336(2)条之“临时实施日”亦作为“实施日”。依第114(2)条，旅客个人行李所携物品（及宠物、现金）受附件22和23约束。仅“个人行李”中“非商业性质”物品在“免税额度”内可免办理进口海关手续、免缴交易税/消费税；额度据直政府综合FAQ以等值英镑适用：一般物品空/海运430欧元、陆运300欧元（未满15岁两种方式均为175欧元）；烟草：香烟200支或小雪茄100支或雪茄50支或烟草250克；酒类：烈酒（>22%）1升或强化酒/其他酒（≤22%）2升，另加静止葡萄酒4升或啤酒16升。超过上述额度（额度以内不触发申报）即使仍属非商业性质，也须办理海关申报并缴纳交易税/消费税（条约法附表2第1(1)(f)段）。直海关现行页面（2026-09-27捕获）要求进入直布罗陀的旅客走红/绿通道之一并“申报超过免税额度的一切物品”，两通道均对禁限物品实施抽查——毒品、枪械、弹药、攻击性武器、爆炸物、烟花、不雅或淫亵物品、高速摩托艇、原牙及加工象牙、六米及以上硬底充气艇、商业数量香烟——有疑问前往海关问询处（Custom House, Waterport；电话20078879）。该页未自行指定各陆/海/空路线超额物品申报的接收机关；当前仅证实如下义务：入境走红/绿通道之一，超额物品向主管海关申报，若不确定向现场海关问询（页原文 'If you are in any doubt, go to the customs inquiry point.'）。适用性警示——西英《旅客行政协议》（BOE-A-2026-15670）：该协议于最后一方签署日（2026年6月25日）生效，但其最终条款规定“自英欧条约生效之日起方可适用”（aplicable desde la fecha de entrada en vigor del acuerdo）。该时点是否已到，尚无官方声明确认：没有官方声明宣布条约已生效或该协议已适用（2026年9月25日政府稿仍称 provisional application）。条约第336(2)条要求双方在临时适用开始前互相通知第251、260、265条等行政安排已“in effect and have been fully implemented”，因此自2026年7月15日持续的临时适用——加上2026年9月25日关于新安排已日常运营的陈述——强烈表明这些安排，含本协议所实施的第265条/附件22旅客安排，已在实际运转。下述路由为协议已签署文本；实际运转迹象明确，但其是否已适用尚无官方确认：依该协议，超额物品申报在所有必要情形下向西班牙海关当局提交，唯独经陆路进入直布罗陀的旅客向“就直布罗陀而言的英国海关当局”，即直布罗陀皇家海关（HM Customs Gibraltar）提交（第3.3条）。应缴欧盟关税由西班牙海关计算征收；其他间接税按旅客目的地清缴——赴西班牙付增值税，进入直布罗陀付交易税（第3.4、4.3.1条）。自联盟关境外经海/空抵达直布罗陀者：目的地为西班牙适用联盟额度（第2007/74/EC号指令），目的地为直布罗陀适用直布罗陀额度（第4.1.1条）。申报及税费缴纳在机场“二级查验区”（Second Line Inspection Area）并排设置的两个海关柜台办理（第6.2、6.5-6.6条）；付款以电子方式为优先（第4.3.3条）。机场/港口旅客分流并设绿/红通道（第6.8条）。超额但非商业物品仍可携带入境：申报并缴税，购买地已纳的交易税或增值税可就有超额物品申请退还（第4.4.1条）。经海/空进出携带商业性质物品的旅客，物品可被扣押，并可被要求复出口、放弃或销毁（第4.3.1(b)(ii)条）；陆路携带商业物品的旅客仅获告知附件19/21程序、不予协助（第4.3.1(b)(i)条）。额度适用于条约适用最初3年内的欧盟—直布罗陀流动，期满后自欧盟进入直布罗陀不再适用（FAQ；第86/2026号技术通告）。注意：直海关页面自带的量化免税条件（离直至少24小时、每公历月不超过一次、其他物品32英镑、未满17岁烟草/酒类/香水不免税）为条约前旧文，不得据此覆盖2026年条约新额度；也不得用英国本土或欧盟本土额度替代直布罗陀额度。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in Gibraltar — go through the Red or Green Channel; declare goods in excess of the allowances to the competent customs authority at entry; if in doubt, ask customs on-site (inquiry point: Custom House, Waterport; tel. 20078879). The agreement text's Second Line Inspection Area counters apply only once the Spain-UK agreement is applicable.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达直布罗陀时——走红/绿通道之一；入境时向主管海关申报超额物品；若不确定，向现场海关问询（问询处：Custom House, Waterport，电话20078879）。协议文本的二级查验区柜台仅在西英协议可适用后生效。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進入直布羅陀超額物品申報——英歐直布羅陀條約自2026年7月15日起臨時適用（向主管海關申報；西英協議路由繫條件性規則）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：經陸路、海路或空路進入直布羅陀並攜帶個人行李物品的旅客。法律依據狀態（2026-09-27核定）：英歐直布羅陀條約自2026年7月15日起臨時適用（直政府新聞稿705/2026）；《2026年直布羅陀與歐盟條約法》現行，第114條及附表2經LN.2026/148於2026年7月15日生效，該法第6(2)條將第336(2)條之“臨時實施日”亦作為“實施日”。依第114(2)條，旅客個人行李所攜物品（及寵物、現金）受附件22和23約束。僅“個人行李”中“非商業性質”物品在“免稅額度”內可免辦理進口海關手續、免繳交易稅/消費稅；額度據直政府綜合FAQ以等值英鎊適用：一般物品空/海運430歐元、陸運300歐元（未滿15歲兩種方式均為175歐元）；菸草：香菸200支或小雪茄100支或雪茄50支或菸草250克；酒類：烈酒（>22%）1升或強化酒/其他酒（≤22%）2升，另加靜止葡萄酒4升或啤酒16升。超過上述額度（額度以內不觸發申報）即使仍屬非商業性質，也須辦理海關申報並繳納交易稅/消費稅（條約法附表2第1(1)(f)段）。直海關現行頁面（2026-09-27捕獲）要求進入直布羅陀的旅客走紅/綠通道之一併“申報超過免稅額度的一切物品”，兩通道均對禁限物品實施抽查——毒品、槍械、彈藥、攻擊性武器、爆炸物、煙花、不雅或淫褻物品、高速摩托艇、原牙及加工象牙、六米及以上硬底充氣艇、商業數量香菸——有疑問前往海關問詢處（Custom House, Waterport；電話20078879）。該頁未自行指定各陸/海/空路線超額物品申報的接收機關；當前僅證實如下義務：入境走紅/綠通道之一，超額物品向主管海關申報，若不確定向現場海關問詢（頁原文 'If you are in any doubt, go to the customs inquiry point.'）。適用性警示——西英《旅客行政協議》（BOE-A-2026-15670）：該協議於最後一方簽署日（2026年6月25日）生效，但其最終條款規定“自英歐條約生效之日起方可適用”（aplicable desde la fecha de entrada en vigor del acuerdo）。該時點是否已到，尚無官方聲明確認：沒有官方聲明宣佈條約已生效或該協議已適用（2026年9月25日政府稿仍稱 provisional application）。條約第336(2)條要求雙方在臨時適用開始前互相通知第251、260、265條等行政安排已“in effect and have been fully implemented”，因此自2026年7月15日持續的臨時適用——加上2026年9月25日關於新安排已日常營運的陳述——強烈表明這些安排，含本協議所實施的第265條/附件22旅客安排，已在實際運轉。下述路由為協議已簽署文本；實際運轉跡象明確，但其是否已適用尚無官方確認：依該協議，超額物品申報在所有必要情形下向西班牙海關當局提交，唯獨經陸路進入直布羅陀的旅客向“就直布羅陀而言的英國海關當局”，即直布羅陀皇家海關（HM Customs Gibraltar）提交（第3.3條）。應繳歐盟關稅由西班牙海關計算徵收；其他間接稅按旅客目的地清繳——赴西班牙付增值稅，進入直布羅陀付交易稅（第3.4、4.3.1條）。自聯盟關境外經海/空抵達直布羅陀者：目的地為西班牙適用聯盟額度（第2007/74/EC號指令），目的地為直布羅陀適用直布羅陀額度（第4.1.1條）。申報及稅費繳納在機場“二級查驗區”（Second Line Inspection Area）並排設置的兩個海關櫃檯辦理（第6.2、6.5-6.6條）；付款以電子方式為優先（第4.3.3條）。機場/港口旅客分流並設綠/紅通道（第6.8條）。超額但非商業物品仍可攜帶入境：申報並繳稅，購買地已納的交易稅或增值稅可就有超額物品申請退還（第4.4.1條）。經海/空進出攜帶商業性質物品的旅客，物品可被扣押，並可被要求復出口、放棄或銷燬（第4.3.1(b)(ii)條）；陸路攜帶商業物品的旅客僅獲告知附件19/21程序、不予協助（第4.3.1(b)(i)條）。額度適用於條約適用最初3年內的歐盟—直布羅陀流動，期滿後自歐盟進入直布羅陀不再適用（FAQ；第86/2026號技術通告）。注意：直海關頁面自帶的量化免稅條件（離直至少24小時、每公曆月不超過一次、其他物品32英鎊、未滿17歲菸草/酒類/香水不免稅）為條約前舊文，不得據此覆蓋2026年條約新額度；也不得用英國本土或歐盟本土額度替代直布羅陀額度。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達直布羅陀時——走紅/綠通道之一；入境時向主管海關申報超額物品；若不確定，向現場海關問詢（問詢處：Custom House, Waterport，電話20078879）。協議文本的二級查驗區櫃檯僅在西英協議可適用後生效。

procedures.name_en: Accompanied cash declaration of EUR 10,000 or more (threshold inclusive) when entering or leaving Gibraltar — Annex 23 / Imports and Exports Act 1986 Part VIIIA; Annex 23 Appendix 1 form and authority routing under the Spain-UK travellers agreement conditional
procedures.name_zh: 进出直布罗陀随身现金申报（总值达10,000欧元或以上，含本数）——附件23／《1986年进出口法》第VIIIA部；西英旅客行政协议下的附件23附录1表格与机关路由系条件性规则
procedures.agency: Current: HM Customs Gibraltar (Collector of Customs) under the in-force Imports and Exports Act 1986 Part VIIIA (s.91D competent authority; s.91E written declaration in approved form); allocation between Spanish customs authorities and UK customs authorities with respect to Gibraltar by direction and mode is the Spain-UK travellers agreement's conditional rule; declaration data transmitted to the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit (GFIU)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering or leaving Gibraltar, by air, sea or land, carrying accompanied cash of a value of EUR 10,000 or more (threshold inclusive; agreement text 'igual o superior a 10.000 euros'). Current domestic basis (verified 2026-09-27): the UK-EU Treaty applies provisionally since 15 July 2026 (HMGoG press release 705/2026); s.114(2) of the Treaty on Gibraltar and the European Union Act 2026 (in force 15.7.2026, LN.2026/148; s.6(2) treats the Provisional Implementation Date as an Implementation Date) subjects the entry and exit of cash to Annex 23. Part VIIIA of the Imports and Exports Act 1986 (ss.91C-91O) is in force and requires a declaration under Article 3 of the European Regulation (Regulation (EC) No 1889/2005 — accompanied cash of EUR 10,000 or more) to be made in writing in a form approved by the competent authority (s.91E); the Collector of Customs is the competent authority (s.91D); customs officers may require information and have search powers, and cash imported or exported without the required declaration may be seized and detained (ss.91F-91K); penalties are of such amount as the competent authority considers appropriate (s.91L — no fixed published amount); declaration information goes to the GFIU (s.91O). Applicability caveat — Spain-UK administrative agreement on travellers (BOE-A-2026-15670): it entered into force on the date of the last signature (25 June 2026), but by its final provisions it is 'aplicable desde la fecha de entrada en vigor del acuerdo' — applicable only from the UK-EU Treaty's entry into force; no official statement announces the Treaty's entry into force or the agreement's application (the 25 September 2026 release still speaks of 'provisional application'). Article 336(2) of the treaty required the Parties, before provisional application started, to notify each other that the administrative arrangements of Articles 251, 260 and 265 (among others) were 'in effect and have been fully implemented', so the provisional application running since 15 July 2026 strongly indicates those arrangements operate in practice. The rules below are the agreement's agreed text; they appear to be operating in practice, but their application has not been officially confirmed: the duty to declare accompanied cash and make it available for control, using the form set out in Appendix 1 of Annex 23 (para 4.5.1); declarations to the Spanish customs authorities — air/sea travellers intending to enter Spain immediately after arriving in Gibraltar (whether arriving from outside or from within the Union customs territory, the latter under Spanish national rules), and air/sea travellers intending to leave Gibraltar immediately after entering it from Spain, toward the Union or outside it (paras 4.5.2-4.5.3); declarations to the UK customs authorities with respect to Gibraltar (HM Customs Gibraltar) — air/sea travellers intending to enter Gibraltar immediately after arriving in Gibraltar by air or sea, and air/sea travellers leaving Gibraltar after having stayed there (para 4.5.4); land route between Gibraltar and Spain — two successive declarations in each direction: leaving Spain into Gibraltar, first to Spanish customs and then, on entering Gibraltar, to the UK customs authorities with respect to Gibraltar; leaving Gibraltar into Spain, first to the latter and then, on entering Spain, to Spanish customs (para 4.5.5). No routine checks or verifications of accompanied cash are carried out on travellers moving between Gibraltar and Spain — this does not remove the declaration duty and is without prejudice to Annex 23 art. 22(3) and any non-discriminatory checks by the Spanish authorities on Spanish territory (para 4.5.6). Information from declarations made to the UK authorities with respect to Gibraltar is transmitted to the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit under s.91O of the Imports and Exports Act 1986 (para 4.5.7). Caution: Part VIIIA still cross-refers to Regulation (EC) No 1889/2005 for its definitions, and s.2A (inserted by the Treaty on Gibraltar and the European Union Act 2026, in force 15 July 2026) makes the Act subject to the Treaty; until an official statement confirms that the agreement's application condition is met, the Annex 23 Appendix 1 form model and the dual-authority routing (including the double land-route declaration) are not in confirmed day-to-day use — the written-form requirement in force is that of s.91E, with forms approved by the Collector of Customs.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：经空路、海路或陆路进入或离开直布罗陀、携带总值达10,000欧元或以上（含10,000欧元本数，协议原文“igual o superior a 10.000 euros”）随身现金的旅客。现行本地法律依据（2026-09-27核定）：英欧条约自2026年7月15日起临时适用（直政府新闻稿705/2026）；《2026年直布罗陀与欧盟条约法》第114(2)条（经LN.2026/148于2026年7月15日生效；第6(2)条将临时实施日作为实施日）规定现金的进出受附件23约束。《1986年进出口法》第VIIIA部（第91C-91O条）现行有效，要求就欧洲条例（第1889/2005号（欧共体）条例——随身现金达10,000欧元或以上）第3条所指申报以书面、经主管当局核准的表格作出（第91E条）；海关关长（Collector of Customs）为主管当局（第91D条）；海关关员可要求提供信息并有搜查权，未申报即进出口的现金可被扣押扣留（第91F-91K条）；罚额由主管当局酌定（第91L条——无固定公布金额）；申报信息传送GFIU（第91O条）。适用性警示——西英《旅客行政协议》（BOE-A-2026-15670）：该协议于最后一方签署日（2026年6月25日）生效，但其最终条款规定自英欧条约生效之日起方可适用（aplicable desde la fecha de entrada en vigor del acuerdo）；尚无官方声明宣布条约已生效或该协议已适用（2026年9月25日政府稿仍称 provisional application）。条约第336(2)条要求双方在临时适用开始前互相通知第251、260、265条等行政安排已“in effect and have been fully implemented”，故自2026年7月15日持续的临时适用强烈表明这些安排已在实际运转。以下规则为协议已签署文本；实际运转迹象明确，但其是否已适用尚无官方确认：申报随身现金并供查验、使用附件23附录1所载表格的义务（第4.5.1条）；向西班牙海关当局申报——经海/空抵达直布罗陀后拟随即进入西班牙的旅客（无论来自联盟关境外或境内，后者系依西班牙本国规定），以及自西班牙进入直布罗陀后拟随即经海/空离开直布罗陀（前往联盟或联盟以外）的旅客（第4.5.2-4.5.3条）；向就直布罗陀而言的英国海关当局（直布罗陀皇家海关）申报——经海/空抵达直布罗陀后拟随即进入直布罗陀的旅客，以及在直布罗陀停留后拟经海/空离开直布罗陀的旅客（第4.5.4条）；直布罗陀—西班牙陆路——每一方向均须先后两次申报：自西班牙赴直布罗陀，先向西班牙海关申报，进入直布罗陀时再向就直布罗陀而言的英国海关申报；自直布罗陀赴西班牙，先向后者申报，进入西班牙时再向西班牙海关申报（第4.5.5条）。对直西之间通行旅客的随身现金不进行例行查验或核查——但这不免除申报义务，且不影响附件23第22(3)条及西班牙当局在西班牙境内实施的非歧视性查验（第4.5.6条）。向就直布罗陀而言的英国当局所作申报的信息，依《1986年进出口法》第91O条传送直布罗陀金融情报室（GFIU）（第4.5.7条）。注意：第VIIIA部定义仍援引第1889/2005号欧共体条例，第2A条（经《2026年直布罗陀与欧盟条约法》插入，2026年7月15日生效）使该法服从条约；在该协议适用条件获官方声明确认满足前，附件23附录1表格模型与双主管机关路由（含陆路两边先后申报）尚未确认投入日常使用——现行书面表格要求以第91E条（海关关长核准表格）为准。
procedures.timing_en: When entering or leaving Gibraltar — written declaration in the form approved by the Collector of Customs (s.91E); the agreement's Second Line Inspection Area counter and land-route two-side channels apply only once the Spain-UK agreement is applicable.
procedures.timing_zh: 进入或离开直布罗陀时——以海关关长核准的表格书面申报（第91E条）；协议的二级查验区柜台与陆路两边渠道仅在西英协议可适用后生效。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出直布羅陀隨身現金申報（總值達10,000歐元或以上，含本數）——附件23／《1986年進出口法》第VIIIA部；西英旅客行政協議下的附件23附錄1表格與機關路由繫條件性規則
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：經空路、海路或陸路進入或離開直布羅陀、攜帶總值達10,000歐元或以上（含10,000歐元本數，協議原文“igual o superior a 10.000 euros”）隨身現金的旅客。現行本地法律依據（2026-09-27核定）：英歐條約自2026年7月15日起臨時適用（直政府新聞稿705/2026）；《2026年直布羅陀與歐盟條約法》第114(2)條（經LN.2026/148於2026年7月15日生效；第6(2)條將臨時實施日作為實施日）規定現金的進出受附件23約束。《1986年進出口法》第VIIIA部（第91C-91O條）現行有效，要求就歐洲條例（第1889/2005號（歐共體）條例——隨身現金達10,000歐元或以上）第3條所指申報以書面、經主管當局核准的表格作出（第91E條）；海關關長（Collector of Customs）為主管當局（第91D條）；海關關員可要求提供資訊並有搜查權，未申報即進出口的現金可被扣押扣留（第91F-91K條）；罰額由主管當局酌定（第91L條——無固定公佈金額）；申報資訊傳送GFIU（第91O條）。適用性警示——西英《旅客行政協議》（BOE-A-2026-15670）：該協議於最後一方簽署日（2026年6月25日）生效，但其最終條款規定自英歐條約生效之日起方可適用（aplicable desde la fecha de entrada en vigor del acuerdo）；尚無官方聲明宣佈條約已生效或該協議已適用（2026年9月25日政府稿仍稱 provisional application）。條約第336(2)條要求雙方在臨時適用開始前互相通知第251、260、265條等行政安排已“in effect and have been fully implemented”，故自2026年7月15日持續的臨時適用強烈表明這些安排已在實際運轉。以下規則為協議已簽署文本；實際運轉跡象明確，但其是否已適用尚無官方確認：申報隨身現金並供查驗、使用附件23附錄1所載表格的義務（第4.5.1條）；向西班牙海關當局申報——經海/空抵達直布羅陀後擬隨即進入西班牙的旅客（無論來自聯盟關境外或境內，後者系依西班牙本國規定），以及自西班牙進入直布羅陀後擬隨即經海/空離開直布羅陀（前往聯盟或聯盟以外）的旅客（第4.5.2-4.5.3條）；向就直布羅陀而言的英國海關當局（直布羅陀皇家海關）申報——經海/空抵達直布羅陀後擬隨即進入直布羅陀的旅客，以及在直布羅陀停留後擬經海/空離開直布羅陀的旅客（第4.5.4條）；直布羅陀—西班牙陸路——每一方向均須先後兩次申報：自西班牙赴直布羅陀，先向西班牙海關申報，進入直布羅陀時再向就直布羅陀而言的英國海關申報；自直布羅陀赴西班牙，先向後者申報，進入西班牙時再向西班牙海關申報（第4.5.5條）。對直西之間通行旅客的隨身現金不進行例行查驗或核查——但這不免除申報義務，且不影響附件23第22(3)條及西班牙當局在西班牙境內實施的非歧視性查驗（第4.5.6條）。向就直布羅陀而言的英國當局所作申報的資訊，依《1986年進出口法》第91O條傳送直布羅陀金融情報室（GFIU）（第4.5.7條）。注意：第VIIIA部定義仍援引第1889/2005號歐共體條例，第2A條（經《2026年直布羅陀與歐盟條約法》插入，2026年7月15日生效）使該法服從條約；在該協議適用條件獲官方聲明確認滿足前，附件23附錄1表格模型與雙主管機關路由（含陸路兩邊先後申報）尚未確認投入日常使用——現行書面表格要求以第91E條（海關關長核准表格）為準。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 進入或離開直布羅陀時——以海關關長核准的表格書面申報（第91E條）；協議的二級查驗區櫃檯與陸路兩邊渠道僅在西英協議可適用後生效。

procedures.name_en: Cash items declaration when entering or leaving the EU through Greece
procedures.name_zh: 经希腊进出欧盟的随身（陪同）现金类物品申报
procedures.agency: Customs authorities of the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE), Greece
procedures.applicability_en: Applies only when entering or leaving the European Union through Greece; the AADE pages read do not extend this to travel between EU Member States. Any natural person carrying 'cash items' with a value equal to or greater than EUR 10,000.00 (threshold inclusive) must declare them to the competent (customs) authorities: cash in circulation (banknotes and coins), negotiable bearer instruments (e.g. cheques, promissory notes), coins containing at least 90% gold, and gold bars such as ingots, nuggets or lumps containing at least 99.5% gold. Under AADE Directive O. 3039/28-07-2025 (in force from 01/08/2025, 06:00), declarations of accompanied liquid assets of a value equal to or greater than EUR 10,000.00 must be submitted electronically through the AADE application at all border crossing points of the country; handwritten completion of the form is allowed only where the electronic application is unavailable. Non-compliance, or submission of an inaccurate or incomplete declaration, triggers an administrative fine equal to 25% of the undeclared amount (a Greek enforcement fine as stated on the AADE cash page and in the accompanied-cash FAQ).
procedures.applicability_zh: 仅在经希腊进入或离开欧盟时适用；所读 AADE 页面未将此扩展至欧盟成员国之间的旅行。随身携带"现金类物品"价值等于或大于 10,000.00 欧元（阈值含本数）的自然人须向主管（海关）机关申报：流通现金（纸币与硬币）、可转让无记名票据（如支票、本票）、含金量至少 90% 的金币、以及含金量至少 99.5% 的金条（金锭、天然金块等）。依据 AADE 第 O. 3039/2025-07-28 号指令（自 2025-08-01 06:00 起施行），价值等于或大于 10,000.00 欧元的随身流动资产申报须通过 AADE 电子应用在全国所有过境口岸提交；仅在电子应用不可用时方可手写填报。不申报或申报不实、不全，按未申报金额的 25% 处行政罚款（该罚则为 AADE 现金页面与随身现金 FAQ 所载的希腊执法罚则）。
procedures.timing_en: File electronically through the AADE application (digital path: Customs - e-Transactions - e-Customs - Liquid Assets Declaration); the application allows submission up to 15 days before travel; finalisation requires the traveller to appear before the customs authority, with verification of the travel document and counting/verification of the declared amount.
procedures.timing_zh: 通过 AADE 应用电子提交（数字路径：Τελωνεία – Ηλεκτρονικές συναλλαγές – e Customs – Δήλωση Ρευστών Διαθεσίμων，即"海关–电子交易–e Customs–流动资产申报"）；应用支持最早在旅行前 15 天提交；结案须旅客本人到海关当面出示，经旅行证件核验并清点核对申报金额。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 經希臘進出歐盟的隨身（陪同）現金類物品申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 僅在經希臘進入或離開歐盟時適用；所讀 AADE 頁面未將此擴展至歐盟成員國之間的旅行。隨身攜帶"現金類物品"價值等於或大於 10,000.00 歐元（閾值含本數）的自然人須向主管（海關）機關申報：流通現金（紙幣與硬幣）、可轉讓無記名票據（如支票、本票）、含金量至少 90% 的金幣、以及含金量至少 99.5% 的金條（金錠、天然金塊等）。依據 AADE 第 O. 3039/2025-07-28 號指令（自 2025-08-01 06:00 起施行），價值等於或大於 10,000.00 歐元的隨身流動資產申報須通過 AADE 電子應用在全國所有過境口岸提交；僅在電子應用不可用時方可手寫填報。不申報或申報不實、不全，按未申報金額的 25% 處行政罰款（該罰則為 AADE 現金頁面與隨身現金 FAQ 所載的希臘執法罰則）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 通過 AADE 應用電子提交（數字路徑：Τελωνεία – Ηλεκτρονικές συναλλαγές – e Customs – Δήλωση Ρευστών Διαθεσίμων，即"海關–電子交易–e Customs–流動資產申報"）；應用支持最早在旅行前 15 天提交；結案須旅客本人到海關當面出示，經旅行證件核驗並清點核對申報金額。

procedures.name_en: Written declaration for cross-border transportation of cash of €10,000 or more — Law N. XVIII of 8 October 2013, Art. 82 (formerly Art. 81), as amended by Law N. DCXIV of 7 November 2023
procedures.name_zh: 跨境携带1万欧元（含）及以上现金的书面申报——2013年10月8日第XVIII号法第82条（原第81条），经2023年11月7日第DCXIV号法修正
procedures.agency: Corpo della Gendarmeria dello Stato della Città del Vaticano (Gendarmerie Corps of Vatican City State), or offices authorized by the Autorità di Supervisione e Informazione Finanziaria (ASIF, Supervisory and Financial Information Authority)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: both entering and leaving Vatican City State ('in entrata o in uscita dallo Stato') — the duty is bidirectional. Anyone ('Chiunque') who effects a cross-border transportation, entering or leaving the State, of cash (denaro contante) to the value of €10,000 or more must make a written declaration at the offices of the Gendarmerie Corps or at offices authorized by the Supervisory and Financial Information Authority (the original 2013 text names the 'Autorità di Informazione Finanziaria', renamed 'Autorità di Supervisione e Informazione Finanziaria' in the current consolidated wording). The threshold 'pari o superiore a 10.000 euro' is inclusive: exactly €10,000 already triggers the duty. The declaration includes: the declarant's identification data; the particulars of the owner and of the recipient of the cash; the amount and nature of the cash; its origin and destination; the itinerary followed; and the means of transport used. The obligation is not satisfied if the information provided is inaccurate or incomplete. Sanctions (Art. 86 as renumbered, formerly Art. 85): in case of a false, omitted or incomplete declaration the holder must rectify or complete it and incurs an administrative pecuniary sanction of 10% to 40% of the sums possessed exceeding the €10,000 limit; the Gendarmerie may, at the time the violation is contested, seize up to 40% of the excess sums as a guarantee. Scope: this is Vatican City State law on the physical cross-border transportation of cash carried by the traveller; it is not an Italian or EU customs regime, and obligations arising for postal or commercial channels are not addressed here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：进入或离开梵蒂冈城邦均可触发（'in entrata o in uscita dallo Stato'）——该义务为双向。任何人（'Chiunque'）跨境运送、即进入或离开该城邦时携带价值 10,000 欧元（含）及以上的现金（denaro contante），必须在宪兵部队（Gendarmeria）办公室或监督与金融信息局（ASIF；2013年原文称'Autorità di Informazione Finanziaria'，现行合并文本称'Autorità di Supervisione e Informazione Finanziaria'）授权的办公室递交书面申报。门槛'pari o superiore a 10.000 euro'含本数：恰为 10,000 欧元即触发义务。申报内容包括：申报人身份资料；现金所有人与接收人的概况；现金金额与性质；来源与去向；所经路线；所用运输工具。所提供资料不准确或不完整的，义务即未满足。罚则（改号后第86条，原第85条）：申报虚假、遗漏或不完整的，持有人须更正或补全申报，并被处超出 10,000 欧元限额部分金额 10%至40%的行政罚款；宪兵部队可在指控违规时扣押超额部分至多 40%的款项作为担保。范围说明：这是梵蒂冈城邦关于旅客随身跨境携带现金的本国法律，不是意大利或欧盟海关规则；邮寄或商业渠道产生的义务此处不作说明。
procedures.timing_en: Under Law N. XVIII, Art. 82 as amended by Law N. DCXIV of 2023, anyone carrying €10,000 or more across the border, in either direction (entering or leaving the State), must file a written declaration at the Gendarmerie offices or at offices authorized by ASIF. Whether the declaration is to be filed before or at the moment of the border crossing is not stated in the published official texts.
procedures.timing_zh: 依法（2013年第XVIII号法第82条，经2023年第DCXIV号法修正），进入或离开梵蒂冈城邦任一方向携带 10,000 欧元（含）及以上现金，均须向宪兵部队办公室或 ASIF 授权办公室递交书面申报。书面申报应在过境之前还是过境当时递交，已公布的官方文本未作规定。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境攜帶1萬歐元（含）及以上現金的書面申報——2013年10月8日第XVIII號法第82條（原第81條），經2023年11月7日第DCXIV號法修正
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：進入或離開梵蒂岡城邦均可觸發（'in entrata o in uscita dallo Stato'）——該義務為雙向。任何人（'Chiunque'）跨境運送、即進入或離開該城邦時攜帶價值 10,000 歐元（含）及以上的現金（denaro contante），必須在憲兵部隊（Gendarmeria）辦公室或監督與金融資訊局（ASIF；2013年原文稱'Autorità di Informazione Finanziaria'，現行合併文本稱'Autorità di Supervisione e Informazione Finanziaria'）授權的辦公室遞交書面申報。門檻'pari o superiore a 10.000 euro'含本數：恰為 10,000 歐元即觸發義務。申報內容包括：申報人身份資料；現金所有人與接收人的概況；現金金額與性質；來源與去向；所經路線；所用運輸工具。所提供資料不準確或不完整的，義務即未滿足。罰則（改號後第86條，原第85條）：申報虛假、遺漏或不完整的，持有人須更正或補全申報，並被處超出 10,000 歐元限額部分金額 10%至40%的行政罰款；憲兵部隊可在指控違規時扣押超額部分至多 40%的款項作為擔保。範圍說明：這是梵蒂岡城邦關於旅客隨身跨境攜帶現金的本國法律，不是意大利或歐盟海關規則；郵寄或商業渠道產生的義務此處不作說明。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 依法（2013年第XVIII號法第82條，經2023年第DCXIV號法修正），進入或離開梵蒂岡城邦任一方向攜帶 10,000 歐元（含）及以上現金，均須向憲兵部隊辦公室或 ASIF 授權辦公室遞交書面申報。書面申報應在過境之前還是過境當時遞交，已公佈的官方文本未作規定。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of accompanied cash and equivalent instruments when entering or leaving Italy (EUR 10,000 or more)
procedures.name_zh: 进出意大利随身现金及等效工具申报（满1万欧元及以上，dichiarazione di denaro contante al seguito）
procedures.agency: Agenzia delle Dogane e dei Monopoli (ADM)
procedures.applicability_en: Transporting accompanied cash (denaro contante) or equivalent instruments (valori assimilati: bearer-negotiable instruments and assets used as highly liquid stores of value, e.g. gold) with a combined total of EUR 10,000 or more ('pari o superiori a 10.000 euro' — the threshold includes exactly EUR 10,000) requires a declaration when entering or leaving Italy. The duty is two-directional and covers both country groups, per the Carta doganale (Edizione Agosto 2026): section 2.2 'La misura si applica a tutti i movimenti da e verso i paesi UE' (all movements to and from EU member states — Italy's own intra-EU rule, going beyond the EU external-border regime); section 3.2 states the same for 'tutti i movimenti da e verso paesi extracomunitari' (non-EU countries, matching Reg. (UE) 2018/1672). The ADM FAQ confirms: 'La misura si applica a tutti i movimenti da e per Paesi UE ed extra UE'. Below EUR 10,000 in total, transport is free. The official form 'Modello di dichiarazione (denaro al seguito)' (Art. 3 Regolamento (UE) 2018/1672; D.Lgs. 195/2008) offers four situations in section 1 — entry into / exit from the EU and entry into / exit from Italy — corroborating the four-way scope. This corrects the previous v18 entry, which wrongly limited the duty to arrival only; the EU-level 2009 EC leaflet linked by ADM — superseded historical background, retained as a source for provenance only and supporting nothing — covers only the EU external border and itself notes that member states keep separate intra-Community rules, so it cannot narrow the national scope.
procedures.applicability_zh: 随身携带现金（denaro contante）或等效工具（valori assimilati：无记名可转让票据、作为高流动性价值储备的资产，如黄金），总额“pari o superiori a 10.000 euro”（满1万欧元即触发，含恰好1万欧元）的，进入或离开意大利均须申报。依据2026年8月版《Carta doganale per chi viaggia》，义务双向适用且覆盖两类方向：第2.2节原文“La misura si applica a tutti i movimenti da e verso i paesi UE”（适用于与欧盟成员国之间的全部流动，即意大利本国的欧盟内申报规则，超出欧盟外部边界制度范围）；第3.2节对非欧盟国家同样规定“a tutti i movimenti da e verso paesi extracomunitari”（与欧盟第2018/1672号条例一致）。ADM FAQ 亦确认：“La misura si applica a tutti i movimenti da e per Paesi UE ed extra UE”。总额低于1万欧元的携带自由。官方表格《Modello di dichiarazione (denaro al seguito)》（欧盟条例2018/1672第3条；意大利D.Lgs. 195/2008）第1节“Situazione”并列四种情形——进入/离开欧盟、进入/离开意大利——印证四向适用。此修正v18旧记录仅限入境的错误；ADM同页链接的2009年欧盟委员会传单（已过时的历史背景，仅作来源存档保留、不证明现行义务）只覆盖欧盟外部边界且本身提示成员国另有欧盟内规则，不能用以收窄本国义务范围。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of entering or leaving Italy, complete, sign and deposit the declaration exclusively at a customs office — Carta doganale §§2.2/3.2: 'compilare una dichiarazione, da sottoscrivere e depositare esclusivamente presso gli uffici doganali al momento dell’entrata nello Stato o in uscita dallo stesso'. The model form is downloadable from the ADM Carta doganale page ('Modello per la dichiarazione di trasferimento di denaro contante') and from the Modulistica section of adm.gov.it (ADM FAQ); it requires the carrier's dated signature (form section 8). No electronic filing channel is stated in the current sources. Non-, incorrect or incomplete declaration is a currency-law violation carrying administrative seizure of part of the sum and administrative sanctions (August 2026 Charter ladder).
procedures.timing_zh: 在进入或离开意大利之时，填写、签署申报表并“仅”向海关办事机构提交——2026年8月版Carta doganale第2.2/3.2节原文：“compilare una dichiarazione, da sottoscrivere e depositare esclusivamente presso gli uffici doganali al momento dell’entrata nello Stato o in uscita dallo stesso”。表格模板可从ADM“Carta doganale”页面（“Modello per la dichiarazione di trasferimento di denaro contante”）及 adm.gov.it 表格（Modulistica）栏目下载（ADM FAQ），表格第8节要求运输人注明日期并签字。现行原始文件未提供电子申报渠道。不申报或申报不实/不完整构成外汇管理违规，面临部分行政扣押与行政罚款（按2026年8月版Carta的阶梯规定）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出意大利隨身現金及等效工具申報（滿1萬歐元及以上，dichiarazione di denaro contante al seguito）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 隨身攜帶現金（denaro contante）或等效工具（valori assimilati：無記名可轉讓票據、作為高流動性價值儲備的資產，如黃金），總額“pari o superiori a 10.000 euro”（滿1萬歐元即觸發，含恰好1萬歐元）的，進入或離開意大利均須申報。依據2026年8月版《Carta doganale per chi viaggia》，義務雙向適用且覆蓋兩類方向：第2.2節原文“La misura si applica a tutti i movimenti da e verso i paesi UE”（適用於與歐盟成員國之間的全部流動，即意大利本國的歐盟內申報規則，超出歐盟外部邊界制度範圍）；第3.2節對非歐盟國家同樣規定“a tutti i movimenti da e verso paesi extracomunitari”（與歐盟第2018/1672號條例一致）。ADM FAQ 亦確認：“La misura si applica a tutti i movimenti da e per Paesi UE ed extra UE”。總額低於1萬歐元的攜帶自由。官方表格《Modello di dichiarazione (denaro al seguito)》（歐盟條例2018/1672第3條；意大利D.Lgs. 195/2008）第1節“Situazione”並列四種情形——進入/離開歐盟、進入/離開意大利——印證四向適用。此修正v18舊記錄僅限入境的錯誤；ADM同頁連結的2009年歐盟委員會傳單（已過時的歷史背景，僅作來源存檔保留、不證明現行義務）只覆蓋歐盟外部邊界且本身提示成員國另有歐盟內規則，不能用以收窄本國義務範圍。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在進入或離開意大利之時，填寫、簽署申報表並“僅”向海關辦事機構提交——2026年8月版Carta doganale第2.2/3.2節原文：“compilare una dichiarazione, da sottoscrivere e depositare esclusivamente presso gli uffici doganali al momento dell’entrata nello Stato o in uscita dallo stesso”。表格模板可從ADM“Carta doganale”頁面（“Modello per la dichiarazione di trasferimento di denaro contante”）及 adm.gov.it 表格（Modulistica）欄目下載（ADM FAQ），表格第8節要求運輸人註明日期並簽字。現行原始文件未提供電子申報渠道。不申報或申報不實/不完整構成外匯管理違規，面臨部分行政扣押與行政罰款（按2026年8月版Carta的階梯規定）。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration to the Comptroller of Customs
procedures.name_zh: 向海关总监申报现金
procedures.agency: Malta Tax & Customs Administration (MTCA), Office of the Comptroller of Customs
procedures.applicability_en: Any person entering, leaving or transiting Malta and carrying a sum equivalent to EUR 10,000 or more in cash (or its equivalent in other currencies, including commodities used as highly-liquid stores of value) must declare it to the Comptroller of Customs (SL 233.07). Cash is defined in Article 2 of Regulation (EU) 2018/1672 as currency, bearer-negotiable instruments, commodities used as highly-liquid stores of value, and prepaid cards. The specific EU Cash Declaration Form must be used. Separately, unaccompanied cash of EUR 10,000 or more (postal/freight) must be declared to the Commissioner by the sender or recipient within 30 days of a customs request for disclosure; this is a separate requirement, distinct from the declaration travellers make at the border when carrying cash themselves.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何人在进入、离开或过境马耳他时携带等于或超过 1 万欧元（或等值外币，含高流动性价值储藏商品）的现金，须向海关总监（Comptroller of Customs）申报（SL 233.07）。现金依 (EU) 2018/1672 第 2 条定义，含钞币、不记名可转让票据、高流动性价值储藏商品与预付卡。必须使用指定的欧盟现金申报统一表格。另外，非随行（邮寄/货运）现金 ≥1 万欧元由寄件人或收件人在海关（Commissioner）要求披露后 30 天内申报；这是另一项单独的要求，与旅客随身携带现金出入境时的申报分开。
procedures.timing_en: When entering, leaving or transiting Malta with EUR 10,000 or more in cash, declare to Customs using the specific EU Cash Declaration Form; the form comes in EU and Non-EU versions, with additional sheets.
procedures.timing_zh: 在进入、离开或过境马耳他携带 ≥1 万欧元现金时，使用指定的欧盟现金申报统一表格向海关申报；该表格分 EU 与非 EU 版本，另有附页。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 向海關總監申報現金
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何人在進入、離開或過境馬耳他時攜帶等於或超過 1 萬歐元（或等值外幣，含高流動性價值儲藏商品）的現金，須向海關總監（Comptroller of Customs）申報（SL 233.07）。現金依 (EU) 2018/1672 第 2 條定義，含鈔幣、不記名可轉讓票據、高流動性價值儲藏商品與預付卡。必須使用指定的歐盟現金申報統一表格。另外，非隨行（郵寄/貨運）現金 ≥1 萬歐元由寄件人或收件人在海關（Commissioner）要求披露後 30 天內申報；這是另一項單獨的要求，與旅客隨身攜帶現金出入境時的申報分開。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在進入、離開或過境馬耳他攜帶 ≥1 萬歐元現金時，使用指定的歐盟現金申報統一表格向海關申報；該表格分 EU 與非 EU 版本，另有附頁。

procedures.name_en: Border declaration of cash and bearer payment instruments of EUR 10,000 or more
procedures.name_zh: 出入境携带1万欧元及以上现金或无记名支付工具的申报
procedures.agency: Uprava carina Crne Gore (Customs Administration of Montenegro)
procedures.applicability_en: Every traveller — resident or non-resident of Montenegro, including ship and aircraft crew — who enters or leaves Montenegro by road, rail, sea or air carrying cash, cheques, bearer securities, precious metals or precious stones worth in total EUR 10,000 or more (exactly EUR 10,000 included; other currencies and other payment instruments at the equivalent value) must declare it to the customs authority at each entry and each exit; persons carrying payment instruments for a company or for another natural person are also covered.
procedures.applicability_zh: 凡经公路、铁路、海运或空运出入黑山的旅客——不论黑山居民或非居民，含船舶与航空机组人员——携带现金、支票、无记名有价证券、贵金属或宝石，总额达1万欧元或以上（恰为1万欧元亦须申报，其他货币及其他支付工具按等值折算）者，每次入境或出境均须向海关申报；替法人或其他自然人携带支付工具者同样负有申报义务。
procedures.timing_en: At the border crossing point — the place of entry into or exit from Montenegro — on each entry and each exit: the traveller reports to the customs authority and completes/submits the Prijava (declaration form), which border customs posts must keep available to passengers on both the entry and the exit side, and presents documents on the origin of the funds for the customs check.
procedures.timing_zh: 于每次入境及每次出境时，在黑山入境或出境地点的边境口岸办理：旅客向海关报告并填写/提交申报表（Prijava，边境海关在入境侧与出境侧均须向旅客备置表格），并按海关查验要求出示资金来源文件。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入境攜帶1萬歐元及以上現金或無記名支付工具的申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 凡經公路、鐵路、海運或空運出入黑山的旅客——不論黑山居民或非居民，含船舶與航空機組人員——攜帶現金、支票、無記名有價證券、貴金屬或寶石，總額達1萬歐元或以上（恰為1萬歐元亦須申報，其他貨幣及其他支付工具按等值折算）者，每次入境或出境均須向海關申報；替法人或其他自然人攜帶支付工具者同樣負有申報義務。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 於每次入境及每次出境時，在黑山入境或出境地點的邊境口岸辦理：旅客向海關報告並填寫/提交申報表（Prijava，邊境海關在入境側與出境側均須向旅客備置表格），並按海關查驗要求出示資金來源文件。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration when entering or leaving the EU
procedures.name_zh: 入出境欧盟现金申报
procedures.agency: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira (AT)
procedures.applicability_en: If you enter or leave the European Union with EUR 10,000 or more, or the equivalent amount in another currency, you must declare the cash to Customs — a mandatory EU rule to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing (Regulation (EU) 2018/1672, implemented in Portugal by Decreto-Lei n.º 82/2024 of 31 October; declaration form templates under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776). In Portugal, cash declarations are handled by the Tax and Customs Authority (Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira – AT) through Customs services. The duty arises when you carry EUR 10,000 or more through an external EU border when entering or leaving the EU, including airports and ports in Portugal; movements between Portugal and other EU countries are not EU external-border crossings and do not trigger this declaration. Declare all cash carried: banknotes and coins; negotiable bearer instruments such as traveller's cheques, personal cheques, money orders and promissory notes; gold coins with a gold content of at least 90%; gold bars, nuggets or clumps with a gold content of at least 99.5%. The February 2026 AT guide states the same duty in Portuguese: travellers who enter EU territory, or leave it, carrying EUR 10,000 or more must declare it to Customs (Alfândega). You must complete the EU Cash Declaration Form, stating the amount of cash carried, the source of the cash (for example savings or sale of property), the intended use (for example purchase of goods or investment), and the identification of the owner and the bearer when they are different persons. Unaccompanied cash of EUR 10,000 or more sent by post, freight or courier is a separate cash disclosure, not this traveller procedure: Customs authorities may request it when detected, and if requested the recipient, sender or an appointed representative must lodge it within 30 days. Failing to declare, or providing false or incomplete information, may lead to retention or seizure of the cash and to fines.
procedures.applicability_zh: 进入或离开欧盟时携带 1 万欧元或以上现金（或等值外币），须向海关申报——这是欧盟防止洗钱和恐怖融资的强制规则（欧盟 2018/1672 号条例，葡萄牙经 2024 年 10 月 31 日第 82/2024 号法令实施；申报表模板见欧盟 2021/776 号实施条例）。葡萄牙的现金申报由税务海关总局（Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira – AT）通过海关办理。义务在经欧盟外部边界进入或离开欧盟、携带 1 万欧元或以上时触发，包括经葡萄牙的机场和港口；葡萄牙与其他欧盟国家之间的移动不属于欧盟外部边界穿越，不触发本申报。须申报携带的全部现金：纸币和硬币；无记名可转让票据，如旅行支票、个人支票、汇票和本票；含金量至少 90% 的金币；含金量至少 99.5% 的金条、天然金块或金块。AT 2026 年 2 月指南以葡文载明同一义务：进入或离开欧盟领土时随身携带 1 万欧元及以上的旅客，须向海关（Alfândega）申报。须填写欧盟统一现金申报表，载明所携现金金额、现金来源（例如储蓄或出售房产）、拟用途（例如购买商品或投资），以及所有人与携带人不同时两者的身份。经邮递、货运或快递寄送的 1 万欧元及以上非随身现金属独立的现金披露，不属本旅客程序：海关查获时可要求提交，被要求时由收件人、寄件人或其委托代表在 30 日内办理。不申报或提供虚假、不完整信息，可导致现金被扣留或没收并处以罚款。
procedures.timing_en: At the external EU border when entering or leaving: lodge the cash declaration at the customs office at the external EU border where you are entering or leaving, or complete the Cash Declaration on Portal das Finanças beforehand for the money you are carrying, or will carry; at Portuguese airports go to the Red Channel (Goods to Declare) and inform a customs officer on the spot.
procedures.timing_zh: 进入或离开欧盟时在欧盟外部边界办理：向进出所经海关办事处递交现金申报，或事先在 Portal das Finanças 网站填写 Cash Declaration（适用于正携带或将携带的现金）；在葡萄牙机场走红通道（Goods to Declare）当场告知海关关员。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入出境歐盟現金申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 進入或離開歐盟時攜帶 1 萬歐元或以上現金（或等值外幣），須向海關申報——這是歐盟防止洗錢和恐怖融資的強制規則（歐盟 2018/1672 號條例，葡萄牙經 2024 年 10 月 31 日第 82/2024 號法令實施；申報表模板見歐盟 2021/776 號實施條例）。葡萄牙的現金申報由稅務海關總局（Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira – AT）通過海關辦理。義務在經歐盟外部邊界進入或離開歐盟、攜帶 1 萬歐元或以上時觸發，包括經葡萄牙的機場和港口；葡萄牙與其他歐盟國家之間的移動不屬於歐盟外部邊界穿越，不觸發本申報。須申報攜帶的全部現金：紙幣和硬幣；無記名可轉讓票據，如旅行支票、個人支票、匯票和本票；含金量至少 90% 的金幣；含金量至少 99.5% 的金條、天然金塊或金塊。AT 2026 年 2 月指南以葡文載明同一義務：進入或離開歐盟領土時隨身攜帶 1 萬歐元及以上的旅客，須向海關（Alfândega）申報。須填寫歐盟統一現金申報表，載明所攜現金金額、現金來源（例如儲蓄或出售房產）、擬用途（例如購買商品或投資），以及所有人與攜帶人不同時兩者的身份。經郵遞、貨運或快遞寄送的 1 萬歐元及以上非隨身現金屬獨立的現金披露，不屬本旅客程序：海關查獲時可要求提交，被要求時由收件人、寄件人或其委託代表在 30 日內辦理。不申報或提供虛假、不完整資訊，可導致現金被扣留或沒收並處以罰款。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 進入或離開歐盟時在歐盟外部邊界辦理：向進出所經海關辦事處遞交現金申報，或事先在 Portal das Finanças 網站填寫 Cash Declaration（適用於正攜帶或將攜帶的現金）；在葡萄牙機場走紅通道（Goods to Declare）當場告知海關關員。

procedures.name_en: Red/green channel declaration of goods
procedures.name_zh: 红绿通道商品申报
procedures.agency: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira (AT)
procedures.applicability_en: On arrival at a Portuguese airport travellers choose one of two customs channels. Green channel (Nothing to Declare) requires all of: no luggage, or luggage within customs duty and allowance limits, and no goods whose circulation is prohibited or restricted. Red channel (Goods to Declare) is used if you do not meet the conditions of the green channel, if you are unsure whether you must declare goods (when in doubt, choose the red channel), or if you are a crew or staff member; luggage selection for inspection is random and travellers must present luggage and contents whenever Customs officers request. Travellers from third countries may carry tobacco and alcohol duty- and tax-free in personal baggage up to (no exemption under 17): 200 cigarettes, or 100 cigarillos or cigars of at most 3 g per unit, or 50 cigars, or 250 g smoking tobacco — or a proportional assortment of these; 1 litre of spirits or 2 litres of intermediate products, plus 4 litres of table wine and 16 litres of beer. Other tobacco products enjoy an excise (IEC) franchise for travellers from third countries, third territories and EU member states alike: snuff 250 g, chewing tobacco 250 g, heated tobacco 20 g, e-cigarette refill liquid 30 ml, nicotine pouches 20 g. Medicines up to the quantity corresponding to personal needs, accompanied by the medical prescription. Other non-commercial goods from third countries are covered by the customs and fiscal franchise up to a global value of EUR 300 (road or rail travellers, and private aviation or recreational navigation), EUR 430 (air or sea travellers), EUR 150 (travellers under 15) or EUR 200 (crew). For crews travelling in the exercise of their professional activity, Article 6.º of the regime annexed to Article 116.º of Lei n.º 64-A/2008 applies those same exemptions with the global value capped at EUR 200 per crew member and tobacco capped by Mapa II: 80 cigarettes, or 20 cigarillos (cigars of at most 3 g each), or 10 cigars, or 50 g of smoking tobacco; no assortment rule is written for Mapa II (the proportional-mixing provision of Artigo 5.º n.º 3 covers Mapa I only), so whether crew tobacco categories may be proportionally combined is not stated in the law; Mapa II lists tobacco only, so there is no separate crew alcohol allowance — crew alcohol stays within the standard quantities above, which, like tobacco, are unavailable to travellers under 17. Goods beyond the franchise are declared through the red channel to the customs officers; the guide also defines a flat-rate customs charge (direito forfetário) of 2.5% on the global value of goods not exceeding EUR 700. From another EU country, tobacco and alcoholic beverages may be carried up to 800 cigarettes / 400 cigarillos / 200 cigars / 1 kg smoking tobacco and 10 litres of spirits or 20 litres of intermediate products / 90 litres of wine (of which at most 60 litres sparkling) / 110 litres of beer, provided excise duty was paid in the country of purchase and the limits are respected — in those cases no additional excise duty is due in Portugal (traveller exemption regime anchored in Artigo 116.º da Lei n.º 64-A/2008, transposing Council Directive 2007/74/EC, and Artigos 6.º e 61.º do Código dos Impostos Especiais de Consumo). Prohibited or restricted imports include drugs and drug precursors, radioactive materials, offensive weapons, firearms, explosives and ammunition, counterfeit goods, protected species of plants and animals and their parts or derivatives, foodstuffs and animal-origin products, plant products including fruits and seeds, and pets of no commercial value with their feed. Cash of EUR 10,000 or more is declared separately (see pt-cash-declaration), using the same red channel at airports.
procedures.applicability_zh: 抵达葡萄牙机场时，旅客在两种海关通道中选择其一。绿通道（无须申报）须同时满足：无行李，或行李在关税及免税限额之内，且不携带流通被禁止或受限制的物品。红通道（申报物品）适用于：不满足绿通道条件；不确定是否须申报（有疑问即走红通道）；或属机组、工作人员；行李抽查随机进行，海关关员要求时旅客必须出示行李及内容物。自第三国来的旅客个人行李中的烟酒免税限量（17 岁以下无免税）：香烟 200 支，或每支不超过 3 克的小雪茄/雪茄 100 支，或雪茄 50 支，或吸烟用烟丝 250 克——可按比例混搭；烈酒 1 升或中间产品 2 升，另加佐餐葡萄酒 4 升、啤酒 16 升。其他烟草制品对来自第三国、第三领土及欧盟成员国的旅客同样享受消费税（IEC）免税：鼻烟 250 克、嚼烟 250 克、加热烟草 20 克、电子烟补充液 30 毫升、尼古丁袋 20 克。药品可携个人所需数量并附医生处方。自第三国带入的其他非商业商品，海关及税收免税按总值计：陆路或铁路旅客以及私人航空或休闲航行 300 欧，空运或海运旅客 430 欧，15 岁以下旅客 150 欧，机组 200 欧。机组人员执行职务旅行时，依第 64-A/2008 号法律第 116 条附件制度第 6 条适用同样的免税，但总值以每名机组 200 欧为限，烟草以 Mapa II 为限：香烟 80 支，或小雪茄（每支不超过 3 克的雪茄）20 支，或雪茄 10 支，或吸烟用烟丝 50 克；Mapa II 未写混搭规则（第 5 条第 3 款比例混搭明文仅指 Mapa I），机组烟草各品类能否按比例组合无明文规定；Mapa II 仅列烟草，故无独立的机组酒精限额——机组酒精仍受上文一般数量限制，且与烟草一样，17 岁以下旅客不适用。超出免税额的商品走红通道向海关关员申报；指南另规定总额不超过 700 欧的商品可按 2.5% 单一税率征收从量关税（direito forfetário）。自欧盟其他国家来葡，烟草和酒精饮料在购买国已缴消费税且不超限额的前提下可携：香烟 800 支/小雪茄 400 支/雪茄 200 支/烟丝 1 公斤，烈酒 10 升或中间产品 20 升/葡萄酒 90 升（其中起泡酒至多 60 升）/啤酒 110 升——此时葡萄牙不再补征消费税（旅客免税制度的法律依据为第 64-A/2008 号法律第 116 条，转化欧盟理事会第 2007/74/EC 号指令，另见《特别消费税法典》第 6 条及第 61 条）。禁止或受限制进口的物品包括：毒品及毒品前体、放射性材料、攻击性武器、枪械、爆炸物及弹药、假冒商品、受保护的动植物物种及其部分或衍生物、食品及动物源性产品、植物产品包括水果和种子、无商业价值的宠物及其饲料。1 万欧元及以上现金另行申报（见 pt-cash-declaration），在机场同样走红通道。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival at the Portuguese airport: pass the red channel and inform the customs officers when carrying goods to declare; crew and staff members always use the red channel. Both web pages re-fetched and verified on 2026-09-27; the AT guide is dated February 2026.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达葡萄牙机场时：携带须申报物品的旅客走红通道并告知海关关员；机组及工作人员一律走红通道。两个网页均于 2026-09-27 重新直取核实；AT 指南标注 2026 年 2 月。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 紅綠通道商品申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 抵達葡萄牙機場時，旅客在兩種海關通道中選擇其一。綠通道（無須申報）須同時滿足：無行李，或行李在關稅及免稅限額之內，且不攜帶流通被禁止或受限制的物品。紅通道（申報物品）適用於：不滿足綠通道條件；不確定是否須申報（有疑問即走紅通道）；或屬機組、工作人員；行李抽查隨機進行，海關關員要求時旅客必須出示行李及內容物。自第三國來的旅客個人行李中的菸酒免稅限量（17 歲以下無免稅）：香菸 200 支，或每支不超過 3 克的小雪茄/雪茄 100 支，或雪茄 50 支，或吸菸用菸絲 250 克——可按比例混搭；烈酒 1 升或中間產品 2 升，另加佐餐葡萄酒 4 升、啤酒 16 升。其他菸草製品對來自第三國、第三領土及歐盟成員國的旅客同樣享受消費稅（IEC）免稅：鼻菸 250 克、嚼煙 250 克、加熱菸草 20 克、電子煙補充液 30 毫升、尼古丁袋 20 克。藥品可攜個人所需數量並附醫生處方。自第三國帶入的其他非商業商品，海關及稅收免稅按總值計：陸路或鐵路旅客以及私人航空或休閒航行 300 歐，空運或海運旅客 430 歐，15 歲以下旅客 150 歐，機組 200 歐。機組人員執行職務旅行時，依第 64-A/2008 號法律第 116 條附件制度第 6 條適用同樣的免稅，但總值以每名機組 200 歐為限，菸草以 Mapa II 為限：香菸 80 支，或小雪茄（每支不超過 3 克的雪茄）20 支，或雪茄 10 支，或吸菸用菸絲 50 克；Mapa II 未寫混搭規則（第 5 條第 3 款比例混搭明文僅指 Mapa I），機組菸草各品類能否按比例組合無明文規定；Mapa II 僅列菸草，故無獨立的機組酒精限額——機組酒精仍受上文一般數量限制，且與菸草一樣，17 歲以下旅客不適用。超出免稅額的商品走紅通道向海關關員申報；指南另規定總額不超過 700 歐的商品可按 2.5% 單一稅率徵收從量關稅（direito forfetário）。自歐盟其他國家來葡，菸草和酒精飲料在購買國已繳消費稅且不超限額的前提下可攜：香菸 800 支/小雪茄 400 支/雪茄 200 支/菸絲 1 公斤，烈酒 10 升或中間產品 20 升/葡萄酒 90 升（其中起泡酒至多 60 升）/啤酒 110 升——此時葡萄牙不再補徵消費稅（旅客免稅制度的法律依據為第 64-A/2008 號法律第 116 條，轉化歐盟理事會第 2007/74/EC 號指令，另見《特別消費稅法典》第 6 條及第 61 條）。禁止或受限制進口的物品包括：毒品及毒品前體、放射性材料、攻擊性武器、槍械、爆炸物及彈藥、假冒商品、受保護的動植物物種及其部分或衍生物、食品及動物源性產品、植物產品包括水果和種子、無商業價值的寵物及其飼料。1 萬歐元及以上現金另行申報（見 pt-cash-declaration），在機場同樣走紅通道。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達葡萄牙機場時：攜帶須申報物品的旅客走紅通道並告知海關關員；機組及工作人員一律走紅通道。兩個網頁均於 2026-09-27 重新直取核實；AT 指南標註 2026 年 2 月。
