procedures.name_en: Accompanied cash declaration on entering or leaving San Marino (EUR 10,000 or more)
procedures.name_zh: 进出圣马力诺随身现金申报（1万欧元及以上）
procedures.agency: Repubblica di San Marino — Forze di Polizia (paper form delivered at the Comando or detached station nearest the crossed border; telematic declaration via www.ttc.sm; legal basis: Decreto Delegato 5 ottobre 2022 n. 141 e succ.mod.)
procedures.applicability_en: A natural person entering or leaving the territory of the Republic of San Marino who carries "denaro contante" with a total value equal to or above EUR 10,000 must declare it as an accompanied transfer ("pari o superiore a 10.000 euro" — the threshold includes exactly EUR 10,000). "Denaro contante" covers banknotes and coins in circulation (or exchangeable for circulating currency); bearer-negotiable instruments (traveller's cheques; bearer cheques, bills of exchange and payment orders); gold coins with at least 90% gold content and gold bars, nuggets or aggregates with at least 99.5% gold; and non-named prepaid cards not linked to a bank account. The duty applies even if the traveller is not stopped by a police officer. Cash moved by post, courier, aircraft or other cargo follows the separate unaccompanied ("Non Accompagnato") declaration and is out of scope here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 进入或离开圣马力诺共和国领土、随身携带“现金（denaro contante）”且总额“pari o superiore a 10.000 euro”（满1万欧元及以上，含恰好1万欧元）的自然人，必须按“随行现金（Accompagnato）”办理申报。“现金”范围：流通中（或可经金融机构/央行兑换为流通中）的纸币与硬币；无记名可转让票据（旅行支票；无记名支票、汇票及支付命令）；含金量≥90%的金币与≥99.5%的金条/金块/金砂聚合体；不记名且未关联银行账户的预付卡。即使未被执法警察拦停，申报义务同样存在。经邮政、快递、航空或其他货运方式移动的非随身现金适用另行“非随行（Non Accompagnato）”申报（收件人于收到后48小时内、寄件人最迟于交寄时），不在本条范围。
procedures.timing_en: Paper channel: deliver the completed accompanied-transfer form to the Comando or detached station of the Forza di Polizia nearest the crossed border. Electronic channel (equivalent alternative offered on the same page): file on www.ttc.sm before crossing the border and carry the telematic registration number with you. DD141 original (2026-09-29): the allegato 1 declaration is either transmitted telematically before crossing — the carrier then keeps a paper or electronic copy with the registration number — or delivered in writing to the Comando or detached station of the Forza di Polizia nearest the crossed or intended border point, which releases a copy bearing the office's attestation of receipt ("copia con attestazione di ricevimento da parte dell'ufficio" — an office receipt attestation, not a countersignature), and the carrier must carry that copy with them ("tale copia deve essere portata al seguito dal portatore"). Unaccompanied transfers ≥€10,000 require the sender's allegato 2 information at the latest at dispatch.
procedures.timing_zh: 纸质渠道：将填妥的“随行现金”申报表递交至距所越边境最近的警察部队（Forza di Polizia）指挥部或派驻机构。电子渠道（同一官方页面的等效替代）：越境前在 www.ttc.sm 在线提交，并随身携带系统赋予的申报注册号。 DD141 原文（2026-09-29）：附件1申报可在跨越边境前以电子方式传送（携纸本或电子副本及系统注册号），或书面递交至所越或拟越边境点最近的警察部队（Forza di Polizia）指挥部/派出机构，由该机构签发附办公室收讫证明的副本（copia con attestazione di ricevimento da parte dell'ufficio，系办公室收讫证明而非“会签/countersigned”），且携带人须将该副本随身携带（tale copia deve essere portata al seguito dal portatore）；不随行 ≥€10,000 现金最迟于交寄时由寄件人按附件2履行信息义务。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出聖馬力諾隨身現金申報（1萬歐元及以上）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 進入或離開聖馬力諾共和國領土、隨身攜帶“現金（denaro contante）”且總額“pari o superiore a 10.000 euro”（滿1萬歐元及以上，含恰好1萬歐元）的自然人，必須按“隨行現金（Accompagnato）”辦理申報。“現金”範圍：流通中（或可經金融機構/央行兌換為流通中）的紙幣與硬幣；無記名可轉讓票據（旅行支票；無記名支票、匯票及支付命令）；含金量≥90%的金幣與≥99.5%的金條/金塊/金砂聚合體；不記名且未關聯銀行賬戶的預付卡。即使未被執法警察攔停，申報義務同樣存在。經郵政、快遞、航空或其他貨運方式移動的非隨身現金適用另行“非隨行（Non Accompagnato）”申報（收件人於收到後48小時內、寄件人最遲於交寄時），不在本條範圍。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 紙質渠道：將填妥的“隨行現金”申報表遞交至距所越邊境最近的警察部隊（Forza di Polizia）指揮部或派駐機構。電子渠道（同一官方頁面的等效替代）：越境前在 www.ttc.sm 線上提交，並隨身攜帶系統賦予的申報註冊號。 DD141 原文（2026-09-29）：附件1申報可在跨越邊境前以電子方式傳送（攜紙本或電子副本及系統註冊號），或書面遞交至所越或擬越邊境點最近的警察部隊（Forza di Polizia）指揮部/派出機構，由該機構簽發附辦公室收訖證明的副本（copia con attestazione di ricevimento da parte dell'ufficio，系辦公室收訖證明而非“會籤/countersigned”），且攜帶人須將該副本隨身攜帶（tale copia deve essere portata al seguito dal portatore）；不隨行 ≥€10,000 現金最遲於交寄時由寄件人按附件2履行資訊義務。

procedures.name_en: Reporting cash of EUR 10,000 or more per person when entering or leaving Serbia — Report on the physical transfer of payment means across the state border, in duplicate
procedures.name_zh: 入出塞尔维亚每人携带1万欧元及以上现金的申报——《跨境实物支付工具转移报告表》，一式两份
procedures.agency: Uprava carina (Customs Administration), Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Serbia
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: every crossing of the Serbian state border, both on entry and on exit. Trigger (page 'Унос/износ девиза', last updated 2026-04-08): any sum of EUR 10,000 or more per person — in dinars or in a foreign currency — must be reported; the threshold applies to each person individually, including children. Form: the 'Образац пријаве преноса физички преносивих средстава плаћања преко државне границе' (report form for the physical transfer of payment means across the state border) is available to every traveller at entry and at exit and is posted with instructions on the Customs Administration website; it is completed in duplicate; the traveller may fill it in block letters in Serbian or English, sign it and hand it to the customs officer, or the officer completes it; the officer then compares the form data, checks the cash carried, certifies the form with signature and facsimile, keeps one copy and returns one. Reporting is distinct from, and does not remove, separate limits on taking cash OUT: foreign cash above EUR 10,000 may be taken out by non-residents (foreign citizens residing abroad, including foreign diplomatic-consular representatives in Serbia and their family members, and domestic citizens staying abroad for more than one year on a residence permit or work visa) only up to the amount evidenced by the customs confirmation of cash declared at entry, a bank confirmation of withdrawal from a foreign-currency account or savings book in Serbia, or an exchange-office confirmation for dinars acquired through prior card use in Serbia; residents (domestic citizens residing in Serbia, including Serbian diplomats abroad and their families, and foreign citizens staying in Serbia for more than one year) may take foreign cash above EUR 10,000 out only on the basis of proof of emigration. Where foreign currency, dinars, traveller's cheques and securities are taken out simultaneously, the total may not exceed EUR 10,000; dinars may be freely taken out only up to the dinar counter-value of EUR 10,000, and dinars above that counter-value may be brought into Serbia only if purchased from a foreign bank up to the amount in that bank's confirmation; payment cards may be freely brought in and taken out. The confirmation of a declared sum is invalidated on the first exit from Serbia; data on reported transfers are forwarded within 3 days to the Administration for the Prevention of Money Laundering; unreported funds found at exit above EUR 10,000 are temporarily retained under the Law on Foreign Exchange Operations, a record is drawn up, the funds are deposited to an account with the National Bank of Serbia within two days and misdemeanor proceedings follow. The page answers that nothing is paid on the declared sum above EUR 10,000 ('you pay nothing, you receive a confirmation').
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：每次跨越塞尔维亚国境，入境与出境均适用。触发条件（页面《Унос/износ девиза》，最后更新 2026-04-08）：每人 10,000 欧元或以上（以第纳尔或外币计）的任何金额必须申报；该门槛按每个人单独计算，包括儿童。表格：《跨境实物支付工具转移报告表》（Образац пријаве преноса физички преносивих средстава плаћања преко државне границе）对出入境每位旅客开放，并连同一份填写说明发布于海关管理局网站；一式两份填写；旅客可自行以塞尔维亚文或英文大写字母填写、签字后交海关官员，或由官员填写；官员随后核对表内数据、查验所携现金，以签字和印章（faxsimile）认证表格，留存一份、退还一份。申报义务不等于、也不解除出境携带限额：非居民（居住国外的外国公民，含驻塞外交领事代表及家属；以及持居留许可或工作签证在境外停留超过一年的本国公民）携超过 10,000 欧元外币出境，仅以至入境时申报现金所获海关确认函、塞尔维亚银行外币账户/外币存折取款确认函、或凭先前在塞刷卡消费所得第纳尔经兑换点售汇的确认函所载金额为限；居民（居住塞尔维亚的本国公民，含本国外交官及家属；以及在塞停留超过一年的外国公民）携超过 10,000 欧元外币出境仅可凭移居国外证明办理。外币、第纳尔、旅行支票与有价证券同时携出时，总额不得超过 10,000 欧元；第纳尔仅可自由携出至 10,000 欧元的第纳尔等值，超过该等值的第纳尔仅当从外国银行购买、以至该行确认函所载金额为限时方可携入；支付卡可自由携入携出。入境申报确认于首次离开塞尔维亚时失效；申报数据 3 日内转送反洗钱管理局；出境时查获未申报的超过 10,000 欧元资金，依《外汇业务法》被暂时扣留并制作笔录，两日内存入塞尔维亚国家银行账户，随后进入违规（misdemeanor）程序。页面答复称对申报的超过 10,000 欧元金额'分文不缴，仅领取确认'。
procedures.timing_en: At every border crossing, on entry and on exit: complete the report form in duplicate and hand it to the customs officer, who checks the amounts, certifies the form and returns one copy; the confirmation obtained at entry evidences the declared sum for that stay but is invalidated on first exit. No pre-departure online step is described on the page.
procedures.timing_zh: 每次过境（入境与出境）时：一式两份填写报告表交海关官员，官员核对金额、认证表格并退还一份；入境时取得的确认可证明该次停留所申报金额，但于首次出境时失效。页面未描述任何行前线上步骤。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入出塞爾維亞每人攜帶1萬歐元及以上現金的申報——《跨境實物支付工具轉移報告表》，一式兩份
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：每次跨越塞爾維亞國境，入境與出境均適用。觸發條件（頁面《Унос/износ девиза》，最後更新 2026-04-08）：每人 10,000 歐元或以上（以第納爾或外幣計）的任何金額必須申報；該門檻按每個人單獨計算，包括兒童。表格：《跨境實物支付工具轉移報告表》（Образац пријаве преноса физички преносивих средстава плаћања преко државне границе）對出入境每位旅客開放，並連同一份填寫說明發佈於海關管理局網站；一式兩份填寫；旅客可自行以塞爾維亞文或英文大寫字母填寫、簽字後交海關官員，或由官員填寫；官員隨後核對表內資料、查驗所攜現金，以簽字和印章（faxsimile）認證表格，留存一份、退還一份。申報義務不等於、也不解除出境攜帶限額：非居民（居住國外的外國公民，含駐塞外交領事代表及家屬；以及持居留許可或工作簽證在境外停留超過一年的本國公民）攜超過 10,000 歐元外幣出境，僅以至入境時申報現金所獲海關確認函、塞爾維亞銀行外幣賬戶/外幣存摺取款確認函、或憑先前在塞刷卡消費所得第納爾經兌換點售匯的確認函所載金額為限；居民（居住塞爾維亞的本國公民，含本國外交官及家屬；以及在塞停留超過一年的外國公民）攜超過 10,000 歐元外幣出境僅可憑移居國外證明辦理。外幣、第納爾、旅行支票與有價證券同時攜出時，總額不得超過 10,000 歐元；第納爾僅可自由攜出至 10,000 歐元的第納爾等值，超過該等值的第納爾僅當從外國銀行購買、以至該行確認函所載金額為限時方可攜入；支付卡可自由攜入攜出。入境申報確認於首次離開塞爾維亞時失效；申報資料 3 日內轉送反洗錢管理局；出境時查獲未申報的超過 10,000 歐元資金，依《外匯業務法》被暫時扣留並製作筆錄，兩日內存入塞爾維亞國家銀行賬戶，隨後進入違規（misdemeanor）程序。頁面答覆稱對申報的超過 10,000 歐元金額'分文不繳，僅領取確認'。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 每次過境（入境與出境）時：一式兩份填寫報告表交海關官員，官員核對金額、認證表格並退還一份；入境時取得的確認可證明該次停留所申報金額，但於首次出境時失效。頁面未描述任何行前線上步驟。

procedures.name_en: Personal-luggage import-duty relief for arriving passengers and reporting of goods above EUR 100 to customs at the border (Decree on customs reliefs, Article 3)
procedures.name_zh: 入境旅客个人行李免征进口税与超过100欧元货物向口岸海关申报（《海关优惠条例》第3条）
procedures.agency: Uprava carina (Customs Administration), Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Serbia
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers arriving in the Republic of Serbia from abroad. Legal basis: Article 245(1)-(2) of the Customs Law (Царински закон, 'Сл. гласник РС' 95/18) and Article 3 of the Decree on customs reliefs (Уредба о царинским повластицама, 'Сл. гласник РС' 38/2019, 86/2019 and 103/2025, editorially consolidated text). (1) Passengers arriving from abroad are exempt from import duties on items serving their personal needs during the journey (personal luggage), whether carried with them or consigned to a carrier; for personal luggage sent on by another means of transport or by post, the traveller submits proof at the customs authority's request that it is personal luggage. (2) Domestic passengers are additionally exempt on items they bring in from abroad which are not intended for resale, up to a total value of EUR 100 in dinar counter-value; an item in this category that is not divisible (a single indivisible good) is not covered by this relief. This EUR 100 relief is stated in the Decree for domestic passengers only. (3) Traveller action (Customs Administration FAQ 'Лични пртљаг', last updated 2024-10-16): a traveller carrying goods of value greater than EUR 100 should report them to the customs officials at the border crossing — the FAQ addresses travellers generally and does not state which persons are bound by this report duty, on what legal basis, or how it relates to the Decree's EUR 100 relief confined to domestic passengers; personal luggage (e.g. clothing, footwear, technical devices, sports equipment, personal-hygiene items, medicines for the traveller's usual therapy) and mobile devices configured for personal use are treated as personal luggage, while e.g. a new device outside personal luggage remains subject to import duties. (4) The same FAQ states entry quantities for Serbia — tobacco: 50 cigarettes, 25 cigarillos (up to 3 g each), 10 cigars, 50 g smoking tobacco or a proportional combination (oral tobacco/snus may not be imported or marketed); alcohol: 1 L spirits or 1 L sparkling and liqueur wines or a proportional combination, plus 1 L other wines; perfumes: 1 perfume (up to 50 ml) and 1 toilet water (up to 25 ml); food: factory-packed food in a reasonable quantity, with food of animal origin limited to 1 kg — but the FAQ cites no article, and in the Decree these identical tobacco/alcohol/perfume quantities appear in Article 6, which governs low-value shipments (total value up to EUR 70) received free of charge from private persons abroad rather than accompanied passenger luggage. (5) Separate consignment reliefs, not accompanied-luggage allowances: Article 6 low-value shipments from private persons (up to EUR 70, non-commercial, indivisible goods excluded) and Article 26 low-value non-commercial shipments of actual value not exceeding EUR 50 excluding alcohol, perfumes and tobacco (value as amended by 'Сл. гласник РС' 103/2025).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：自国外抵达塞尔维亚共和国的旅客。法律依据：《海关法》（Царински закон，《官报》RS 95/18）第 245 条第 1、2 项；《海关优惠条例》（Уредба о царинским повластицама，《官报》RS 38/2019、86/2019、103/2025，编辑整理合并文本）第 3 条。(1) 自国外抵达的旅客，对其旅行期间个人所需的物品（个人行李）免征进口税费，无论随身携带还是交由承运人运输；对以其他运输工具或邮寄另行发运的个人行李，应海关要求提交证明其为个人行李的相应证据。(2) 国内旅客（домаћи путници）另就其自国外携入、非以转售为目的的物品，在总值不超过 100 欧元的第纳尔等值范围内免征进口税费；该类物品中不可分割（单件不可拆分）的货物不适用此减免。该 100 欧元减免在条例中仅针对国内旅客。(3) 旅客动作（海关管理局 FAQ《Лични пртљаг》，最后更新 2024-10-16）：随身携带价值超过 100 欧元货物的旅客，应在边境口岸向海关官员申报——该 FAQ 面向旅客通称，未说明此申报义务约束哪些人员、依据为何，亦未说明其与条例中仅限国内旅客的 100 欧元减免的关系；个人行李（如衣物、鞋靴、技术设备、运动器材、个人卫生用品、旅客日常治疗用药）及配置为个人使用的移动设备（笔记本电脑、平板、手机等）视作个人行李，而例如个人行李之外的新设备仍需缴纳进口税费。(4) 同一 FAQ 列出入境数量——烟草：50 支香烟、25 支小雪茄（每支不超过 3 克）、10 支雪茄、50 克吸烟烟丝或按比例组合（口用烟草/鼻烟 snus 禁止进口和销售）；酒精：1 升烈性酒或 1 升起泡酒/利口酒或按比例组合，另加 1 升其他葡萄酒；香水：1 瓶香水（不超过 50 毫升）和 1 瓶淡香水（不超过 25 毫升）；食品：工厂封装、数量合理，动物源性食品限 1 公斤——但 FAQ 未注明条款，且条例中这些烟草/酒精/香水数量出现在第 6 条（自国外私人免费接收、总值不超过 70 欧元的低值邮包类收寄），并非第 3 条随身行李。(5) 以下为另行收寄渠道的减免，非随身行李额度：第 6 条私人间低值包裹（不超过 70 欧元、非商用、不可分割货物除外）；第 26 条低值非商用寄递（实际价值不超过 50 欧元，不含酒精、香水、烟草；该数值经《官报》RS 103/2025 修订）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival at the border crossing: personal luggage as defined passes free of import duties; goods of value greater than EUR 100 (per the FAQ) are to be reported to the customs officials at the crossing; luggage sent separately or by post is evidenced as personal luggage at the customs authority's request.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达边境口岸时：符合定义的个人行李免征进口税进口；携带价值超过 100 欧元的货物（依 FAQ）应在口岸向海关官员申报；另行发运或邮寄的个人行李应海关要求提交证明。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境旅客個人行李免徵進口稅與超過100歐元貨物向口岸海關申報（《海關優惠條例》第3條）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：自國外抵達塞爾維亞共和國的旅客。法律依據：《海關法》（Царински закон，《官報》RS 95/18）第 245 條第 1、2 項；《海關優惠條例》（Уредба о царинским повластицама，《官報》RS 38/2019、86/2019、103/2025，編輯整理合併文本）第 3 條。(1) 自國外抵達的旅客，對其旅行期間個人所需的物品（個人行李）免徵進口稅費，無論隨身攜帶還是交由承運人運輸；對以其他運輸工具或郵寄另行發運的個人行李，應海關要求提交證明其為個人行李的相應證據。(2) 國內旅客（домаћи путници）另就其自國外攜入、非以轉售為目的的物品，在總值不超過 100 歐元的第納爾等值範圍內免徵進口稅費；該類物品中不可分割（單件不可拆分）的貨物不適用此減免。該 100 歐元減免在條例中僅針對國內旅客。(3) 旅客動作（海關管理局 FAQ《Лични пртљаг》，最後更新 2024-10-16）：隨身攜帶價值超過 100 歐元貨物的旅客，應在邊境口岸向海關官員申報——該 FAQ 面向旅客通稱，未說明此申報義務約束哪些人員、依據為何，亦未說明其與條例中僅限國內旅客的 100 歐元減免的關係；個人行李（如衣物、鞋靴、技術設備、運動器材、個人衛生用品、旅客日常治療用藥）及配置為個人使用的移動設備（筆電電腦、平板、手機等）視作個人行李，而例如個人行李之外的新設備仍需繳納進口稅費。(4) 同一 FAQ 列出入境數量——菸草：50 支香菸、25 支小雪茄（每支不超過 3 克）、10 支雪茄、50 克吸菸菸絲或按比例組合（口用菸草/鼻菸 snus 禁止進口和銷售）；酒精：1 升烈性酒或 1 升起泡酒/利口酒或按比例組合，另加 1 升其他葡萄酒；香水：1 瓶香水（不超過 50 毫升）和 1 瓶淡香水（不超過 25 毫升）；食品：工廠封裝、數量合理，動物源性食品限 1 公斤——但 FAQ 未註明條款，且條例中這些菸草/酒精/香水數量出現在第 6 條（自國外私人免費接收、總值不超過 70 歐元的低值郵包類收寄），並非第 3 條隨身行李。(5) 以下為另行收寄渠道的減免，非隨身行李額度：第 6 條私人間低值包裹（不超過 70 歐元、非商用、不可分割貨物除外）；第 26 條低值非商用寄遞（實際價值不超過 50 歐元，不含酒精、香水、菸草；該數值經《官報》RS 103/2025 修訂）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達邊境口岸時：符合定義的個人行李免徵進口稅進口；攜帶價值超過 100 歐元的貨物（依 FAQ）應在口岸向海關官員申報；另行發運或郵寄的個人行李應海關要求提交證明。

procedures.name_en: Written cash declaration when entering or leaving the EU with EUR 10,000 or more
procedures.name_zh: 进出欧盟携带 1 万欧元及以上现金的书面申报
procedures.agency: Financial Administration of the Republic of Slovenia (FURS), customs
procedures.applicability_en: Any traveller carrying cash of EUR 10,000 or more (or its equivalent in other currencies, made up of one or more items) must declare it in writing to the customs authority at the control point of entry into or exit from the EU (i.e. crossing the EU external border, including at Slovenian control points). Cash covers: banknotes and coins; cheques, traveller cheques, promissory notes or money orders without a named beneficiary; gold coins with gold content of at least 90%, and gold bars, nuggets or clumps with gold content of at least 99.5%. The harmonized EU declaration form must be completed in one of the languages available for the country of entry/exit (non-EU language reference versions exist to help); forms are available online or from the authorities at the control point. Distinct case, not a proactive duty: when crossing Slovenia's border with other EU member states, cash of EUR 10,000 or more must be declared only if the customs authority or the police so request. Unaccompanied cash sent by post, freight or courier (EUR 10,000 or more) may be subject to a disclosure declaration only at the authorities' request, to be made within 30 days by the recipient, sender or their representative; this is not a traveller border action and is out of scope. Authorities may detain the cash and penalties apply for non-compliance.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何旅客携带价值 1 万欧元及以上现金（或等值其他货币，可由一项或多项合计构成）进出欧盟（即跨越欧盟外部边境，含斯洛文尼亚各管制点）时，须在进出欧盟的管制点向海关书面申报。现金范围：纸币和硬币；无记名支票、旅行支票、本票或汇票；含金量至少 90% 的金币，以及含金量至少 99.5% 的金条、金块或金疙瘩。须使用欧盟统一申报表，以入境/出境国提供的语言之一填写（另有非欧盟语言参考版辅助）；表格可在线获取或向管制点机关索取。区别情形（非主动义务）：跨越斯洛文尼亚与其他欧盟成员国边境时，携带 1 万欧元及以上现金仅在海关或警察要求时才须申报。邮寄、货运或快递的非随身现金（1 万欧元及以上）仅在机关要求披露时，由收件人、寄件人或其代表在 30 日内申报，不属旅客边境动作、不在本项范围。违规可能被扣留现金并受处罚。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of entering or leaving the EU: complete the harmonized declaration form and lodge it with customs at the control point of entry or exit; forms are available online or at the control point.
procedures.timing_zh: 在进入或离开欧盟时：填写统一申报表并向进出欧盟管制点的海关提交；表格可在线获取或在管制点索取。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出歐盟攜帶 1 萬歐元及以上現金的書面申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何旅客攜帶價值 1 萬歐元及以上現金（或等值其他貨幣，可由一項或多項合計構成）進出歐盟（即跨越歐盟外部邊境，含斯洛文尼亞各管制點）時，須在進出歐盟的管制點向海關書面申報。現金範圍：紙幣和硬幣；無記名支票、旅行支票、本票或匯票；含金量至少 90% 的金幣，以及含金量至少 99.5% 的金條、金塊或金疙瘩。須使用歐盟統一申報表，以入境/出境國提供的語言之一填寫（另有非歐盟語言參考版輔助）；表格可線上獲取或向管制點機關索取。區別情形（非主動義務）：跨越斯洛文尼亞與其他歐盟成員國邊境時，攜帶 1 萬歐元及以上現金僅在海關或警察要求時才須申報。郵寄、貨運或快遞的非隨身現金（1 萬歐元及以上）僅在機關要求披露時，由收件人、寄件人或其代表在 30 日內申報，不屬旅客邊境動作、不在本項範圍。違規可能被扣留現金並受處罰。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在進入或離開歐盟時：填寫統一申報表並向進出歐盟管制點的海關提交；表格可線上獲取或在管制點索取。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding import duty relief (duties and taxes at the border-crossing point)
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报（在边境口岸办理关税与税款）
procedures.agency: Financial Administration of the Republic of Slovenia (FURS)
procedures.applicability_en: Traveller entering Slovenia (EU) from a third country with non-commercial personal-use goods whose value or quantity exceeds the relief thresholds must pay the prescribed duties and taxes (customs duty, VAT, excise for excise goods); all customs formalities for release of the goods for free circulation can be carried out at a border-crossing point, and after completion the traveller is free to dispose of the goods. Relief thresholds that trigger the obligation: goods up to EUR 300 per person, EUR 430 for travellers in air and maritime traffic (private pleasure flights/yacht sea-navigation excluded), EUR 150 for travellers under 15; an over-limit single item cannot be split, and relief rights cannot be cumulated between travellers. Tobacco (travellers aged 17 or older): 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 g smoking tobacco or a proportional assortment; alcohol (travellers aged 17 or older): 1 L over 22% vol or 2 L up to 22% vol, plus 4 L still wine and 16 L beer; fuel: standard tank plus 10 L in a portable container. The traveller's customs declaration is normally made orally to customs, but where justified the customs authority may reject the oral customs declaration and require regular customs clearance, so the traveller must submit a (written) customs declaration in one of the customs clearance departments. Duty calculation (indicative): for non-commercial goods with total value not exceeding EUR 700 (except tobacco products and zero-duty goods) import duties may be calculated at a flat rate of 2.5%, unless the traveller requests tariff-rate assessment before clearance; for FTA-origin goods a preferential rate may be requested orally up to EUR 1,200 (proof of origin required above that).
procedures.applicability_zh: 自第三国入境斯洛文尼亚（欧盟）的旅客，携带非商业自用商品的价值或数量超过免税门槛时，须缴纳规定的关税与税款（关税、增值税，应税商品另缴消费税）；货物自由流通放行的全部海关手续可在边境口岸办理，办结后旅客即可自由处置货物。触发义务的免税门槛：商品每人 300 欧，空运与海运旅客 430 欧（私人娱乐飞行/游艇航行除外），未满 15 岁旅客 150 欧；超限单件不可拆分，旅客之间不可合并免税额度。烟草（年满 17 岁旅客）：200 支香烟或 100 支 cigarillos 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克烟丝或按比例组合；酒精（年满 17 岁旅客）：1 升超 22% vol 或 2 升不超 22% vol，另加 4 升静止葡萄酒和 16 升啤酒；燃料：标准油箱加便携容器 10 升。旅客报关通常向海关口头进行，但在有正当理由时海关可拒绝口头报关并要求正规清关，旅客须在清关部门之一提交（书面）报关单。税款计算（指示性）：非商业商品总值不超 700 欧（烟草制品与零关税商品除外）可按 2.5% 简易税率计征，旅客亦可在清关前要求按税率表计征；自贸协定原产商品价值不超 1200 欧可口头要求优惠税率，超出的须提供原产地证明。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival at the border-crossing point: declare to customs and pay the duties and taxes; a receipt is issued against payment. If the oral customs declaration is rejected, submit a regular customs declaration in one of the customs clearance departments.
procedures.timing_zh: 到达边境口岸时：向海关申报并缴纳税款，缴款后取得凭证；如口头报关被拒，须在清关部门之一提交正规报关单。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報（在邊境口岸辦理關稅與稅款）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自第三國入境斯洛文尼亞（歐盟）的旅客，攜帶非商業自用商品的價值或數量超過免稅門檻時，須繳納規定的關稅與稅款（關稅、增值稅，應稅商品另繳消費稅）；貨物自由流通放行的全部海關手續可在邊境口岸辦理，辦結後旅客即可自由處置貨物。觸發義務的免稅門檻：商品每人 300 歐，空運與海運旅客 430 歐（私人娛樂飛行/遊艇航行除外），未滿 15 歲旅客 150 歐；超限單件不可拆分，旅客之間不可合併免稅額度。菸草（年滿 17 歲旅客）：200 支香菸或 100 支 cigarillos 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克菸絲或按比例組合；酒精（年滿 17 歲旅客）：1 升超 22% vol 或 2 升不超 22% vol，另加 4 升靜止葡萄酒和 16 升啤酒；燃料：標準油箱加便攜容器 10 升。旅客報關通常向海關口頭進行，但在有正當理由時海關可拒絕口頭報關並要求正規清關，旅客須在清關部門之一提交（書面）報關單。稅款計算（指示性）：非商業商品總值不超 700 歐（菸草製品與零關稅商品除外）可按 2.5% 簡易稅率計徵，旅客亦可在清關前要求按稅率表計徵；自貿協定原產商品價值不超 1200 歐可口頭要求優惠稅率，超出的須提供原產地證明。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 到達邊境口岸時：向海關申報並繳納稅款，繳款後取得憑證；如口頭報關被拒，須在清關部門之一提交正規報關單。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of payment means carried on entry, exit or domestic movement (model E1/S1)
procedures.name_zh: 入出境及境内移动随身支付手段申报（E1/S1 表）
procedures.agency: Agencia Tributaria — Departamento de Aduanas e II.EE.
procedures.applicability_en: A traveller physically carrying payment means must declare: banknotes and coins, national or foreign; bearer or endorsable negotiable instruments (traveller's cheques, cheques, promissory notes or payment orders — to bearer, signed with the beneficiary omitted, endorsed without restriction, to a fictitious payee, or incomplete); non-nominative prepaid cards not linked to a bank account; coins of at least 90% gold content and unminted gold (ingots, nuggets) of at least 99.5%. Entering or leaving Spain from or to a non-EU third country with EUR 10,000 or more — inclusive, per person and per trip, all means and currencies aggregated in one declaration — model E1. Entering or leaving Spain from or to an EU member state with EUR 10,000 or more — model S1. Movements within Spanish territory only, of EUR 100,000 or more — model S1. Models E2 and S2 exist only for unaccompanied means sent by post or courier, which the traveller does not carry on their person and does not file. Minors may carry payment means; the person exercising parental authority, guardianship or curatorship owes the declaration and is deemed the carrier, and when the minor and that person travel together a declaration is due if jointly or separately they reach or exceed EUR 10,000. Bank transfers are never declarable. Non-declaration is a serious infringement: fine of at least EUR 600 and up to 50% of the value of the means, with public or private admonition and possible provisional seizure. The declaration is valid for one movement on the declared date and must accompany the means, carried by the person named as carrier in it.
procedures.applicability_zh: 旅客随身携带支付手段入境或出境西班牙须申报，支付手段包括：本国或外国纸币与硬币；无记名或可背书转让的票据（旅行支票、支票、本票或付款指令——无记名式、已签字但漏填收款人、无限制背书、以虚拟收款人为抬头，或未填写完整的票据）；不记名且未关联银行账户的预付卡；含金量至少 90% 的金币及含金量至少 99.5% 的未铸币黄金（金锭、天然金块）。自非欧盟第三国入境或前往非欧盟第三国，携带等于或超过 1 万欧元——含本数，按人按次计算，所有支付手段与所有币种合并为一次申报——用 E1 表。自欧盟成员国入境或前往欧盟成员国，等于或超过 1 万欧元——用 S1 表。仅在西班牙境内移动、等于或超过 10 万欧元——用 S1 表。E2 与 S2 表仅适用于经邮政或快递寄送、非旅客随身携带的支付手段，旅客不填写此类表格。未成年人可以携带支付手段；申报义务由行使亲权、监护或保佐之人承担，且该人在此效力下被视为携带人；未成年人与该人同行时，若合并或单独计算达到或超过 1 万欧元即须申报。银行转账任何情况下均无须此申报。不申报属严重违法：罚款最低 600 欧、最高可达支付手段价值的 50%，可并处公开或非公开训诫，并可临时扣押支付手段。申报仅对申报日的单一移动有效，移动全程须随附申报并由表中载明的携带人运送。
procedures.timing_en: Always before the movement, never after it. Accompanied third-country movements (E1): before the Servicios de Aduanas of the AEAT, prior to any fiscal-control action. Accompanied EU movements (S1): at the border post where customs services exist, otherwise electronically or in person before the customs services before the movement. Within-territory movements of EUR 100,000 or more (S1): in person at the customs services, or at credit entities where the movement is at least partly charged to or credited to an account of the declarant or of the entity's client. A domestic movement chained to an EU entry or exit is declared on a single S1; chained to a third-country exit it takes two models (S1 for the domestic leg, E1 for the exit). The declaration is made on paper or electronically; paper forms are available at AEAT customs and excise offices and at the Delegaciones de Economía y Hacienda, or downloadable; electronic presentation on the sede uses recognized identification, authentication and signature — completing the model does not by itself constitute presentation.
procedures.timing_zh: 一律须在支付手段移动之前申报，不得事后补办。随身携带的第三国流动（E1）：向 AEAT 海关部门提交，且须早于税务机关的任何监管行动。随身携带的欧盟成员国流动（S1）：经由设有海关服务的边境口岸向该服务提交；如口岸未设海关服务，则须在移动前以电子或现场方式向海关部门提交。西班牙境内等于或超过 10 万欧元的移动（S1）：现场向海关部门申报，或当移动至少部分以申报人或机构客户在信贷机构开立的账户收付时，向该信贷机构申报。境内移动与欧盟出入境相衔接时合并为一次 S1 申报；与第三国出境相衔接时须提交两份（境内段 S1、出境段 E1）。申报可纸质或电子办理：纸质表可在 AEAT 海关与消费税机构及各经济与财政部代表处领取，亦可在线下载；电子提交经 sede 使用认可的识别、认证与电子签名——仅填写表格不等于完成提交。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入出境及境內移動隨身支付手段申報（E1/S1 表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 旅客隨身攜帶支付手段入境或出境西班牙須申報，支付手段包括：本國或外國紙幣與硬幣；無記名或可背書轉讓的票據（旅行支票、支票、本票或付款指令——無記名式、已簽字但漏填收款人、無限制背書、以虛擬收款人為抬頭，或未填寫完整的票據）；不記名且未關聯銀行賬戶的預付卡；含金量至少 90% 的金幣及含金量至少 99.5% 的未鑄幣黃金（金錠、天然金塊）。自非歐盟第三國入境或前往非歐盟第三國，攜帶等於或超過 1 萬歐元——含本數，按人按次計算，所有支付手段與所有幣種合併為一次申報——用 E1 表。自歐盟成員國入境或前往歐盟成員國，等於或超過 1 萬歐元——用 S1 表。僅在西班牙境內移動、等於或超過 10 萬歐元——用 S1 表。E2 與 S2 表僅適用於經郵政或快遞寄送、非旅客隨身攜帶的支付手段，旅客不填寫此類表格。未成年人可以攜帶支付手段；申報義務由行使親權、監護或保佐之人承擔，且該人在此效力下被視為攜帶人；未成年人與該人同行時，若合併或單獨計算達到或超過 1 萬歐元即須申報。銀行轉賬任何情況下均無須此申報。不申報屬嚴重違法：罰款最低 600 歐、最高可達支付手段價值的 50%，可並處公開或非公開訓誡，並可臨時扣押支付手段。申報僅對申報日的單一移動有效，移動全程須隨附申報並由表中載明的攜帶人運送。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 一律須在支付手段移動之前申報，不得事後補辦。隨身攜帶的第三國流動（E1）：向 AEAT 海關部門提交，且須早於稅務機關的任何監管行動。隨身攜帶的歐盟成員國流動（S1）：經由設有海關服務的邊境口岸向該服務提交；如口岸未設海關服務，則須在移動前以電子或現場方式向海關部門提交。西班牙境內等於或超過 10 萬歐元的移動（S1）：現場向海關部門申報，或當移動至少部分以申報人或機構客戶在信貸機構開立的賬戶收付時，向該信貸機構申報。境內移動與歐盟出入境相銜接時合併為一次 S1 申報；與第三國出境相銜接時須提交兩份（境內段 S1、出境段 E1）。申報可紙質或電子辦理：紙質表可在 AEAT 海關與消費稅機構及各經濟與財政部代表處領取，亦可線上下載；電子提交經 sede 使用認可的識別、認證與電子簽名——僅填寫表格不等於完成提交。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding the traveller franchise on arrival (red channel, Declaración Verbal de Viajeros)
procedures.name_zh: 入境超旅客免税额物品申报（红通道，Declaración Verbal de Viajeros）
procedures.agency: Agencia Tributaria — Departamento de Aduanas e II.EE.
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving in Spain from a non-EU country at a port, airport or land entry point, the traveller passes either the green channel (nothing to declare — itself a presumed customs declaration, with selective checks possible) or the red channel (goods to declare). The red channel is required when carrying: non-commercial goods exceeding the traveller franchise — value EUR 430 by air or sea, EUR 300 by land, EUR 150 for travellers under 15 by any mode (the value of personal medicines is not counted); tobacco 200 cigarettes or 100 puritos (cigars of at most 3 g each) or 50 cigars or 250 g smoking tobacco; alcohol 1 L spirits over 22% or 2 L of drinks up to 22%, fortified or sparkling wine (combinable pro rata), plus 4 L still wine and 16 L beer — travellers under 17 get no tobacco or alcohol franchise, and transport staff allowances fall to one tenth; or commercial goods; or restricted items (pets, CITES species, animal-origin food, plants and seeds, medicines requiring proof); or payment means of EUR 10,000 or more — this page's example reads 'más de 10.000 euros', while the dedicated medios de pago page sets 'igual o superior a 10.000 euros', which governs. Controls apply regardless of the traveller's residence or nationality. The verbal declaration is recorded in a Declaración Verbal de Viajeros; if the shipment is non-commercial, import duties are liquidated with a payment letter, or the goods may be abandoned or reexported; commercial goods are routed to the H1 electronic channel. The franquicias page handles excess goods through the TALÓN PARA DECLARACIÓN VERBAL (C7 with payment, D6 with guarantee, D12 deferred destination), stamped by customs and shown at the exit control.
procedures.applicability_zh: 从非欧盟国家经海港、机场或陆路入境点抵达西班牙时，旅客须通过绿通道（无须申报——本身即视为推定海关申报，且海关可实施抽查）或红通道（有物品申报）。有下列情形应走红通道：携带超过旅客免税额的非商业物品——航空或海路 430 欧、陆路 300 欧、15 岁以下旅客不论交通方式 150 欧（个人自用药品价值不计入）；烟草 200 支香烟或 100 支 puritos（每支不超过 3 克的小雪茄）或 50 支雪茄或 250 克吸烟用烟丝；酒精 1 升 22 度以上烈酒或 2 升 22 度及以下、加强型或起泡酒（可按比例组合），另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒和 16 升啤酒——17 岁以下旅客不适用烟酒免税，国际运输从业人员额度降为十分之一；或商业性质货物；或受管制物品（宠物、CITES 濒危物种、动物源性食品、植物与种子、须证明自用的药品）；或等于或超过 1 万欧元的支付手段——本页示例写作 más de 10.000 euros，而专门的支付手段页规定为 igual o superior a 10.000 euros，以专门页为准。海关监管不因旅客居民身份或国籍而豁免。口头申报由海关记入 Declaración Verbal de Viajeros；如属非商业物品，进口税经付款单结算，货物亦可放弃或复出口；商业货物改走 H1 电子渠道。免税额页对超额货物使用 TALÓN PARA DECLARACIÓN VERBAL（缴税 C7、担保 D6、递延处置 D12），由海关盖章后在出场监管时出示。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival at the entry point: pass the red channel and state what you have to declare; customs records the verbal declaration as a Declaración Verbal de Viajeros and settles the duties with a payment letter (telematic payment available); under the TALÓN route the stamped form (C7/D6/D12) is presented at the exit control of the customs premises. The payment-means declaration for cash is a separate duty that must already have been filed before the movement.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达入境点时：走红通道并说明须申报事项；海关将口头申报记录为 Declaración Verbal de Viajeros，并出具付款单结算进口税费（可电子支付）；走 TALÓN 流程时，海关盖章的表格（C7/D6/D12）须在海关场所出场监管时出示。现金支付手段申报为独立义务，须已在移动前完成。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境超旅客免稅額物品申報（紅通道，Declaración Verbal de Viajeros）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 從非歐盟國家經海港、機場或陸路入境點抵達西班牙時，旅客須通過綠通道（無須申報——本身即視為推定海關申報，且海關可實施抽查）或紅通道（有物品申報）。有下列情形應走紅通道：攜帶超過旅客免稅額的非商業物品——航空或海路 430 歐、陸路 300 歐、15 歲以下旅客不論交通方式 150 歐（個人自用藥品價值不計入）；菸草 200 支香菸或 100 支 puritos（每支不超過 3 克的小雪茄）或 50 支雪茄或 250 克吸菸用菸絲；酒精 1 升 22 度以上烈酒或 2 升 22 度及以下、加強型或起泡酒（可按比例組合），另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒和 16 升啤酒——17 歲以下旅客不適用菸酒免稅，國際運輸從業人員額度降為十分之一；或商業性質貨物；或受管制物品（寵物、CITES 瀕危物種、動物源性食品、植物與種子、須證明自用的藥品）；或等於或超過 1 萬歐元的支付手段——本頁示例寫作 más de 10.000 euros，而專門的支付手段頁規定為 igual o superior a 10.000 euros，以專門頁為準。海關監管不因旅客居民身份或國籍而豁免。口頭申報由海關記入 Declaración Verbal de Viajeros；如屬非商業物品，進口稅經付款單結算，貨物亦可放棄或復出口；商業貨物改走 H1 電子渠道。免稅額頁對超額貨物使用 TALÓN PARA DECLARACIÓN VERBAL（繳稅 C7、擔保 D6、遞延處置 D12），由海關蓋章後在出場監管時出示。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達入境點時：走紅通道並說明須申報事項；海關將口頭申報記錄為 Declaración Verbal de Viajeros，並出具付款單結算進口稅費（可電子支付）；走 TALÓN 流程時，海關蓋章的表格（C7/D6/D12）須在海關場所出場監管時出示。現金支付手段申報為獨立義務，須已在移動前完成。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods on entry to Austria from a non-EU country (duty-free amounts and duty-free allowance) — Zoll Austria / BMF
procedures.name_zh: 自非欧盟国家入境奥地利的物品申报（免税数量与免税额度）——奥地利海关／财政部（BMF）
procedures.agency: Zoll Austria — Bundesministerium für Finanzen (BMF), Austria — national customs authority
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering Austria from a non-EU (third) country. The figures below are the general travellers' duty-free amounts; the reduced cross-border-traffic amounts (including the Samnaun Valley tobacco amounts for travellers domiciled in Austria) are special regimes listed separately at the end and must not be read as the general values. Goods intended for your own personal use or for persons living in the same household can be brought into Austria without paying charges. When going through customs control you must declare the following goods — in other words you must submit a customs declaration for: goods not intended for your personal use; goods obtained outside the EU which exceed the duty-free amounts for tobacco products, alcoholic beverages and medicinal products or the duty-free allowance for other goods; and goods that are subject to prohibitions or restrictions on imports. Duty-free when imported in your personal luggage for your own personal use or as a gift, traveller aged 17 or older: tobacco — 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 grams of smoking tobacco or a proportional combination of these goods (for the product category 'Tobacco for heating'/tobacco sticks the duty-free limits of the 'Other goods' section apply); alcoholic beverages — 1 litre of alcohol, distilled beverages and spirits with an alcohol content exceeding 22% vol. (including undenatured ethyl alcohol of 80% vol. and over), or 2 litres of alcohol and alcoholic beverages with an alcohol content not exceeding 22% vol., or a proportional combination of these goods, and in addition 4 litres of non-sparkling wines as well as 16 litres of beer; medicine — amounts consistent with your personal needs during the trip (without authorisation, travellers resident in the EU may import medication they already carried with them on departure; import of medication bought abroad is only permitted up to three retailer packages per person); other goods — with a cumulative value of EUR 430 for airline travellers or EUR 300 for all other travellers per calendar day, provided it is a non-commercial import; for travellers younger than 15 years those amounts are generally reduced to EUR 150. Within those amounts the product group 'Tobacco for heating' may not contain more than 800 tobacco sticks or, in other presentation, 250 grams of tobacco; when exceeding these indicative levels you must demonstrate that the goods really are for your personal use. Several travellers are not allowed to pool their allowances, and the duty-free allowance may be claimed once per calendar day. When travelling via another EU member state, that member state's individual regulations must be considered. Import prohibitions and restrictions also apply to the duty-free goods listed above. Special regime — reduced duty-free amounts in cross-border traffic: tobacco (17+) 25 cigarettes or 10 cigarillos or 5 cigars or 25 grams of smoking tobacco or a proportional combination; alcohol (17+) 0.25 litres exceeding 22% vol. or 0.75 litres not exceeding 22% vol. or a proportional combination; 1 litre non-sparkling wine (17+); 2 litres beer (17+); other goods up to a cumulative value of EUR 40 (non-commercial); the 'small' cross-border traffic agreement covers persons residing at the border of Austria's neighbouring countries Switzerland and Liechtenstein, with further food-related exemptions. Special regime — Samnaun Valley: for travellers domiciled in Austria entering from the Swiss customs exclave Samnaun Valley, reduced tobacco amounts apply (17+): 40 cigarettes or 20 cigarillos or 10 cigars or 50 grams of smoking tobacco or a proportional combination; other goods remain duty-free at the general cumulative values (EUR 430 airline / EUR 300 other travellers per calendar day, EUR 150 for travellers under 15); entries with tobacco products obtained in Samnaun Valley via the customs offices of Pfunds, Spiss or Martinsbruck are regarded as direct imports.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：自非欧盟（第三国）国家入境奥地利的旅客。以下为一般旅客免税数值；边境通勤减免数值（含居住在奥地利的旅客自 Samnaun 飞地入境的烟草减免）为文末单列的特别制度，不得当作一般数值使用。自用或供同住家庭成员使用的物品，可免税带入奥地利。经海关检查时必须申报下列物品——即须提交海关申报（submit a customs declaration）：非自用物品；在欧盟境外获得、超过烟草制品、酒精饮料、药品免税数量或超过其他商品免税额度的物品；受进口禁止或限制的物品。在随身行李中自用或作为礼品免税（须满 17 周岁）：烟草——200 支香烟，或 100 支小雪茄（cigarillos），或 50 支雪茄，或 250 克吸用烟草，或按比例组合（'加热烟草'即烟草棒类产品适用'其他商品'一节的免税限额）；酒精饮料——酒精含量超过 22% vol. 的酒精、蒸馏饮料和烈酒（含 80% vol. 及以上的未变性乙醇）1 升，或酒精含量不超过 22% vol. 的酒精饮料 2 升，或按比例组合，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒以及 16 升啤酒；药品——与旅途个人需要相一致的数量（欧盟居民无需许可即可携带其出境时已随身携带的药品入境；在境外购买的药品每人仅限 3 个零售包装）；其他商品——每公历日累计价值航空旅客 430 欧元、其他所有旅客 300 欧元，以非商业性入境为前提；15 岁以下旅客该额度一般降为 150 欧元。在该额度内，'加热烟草'类产品不得超过 800 支烟草棒或以其他形态计 250 克烟草；超过该指示性数量时，须证明物品确为自用。多名旅客不得合并免税额度（例如两人不能合并 80 欧元额度免税带入一件商品）；免税额度每公历日只能主张一次。经另一欧盟成员国中转前来时，须注意该成员国自身的规定。上述免税商品同样适用进口禁止与限制。特别制度——边境通勤减免：烟草（17 周岁及以上）25 支香烟或 10 支小雪茄或 5 支雪茄或 25 克吸用烟草或按比例组合；酒精（17 周岁及以上）超过 22% vol. 的 0.25 升或不超过 22% vol. 的 0.75 升或按比例组合；不起泡葡萄酒（17 周岁及以上）1 升；啤酒（17 周岁及以上）2 升；其他商品累计价值不超过 40 欧元（非商业性）；'小'边境交通协议涵盖居住在奥地利邻国瑞士和列支敦士登边境的人员，并含特定食品的进一步豁免。特别制度——Samnaun 飞地：居住在奥地利的旅客自瑞士海关飞地 Samnaun 入境时，烟草适用减免数量（17 周岁及以上）：40 支香烟或 20 支小雪茄或 10 支雪茄或 50 克吸用烟草或按比例组合；其他商品仍按一般累计价值免税（航空旅客每公历日 430 欧元／其他旅客 300 欧元，15 岁以下 150 欧元）；自 Samnaun 购得烟草制品经 Pfunds、Spiss 或 Martinsbruck 海关办事处入境视同直接进口。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival at the border: when going through customs control, submit the customs declaration there for goods not intended for personal use, goods obtained outside the EU exceeding the duty-free amounts/allowance, and prohibited or restricted goods; goods within the allowances for personal or same-household use pass without charges.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达边境时：经海关检查须当场提交海关申报，对象为非自用物品、在欧盟境外获得且超过免税数量/额度的物品以及禁止或限制进口的物品；额度内的自用或同住家庭用品免税放行。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 自非歐盟國家入境奧地利的物品申報（免稅數量與免稅額度）——奧地利海關／財政部（BMF）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：自非歐盟（第三國）國家入境奧地利的旅客。以下為一般旅客免稅數值；邊境通勤減免數值（含居住在奧地利的旅客自 Samnaun 飛地入境的菸草減免）為文末單列的特別制度，不得當作一般數值使用。自用或供同住家庭成員使用的物品，可免稅帶入奧地利。經海關檢查時必須申報下列物品——即須提交海關申報（submit a customs declaration）：非自用物品；在歐盟境外獲得、超過菸草製品、酒精飲料、藥品免稅數量或超過其他商品免稅額度的物品；受進口禁止或限制的物品。在隨身行李中自用或作為禮品免稅（須滿 17 週歲）：菸草——200 支香菸，或 100 支小雪茄（cigarillos），或 50 支雪茄，或 250 克吸用菸草，或按比例組合（'加熱菸草'即菸草棒類產品適用'其他商品'一節的免稅限額）；酒精飲料——酒精含量超過 22% vol. 的酒精、蒸餾飲料和烈酒（含 80% vol. 及以上的未變性乙醇）1 升，或酒精含量不超過 22% vol. 的酒精飲料 2 升，或按比例組合，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒以及 16 升啤酒；藥品——與旅途個人需要相一致的數量（歐盟居民無需許可即可攜帶其出境時已隨身攜帶的藥品入境；在境外購買的藥品每人僅限 3 個零售包裝）；其他商品——每公曆日累計價值航空旅客 430 歐元、其他所有旅客 300 歐元，以非商業性入境為前提；15 歲以下旅客該額度一般降為 150 歐元。在該額度內，'加熱菸草'類產品不得超過 800 支菸草棒或以其他形態計 250 克菸草；超過該指示性數量時，須證明物品確為自用。多名旅客不得合併免稅額度（例如兩人不能合併 80 歐元額度免稅帶入一件商品）；免稅額度每公曆日只能主張一次。經另一歐盟成員國中轉前來時，須注意該成員國自身的規定。上述免稅商品同樣適用進口禁止與限制。特別制度——邊境通勤減免：菸草（17 週歲及以上）25 支香菸或 10 支小雪茄或 5 支雪茄或 25 克吸用菸草或按比例組合；酒精（17 週歲及以上）超過 22% vol. 的 0.25 升或不超過 22% vol. 的 0.75 升或按比例組合；不起泡葡萄酒（17 週歲及以上）1 升；啤酒（17 週歲及以上）2 升；其他商品累計價值不超過 40 歐元（非商業性）；'小'邊境交通協議涵蓋居住在奧地利鄰國瑞士和列支敦士登邊境的人員，並含特定食品的進一步豁免。特別制度——Samnaun 飛地：居住在奧地利的旅客自瑞士海關飛地 Samnaun 入境時，菸草適用減免數量（17 週歲及以上）：40 支香菸或 20 支小雪茄或 10 支雪茄或 50 克吸用菸草或按比例組合；其他商品仍按一般累計價值免稅（航空旅客每公曆日 430 歐元／其他旅客 300 歐元，15 歲以下 150 歐元）；自 Samnaun 購得菸草製品經 Pfunds、Spiss 或 Martinsbruck 海關辦事處入境視同直接進口。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達邊境時：經海關檢查須當場提交海關申報，對象為非自用物品、在歐盟境外獲得且超過免稅數量/額度的物品以及禁止或限制進口的物品；額度內的自用或同住家庭用品免稅放行。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration on entering or leaving the EU through Austria (EUR 10,000 or more)
procedures.name_zh: 经奥地利入出欧盟的现金申报（1 万欧元及以上）
procedures.agency: Zollamt Österreich / Bundesministerium für Finanzen (BMF)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: both, at the EU external border. All travellers and crew members who enter or leave the EU by air, land, rail or sea carrying cash worth EUR 10,000 or more (or the equivalent in other currencies) must declare it to customs when Austria is the Member State of entry or exit. Cash includes banknotes and coins, bearer negotiable instruments such as cheques, travellers' cheques, promissory notes and money orders, gold coins with at least 90% gold content, and gold bars, nuggets or clumps with at least 99.5% gold content. Casino chips are not cash. The EUR 10,000 limit applies to each member of a travelling group separately. Parents or legal guardians declare for minors and adults without legal capacity. A traveller carrying cash for a company must name the company in the declaration. Undeclared cash of EUR 10,000 or more may be retained or seized and penalties may follow; customs may also act on smaller amounts if there are signs of criminal activity. Entering Austria from another EU member state does not call for an unprompted declaration: travellers only have to disclose cash of EUR 10,000 or more if customs ask.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：双向，指欧盟外部边境。所有经空运、陆路、铁路或海路入境或离开欧盟的旅客和机组人员，携带价值 1 万欧元及以上（或等值外币）现金，且以奥地利为入境或出境成员国时，须向海关申报。现金包括纸币和硬币、无记名可转让票据（如支票、旅行支票、本票和汇票）、含金量至少 90% 的金币、含金量至少 99.5% 的金条、金块或金锭；赌场筹码不算现金。1 万欧元限额对同行团体中的每个人分别适用。未成年人和无行为能力的成年人由父母或法定监护人代为申报。为公司携带现金的，须在申报中写明公司名称。未申报的 1 万欧元及以上现金可被扣留或没收并可能受罚；有犯罪迹象时，海关对更小金额也可采取行动。从其他欧盟成员国入境奥地利无须主动申报：仅在海关询问时，旅客才须说明 1 万欧元及以上的现金。
procedures.timing_en: Fill in the cash declaration form (Barmittelerklärung, form CC2) and hand it to the customs office when you enter or leave the EU. Austrian customs recommend filling in the declaration beforehand and sending it electronically to Zollamt Österreich for quicker handling; customs officers answer questions and help with the form.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或离开欧盟时填写现金申报表（Barmittelerklärung，表格 CC2）并交给海关办事处。奥地利海关建议提前填好申报并以电子方式发送给奥地利海关局（Zollamt Österreich）以加快办理；海关人员解答疑问并协助填表。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 經奧地利入出歐盟的現金申報（1 萬歐元及以上）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：雙向，指歐盟外部邊境。所有經空運、陸路、鐵路或海路入境或離開歐盟的旅客和機組人員，攜帶價值 1 萬歐元及以上（或等值外幣）現金，且以奧地利為入境或出境成員國時，須向海關申報。現金包括紙幣和硬幣、無記名可轉讓票據（如支票、旅行支票、本票和匯票）、含金量至少 90% 的金幣、含金量至少 99.5% 的金條、金塊或金錠；賭場籌碼不算現金。1 萬歐元限額對同行團體中的每個人分別適用。未成年人和無行為能力的成年人由父母或法定監護人代為申報。為公司攜帶現金的，須在申報中寫明公司名稱。未申報的 1 萬歐元及以上現金可被扣留或沒收並可能受罰；有犯罪跡象時，海關對更小金額也可採取行動。從其他歐盟成員國入境奧地利無須主動申報：僅在海關詢問時，旅客才須說明 1 萬歐元及以上的現金。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或離開歐盟時填寫現金申報表（Barmittelerklärung，表格 CC2）並交給海關辦事處。奧地利海關建議提前填好申報並以電子方式發送給奧地利海關局（Zollamt Österreich）以加快辦理；海關人員解答疑問並協助填表。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration of EUR 10,000 or more when entering or leaving the EU through Belgium (Regulation (EU) 2018/1672)
procedures.name_zh: 经比利时入出欧盟携带1万欧元及以上现金须申报（欧盟第2018/1672号条例）
procedures.agency: Belgian customs (General Administration of Customs and Excise, Federal Public Service Finance)
procedures.applicability_en: Any traveller who enters the EU from a non-EU country, or leaves the EU for a non-EU country, through Belgium and carries cash worth EUR 10,000 or more (or the equivalent in other currencies) must declare it to the Belgian authorities, which include the General Administration of Customs and Excise of the Federal Public Service Finance and make the cash available for control. Cash means banknotes and coins, bearer negotiable instruments such as cheques, traveller’s cheques, promissory notes and money orders, gold coins with a gold content of at least 90%, and gold bars, nuggets or clumps with a gold content of at least 99.5%. The declaration is made in writing or electronically on the harmonised EU cash declaration form, in one of the languages available in the country where you enter or leave the EU. It covers the carrier, the owner and the intended recipient, the nature and amount of the cash, its economic provenance, its intended use, the transport route and the means of transport. The EUR 10,000 limit applies to each person individually, including each member of a group; minors declare through a parent or legal guardian; if you carry cash for a company, the company name goes on the form. Incorrect or incomplete information, or failing to make the cash available for control, counts as not declaring. Undeclared cash may be detained and national penalties apply. The EU rule does not apply to travel between two EU countries, but some EU countries have their own national rules on cash carried inside the EU.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何经比利时从非欧盟国家入境欧盟、或从欧盟出境前往非欧盟国家的旅客，携带价值1万欧元或以上现金（或等值的其他货币）时，须向比利时主管机关（包括联邦公共服务财政部下属的海关与消费税总局）申报，并将现金交出供查验。“现金”指纸币和硬币、可无记名转让的票据（如支票、旅行支票、本票、汇票）、含金量不低于90%的金币，以及含金量不低于99.5%的金条、金块。申报须以书面或电子方式，使用欧盟统一的现金申报表，并用入出境国家提供的语言之一填写。内容包括携带人、所有人和预定收款人的信息，现金的性质和金额，经济来源，预定用途，运输路线和运输工具。1万欧元的限额按每个人单独计算，同行团体中每个人各自适用；未成年人通过父母或法定监护人申报；替公司携带现金的，须在申报表中写明公司名称。信息不实或不完整、或未将现金交出供查验，均视为未申报。未申报的现金可能被扣留，并可能受到各国规定的处罚。欧盟的这项规则不适用于两个欧盟国家之间的旅行，但部分欧盟国家对欧盟境内携带现金另有本国规定。
procedures.timing_en: At the point where you enter or leave the EU through Belgium, before the cash leaves customs control.
procedures.timing_zh: 经比利时入境或出境欧盟时，在现金离开海关监管前办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 經比利時入出歐盟攜帶1萬歐元及以上現金須申報（歐盟第2018/1672號條例）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何經比利時從非歐盟國家入境歐盟、或從歐盟出境前往非歐盟國家的旅客，攜帶價值1萬歐元或以上現金（或等值的其他貨幣）時，須向比利時主管機關（包括聯邦公共服務財政部下屬的海關與消費稅總局）申報，並將現金交出供查驗。“現金”指紙幣和硬幣、可無記名轉讓的票據（如支票、旅行支票、本票、匯票）、含金量不低於90%的金幣，以及含金量不低於99.5%的金條、金塊。申報須以書面或電子方式，使用歐盟統一的現金申報表，並用入出境國家提供的語言之一填寫。內容包括攜帶人、所有人和預定收款人的資訊，現金的性質和金額，經濟來源，預定用途，運輸路線和運輸工具。1萬歐元的限額按每個人單獨計算，同行團體中每個人各自適用；未成年人通過父母或法定監護人申報；替公司攜帶現金的，須在申報表中寫明公司名稱。資訊不實或不完整、或未將現金交出供查驗，均視為未申報。未申報的現金可能被扣留，並可能受到各國規定的處罰。歐盟的這項規則不適用於兩個歐盟國家之間的旅行，但部分歐盟國家對歐盟境內攜帶現金另有本國規定。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 經比利時入境或出境歐盟時，在現金離開海關監管前辦理。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of cross-border transports of cash of EUR 10,000 or more (obligation déclarative d'argent liquide)
procedures.name_zh: 跨境携带现金 1 万欧元及以上申报（obligation déclarative d'argent liquide）
procedures.agency: Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (DGDDI)
procedures.applicability_en: Any person, French resident or not, entering or leaving France carrying EUR 10,000 or more (inclusive, or the equivalent in foreign currency) in cash or bearer instruments must declare it to customs: banknotes and coins; bearer or endorsable negotiable instruments (bearer cheques, traveller's cheques, money orders, non-domiciled bills of exchange and letters of credit, anonymous cashier's certificates, bearer securities and capitalization bonds); gold — coins, and unminted metal such as ingots, nuggets or other native gold agglomerates containing at least 99.5% gold. Prepaid cards are covered only for intra-EU flows. Both flows are declared: to or from a non-EU country (Regulation (EU) 2018/1672) and to or from an EU member state (article L152-1 of the Code monétaire et financier); transports to or from Monaco are included, while interbank and dematerialized transfers are outside the scheme. If you carry for a third party, the declaration must additionally identify the owner of the funds. Non-declaration, false declaration or non-presentation of the money: fine of up to 50% of the sum concerned and temporary retention of the cash; no declaration may be deposited a posteriori as regularization.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何人员（无论是否法国居民）入境或出境法国时携带等于或超过 1 万欧元（含本数，或等值外币）的现金或无记名工具，均须向海关申报：纸币与硬币；无记名或可背书转让的票据（无记名支票、旅行支票、汇票 mandats、非 domicilié 的商业票据与信用证、无记名存单、无记名有价证券与资本化债券）；黄金——金币，以及未铸币形态的金属（金锭、天然金块或其他含金量至少 99.5% 的自然金凝聚物）。预付卡仅适用于欧盟内部流动（intra-UE）。两种流动均须申报：与欧盟以外国家之间（欧盟 (UE) 2018/1672 号条例）以及与欧盟成员国之间（《货币与金融法典》L152-1 条）；与摩纳哥之间的运送同样包含，银行间转账及经专门机构的非实体化资金转账不适用。为第三方携带时，申报还须载明资金所有人身份。未申报、虚假申报或不出示资金：最高可处涉案金额 50% 的罚款并临时扣留现金；不得事后补报作为补正。
procedures.timing_en: The person transporting the cash files the declaration. Electronically, via the DALIA teledeclaration service (recommended by the douane): at the earliest 30 days before the transport date, at the latest before crossing the border on the day of travel. On paper: the EU harmonized form for extra-EU flows; the national FR form for intra-EU flows (metropolitan France, DROM, Saint-Martin); the COM form for flows involving Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, New Caledonia, French Polynesia, Wallis-et-Futuna or Saint-Barthélemy. Or directly with the customs service at the moment of entry into or exit from French territory.
procedures.timing_zh: 由实际携带现金之人申报。电子方式：经 DALIA 电子申报服务（海关推荐使用），最早可在运送日期前 30 天内、最迟须在旅行当日越过边境之前提交。纸质方式：欧盟外流动用欧盟统一表格；欧盟内部流动（法国本土、海外省与大区 DROM、圣马丁）用法国国家表格；涉及圣皮埃尔和密克隆、新喀里多尼亚、法属波利尼西亚、瓦利斯和富图纳或圣巴泰勒米的流动用 COM 表格。或在入境或出境法国领土之时直接向海关部门申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境攜帶現金 1 萬歐元及以上申報（obligation déclarative d'argent liquide）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何人員（無論是否法國居民）入境或出境法國時攜帶等於或超過 1 萬歐元（含本數，或等值外幣）的現金或無記名工具，均須向海關申報：紙幣與硬幣；無記名或可背書轉讓的票據（無記名支票、旅行支票、匯票 mandats、非 domicilié 的商業票據與信用證、無記名存單、無記名有價證券與資本化債券）；黃金——金幣，以及未鑄幣形態的金屬（金錠、天然金塊或其他含金量至少 99.5% 的自然金凝聚物）。預付卡僅適用於歐盟內部流動（intra-UE）。兩種流動均須申報：與歐盟以外國家之間（歐盟 (UE) 2018/1672 號條例）以及與歐盟成員國之間（《貨幣與金融法典》L152-1 條）；與摩納哥之間的運送同樣包含，銀行間轉賬及經專門機構的非實體化資金轉賬不適用。為第三方攜帶時，申報還須載明資金所有人身份。未申報、虛假申報或不出示資金：最高可處涉案金額 50% 的罰款並臨時扣留現金；不得事後補報作為補正。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 由實際攜帶現金之人申報。電子方式：經 DALIA 電子申報服務（海關推薦使用），最早可在運送日期前 30 天內、最遲須在旅行當日越過邊境之前提交。紙質方式：歐盟外流動用歐盟統一表格；歐盟內部流動（法國本土、海外省與大區 DROM、聖馬丁）用法國國家表格；涉及聖皮埃爾和密克隆、新喀里多尼亞、法屬波利尼西亞、瓦利斯和富圖納或聖巴泰勒米的流動用 COM 表格。或在入境或出境法國領土之時直接向海關部門申報。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding the customs and tax franchises (franchises douanières et fiscales)
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报（franchises douanières et fiscales）
procedures.agency: Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (DGDDI)
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving in metropolitan France with goods bought (or received as gifts) in a country or territory that counts as non-EU for these franchises: a third country; a collectivité d'Outre-Mer or New Caledonia (outside the EU customs territory); or a fiscally third territory such as the DOM (Guadeloupe, Martinique, Guyane, Réunion, Mayotte), Saint-Martin, the Channel Islands or the Canary Islands. Within the value franchise nothing is declared and nothing is due: EUR 430 by plane or boat, EUR 300 by car, train or any other mode, EUR 150 for travellers under 15 whatever the mode. Arriving from a DOM, the Channel Islands or the Canary Islands, customs duties are not due but VAT applies above the same value thresholds; Andorra has its own franchise regime. Any object whose value exceeds the franchise must be declared, with VAT and customs duties levied on the whole purchase price. Quantitative franchises on non-EU arrivals (metropolitan France only): tobacco 200 cigarettes (1 carton), 100 cigarillos, 50 cigars or 250 g smoking tobacco, pro-rata assortment within the category, travellers under 17 excluded, not applicable to Andorra tobacco; alcohol 4 L still wine plus 16 L beer plus 1 L over 22% or 2 L at or under 22% (proportionate assortment), travellers under 17 excluded; medicines to the traveller's needs and fuel (normal tank plus a reserve can of up to 10 L) are separately franchised; quantities are per person, not per vehicle. Frontier workers, cross-border workers and international transport staff have reduced franchises (value EUR 75, EUR 40 for under-15s; 40 cigarettes). Returning from an EU member state: no fixed value or quantity caps on this page — products for the traveller's own use bear no French excise, assessed per passenger aged over 18 (décret n° 2024-276).
procedures.applicability_zh: 在视为非欧盟的国家或地区购物（或获赠）后抵达法国本土时适用：第三国；海外领地或新喀里多尼亚（欧盟关税领土之外）；或财政上视为第三方的领地，如海外省 DOM（瓜德罗普、马提尼克、圭亚那、留尼汪、马约特）、圣马丁、盎格鲁-诺曼底群岛或加那利群岛。价值免税额内无须申报、无须缴税：乘飞机或船 430 欧，乘汽车、火车或其他任何方式 300 欧，15 岁以下旅客不论交通方式 150 欧。自海外省、盎格鲁-诺曼底群岛或加那利群岛入境：无须缴关税，但超过同样的价值门槛须缴增值税；安道尔另有专门免税制度。任何价值超过免税额的物品均须申报，增值税与关税按购货全价计征。非欧盟入境的数量免税额（仅限法国本土）：烟草 200 支香烟（1 条）、100 支 cigarillos、50 支雪茄或 250 克吸烟烟丝，同类内可按比例组合，17 岁以下旅客排除，安道尔烟草不适用；酒精 4 升不起泡葡萄酒加 16 升啤酒，加 1 升 22 度以上或 2 升 22 度及以下（可按比例组合），17 岁以下旅客排除；药品以旅客行程所需为限、燃料以正常油箱加最多 10 升备用桶为限，另行免税；数量按人计算而非按车辆。边境居民、跨境工作者与国际运输从业人员适用减免额度（价值 75 欧、15 岁以下 40 欧；香烟 40 支）。自欧盟成员国返回：本页无固定价值或数量上限——自用产品在法国不产生消费税，按 18 岁以上每位旅客逐人判定（2024-276 号政令）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in France: goods within the value and quantity franchises require no declaration and no payment; above them, the object must be declared, and customs duties, VAT and excise apply to the whole price on the purchase invoice (or the appraised value for a private sale), surplus goods being taxed when several objects are imported at once.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境法国时：价值与数量均在免税额内的物品无须申报、无须缴税；超出时该物品须申报，关税、增值税与消费税按购货发票全价（无发票则按协议估价）计征，同时进口多件物品时超额部分课税。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報（franchises douanières et fiscales）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 在視為非歐盟的國家或地區購物（或獲贈）後抵達法國本土時適用：第三國；海外領地或新喀里多尼亞（歐盟關稅領土之外）；或財政上視為第三方的領地，如海外省 DOM（瓜德羅普、馬提尼克、圭亞那、留尼汪、馬約特）、聖馬丁、盎格魯-諾曼底群島或加那利群島。價值免稅額內無須申報、無須繳稅：乘飛機或船 430 歐，乘汽車、火車或其他任何方式 300 歐，15 歲以下旅客不論交通方式 150 歐。自海外省、盎格魯-諾曼底群島或加那利群島入境：無須繳關稅，但超過同樣的價值門檻須繳增值稅；安道爾另有專門免稅制度。任何價值超過免稅額的物品均須申報，增值稅與關稅按購貨全價計徵。非歐盟入境的數量免稅額（僅限法國本土）：菸草 200 支香菸（1 條）、100 支 cigarillos、50 支雪茄或 250 克吸菸菸絲，同類內可按比例組合，17 歲以下旅客排除，安道爾菸草不適用；酒精 4 升不起泡葡萄酒加 16 升啤酒，加 1 升 22 度以上或 2 升 22 度及以下（可按比例組合），17 歲以下旅客排除；藥品以旅客行程所需為限、燃料以正常油箱加最多 10 升備用桶為限，另行免稅；數量按人計算而非按車輛。邊境居民、跨境工作者與國際運輸從業人員適用減免額度（價值 75 歐、15 歲以下 40 歐；香菸 40 支）。自歐盟成員國返回：本頁無固定價值或數量上限——自用產品在法國不產生消費稅，按 18 歲以上每位旅客逐人判定（2024-276 號政令）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境法國時：價值與數量均在免稅額內的物品無須申報、無須繳稅；超出時該物品須申報，關稅、增值稅與消費稅按購貨發票全價（無發票則按協議估價）計徵，同時進口多件物品時超額部分課稅。

procedures.name_en: Cash and equivalent means of payment declaration (Barmittelanmeldung)
procedures.name_zh: 现金及等同支付手段申报（Barmittelanmeldung）
procedures.agency: Generalzolldirektion / Zoll (German Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Two distinct duties per the Zoll page, not one blanket obligation. (1) Cash (Barmittel): travellers entering Germany from a non-EU member state carrying cash with a total value of 10,000 euros or more must proactively register (anmelden) the amount with customs. (2) Equal means of payment (gleichgestellte Zahlungsmittel, e.g. securities, precious metals, money instruments): these are not subject to proactive registration; they must be declared orally only upon questioning (auf Befragung) by a customs officer. The obligation also applies to passengers from a non-EU state staying in the international transit zone of an EU member state airport before flying on to another non-EU state.
procedures.applicability_zh: 按 Zoll 官方页面，这是两项不同的义务，不能用一句“须主动申报”统括。(1) 现金（Barmittel）：从非欧盟成员国入境德国、携带总价值 10,000 欧元及以上现金的旅客，必须主动向海关申报登记该金额。(2) 等同支付手段（gleichgestellte Zahlungsmittel，如有价证券、贵金属、货币票据）：不适用主动申报，仅在海关人员询问时口头申报。从非欧盟国家出发、经欧盟成员国机场国际中转区前往另一非欧盟国家的旅客同样适用。
procedures.timing_en: Online via the Zollportal service 'Barmittelanmeldeerklärung', form 040000_1; registration and login are required and submission produces a reference number. Paper forms 040000 (German) / 040001 (English) with annex sheets 040050/040051 may still be used in individual cases only — not an unconditional equivalent option.
procedures.timing_zh: 通过 Zollportal 在线服务「Barmittelanmeldeerklärung」办理，表单 040000_1，需注册登录，提交后产生识别码。纸质表 040000（德文）/040001（英文）及附页 040050/040051 仅在个别情况下仍可使用，不是无条件等价的任选路径。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金及等同支付手段申報（Barmittelanmeldung）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 按 Zoll 官方頁面，這是兩項不同的義務，不能用一句“須主動申報”統括。(1) 現金（Barmittel）：從非歐盟成員國入境德國、攜帶總價值 10,000 歐元及以上現金的旅客，必須主動向海關申報登記該金額。(2) 等同支付手段（gleichgestellte Zahlungsmittel，如有價證券、貴金屬、貨幣票據）：不適用主動申報，僅在海關人員詢問時口頭申報。從非歐盟國家出發、經歐盟成員國機場國際中轉區前往另一非歐盟國家的旅客同樣適用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 通過 Zollportal 線上服務「Barmittelanmeldeerklärung」辦理，表單 040000_1，需註冊登入，提交後產生識別碼。紙質表 040000（德文）/040001（英文）及附頁 040050/040051 僅在個別情況下仍可使用，不是無條件等價的任選路徑。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding travellers' allowances (Reisefreimengen)
procedures.name_zh: 超旅客免税额商品申报（Reisefreimengen）
procedures.agency: Generalzolldirektion / Zoll (German Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Entering Germany from a non-EU country: goods up to EUR 300 duty-free (EUR 430 for air/sea travellers, EUR 175 for travellers under 15). Alcohol (17+): 1 L spirits over 22% vol or 2 L up to 22%, plus 4 L still wine and 16 L beer. Tobacco (17+): 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 g tobacco. Fuel: tank plus up to 10 L in a portable container. Goods above the allowances must be declared and taxed on the whole item value.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自非欧盟国家入境德国：商品价值免税额 300 欧（飞机/海路 430 欧，15 岁以下 175 欧）；酒精（17 岁以上）22% vol 以上 1 升或 22% 及以下 2 升，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒和 16 升啤酒；烟草（17 岁以上）200 支香烟或 100 支 cigarillos 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克烟丝；燃料为油箱加最多 10 升备用。超出免税额的商品须申报并按整件计税。
procedures.timing_en: Use the red channel / declare to customs on arrival; the current official page is travellers-allowances_node.html (previously cited _functions.html URL is dead).
procedures.timing_zh: 入境走红通道或向海关申报；现行官方页为 travellers-allowances_node.html（原引用的 _functions.html 已失效）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超旅客免稅額商品申報（Reisefreimengen）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自非歐盟國家入境德國：商品價值免稅額 300 歐（飛機/海路 430 歐，15 歲以下 175 歐）；酒精（17 歲以上）22% vol 以上 1 升或 22% 及以下 2 升，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒和 16 升啤酒；菸草（17 歲以上）200 支香菸或 100 支 cigarillos 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克菸絲；燃料為油箱加最多 10 升備用。超出免稅額的商品須申報並按整件計稅。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境走紅通道或向海關申報；現行官方頁為 travellers-allowances_node.html（原引用的 _functions.html 已失效）。

procedures.name_en: Unsolicited declaration of carried goods at the external border of the customs territory (green/red channel, QuickZoll) — Swiss customs rules applicable to Liechtenstein through the customs union
procedures.name_zh: 在共同海关领地对外边境主动申报随身物品（绿色/红色通道、QuickZoll）——经关税同盟适用于列支敦士登的瑞士海关规则
procedures.agency: Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (Bundesamt für Zoll und Grenzsicherheit, BAZG), Switzerland — customs authority for the Swiss customs territory, which includes Liechtenstein under the Customs Union Treaty of 29 March 1923
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering the common Swiss–Liechtenstein customs territory with goods — for Liechtenstein this is effectively its external border (with Austria); the same Swiss rules govern the Swiss external borders, while crossing between Switzerland and Liechtenstein is not a repeat declaration point for these import matters — the 1923 Customs Union Treaty Art. 1(2) expressly provides only that neither side may levy duties or impose general import/export restrictions at that internal border, and no assertion is made that customs questioning or other checks cannot occur there. Territorial basis: Treaty Art. 1(1) and Art. 4(1); EGZV Art. 1(1) (entire Swiss customs legislation applies in Liechtenstein). At the border crossing, travellers should keep recognized valid travel documents ready and unsolicitedly declare all goods and animals they are carrying that are not covered by the duty-free allowances (Freimengen) and the value-free limit (Wertfreigrenze) — i.e. declarable goods must be declared even without being asked. The customs declaration can be completed for most goods with the QuickZoll app (which also pre-calculates import charges for traveller imports); travellers unsure whether goods must be declared should choose the red channel / customs office, while travellers with nothing to declare may use the green channel (e.g. at airports) or display the green visor self-declaration card (Sichtzollanmeldung) on the dashboard when crossing by car. The green self-declaration is binding, and customs staff may conduct controls without questioning. Specific allowance figures (including any CHF 150-type value-free limit) are deliberately NOT stated here: the direction-specific BAZG subpages carrying the figures were not located.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：携带物品进入瑞士—列支敦士登共同海关领地的旅客——对列支敦士登而言即其对外边境（与奥地利接壤处）；瑞士对外边境适用同样规则，而在瑞士与列支敦士登之间穿越内部边境不构成此类对外进口事项的重复申报点——1923年《同盟条约》第1条第2款明文仅规定该内部边境双方不得征收关税、不得设一般进出口限制，此处不断言该边境不会发生海关问询或其他查验。属地依据：条约第1条第1款、第4条第1款；EGZV 第1条第1款（瑞士全部海关立法在列支敦士登适用）。过境时应备好受认可的有效旅行证件，并主动（无待询问）申报所携带的一切不在免税额度（Freimengen）与免征限额（Wertfreigrenze）范围内的物品及动物——即须申报物品即使未被询问也须申报。大多数物品的海关申报可用 QuickZoll 应用办理（该应用还可预计算旅行入境物品的进口费用）；不确定是否须申报时应走红色通道/海关柜台，无可申报者可走绿色通道（如机场）或在乘车过境时将绿色自觉申报卡（Sichtzollanmeldung）置于仪表板上。绿色自觉申报具约束力，海关人员可不经问询即实施检查。具体免税额度数字（包括任何类似 150 瑞郎的免征限额）在此明确不作断言：载有数字的分方向 BAZG 子页面暂未获取。
procedures.timing_en: At the border crossing on entry: declare carried goods beyond the allowances unsolicited — via the QuickZoll app (self-assessment, usable before reaching the border) or at the red channel / customs post on arrival; nothing to declare → green channel or dashboard visor card. Crossing between Switzerland and Liechtenstein is not a repeat declaration point for this goods declaration — Treaty Art. 1(2) expressly provides only that neither side may levy duties or impose general import/export restrictions at that internal border; no assertion is made that customs questioning or other checks cannot occur there.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境过境时：主动申报超额随身物品——可用 QuickZoll 应用（自行估税，可在抵达边境前办理）或在抵达时经红色通道/海关柜台申报；无可申报则走绿色通道或放置仪表板自觉申报卡。在瑞士与列支敦士登之间穿越不构成此项物品申报的重复申报点——条约第1条第2款明文仅规定该内部边境不得征税、不得设一般进出口限制；此处不断言该边境不会发生海关问询或其他查验。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 在共同海關領地對外邊境主動申報隨身物品（綠色/紅色通道、QuickZoll）——經關稅同盟適用於列支敦士登的瑞士海關規則
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：攜帶物品進入瑞士—列支敦士登共同海關領地的旅客——對列支敦士登而言即其對外邊境（與奧地利接壤處）；瑞士對外邊境適用同樣規則，而在瑞士與列支敦士登之間穿越內部邊境不構成此類對外進口事項的重複申報點——1923年《同盟條約》第1條第2款明文僅規定該內部邊境雙方不得徵收關稅、不得設一般進出口限制，此處不斷言該邊境不會發生海關問詢或其他查驗。屬地依據：條約第1條第1款、第4條第1款；EGZV 第1條第1款（瑞士全部海關立法在列支敦士登適用）。過境時應備好受認可的有效旅行證件，並主動（無待詢問）申報所攜帶的一切不在免稅額度（Freimengen）與免徵限額（Wertfreigrenze）範圍內的物品及動物——即須申報物品即使未被詢問也須申報。大多數物品的海關申報可用 QuickZoll 應用辦理（該應用還可預計算旅行入境物品的進口費用）；不確定是否須申報時應走紅色通道/海關櫃檯，無可申報者可走綠色通道（如機場）或在乘車過境時將綠色自覺申報卡（Sichtzollanmeldung）置於儀表板上。綠色自覺申報具約束力，海關人員可不經問詢即實施檢查。具體免稅額度數字（包括任何類似 150 瑞郎的免徵限額）在此明確不作斷言：載有數字的分方向 BAZG 子頁面暫未獲取。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境過境時：主動申報超額隨身物品——可用 QuickZoll 應用（自行估稅，可在抵達邊境前辦理）或在抵達時經紅色通道/海關櫃檯申報；無可申報則走綠色通道或放置儀表板自覺申報卡。在瑞士與列支敦士登之間穿越不構成此項物品申報的重複申報點——條約第1條第2款明文僅規定該內部邊境不得徵稅、不得設一般進出口限制；此處不斷言該邊境不會發生海關問詢或其他查驗。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding allowances (franchises hors UE)
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报（franchises hors UE）
procedures.agency: Administration des douanes et accises du Luxembourg (ADA)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers arriving directly in Luxembourg from a country outside the European Union. On entry, you must declare the transported goods to the customs office (bureau de douane) and pay the corresponding duties and taxes — the current page states an actual traveller submission action, so this obligation is treated as a genuine customs declaration duty. Duty-free franchises (purchases or gifts): tobacco products — 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 g of tobacco (proportional assortment within the same category; travellers under 17 excluded); alcoholic beverages — in total 1 litre of alcohol and alcoholic beverages over 22% vol., or non-denatured ethyl alcohol of 80% vol. and above, or in total 2 litres of alcohol and alcoholic beverages not exceeding 22% vol., plus 4 litres of still wine and up to 16 litres of beer in total (for VAT and excise purposes; travellers under 17 excluded); other goods, including perfume, coffee or tea, and products assimilated to manufactured tobacco such as heated tobacco, e-liquids and nicotine pouches — value not exceeding EUR 430 for travellers by air or sea, EUR 300 for other travellers, reduced to EUR 175 for travellers under 15. Franchise amounts cannot be pooled by several persons for one and the same object (a group or family of four cannot claim the franchise for a EUR 1,720 item), and goods composed of several elements transported together count as a single set regardless of the number of invoices. Any object whose value exceeds the franchise must be declared, and duties and taxes are charged on the total value without any abatement. Personal effects of EU residents in a regular EU situation (bought in the EU with taxes paid, or with proof that EU duties/taxes were paid) may be admitted without formalities and without national duties/taxes; customs may ask for supporting documents on arrival, and unworn items in original packaging, large quantities of apparently new personal effects or high-value electronics can raise a presumption that the franchise conditions are not met.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：自欧盟外国家直接抵达卢森堡的旅客。入境时必须向海关办事处（bureau de douane）申报所运物品并缴纳相应关税与税款——现行官方页面载有真实的旅客申报动作，故本条保留为真实的海关申报义务。免税额度（购物或礼品）：烟草制品——200 支香烟或 100 支 cigarillos 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克烟草（同类别内可按比例组合；17 岁以下旅客不适用）；酒精饮料——合计 1 升酒精含量超过 22% vol. 的酒精及酒精饮料，或 80% vol. 及以上的非变性乙醇，或合计 2 升不超过 22% vol. 的酒精及酒精饮料，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒及总共最多 16 升啤酒（仅为增值税与消费税目的；17 岁以下旅客不适用）；其他商品（含香水、咖啡、茶，以及视同烟草制品的加热烟草、电子烟烟液与尼古丁袋）——乘飞机或海路旅客价值不超过 430 欧，其他旅客 300 欧，15 岁以下旅客减为 175 欧。多人不得就同一物品合并免税额（四人家庭不能对 1,720 欧物品主张 430 欧×4），由多个部件组成并经同一交通工具同时运输的商品无论发票数量均视为单件成套物品。任何价值超过免税额的物品均须申报，关税与税款按总值计征、不作任何扣减。处于欧盟合规状态（在欧盟含税购得，或能出示欧盟关税/税款已缴证明）的欧盟居民个人自用品可免手续、免国家税费携入；海关可在入境时要求出示凭证，未有明显使用痕迹的原包装物品、大批量看似全新的个人衣物或高价值电子产品可能引发不符合免税条件的推定。
procedures.timing_en: At entry to Luxembourg: declare the transported goods to the customs office and pay the corresponding duties and taxes; goods within the franchise pass free of duties and taxes. The amounts and the declaration duty are stated on the hors-ce subpage of the franchises section (captured live 2026-09-27, HTTP 200). The duties and taxes payable on excess goods are a tax charge on the goods, not a form-filing fee.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境卢森堡时：向海关办事处申报所运物品并缴纳相应关税与税款；免税额内物品免征放行。各项额度与申报义务载于 franchises 栏目 hors-ce 子页（2026-09-27 现场抓取，HTTP 200）。超额物品缴纳的关税与税款属对物品征收的税负，并非表格申报费用。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報（franchises hors UE）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：自歐盟外國家直接抵達盧森堡的旅客。入境時必須向海關辦事處（bureau de douane）申報所運物品並繳納相應關稅與稅款——現行官方頁面載有真實的旅客申報動作，故本條保留為真實的海關申報義務。免稅額度（購物或禮品）：菸草製品——200 支香菸或 100 支 cigarillos 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克菸草（同類別內可按比例組合；17 歲以下旅客不適用）；酒精飲料——合計 1 升酒精含量超過 22% vol. 的酒精及酒精飲料，或 80% vol. 及以上的非變性乙醇，或合計 2 升不超過 22% vol. 的酒精及酒精飲料，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒及總共最多 16 升啤酒（僅為增值稅與消費稅目的；17 歲以下旅客不適用）；其他商品（含香水、咖啡、茶，以及視同菸草製品的加熱菸草、電子煙煙液與尼古丁袋）——乘飛機或海路旅客價值不超過 430 歐，其他旅客 300 歐，15 歲以下旅客減為 175 歐。多人不得就同一物品合併免稅額（四人家庭不能對 1,720 歐物品主張 430 歐×4），由多個部件組成並經同一交通工具同時運輸的商品無論發票數量均視為單件成套物品。任何價值超過免稅額的物品均須申報，關稅與稅款按總值計徵、不作任何扣減。處於歐盟合規狀態（在歐盟含稅購得，或能出示歐盟關稅/稅款已繳證明）的歐盟居民個人自用品可免手續、免國家稅費攜入；海關可在入境時要求出示憑證，未有明顯使用痕跡的原包裝物品、大批量看似全新的個人衣物或高價值電子產品可能引發不符合免稅條件的推定。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境盧森堡時：向海關辦事處申報所運物品並繳納相應關稅與稅款；免稅額內物品免徵放行。各項額度與申報義務載於 franchises 欄目 hors-ce 子頁（2026-09-27 現場抓取，HTTP 200）。超額物品繳納的關稅與稅款屬對物品徵收的稅負，並非表格申報費用。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of cross-border transports of accompanied cash of EUR 10,000 or more (déclaration d'argent liquide)
procedures.name_zh: 跨境运输随行现金满 1 万欧元及以上申报（déclaration d'argent liquide）
procedures.agency: Administration des douanes et accises du Luxembourg (ADA)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: any person of full age (whatever their residence and nationality) entering or leaving the Grand-Duchy of Luxembourg while carrying accompanied cash of a sum equal to or greater than EUR 10,000, or the equivalent in other currencies. The duty covers both directions and both regimes: transports from Luxembourg to an EU member state (intra-EU) or to a third country (extra-EU), and transports into Luxembourg from an EU member state or from a third country. Declared instruments (aggregate value EUR 10,000 or more): banknotes and coins in circulation as instruments of exchange; bearer negotiable instruments, including monetary instruments such as travellers' cheques; negotiable instruments including cheques, promissory notes and money orders that are to bearer, endorsable without restriction, made out to a fictitious payee, or in a form transferring ownership upon delivery; incomplete signed instruments (cheques, promissory notes, money orders) with no payee indicated; and very liquid stores of value with a high value-to-volume ratio easily converted into cash at low transaction cost — coins containing at least 90% gold, and unminted metal such as ingots, nuggets or other native gold agglomerates containing at least 99.5% gold. Jewellery, diamonds and other precious stones are not covered. The duty applies whether the person carries for their own account or for a third party (individual or company); minors declare through their parents or legal guardians, and adults under guardianship through their legal representative. Interbank transfers are not covered. In extra-EU transports, a customs declaration may additionally be required for gold stores-of-value transported to or from third countries. The declaration is not deemed executed if the information provided is incorrect or incomplete. Non-declaration or false declaration: criminal fine of EUR 251 to 25,000 under article 14 of the law of 16 July 2021, plus possible partial confiscation of the cash — a penalty, not a filing fee. Scope decision: unaccompanied cash forming part of a shipment (e.g. sent by mail, parcel or freight) is subject to a separate disclosure declaration (déclaration de divulgation d'argent liquide) with its own intra-EU and extra-EU forms, and, where not filed beforehand, must be disclosed at the latest within 30 days of an ADA requisition; that shipment procedure is distinct and deliberately outside this traveller accompanied-cash record.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：任何成年人员（无论居住地与国籍）进入或离开卢森堡大公国时携带总和等于或超过 1 万欧元（或等值其他货币）的随行现金。义务双向覆盖、两种制度并包：自卢森堡前往欧盟成员国（欧盟内 intra-UE）或第三国（欧盟外 extra-UE），以及自欧盟成员国或第三国进入卢森堡。应申报工具（合计价值满 1 万欧元及以上）：流通中作为交换手段的纸币与硬币；无记名可转让票据，含旅行支票等无记名货币工具；以无记名、无限制背书、以虚构受益人为抬头或以交付即转移所有权形式存在的可转让票据（支票、本票、汇票）；已签署但未载明受益人姓名的不完整票据（支票、本票、汇票）；以及价值/体积比高、仅低交易成本即可在可及市场轻易变现的高流动性价值储藏商品——含金量至少 90% 的金币，及含金量至少 99.5% 的未铸币金属（金锭、天然金块或其他自然金凝聚物）。珠宝、钻石及其他宝石不属于申报范围。为本人或为第三方（个人或公司）携带均适用义务；未成年人须经父母或法定监护人申报，受监护的成年人须经法定代理人申报。银行间转账不适用。欧盟外运输中，与第三国往来的黄金价值储藏物或须在现金申报之外另行提交海关申报（déclaration en douane）。所提供信息不实或不全的，申报视为未履行。未申报或虚假申报：依 2021 年 7 月 16 日法律第 14 条可处 251 至 25,000 欧刑事罚款，并可能被部分没收现金——此为处罚，并非申报费用。范围决定：作为货物发送的非随行现金（如经邮寄、包裹、货运）适用另一项独立的披露申报（déclaration de divulgation d'argent liquide），另有无欧盟内/欧盟外专用表格；未事先申报的，最迟须在 ADA 要求（réquisition）后 30 日内披露。该发送程序性质不同，明确不在本旅客随行现金记录范围内。
procedures.timing_en: Before the movement (préalablement au déplacement): file the declaration via the MyGuichet procedure 'Déclaration de transport transfrontalier d'argent liquide' (authenticated mode, private or business space, or non-authenticated mode under MyGuichet.lu conditions), or complete and sign the paper form (intra-EU or extra-EU version, plus supplementary sheet if needed) and return it by e-mail to cashdeclaration@do.etat.lu, or by post or by deposit at one of the customs offices: Centre Douanier - Croix de Gasperich, Bureau Nord, or Findel Aérogare (departure: desk Douane/Customs (9) at level 0; arrival: desk contrôle Douane/Customs Control (30) at level -1). If no declaration has been made before entering or leaving the territory, you are in violation of the legal framework. Information: ADA Bureau Centre, (+352) 2818 4499, cashinfo@do.etat.lu. Legal basis: Regulation (EU) 2018/1672, Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776, the law of 16 July 2021 and the grand-ducal regulation of 16 July 2021.
procedures.timing_zh: 在出行前（préalablement au déplacement）办理：经 MyGuichet 程序「Déclaration de transport transfrontalier d'argent liquide」申报（认证模式——个人空间或专业空间——或按 MyGuichet.lu 规则以非认证模式），或填写并签署纸质表格（欧盟内版或欧盟外版，需要时加附页）后，以电子邮件发回 cashdeclaration@do.etat.lu，或以邮寄/当面递交至以下海关办事处之一：Centre Douanier - Croix de Gasperich、Bureau Nord 或 Findel 机场航站楼（出发：0 层 Douane/Customs 9 号柜台；到达：-1 层 contrôle Douane/Customs Control 30 号柜台）。入境或出境领土前未申报的，即属违反法律框架。咨询：ADA Bureau Centre，(+352) 2818 4499，cashinfo@do.etat.lu。法律依据：欧盟 2018/1672 号条例、欧盟实施条例 2021/776、2021 年 7 月 16 日法律及 2021 年 7 月 16 日大公国条例。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境運輸隨行現金滿 1 萬歐元及以上申報（déclaration d'argent liquide）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：任何成年人員（無論居住地與國籍）進入或離開盧森堡大公國時攜帶總和等於或超過 1 萬歐元（或等值其他貨幣）的隨行現金。義務雙向覆蓋、兩種制度並包：自盧森堡前往歐盟成員國（歐盟內 intra-UE）或第三國（歐盟外 extra-UE），以及自歐盟成員國或第三國進入盧森堡。應申報工具（合計價值滿 1 萬歐元及以上）：流通中作為交換手段的紙幣與硬幣；無記名可轉讓票據，含旅行支票等無記名貨幣工具；以無記名、無限制背書、以虛構受益人為抬頭或以交付即轉移所有權形式存在的可轉讓票據（支票、本票、匯票）；已簽署但未載明受益人姓名的不完整票據（支票、本票、匯票）；以及價值/體積比高、僅低交易成本即可在可及市場輕易變現的高流動性價值儲藏商品——含金量至少 90% 的金幣，及含金量至少 99.5% 的未鑄幣金屬（金錠、天然金塊或其他自然金凝聚物）。珠寶、鑽石及其他寶石不屬於申報範圍。為本人或為第三方（個人或公司）攜帶均適用義務；未成年人須經父母或法定監護人申報，受監護的成年人須經法定代理人申報。銀行間轉賬不適用。歐盟外運輸中，與第三國往來的黃金價值儲藏物或須在現金申報之外另行提交海關申報（déclaration en douane）。所提供資訊不實或不全的，申報視為未履行。未申報或虛假申報：依 2021 年 7 月 16 日法律第 14 條可處 251 至 25,000 歐刑事罰款，並可能被部分沒收現金——此為處罰，並非申報費用。範圍決定：作為貨物發送的非隨行現金（如經郵寄、包裹、貨運）適用另一項獨立的披露申報（déclaration de divulgation d'argent liquide），另有無歐盟內/歐盟外專用表格；未事先申報的，最遲須在 ADA 要求（réquisition）後 30 日內披露。該發送程序性質不同，明確不在本旅客隨行現金記錄範圍內。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在出行前（préalablement au déplacement）辦理：經 MyGuichet 程序「Déclaration de transport transfrontalier d'argent liquide」申報（認證模式——個人空間或專業空間——或按 MyGuichet.lu 規則以非認證模式），或填寫並簽署紙質表格（歐盟內版或歐盟外版，需要時加附頁）後，以電子郵件發回 cashdeclaration@do.etat.lu，或以郵寄/當面遞交至以下海關辦事處之一：Centre Douanier - Croix de Gasperich、Bureau Nord 或 Findel 機場航站樓（出發：0 層 Douane/Customs 9 號櫃檯；到達：-1 層 contrôle Douane/Customs Control 30 號櫃檯）。入境或出境領土前未申報的，即屬違反法律框架。諮詢：ADA Bureau Centre，(+352) 2818 4499，cashinfo@do.etat.lu。法律依據：歐盟 2018/1672 號條例、歐盟實施條例 2021/776、2021 年 7 月 16 日法律及 2021 年 7 月 16 日大公國條例。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of accompanied cash on entering or leaving Monaco (over EUR 10,000)
procedures.name_zh: 进出摩纳哥随身现金申报（超过1万欧元）
procedures.agency: Direction de la Sûreté Publique — autorité de contrôle designated by Article 52 of Ordonnance Souveraine n° 2.318 (Principauté de Monaco)
procedures.applicability_en: Any natural person entering or leaving the territory of the Principality of Monaco who transports cash on themselves, in their baggage or in their means of transport must declare it when the total is strictly above EUR 10,000 (Law n° 1.362 of 3 August 2009, Art. 60: "supérieur à un montant fixé par ordonnance souveraine"; Ordonnance Souveraine n° 2.318, Art. 64 fixes that amount at 10.000 euros and the annex form is for a "valeur totale excédant 10.000 euros" — exactly EUR 10,000 does not trigger the duty; do not apply the French/EU "EUR 10,000 or more" rule). "Argent liquide" per OS 2.318 Art. 51-1: banknotes and coins in circulation; bearer-negotiable instruments (travellers' cheques; bearer cheques, promissory notes and money orders); gold coins with at least 90% gold and unminted gold (bars, nuggets, aggregates) with at least 99.5% gold; non-named prepaid cards not linked to a bank account. Unaccompanied cash shipped without a carrier falls under Law Art. 60-1 (sender/recipient disclosure) and is out of scope here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何自然人进入或离开摩纳哥公国领土，随身、行李或所乘交通工具携带“现金（argent liquide）”且总额严格超过1万欧元时，必须申报：法律第60条原文为“supérieur à un montant fixé par ordonnance souveraine”（严格超过，不含本数），实施令（Ordonnance Souveraine n° 2.318）第64条将该金额定为10.000欧元，附件表单亦写明“valeur totale excédant 10.000 euros”——恰好1万欧元不触发申报义务，不得套用法国/欧盟“满1万即须申报”的口径。“现金”范围（实施令第51-1条）：流通中（或仍可兑换为流通中）的纸币与硬币；无记名可转让票据（旅行支票；无记名支票、本票与汇票）；含金量≥90%的金币与≥99.5%的未铸币黄金（金条、天然金块或聚合体）；不记名且未关联银行账户的预付卡。无承运人随行运送的现金属法律第60-1条（寄件人/收件人申报），不在本条范围。
procedures.timing_en: Dated and signed annex form: by post before transporting the funds, addressed to the Direction de la Sûreté Publique (9, rue Suffren-Reymond, BP 555, MC 98015 Monaco Cedex); or at the latest during the transport of the funds in the Principality, by handing it to an agent of the Sûreté Publique. Keep a duplicate of the declaration during the stay in the Principality and produce it on request (OS 2.318 Arts. 53–54). Law Art. 60 also allows declaration "par écrit ou par voie électronique", but the complete consolidated OS 2.318 as served by Legimonaco (version @2025.06.07, full page verified 2026-09-30) operationalises only these two modes for the Arts. 60/60-1 declarations — no electronic filing channel for them appears anywhere in the ordinance text; whether a separate service outside the ordinance offers one is unconfirmed.
procedures.timing_zh: 使用实施令附件表单（须注明日期并签字）：可在运送资金之前邮寄至公共安全局 Direction de la Sûreté Publique（9, rue Suffren-Reymond, BP 555, MC 98015 Monaco Cedex）；或最迟在公国境内运送资金期间，当面交给公共安全局人员。在公国逗留期间须留存申报副本，并应公共安全局人员要求出示（实施令第53–54条）。法律第60条虽提及“书面或电子形式（par écrit ou par voie électronique）”，但经2026-09-30对 Legimonaco 现行合并版实施令（@2025.06.07）完整页面逐条核验，第52–53条仅落实邮寄与当面递交两种方式，条例全文未载任何针对第60/60-1条申报的电子渠道；条例文本之外的单独服务渠道是否存在仍未确认。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出摩納哥隨身現金申報（超過1萬歐元）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何自然人進入或離開摩納哥公國領土，隨身、行李或所乘交通工具攜帶“現金（argent liquide）”且總額嚴格超過1萬歐元時，必須申報：法律第60條原文為“supérieur à un montant fixé par ordonnance souveraine”（嚴格超過，不含本數），實施令（Ordonnance Souveraine n° 2.318）第64條將該金額定為10.000歐元，附件表單亦寫明“valeur totale excédant 10.000 euros”——恰好1萬歐元不觸發申報義務，不得套用法國/歐盟“滿1萬即須申報”的口徑。“現金”範圍（實施令第51-1條）：流通中（或仍可兌換為流通中）的紙幣與硬幣；無記名可轉讓票據（旅行支票；無記名支票、本票與匯票）；含金量≥90%的金幣與≥99.5%的未鑄幣黃金（金條、天然金塊或聚合體）；不記名且未關聯銀行賬戶的預付卡。無承運人隨行運送的現金屬法律第60-1條（寄件人/收件人申報），不在本條範圍。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 使用實施令附件表單（須註明日期並簽字）：可在運送資金之前郵寄至公共安全局 Direction de la Sûreté Publique（9, rue Suffren-Reymond, BP 555, MC 98015 Monaco Cedex）；或最遲在公國境內運送資金期間，當面交給公共安全局人員。在公國逗留期間須留存申報副本，並應公共安全局人員要求出示（實施令第53–54條）。法律第60條雖提及“書面或電子形式（par écrit ou par voie électronique）”，但經2026-09-30對 Legimonaco 現行合併版實施令（@2025.06.07）完整頁面逐條核驗，第52–53條僅落實郵寄與當面遞交兩種方式，條例全文未載任何針對第60/60-1條申報的電子渠道；條例文本之外的單獨服務渠道是否存在仍未確認。
