procedures.name_en: Declaration to customs of goods on arrival in New Caledonia (Direction des douanes de Nouvelle-Calédonie)
procedures.name_zh: 抵达新喀里多尼亚时向海关申报所携物品（新喀里多尼亚地区海关）
procedures.agency: Direction Régionale des Douanes de Nouvelle-Calédonie (regional customs directorate, douane.gouv.nc)
procedures.applicability_en: Conditional and arrival-direction only: no form is filed by every traveller. The duty to declare arises only for a traveller ARRIVING in New Caledonia who carries goods that must be declared — prohibited or authorisation-required goods, goods exceeding the traveller franchise in quantity or value, goods carried professionally or beyond strict personal/family use, goods under temporary admission, or duty-free purchases. A traveller with nothing to declare simply uses the green channel (« Si vous n'avez rien à déclarer, vous pouvez passer au filtre vert »), no proactive submission being required, although customs may stop any traveller at any time. Submission medium: in person, at the border — at Tontouta, after immigration formalities and baggage reclaim, a traveller with goods to declare, or unsure whether goods must be declared, must present himself voluntarily to a customs officer (« vous devez vous présenter volontairement à un agent des douanes »). New Caledonia has customs and fiscal autonomy: its rules are specific and distinct from metropolitan France's and from any other collectivity's (« La fiscalité et les règles douanières en Nouvelle-Calédonie sont spécifiques »), so metropolitan franchise levels do not apply; duties and taxes on goods beyond the franchise are paid at the customs office (DGDDI: « acquitter les droits et taxes correspondants au bureau de douane »). Goods to declare whatever their origin or provenance: (1) prohibited or authorisation-required goods (weapons, drugs, items from protected species, radio equipment, import-quota goods including tobacco beyond franchise); (2) goods exceeding a per-traveller QUANTITY threshold (tobacco, alcohol, perfumes, eaux de toilette, coffee or tea); (3) any other goods exceeding the per-traveller VALUE franchise (table below); (4) goods carried professionally or beyond strict personal/family use; (5) temporary-admission goods, notably under an ATA carnet. Cross-border cash is a separate, both-direction duty, not an item of this arrival goods declaration. Traveller franchise on arrival (achats ou cadeaux): tobacco — 200 cigarettes OR 100 cigarillos OR 50 cigars OR 250 g of smoking tobacco; alcoholic beverages — wines 2 litres AND (spirits/alcoholic beverages over 22°: 1 litre OR alcoholic beverages under 22°: 2 litres); coffee — 500 g OR 200 g of extracts and essences; tea — 100 g OR 50 g of extracts and essences; perfumes — 50 g; eaux de toilette — 25 centilitres; other goods — 30,000 XPF per traveller aged 15 and over (15,000 XPF per traveller under 15). Travellers aged UNDER 17 (« âgés de moins de 17 ans », i.e. 16 and below — the limit is 17, not 18) may not import tobacco or alcoholic beverages duty-free. Franchises may not be pooled by several persons for the same object, and an object whose value exceeds the franchise is taxed on its FULL value without abatement. Duty-free purchases (duty free at port, airport or aircraft, or under bordereaux de détaxe) are subject to declaration on arrival, customs collecting the duties and taxes due after applying the franchises.
procedures.applicability_zh: 条件触发、仅抵达方向：并非每名旅客都填表。申报义务仅发生于抵达新喀里多尼亚且携带须申报物品的旅客——禁运或需许可物品、数量或价值超过旅客免税额的物品、以职业身份或超出严格自用/家庭用途携带的物品、暂时进口物品、或免税店购品。无申报物品者直接走绿色通道（原文：« Si vous n'avez rien à déclarer, vous pouvez passer au filtre vert »），无须主动提交，但海关可随时拦截任何旅客。提交介质：本人当场在边境办理——Tontouta 机场在移民查验与提取行李后，有物品申报或不确定是否须申报者必须主动向海关关员申报（原文：« vous devez vous présenter volontairement à un agent des douanes »）。新喀里多尼亚拥有海关与财政自主权，其规则既不同于法国本土也不同于任何其他属地（原文：« La fiscalité et les règles douanières en Nouvelle-Calédonie sont spécifiques »），故不得照搬法国本土免税额度；超免税额物品的税费在海关办公室缴纳（DGDDI：« acquitter les droits et taxes correspondants au bureau de douane »）。不论物品来源或产地，以下须申报：(1) 禁止或需许可的物品（武器、毒品、受保护物种制品、无线电设备、含超出免税额烟草在内的进口配额商品等）；(2) 超过按旅客计数量门槛的物品（烟草、酒精、香水、花露水、咖啡或茶）；(3) 超过按旅客计价值免税额（见下表）的其他物品；(4) 以职业身份携带或超出严格自用/家庭用途的物品；(5) 暂时进口物品，尤其是 ATA 单证册项下物品。跨境现金为独立的入出双向义务，不属于本抵达货物申报的条目。抵达旅客免税额（购物或礼物）：烟草——200支香烟 或 100支小雪茄 或 50支雪茄 或 250克烟丝；酒精饮料——葡萄酒2升 且（超过22度的烈酒及酒精饮料1升 或 低于22度的酒精饮料2升）；咖啡——500克 或 提取物与香精200克；茶——100克 或 提取物与香精50克；香水——50克；花露水（eaux de toilette）——25厘升；其他物品——15岁及以上每旅客30,000 XPF（15岁以下每旅客15,000 XPF）。未满17岁（« âgés de moins de 17 ans »，即16岁及以下——年龄线是17岁，不是18岁）的旅客不得免税进口烟草和酒精饮料。免税额不得由多人就同一件物品合并使用；价值超过免税额的物品按全值计税、不作扣减。免税店（港口、机场、机上 duty free）或 détaxe 退税单购买须在抵达时申报，海关在适用免税额后就应缴税费征收入库。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival at the border, in person. Tontouta: after immigration formalities and baggage reclaim — green channel if nothing to declare; voluntary presentation to a customs officer if declaring or unsure. Duties and taxes on goods beyond the franchise are paid at the customs office.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时本人在边境办理。Tontouta 机场：移民查验与提取行李之后——无申报走绿色通道，有申报或不确定时主动找海关关员。超免税额物品的税费在海关办公室缴纳。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵達新喀里多尼亞時向海關申報所攜物品（新喀里多尼亞地區海關）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 條件觸發、僅抵達方向：並非每名旅客都填表。申報義務僅發生於抵達新喀里多尼亞且攜帶須申報物品的旅客——禁運或需許可物品、數量或價值超過旅客免稅額的物品、以職業身份或超出嚴格自用/家庭用途攜帶的物品、暫時進口物品、或免稅店購品。無申報物品者直接走綠色通道（原文：« Si vous n'avez rien à déclarer, vous pouvez passer au filtre vert »），無須主動提交，但海關可隨時攔截任何旅客。提交介質：本人當場在邊境辦理——Tontouta 機場在移民查驗與提取行李後，有物品申報或不確定是否須申報者必須主動向海關關員申報（原文：« vous devez vous présenter volontairement à un agent des douanes »）。新喀里多尼亞擁有海關與財政自主權，其規則既不同於法國本土也不同於任何其他屬地（原文：« La fiscalité et les règles douanières en Nouvelle-Calédonie sont spécifiques »），故不得照搬法國本土免稅額度；超免稅額物品的稅費在海關辦公室繳納（DGDDI：« acquitter les droits et taxes correspondants au bureau de douane »）。不論物品來源或產地，以下須申報：(1) 禁止或需許可的物品（武器、毒品、受保護物種製品、無線電設備、含超出免稅額菸草在內的進口配額商品等）；(2) 超過按旅客計數量門檻的物品（菸草、酒精、香水、花露水、咖啡或茶）；(3) 超過按旅客計價值免稅額（見下表）的其他物品；(4) 以職業身份攜帶或超出嚴格自用/家庭用途的物品；(5) 暫時進口物品，尤其是 ATA 單證冊項下物品。跨境現金為獨立的入出雙向義務，不屬於本抵達貨物申報的條目。抵達旅客免稅額（購物或禮物）：菸草——200支香菸 或 100支小雪茄 或 50支雪茄 或 250克菸絲；酒精飲料——葡萄酒2升 且（超過22度的烈酒及酒精飲料1升 或 低於22度的酒精飲料2升）；咖啡——500克 或 提取物與香精200克；茶——100克 或 提取物與香精50克；香水——50克；花露水（eaux de toilette）——25釐升；其他物品——15歲及以上每旅客30,000 XPF（15歲以下每旅客15,000 XPF）。未滿17歲（« âgés de moins de 17 ans »，即16歲及以下——年齡線是17歲，不是18歲）的旅客不得免稅進口菸草和酒精飲料。免稅額不得由多人就同一件物品合併使用；價值超過免稅額的物品按全值計稅、不作扣減。免稅店（港口、機場、機上 duty free）或 détaxe 退稅單購買須在抵達時申報，海關在適用免稅額後就應繳稅費徵收入庫。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時本人在邊境辦理。Tontouta 機場：移民查驗與提取行李之後——無申報走綠色通道，有申報或不確定時主動找海關關員。超免稅額物品的稅費在海關辦公室繳納。

procedures.name_en: Cross-border cash declaration (DALIA) for sums, titles and valeurs of EUR 10,000 or more entering or leaving New Caledonia
procedures.name_zh: 新喀里多尼亚跨境现金申报（DALIA）——入出双向、1万欧元及以上
procedures.agency: Direction Régionale des Douanes de Nouvelle-Calédonie; teleservice operated by Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI), France
procedures.applicability_en: Conditional, BOTH directions: the duty arises only where a natural person transports, across a border between French territory and foreign territory (« lors de tout passage de frontière entre un territoire français et étranger »), sums (cash or cheques), titles (shares, bonds, etc.) or valeurs of an amount equal to or greater than EUR 10,000 (« égal ou supérieur à 10 000 euros »), for his own account or that of another person, natural or legal (« pour son compte ou celui d'autrui »), whether or not he owns the money; travellers below the threshold file nothing. The paper form expressly covers entries and exits (by sea, air, post); the DALIA teleservice covers transports and shipments of cash to or from abroad. In Pacific francs (XPF) the official pages state slightly different figures: the regional page converts the threshold as « soit 1 193 317 XPF ou équivalent en devises », the DGDDI central page as « 1 193 300 francs CFP » (a 17 XPF difference), and the regional Tontouta arrival list uses « dépassant 1 193 317 XPF » (exceeding) whereas the regional cash section uses « égal ou supérieur » for EUR. The pages do not give one consistent XPF figure at which the duty begins; the threshold to apply is the euro rule: amounts equal to or greater than EUR 10,000. Route exemption: only itineraries in direct connection between two French zones are exempt (« seuls les itinéraires en correspondance directe entre 2 zones françaises sont dispensés de l'obligation déclarative de capitaux »); example: from New Caledonia to Metropolitan France with a stopover in a foreign country (Singapore, Japan...) the capital declaration is obligatory even if passengers remain in the transit zone; listed exempt examples are direct flights New Caledonia ↔ Wallis-et-Futuna (except with a stopover via Fiji) and New Caledonia ↔ French Polynesia; if a flight is diverted to a foreign country, a capital declaration may be required on arrival on French soil. Submission medium: online filing via the DALIA teleservice is the rule (« la télé-déclaration (via DALIA) devient la règle »), accessible on computer, smartphone and tablet, with or without a DALIA account; account creation is « rapide, facile et gratuite » and gives pre-filling of later declarations and a history (DKS). If online filing is impossible: a signed written declaration (form CERFA 13426*05) in duplicate may be deposited with the customs service concerned (sea, air and post deposit points are listed on the regional page) at the latest at the moment of entry into or exit from French territory or of the transfer of the funds; the form may IN ADDITION be sent to those services by post, in duplicate and signed, at most five days before the border crossing — an option, not an obligation on ordinary travellers. At a customs check at the border the declarant/passenger must present the complete and valid declaration, as a dematerialised version downloadable from the teleservice or a paper version printable from it; any breach of the declaration obligation is subject to sanctions. The central DGDDI DALIA service page (updated 14/04/2026) expressly lists New Caledonia (with Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Saint-Barthélemy, French Polynesia and the islands of Wallis and Futuna) for transports and shipments of cash from or to abroad, under articles L722-6 and L722-7 of the code monétaire et financier.
procedures.applicability_zh: 条件触发、入出双向：义务仅在自然人跨越法国领地与外国之间的边境（原文：« lors de tout passage de frontière entre un territoire français et étranger »）、以本人或他人（自然人或法人）名义（« pour son compte ou celui d'autrui »）运输等值或超过10,000欧元（« égal ou supérieur à 10 000 euros »）的款项（现金或支票）、证券（股票、债券等）或有价物品时发生，无论其是否为该笔资金所有人；未达门槛的旅客无须申报。纸质程序明确覆盖入境与出境（海路、空路、邮路），DALIA 服务覆盖与外国往来的现金运输与寄送。太平洋法郎（XPF）各官方页面给出的数字略有出入：地区页换算为« soit 1 193 317 XPF ou équivalent en devises »，DGDDI 中央页写« 1 193 300 francs CFP »（相差17 XPF），且地区页 Tontouta 抵达清单用« dépassant 1 193 317 XPF »（超过）而地区页现金章节对欧元用« égal ou supérieur »（等值或超过）。义务自哪个确切的 XPF 数额起算，各页面没有一致说法；适用门槛按欧元规则掌握：等值或超过10,000欧元。航线豁免：只有两个法国区域之间的直达衔接免于现金申报义务（原文：« seuls les itinéraires en correspondance directe entre 2 zones françaises sont dispensés de l'obligation déclarative de capitaux »）；示例：自新喀里多尼亚赴法国本土、行程含外国经停（新加坡、日本等）即触发资本申报义务，即使旅客留在过境区亦然；页面所列豁免示例为新喀里多尼亚↔瓦利斯和富图纳直达航班（经斐济经停除外）与新喀里多尼亚↔法属波利尼西亚；如航班备降外国，抵达法国本土时可能被要求进行资本申报。提交介质：通过 DALIA 电服务在线申报是常规（原文：« la télé-déclaration (via DALIA) devient la règle »），可在电脑、智能手机和平板使用，可无账户申报；开立 DALIA 账户« rapide, facile et gratuite »（快捷、简便且免费），并可预填后续申报、留存申报历史（DKS）。无法在线申报时：可将签字的书面申报（CERFA 13426*05 表）一式两份交至相关海关部门（海、空、邮三个受理点见地区页开列），最迟于进入或离开法国领土或转移资金之时；该表亦可另行经邮寄、一式两份且签字提交上述部门，最迟跨境前5日——这是可选项，并非对普通旅客的邮寄义务。边境查验时，申报人/旅客须出示完整有效的申报：可出示自电服务下载的电子版或自电服务打印的纸质版；违反申报义务将受处罚。DGDDI 中央 DALIA 服务页（2026-04-14更新）逐名列明新喀里多尼亚（连同圣皮埃尔和密克隆、圣巴泰勒米、法属波利尼西亚和瓦利斯和富图纳群岛）适用于与外国之间的现金运输与寄送，依据《货币与金融法典》L722-6 与 L722-7 条。
procedures.timing_en: Applies to both entry and exit. DALIA online (the rule): at the earliest 1 month (30 days) before the travel date, at the latest before crossing the border; modification or cancellation up to the border with an account, cancellation only without one. Paper CERFA 13426*05 in duplicate, only if online filing is impossible: deposited with the customs service concerned at the latest at the moment of entry, exit or transfer of funds; optional postal sending at most 5 days before the border.
procedures.timing_zh: 入出双向适用。DALIA 在线（常规）：最早出发前1个月（30天），最迟跨境前；有账户可在跨境前修改或撤销，无账户仅可撤销。纸质 CERFA 13426*05 一式两份（仅无法在线申报时）：最迟于入境、出境或资金转移之时交相关海关部门；邮寄选项为跨境前最迟5日。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 新喀里多尼亞跨境現金申報（DALIA）——入出雙向、1萬歐元及以上
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 條件觸發、入出雙向：義務僅在自然人跨越法國領地與外國之間的邊境（原文：« lors de tout passage de frontière entre un territoire français et étranger »）、以本人或他人（自然人或法人）名義（« pour son compte ou celui d'autrui »）運輸等值或超過10,000歐元（« égal ou supérieur à 10 000 euros »）的款項（現金或支票）、證券（股票、債券等）或有價物品時發生，無論其是否為該筆資金所有人；未達門檻的旅客無須申報。紙質程序明確覆蓋入境與出境（海路、空路、郵路），DALIA 服務覆蓋與外國往來的現金運輸與寄送。太平洋法郎（XPF）各官方頁面給出的數字略有出入：地區頁換算為« soit 1 193 317 XPF ou équivalent en devises »，DGDDI 中央頁寫« 1 193 300 francs CFP »（相差17 XPF），且地區頁 Tontouta 抵達清單用« dépassant 1 193 317 XPF »（超過）而地區頁現金章節對歐元用« égal ou supérieur »（等值或超過）。義務自哪個確切的 XPF 數額起算，各頁面沒有一致說法；適用門檻按歐元規則掌握：等值或超過10,000歐元。航線豁免：只有兩個法國區域之間的直達銜接免於現金申報義務（原文：« seuls les itinéraires en correspondance directe entre 2 zones françaises sont dispensés de l'obligation déclarative de capitaux »）；示例：自新喀里多尼亞赴法國本土、行程含外國經停（新加坡、日本等）即觸發資本申報義務，即使旅客留在過境區亦然；頁面所列豁免示例為新喀里多尼亞↔瓦利斯和富圖納直達航班（經斐濟經停除外）與新喀里多尼亞↔法屬波利尼西亞；如航班備降外國，抵達法國本土時可能被要求進行資本申報。提交介質：通過 DALIA 電服務線上申報是常規（原文：« la télé-déclaration (via DALIA) devient la règle »），可在電腦、智能手機和平板使用，可無賬戶申報；開立 DALIA 賬戶« rapide, facile et gratuite »（快捷、簡便且免費），並可預填後續申報、留存申報歷史（DKS）。無法線上申報時：可將簽字的書面申報（CERFA 13426*05 表）一式兩份交至相關海關部門（海、空、郵三個受理點見地區頁開列），最遲於進入或離開法國領土或轉移資金之時；該表亦可另行經郵寄、一式兩份且簽字提交上述部門，最遲跨境前5日——這是可選項，並非對普通旅客的郵寄義務。邊境查驗時，申報人/旅客須出示完整有效的申報：可出示自電服務下載的電子版或自電服務列印的紙質版；違反申報義務將受處罰。DGDDI 中央 DALIA 服務頁（2026-04-14更新）逐名列明新喀里多尼亞（連同聖皮埃爾和密克隆、聖巴泰勒米、法屬波利尼西亞和瓦利斯和富圖納群島）適用於與外國之間的現金運輸與寄送，依據《貨幣與金融法典》L722-6 與 L722-7 條。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入出雙向適用。DALIA 線上（常規）：最早出發前1個月（30天），最遲跨境前；有賬戶可在跨境前修改或撤銷，無賬戶僅可撤銷。紙質 CERFA 13426*05 一式兩份（僅無法線上申報時）：最遲於入境、出境或資金轉移之時交相關海關部門；郵寄選項為跨境前最遲5日。

procedures.name_en: PNG Digital Arrival Card (PNGDAC)
procedures.name_zh: 巴布亚新几内亚数字入境卡（PNGDAC）
procedures.agency: Papua New Guinea Immigration and Citizenship Services Authority (ICSA)
procedures.applicability_en: Every person travelling to Papua New Guinea, including PNG citizens, permanent residents and foreign nationals, must complete the PNG Digital Arrival Card. It replaces the paper incoming passenger card and carries the passenger declaration. The official traveller guide describes it for arrivals by air at Jacksons International Airport (POM), Port Moresby; it does not say how arrivals by sea or land are handled. An immigration notice of 6 August 2026 tells airlines to confirm the card is completed before a boarding pass is issued. The card is not a visa. It can be submitted individually or as a group. The immigration authority's page says travellers who have not completed it online can use self-service kiosks at the airport on arrival.
procedures.applicability_zh: 所有前往巴布亚新几内亚的人，包括该国公民、永久居民和外国人，都须填写数字入境卡（PNGDAC）。它取代纸质入境旅客卡，并含旅客申报内容。官方旅客指南描述的是经空路抵达莫尔兹比港杰克逊国际机场（POM）的情形，未说明海路、陆路入境如何处理。移民部门2026年8月6日的通知要求航空公司在签发登机牌前确认旅客已填写。数字入境卡不是签证。可以个人提交，也可以团体提交。移民部门页面称，未在网上填写的旅客可在抵达机场后使用自助服务机。
procedures.timing_en: Complete it online at pngdac.ica.gov.pg up to 72 hours before arrival (the guide says 72 hours before and including the day of arrival), and in any case before the boarding pass is issued. Show the confirmation and your passport to an officer on arrival.
procedures.timing_zh: 在 pngdac.ica.gov.pg 网上填写，最早可在抵达前72小时（指南写明为抵达前72小时至抵达当天），且须在登机牌签发前完成。抵达时向官员出示确认页和护照。

fee.note: The official page states the system is free of charge.

procedures.name_zh_hant: 巴布亞新幾內亞數字入境卡（PNGDAC）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 所有前往巴布亞新幾內亞的人，包括該國公民、永久居民和外國人，都須填寫數字入境卡（PNGDAC）。它取代紙質入境旅客卡，並含旅客申報內容。官方旅客指南描述的是經空路抵達莫爾茲比港傑克遜國際機場（POM）的情形，未說明海路、陸路入境如何處理。移民部門2026年8月6日的通知要求航空公司在簽發登機牌前確認旅客已填寫。數字入境卡不是簽證。可以個人提交，也可以團體提交。移民部門頁面稱，未在網上填寫的旅客可在抵達機場後使用自助服務機。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在 pngdac.ica.gov.pg 網上填寫，最早可在抵達前72小時（指南寫明為抵達前72小時至抵達當天），且須在登機牌簽發前完成。抵達時向官員出示確認頁和護照。

procedures.name_en: Vanuatu Passenger Arrival Card
procedures.name_zh: 瓦努阿图旅客入境卡
procedures.agency: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (official form; card statement covers Customs and Inland Revenue, Immigration, Biosecurity, Border Security, Health, Wildlife, Police and Currency Laws); Biosecurity Vanuatu (pre-arrival completion requirement)
procedures.applicability_en: A separate Arrival Card must be completed for each passenger, including children. The card is a legal document - false declarations can lead to penalties including confiscation of goods, fines, prosecution and imprisonment. Biosecurity Vanuatu requires the card to be completed inside the aircraft prior to arrival and states it is legally binding, with an instant penalty fine for false or incorrect declarations, payment extendable to 14 days and prosecution if unsettled. The official card PDF prints two pages, and its printed question numbering runs 1, 2a, 2b (page 1) then 15, 16, 17 (page 2); questions 3-14 appear nowhere in the file, so only the questions visible on the printed card are listed below. Page 1: privacy/disclosure statement; Q1 flight number/name of ship, seat, overseas boarding port, passport number, nationality, family name, given names, date of birth, country of birth, occupation, Vanuatu address, email, mobile; Q2a (residents) time away from Vanuatu, main country, main reason, next-12-months residence; Q2b (visitors) intended stay (permanently or length), main reason for coming, last country lived 12+ months. Page 2: Q15 did you pack your own bag (Yes/No); Q16 'Please declare if you have' Yes/No items - prohibited/restricted goods (for example medicines, illicit drugs or paraphernalia, firearms including parts and accessories, weapons of any kind, pornographic or obscene items); alcohol over the printed concession (2 Litres of Wine and 2 Litres of Spirits and 9 Litres of Beer) and tobacco over the concession (250 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 25 cigars); more than 100 ml perfume (EDP) or 250 ml toilet water (EDT); other new or unused items including gifts obtained overseas and/or duty free in Vanuatu totalling more than VT 50,000; goods for business or commercial use; goods carried on behalf of other persons; cash currency or negotiable bearer instrument amounting to 1,000,000VT or equivalent in foreign currency; biosecurity items (farm/abattoir contact in last 30 days; food except biscuits/confectionery/cakes/beverages; plants and plant products; farm machinery and camping equipment; soil or articles with soil; animals/animal products; used materials); Q17 truthfulness declaration with signature and date. Printed-version note: the card's alcohol figures (2 L wine / 2 L spirits / 9 L beer) differ from the live Customs travellers page (spirituous liquors not exceeding 2.25 litres, or wine not exceeding 2.25 litres, or beer not exceeding 9 litres); the card print is therefore not relied on for the current concession - see vu-arrival-traveller-customs-declaration. The card's 1,000,000VT cash item is a checkbox on this card only; the actual border cash declaration is the separate procedure vu-border-currency-declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 每名旅客（包括儿童）须各自填写一张入境卡。卡片为法律文件——虚假申报可导致处罚，包括没收物品、罚款、起诉及监禁。瓦努阿图生物安全局要求在到达瓦努阿图前于机舱内填写该卡，并声明该卡具法律约束力，虚假或错误申报将被当场处以罚款，缴费可延期至 14 天，逾期未缴将面临起诉。官方入境卡 PDF 共两页，印刷题号第 1 页为 1、2a、2b，第 2 页为 15、16、17；问题 3–14 在该文件任何位置均不可见，故下文仅列明印刷卡片上可见的问题。第 1 页：隐私/披露声明；问题 1 航班号/船名、座位号、海外登机/登船港口、护照号、国籍、姓、名、出生日期、出生国、职业、在瓦地址、电子邮件、手机；问题 2a（居民）离瓦时长、主要停留国、主要事由、未来 12 个月主要居住国；问题 2b（访客）拟停留时长（永久或年限）、来瓦主要事由、最后连续居住 12 个月以上的国家。第 2 页：问题 15 是否自行收拾行李（是/否）；问题 16「请申报你是否携带」是/否项——禁止或限制物品（例如药品、毒品或吸毒工具、枪械含部件配件、各类武器、色情或不雅物品）；超过印刷优惠的酒类（2 升葡萄酒和 2 升烈酒及 9 升啤酒）与超过优惠的烟草（250 支香烟或 100 支小雪茄或 25 支雪茄）；超过 100 毫升香水（EDP）或 250 毫升化妆水（EDT）；在海外取得和/或在瓦免税购买、总额超过 50,000 瓦图的其他新物品含礼品；商业或业务用途物品；替他人携带的物品；总额达 1,000,000VT 或等值外币的现金货币或可转让无记名票据；生物安全项（过去 30 天农场/屠宰场/肉类加工厂接触或境外牲畜接触；饼干、糖果、糕点、饮料以外的任何食品；植物及植物制品；农机及露营装备；土壤或附土物品；动物/动物制品；旧物料）；问题 17 真实性声明及签名与日期。印刷版本说明：卡片印刷的酒类数字（2 升葡萄酒/2 升烈酒/9 升啤酒）与现行海关旅客网页（烈性酒不超过 2.25 升，或葡萄酒不超过 2.25 升，或啤酒不超过 9 升）不一致，故卡片印刷数字不作为现行优惠依据——见 vu-arrival-traveller-customs-declaration。卡片上的 1,000,000VT 现金项仅为本卡的一个勾选栏；实际的边境现金申报是另行程序 vu-border-currency-declaration。
procedures.timing_en: Card completed inside the aircraft before arrival (Biosecurity Vanuatu). On arrival, biosecurity-risk goods must be declared or disposed of in the amnesty bin: food of any kind (except biscuits/confectionery/cakes/beverages), plants and plant products, used equipment, soil or articles with soil attached, animals and animal products, shells; declared risky goods are inspected and may be detained for assessment, treated (storage charged VT 1,000/night), or confiscated and destroyed if prohibited. The card's cash checkbox (amounting to 1,000,000VT) does not itself discharge the border currency duty: that is executed through the separate Border Currency Report procedure (see vu-border-currency-declaration).
procedures.timing_zh: 入境卡于到达前在机舱内填写（瓦努阿图生物安全局）。到达时须申报或将生物安全风险物品投入特赦箱：任何食品（饼干、糖果、糕点、饮料除外）、植物及其制品、旧设备、土壤或附土物品、动物及其制品、贝壳；已申报的风险物品会被查验，可能被扣留评估、处理（仓储费 1,000 瓦图/晚）或属禁止物品时没收销毁。卡片的现金勾选栏（达 1,000,000VT）本身并不履行边境货币申报义务：该义务经由另行的边境货币报告表程序办理（见 vu-border-currency-declaration）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 瓦努阿圖旅客入境卡
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 每名旅客（包括兒童）須各自填寫一張入境卡。卡片為法律文件——虛假申報可導致處罰，包括沒收物品、罰款、起訴及監禁。瓦努阿圖生物安全局要求在到達瓦努阿圖前於機艙內填寫該卡，並聲明該卡具法律約束力，虛假或錯誤申報將被當場處以罰款，繳費可延期至 14 天，逾期未繳將面臨起訴。官方入境卡 PDF 共兩頁，印刷題號第 1 頁為 1、2a、2b，第 2 頁為 15、16、17；問題 3–14 在該文件任何位置均不可見，故下文僅列明印刷卡片上可見的問題。第 1 頁：隱私/披露聲明；問題 1 航班號/船名、座位號、海外登機/登船港口、護照號、國籍、姓、名、出生日期、出生國、職業、在瓦地址、電子郵件、手機；問題 2a（居民）離瓦時長、主要停留國、主要事由、未來 12 個月主要居住國；問題 2b（訪客）擬停留時長（永久或年限）、來瓦主要事由、最後連續居住 12 個月以上的國家。第 2 頁：問題 15 是否自行收拾行李（是/否）；問題 16「請申報你是否攜帶」是/否項——禁止或限制物品（例如藥品、毒品或吸毒工具、槍械含部件配件、各類武器、色情或不雅物品）；超過印刷優惠的酒類（2 升葡萄酒和 2 升烈酒及 9 升啤酒）與超過優惠的菸草（250 支香菸或 100 支小雪茄或 25 支雪茄）；超過 100 毫升香水（EDP）或 250 毫升化妝水（EDT）；在海外取得和/或在瓦免稅購買、總額超過 50,000 瓦圖的其他新物品含禮品；商業或業務用途物品；替他人攜帶的物品；總額達 1,000,000VT 或等值外幣的現金貨幣或可轉讓無記名票據；生物安全項（過去 30 天農場/屠宰場/肉類加工廠接觸或境外牲畜接觸；餅乾、糖果、糕點、飲料以外的任何食品；植物及植物製品；農機及露營裝備；土壤或附土物品；動物/動物製品；舊物料）；問題 17 真實性聲明及簽名與日期。印刷版本說明：卡片印刷的酒類數字（2 升葡萄酒/2 升烈酒/9 升啤酒）與現行海關旅客網頁（烈性酒不超過 2.25 升，或葡萄酒不超過 2.25 升，或啤酒不超過 9 升）不一致，故卡片印刷數字不作為現行優惠依據——見 vu-arrival-traveller-customs-declaration。卡片上的 1,000,000VT 現金項僅為本卡的一個勾選欄；實際的邊境現金申報是另行程序 vu-border-currency-declaration。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境卡於到達前在機艙內填寫（瓦努阿圖生物安全局）。到達時須申報或將生物安全風險物品投入特赦箱：任何食品（餅乾、糖果、糕點、飲料除外）、植物及其製品、舊設備、土壤或附土物品、動物及其製品、貝殼；已申報的風險物品會被查驗，可能被扣留評估、處理（倉儲費 1,000 瓦圖/晚）或屬禁止物品時沒收銷燬。卡片的現金勾選欄（達 1,000,000VT）本身並不履行邊境貨幣申報義務：該義務經由另行的邊境貨幣報告表程序辦理（見 vu-border-currency-declaration）。

procedures.name_en: Arrival goods declaration to Customs
procedures.name_zh: 到达时向海关申报物品
procedures.agency: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue
procedures.applicability_en: On arrival, the current Customs travellers page states directly: 'You are also required by law to declare the following goods to Customs' - goods carried for business or commercial use; prohibited or restricted goods such as medicines, illicit drugs or drug paraphernalia, firearms or ammunitions (including parts and accessories), weapons of any kind, pornographic materials or any items of obscene nature; and goods carried on behalf of other persons. This declaration duty applies regardless of any duty-free concession. The following concession figures are tax context only, not an additional declaration duty: the duty-free personal concession applies to bona fide passengers over 18 years of age (wording 'over 18 years of age', strictly more than 18) finally disembarking in Vanuatu, for goods not for sale, owned by and accompanying the passenger (or bought immediately after final disembarkation), for personal use or as unsolicited gifts, not in commercial quantities. Limits per person: cigarettes not exceeding 250 sticks, or 100 cigarillos, or 25 cigars, or 250 g of tobacco; spirituous liquors not exceeding 2.25 litres, or wine not exceeding 2.25 litres, or beer not exceeding 9 litres; 25 cL toilet water or 10 cL perfume; other new or used items including gifts not exceeding VT 50,000 in value. Carrying cash or negotiable bearer instruments amounting to VT 1,000,000 is not a concession matter: it is executed through the separate border currency procedure (see vu-border-currency-declaration).
procedures.applicability_zh: 到达时，现行海关旅客页直接载明「You are also required by law to declare the following goods to Customs（依法你还须向海关申报下列物品）」——商业或业务用途物品；禁止或限制物品，例如药品、毒品或吸毒工具、枪械弹药及其部件配件、各类武器、色情或不雅物品；替他人携带的物品。该申报义务无论是否享有免税优惠均适用。以下优惠数字仅为事实性税务背景，并非另一项申报义务：免税个人优惠适用于年龄表述为 over 18 years of age（严格大于 18 岁）、最终在瓦努阿图下船的善意旅客，且物品非售卖、属旅客所有并随身（或下船后立即购买）、供个人使用或为非索取性馈赠、非商业数量。每人限额：香烟不超过 250 支，或 100 支小雪茄，或 25 支雪茄，或 250 克烟草；烈性酒不超过 2.25 升，或葡萄酒不超过 2.25 升，或啤酒不超过 9 升；化妆水 25 厘升或香水 10 厘升；其他新旧物品（含礼品）价值不超过 50,000 瓦图。携带总额达 1,000,000 瓦图的现金或可转让无记名票据不属本优惠事项：由另行的边境货币程序办理（见 vu-border-currency-declaration）。
procedures.timing_en: At final disembarkation. New or unused goods worth more than VT 50,000: the difference is assessed and duty and VAT are charged at the legal rates in force (page example: 120,000 - 50,000 = 70,000 assessable). Accompanied personal effects including professional instruments, apparatus and tools are covered by a separate concession. The official May 2019 'Processing Passenger Allowance' flowchart directs officers to process excess tobacco/alcohol/perfume and new or used items including gifts exceeding 50,000vt.
procedures.timing_zh: 于最终下船时办理。价值超过 50,000 瓦图的新物品：差额部分按现行法定税率征收关税与增值税（页面示例：120,000 − 50,000 = 70,000 为应税基数）。随身个人物品含专业仪器、器具与工具适用另一单独优惠。2019 年 5 月官方《旅客免税品处理》流程图指示关员处理超量的烟草/酒类/香水及超过 50,000vt 的新旧物品与礼品。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 到達時向海關申報物品
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 到達時，現行海關旅客頁直接載明「You are also required by law to declare the following goods to Customs（依法你還須向海關申報下列物品）」——商業或業務用途物品；禁止或限制物品，例如藥品、毒品或吸毒工具、槍械彈藥及其部件配件、各類武器、色情或不雅物品；替他人攜帶的物品。該申報義務無論是否享有免稅優惠均適用。以下優惠數字僅為事實性稅務背景，並非另一項申報義務：免稅個人優惠適用於年齡表述為 over 18 years of age（嚴格大於 18 歲）、最終在瓦努阿圖下船的善意旅客，且物品非售賣、屬旅客所有並隨身（或下船後立即購買）、供個人使用或為非索取性饋贈、非商業數量。每人限額：香菸不超過 250 支，或 100 支小雪茄，或 25 支雪茄，或 250 克菸草；烈性酒不超過 2.25 升，或葡萄酒不超過 2.25 升，或啤酒不超過 9 升；化妝水 25 釐升或香水 10 釐升；其他新舊物品（含禮品）價值不超過 50,000 瓦圖。攜帶總額達 1,000,000 瓦圖的現金或可轉讓無記名票據不屬本優惠事項：由另行的邊境貨幣程序辦理（見 vu-border-currency-declaration）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 於最終下船時辦理。價值超過 50,000 瓦圖的新物品：差額部分按現行法定稅率徵收關稅與增值稅（頁面示例：120,000 − 50,000 = 70,000 為應稅基數）。隨身個人物品含專業儀器、器具與工具適用另一單獨優惠。2019 年 5 月官方《旅客免稅品處理》流程圖指示關員處理超量的菸草/酒類/香水及超過 50,000vt 的新舊物品與禮品。

procedures.name_en: Border cash declaration (Border Currency Report)
procedures.name_zh: 边境现金申报（边境货币报告表）
procedures.agency: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (declaration to an authorised officer under the Currency Declaration Act No. 7 of 2009; form completed at the border and transmitted to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit)
procedures.applicability_en: Both directions; required only when the amount carried reaches the threshold. Strictly more than VT 1,000,000 is caught by every official text. The later, specific Currency Declaration Act No. 7 of 2009 s2(1) (assented 14/08/2009, commenced 04/02/2013; currently listed on the Customs legislation 'Others' page) says 'VT1,000,000, or more' - the 2009 law's text includes exactly VT 1,000,000. The older 2006-consolidated Proceeds of Crime Act [CAP 284] s79A and the currently downloadable Border Currency Report v2 printed instruction (footer 'BCR - Sept 2008') both say 'more than' (strictly above). The paper form's equality-case instruction conflicts with the 2009 law's text: the older form's wording does not override the law, and a traveller carrying exactly VT 1,000,000 is not exempt. On that basis the declaration applies to a person who enters or leaves Vanuatu with currency amounting to VT 1,000,000 or more, or its equivalent in any other currency, and s2(1) provides that such a person 'must make a declaration to an authorised officer in the prescribed form'. The traveller-facing form currently published for this is the Border Currency Report (BCR; listed on the Customs Forms page as 'Border Currency Report Form'; footer 'BCR - Sept 2008'), completed by the traveller in ink and capital letters: Part A travel details with INTO VANUATU / OUT OF VANUATU selection and flight/ship; Part B identity of the person carrying cash; Part C on whose behalf the person is acting; Part D details of the cash (currency type, amount, denominations, source, intended use, origin country); Part E to whom the cash is being delivered; Part F cash counting by officers - completed forms are sent to the Financial Intelligence Unit (State Law Office, Port Vila). The Act's s1 defines 'currency' broadly - coin and paper money that is legal tender; monetary instruments that may be exchanged for money (cheques, travellers cheques, money orders, negotiable instruments in which title passes on delivery); precious metals, precious stones, pearls and jewellery; instruments specified by the Minister by Order; and currency in electronic form, including but not limited to debit cards, credit cards, pre-paid mobile phones and any other electronic device with a stored value. The BCR form's opening instruction and definitions, by contrast, name only cash (coin and paper money that is legal tender in its country of issue) and negotiable bearer instruments - the subset the form itself covers. Whether jewellery, precious metals or electronic stored-value cards at or above the threshold are declared on the BCR form or through another process is not settled by the official texts, which also set no valuation method for stored-value items; there is no basis for treating them as exempt. As the later, specific statute creating the traveller border-currency declaration duty, currently listed by Customs, the 2009 Act settles the duty's comparison operator, so carrying exactly VT 1,000,000 or the exact foreign-currency equivalent must be declared on entry or exit. The divergent older/current wording grants no exemption: 2006-consolidated POCA [CAP 284] s79A(1) 'more than VT 1 million' (>), BCR instruction 'more than VT1 Million' (>), and the comparator-less current web wording 'amounting to 1,000,000vt'. Separate regimes, not part of the border cash declaration: sending out of or receiving into Vanuatu currency of VT 1,000,000 or more by any means including post, courier or transhipment is declared to the Department of Customs under s2(2) (not a traveller border act), and currency exports at or above the equivalent of 1,000,000 VT may separately require an FIU permit/licence under the Customs (Prohibited Export) Regulations Order No. 114 of 2014 - a general export permission list, not a passenger declaration form. The border cash declaration is additional to, and separate from, the Passenger Arrival Card and the arrival goods declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 双向适用，且仅当携带金额达到门槛时须办理。严格超过（多于）1,000,000 瓦图无争议——所有官方文本均予涵盖。较晚的专门立法《2009 年第 7 号货币申报法》第 2(1) 条（2009 年 8 月 14 日御准，2013 年 2 月 4 日生效；现列于海关法规「其他」页）表述为「VT1,000,000, or more（1,000,000 瓦图或以上）」——2009 年法律的文本包含恰为 1,000,000 瓦图。较旧的《2006 年汇编版犯罪收益法 [CAP 284]》第 79A 条与现行可下载的《边境货币报告》v2 印刷说明（页脚「BCR - Sept 2008」）均表述为「more than（超过）」（严格大于）。纸质表格就恰等情形的指示与 2009 年法律文本冲突：较旧表格的措辞不改变法律，恰携 1,000,000 瓦图的旅客不能据此主张豁免。据此，该申报适用于入境或出境瓦努阿图时携带总额达 1,000,000 瓦图或以上、或以任何其他货币计的等值货币的人，第 2(1) 条规定该人「must make a declaration to an authorised officer in the prescribed form（须以规定表格向获授权人员作出申报）」。现行发布的旅客面向表格为《边境货币报告》（BCR；海关表单页列为「Border Currency Report Form」；页脚「BCR - Sept 2008」），由旅客以墨水笔大写字母填写——A 部分旅行信息并勾选「进入瓦努阿图 INTO VANUATU／离开瓦努阿图 OUT OF VANUATU」及航班/船名；B 部分携款人身份；C 部分代表何人行事；D 部分现金明细（币种、金额、面额、来源、拟用途、资金来源国）；E 部分现金交付对象；F 部分关员点钞——填妥的表格寄送金融情报室（维拉港国家法律事务办公室）。该法第 1 条对「货币（currency）」的定义宽泛——属法定货币的硬币与纸币；可兑换为货币的货币票据（支票、旅行支票、汇票、交付即转移所有权的可转让票据）；贵金属、宝石、珍珠与珠宝；经部长以命令指定的票据；以及电子形式的货币，包括但不限于借记卡、信用卡、预付费手机及任何其他具储存价值的电子设备。相比之下，BCR 表格的开头说明与定义仅列明现金（发行国法定货币的硬币与纸币）与可转让无记名票据——此即该表格本身所覆盖的范围。珠宝、贵金属或电子储值卡达到门槛时究竟使用 BCR 表格还是经由其他程序申报，官方文本未作规定，亦未设定任何储值物品的估值方法；不能据此视其为豁免。作为直接设立旅客边境货币申报义务的较晚专门立法且现由海关列示，2009 年法确定了申报义务的比较算符，故携带恰为 1,000,000 瓦图或恰为等值外币者于入境或出境时均须申报。与之分歧的较旧/现行措辞不作为豁免依据：《2006 年汇编版犯罪收益法 [CAP 284]》第 79A(1) 条「超过 100 万瓦图（more than VT 1 million）」（>）、BCR 表格说明「超过 100 万瓦图（more than VT1 Million）」（>）、现行旅客网页无比较词的「达 1,000,000vt」。相关但不同的制度，并非边境现金申报的组成部分：以包括邮政、快递或转运在内的任何方式寄出或收入瓦努阿图总额达 1,000,000 瓦图或以上的货币，依第 2(2) 条向海关部申报（非旅客边境行为）；依《2014 年第 114 号海关（禁止出口）条例》，相当于 1,000,000 瓦图或以上的货币出口可能另需金融情报室签发的许可证——该条属一般出口许可清单，并非旅客申报表格。边境现金申报独立于并附加于旅客入境卡与到达物品申报。
procedures.timing_en: When/to whom: at the border, on entry or exit — the traveller completes the Border Currency Report in ink and capital letters and hands it to an authorised officer (under the Act: a customs, immigration, police or quarantine officer), who counts the cash with the traveller (Part F); the completed BCR is then transmitted to the Financial Intelligence Unit (State Law Office, PMB 9048, Port Vila). Failing to declare currency in the prescribed amount is an offence under the Act.
procedures.timing_zh: 何时/向谁：于入境或出境时在边境办理——旅客以墨水笔大写字母填写《边境货币报告》，交给获授权人员（该法所指：海关、移民、警察或检疫官员），由该官员与旅客当面点钞（F 部分）；填妥的 BCR 随即寄送金融情报室（维拉港国家法律事务办公室，PMB 9048）。未按规定金额申报货币即属该法下的犯罪。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 邊境現金申報（邊境貨幣報告表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 雙向適用，且僅當攜帶金額達到門檻時須辦理。嚴格超過（多於）1,000,000 瓦圖無爭議——所有官方文本均予涵蓋。較晚的專門立法《2009 年第 7 號貨幣申報法》第 2(1) 條（2009 年 8 月 14 日御準，2013 年 2 月 4 日生效；現列於海關法規「其他」頁）表述為「VT1,000,000, or more（1,000,000 瓦圖或以上）」——2009 年法律的文本包含恰為 1,000,000 瓦圖。較舊的《2006 年彙編版犯罪收益法 [CAP 284]》第 79A 條與現行可下載的《邊境貨幣報告》v2 印刷說明（頁腳「BCR - Sept 2008」）均表述為「more than（超過）」（嚴格大於）。紙質表格就恰等情形的指示與 2009 年法律文本衝突：較舊錶格的措辭不改變法律，恰攜 1,000,000 瓦圖的旅客不能據此主張豁免。據此，該申報適用於入境或出境瓦努阿圖時攜帶總額達 1,000,000 瓦圖或以上、或以任何其他貨幣計的等值貨幣的人，第 2(1) 條規定該人「must make a declaration to an authorised officer in the prescribed form（須以規定表格向獲授權人員作出申報）」。現行發佈的旅客面向表格為《邊境貨幣報告》（BCR；海關表單頁列為「Border Currency Report Form」；頁腳「BCR - Sept 2008」），由旅客以墨水筆大寫字母填寫——A 部分旅行資訊並勾選「進入瓦努阿圖 INTO VANUATU／離開瓦努阿圖 OUT OF VANUATU」及航班/船名；B 部分攜款人身份；C 部分代表何人行事；D 部分現金明細（幣種、金額、面額、來源、擬用途、資金來源國）；E 部分現金交付對象；F 部分關員點鈔——填妥的表格寄送金融情報室（維拉港國家法律事務辦公室）。該法第 1 條對「貨幣（currency）」的定義寬泛——屬法定貨幣的硬幣與紙幣；可兌換為貨幣的貨幣票據（支票、旅行支票、匯票、交付即轉移所有權的可轉讓票據）；貴金屬、寶石、珍珠與珠寶；經部長以命令指定的票據；以及電子形式的貨幣，包括但不限於借記卡、信用卡、預付費手機及任何其他具儲存價值的電子設備。相比之下，BCR 表格的開頭說明與定義僅列明現金（發行國法定貨幣的硬幣與紙幣）與可轉讓無記名票據——此即該表格本身所覆蓋的範圍。珠寶、貴金屬或電子儲值卡達到門檻時究竟使用 BCR 表格還是經由其他程序申報，官方文本未作規定，亦未設定任何儲值物品的估值方法；不能據此視其為豁免。作為直接設立旅客邊境貨幣申報義務的較晚專門立法且現由海關列示，2009 年法確定了申報義務的比較算符，故攜帶恰為 1,000,000 瓦圖或恰為等值外幣者於入境或出境時均須申報。與之分歧的較舊/現行措辭不作為豁免依據：《2006 年彙編版犯罪收益法 [CAP 284]》第 79A(1) 條「超過 100 萬瓦圖（more than VT 1 million）」（>）、BCR 表格說明「超過 100 萬瓦圖（more than VT1 Million）」（>）、現行旅客網頁無比較詞的「達 1,000,000vt」。相關但不同的制度，並非邊境現金申報的組成部分：以包括郵政、快遞或轉運在內的任何方式寄出或收入瓦努阿圖總額達 1,000,000 瓦圖或以上的貨幣，依第 2(2) 條向海關部申報（非旅客邊境行為）；依《2014 年第 114 號海關（禁止出口）條例》，相當於 1,000,000 瓦圖或以上的貨幣出口可能另需金融情報室簽發的許可證——該條屬一般出口許可清單，並非旅客申報表格。邊境現金申報獨立於並附加於旅客入境卡與到達物品申報。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 何時/向誰：於入境或出境時在邊境辦理——旅客以墨水筆大寫字母填寫《邊境貨幣報告》，交給獲授權人員（該法所指：海關、移民、警察或檢疫官員），由該官員與旅客當面點鈔（F 部分）；填妥的 BCR 隨即寄送金融情報室（維拉港國家法律事務辦公室，PMB 9048）。未按規定金額申報貨幣即屬該法下的犯罪。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of unaccompanied personal and household effects (residence concession)
procedures.name_zh: 不随身个人及家庭物品申报（定居优惠）
procedures.agency: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue
procedures.applicability_en: For returning residents or persons assuming residence in Vanuatu: concessions for unaccompanied personal and household effects are available to those taking up residence in Vanuatu for the first time, and to returning Vanuatu residents after absence of at least 12 months in the previous two-year period. Permitted goods: personal and household effects in the owner's possession and available for use for at least 12 months immediately prior to departure to Vanuatu; one motor vehicle per family changing residence if similarly owned/used for 12 months (right-hand-drive vehicles are prohibited from import); one power or sail boat on a trailer (further conditions on the page). Submission is on the current official form 'DECLARATION OF UNACCOMPANIED PERSONAL EFFECTS' (listed on the Customs Forms page). It opens by stating that it is a legally binding document and that the penalties for a false declaration are severe, and instructs that the statement must be completed in Block Letters in English or French; it covers the owner and spouse. Its Yes/No items ask whether the traveller packed the goods and is fully aware of the contents; whether the packages contain goods belonging to any other person; and whether the effects contain restricted drugs, narcotics, steroids or performance-enhancing drugs; restricted weapons, firearms, spring-bladed knives, explosives; products manufactured from endangered species; obscene material; Vanuatu or foreign currency in excess of VT 100,000 - this question covers currency inside the consignment only, not a general cash border threshold and not the VT 1,000,000 carried-on-person trigger (see vu-border-currency-declaration); cigarettes, cigars or tobacco; alcoholic liquor; goods for commercial purposes; and other goods owned for less than 12 months - followed by a description/value/date-of-purchase table and the owner's signature and date.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于返瓦居民或将定居瓦努阿图的人士：首次定居者及在之前两年期间离境至少 12 个月的返瓦居民可享受不随身个人及家庭物品优惠。准许物品：离境赴瓦前已拥有并可供使用至少 12 个月的个人及家庭物品；每个迁居家庭一辆机动车（同样须拥有并使用满 12 个月；右舵车禁止进口）；一艘带拖车、可由客车拖行的动力艇或帆船（其余条件见页面）。提交步骤使用现行官方表格：《不随身个人物品申报表》（DECLARATION OF UNACCOMPANIED PERSONAL EFFECTS，列于海关表单页）开篇即声明其为具有法律约束力的文件、虚假申报处罚严厉，并指示该声明须以英文或法文大写字母（Block Letters）填写；覆盖本人及配偶。其是/否项询问：物品是否由本人收拾并完全知悉内容；包裹是否含本人及家庭以外他人的物品；物品是否含受管制药物、麻醉品、类固醇或兴奋剂；受管制武器、枪械、弹簧刀、爆炸物；濒危物种制品；淫秽物品；超过 100,000 瓦图的瓦努阿图或外币货币——该题仅就该不随身行李内装载的货币发问，并非一般性边境现金门槛，亦非随身携带的 1,000,000 瓦图触发点（见 vu-border-currency-declaration）；香烟、雪茄或烟草；酒精饮料；商业用途物品；以及其他拥有不足 12 个月的物品——随后为品名/价值/购买日期明细表及物主签名与日期。
procedures.timing_en: Effects must be imported within 6 months of the residency visa being granted (first-time residents) or within 6 months of the last return to Vanuatu (returning residents); the concession can be granted only once. The declaration form records details of arrival (ship/flight, place, estimated time, container number, bill of lading/air waybill, broker/freight forwarder) and is signed and dated by the owner, so the statement accompanies the consignment's clearance.
procedures.timing_zh: 首次定居者须在定居签证批出后 6 个月内、返瓦居民须在最后一次返回瓦努阿图后 6 个月内进口该等物品；该优惠仅可批给一次。申报表记录到达明细（船名/航班、地点、预计到达时间、集装箱号、提单/空运提单、报关行/货代）并由物主签名注明日期，故该声明随货物清关一并提交。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 不隨身個人及家庭物品申報（定居優惠）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於返瓦居民或將定居瓦努阿圖的人士：首次定居者及在之前兩年期間離境至少 12 個月的返瓦居民可享受不隨身個人及家庭物品優惠。准許物品：離境赴瓦前已擁有並可供使用至少 12 個月的個人及家庭物品；每個遷居家庭一輛機動車（同樣須擁有並使用滿 12 個月；右舵車禁止進口）；一艘帶拖車、可由客車拖行的動力艇或帆船（其餘條件見頁面）。提交步驟使用現行官方表格：《不隨身個人物品申報表》（DECLARATION OF UNACCOMPANIED PERSONAL EFFECTS，列於海關表單頁）開篇即聲明其為具有法律約束力的文件、虛假申報處罰嚴厲，並指示該聲明須以英文或法文大寫字母（Block Letters）填寫；覆蓋本人及配偶。其是/否項詢問：物品是否由本人收拾並完全知悉內容；包裹是否含本人及家庭以外他人的物品；物品是否含受管制藥物、麻醉品、類固醇或興奮劑；受管制武器、槍械、彈簧刀、爆炸物；瀕危物種製品；淫穢物品；超過 100,000 瓦圖的瓦努阿圖或外幣貨幣——該題僅就該不隨身行李內裝載的貨幣發問，並非一般性邊境現金門檻，亦非隨身攜帶的 1,000,000 瓦圖觸發點（見 vu-border-currency-declaration）；香菸、雪茄或菸草；酒精飲料；商業用途物品；以及其他擁有不足 12 個月的物品——隨後為品名/價值/購買日期明細表及物主簽名與日期。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 首次定居者須在定居簽證批出後 6 個月內、返瓦居民須在最後一次返回瓦努阿圖後 6 個月內進口該等物品；該優惠僅可批給一次。申報表記錄到達明細（船名/航班、地點、預計到達時間、集裝箱號、提單/空運提單、報關行/貨代）並由物主簽名註明日期，故該聲明隨貨物清關一併提交。

procedures.name_en: Guam Mandatory Customs Declaration Form (EDF) — electronic-only for all arriving passengers
procedures.name_zh: 关岛强制海关申报表（EDF）——面向全体抵达旅客、仅电子版
procedures.agency: Guam Customs and Quarantine Agency (CQA), Government of Guam
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: arrival into Guam, all arriving passengers. Per the official CQA newsletter THE SHIELD (January-March 2025): as of Feb. 4 the mandatory Guam customs declaration form required of all arriving passengers is available only electronically and the use of hard copy forms has officially been discontinued; all arriving passengers must complete and submit the form and can do so up to 72 hours before arrival; only one form is required per family, defined as all individuals living in the same household who are related by blood, marriage, domestic partnership, or adoption; passengers unable to complete the form online before arrival may complete it at the kiosks in the A.B. Won Pat International Airport baggage claim area before proceeding to the Guam Customs inspection counters, and QR-code banners plus the free airport Wi-Fi login are also available in the baggage claim area for completion on personal devices. The CQA homepage still lists the Guam Electronic Declaration Form with desktop and mobile entries. Territorial boundary: under 19 CFR 7.2 Guam is outside the customs territory of the United States and the customs administration of Guam is under the Government of Guam, so US mainland traveller rules do not apply of their own force. Duty-free allowance quantities and any cash threshold attached to the Guam EDF are not stated on the official pages.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：抵达关岛，全体抵达旅客。据CQA官方通讯THE SHIELD（2025年1-3月期）：自2月4日起，所有抵达旅客强制填写的关岛海关申报表仅提供电子版，纸质表已正式停用；所有抵达旅客必须填写并提交该表，最早可在抵达前72小时完成；每个家庭只需一份申报表，家庭指“住在同一户、有血缘、婚姻、同居伴侣或收养关系的一切成员”；抵达前无法在线完成的旅客，可在A.B. Won Pat国际机场行李提取区的自助终端（kiosk）完成后再前往关岛海关检查柜台，行李区另设有表单二维码横幅及免费机场Wi-Fi登录信息，供旅客在个人设备上填写。CQA主页仍列出“Guam Electronic Declaration Form”桌面版与移动版入口。领土边界：依19 CFR 7.2，关岛在美国关税领土之外，关岛的海关管理隶属关岛政府，美国本土旅客规则不自动适用。免税额度数量及Guam EDF本身是否附带现金门槛，官方页面未作说明。
procedures.timing_en: Electronic submission from up to 72 hours before arrival; arrival-day fallback at the kiosks in the A.B. Won Pat International Airport baggage claim area, before proceeding to the Guam Customs inspection counters.
procedures.timing_zh: 最早抵达前72小时起电子提交；抵达当日可在A.B. Won Pat国际机场行李提取区自助终端（kiosk）补办，再前往关岛海关检查柜台。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 關島強制海關申報表（EDF）——面向全體抵達旅客、僅電子版
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：抵達關島，全體抵達旅客。據CQA官方通訊THE SHIELD（2025年1-3月期）：自2月4日起，所有抵達旅客強制填寫的關島海關申報表僅提供電子版，紙質表已正式停用；所有抵達旅客必須填寫並提交該表，最早可在抵達前72小時完成；每個家庭只需一份申報表，家庭指“住在同一戶、有血緣、婚姻、同居伴侶或收養關係的一切成員”；抵達前無法線上完成的旅客，可在A.B. Won Pat國際機場行李提取區的自助終端（kiosk）完成後再前往關島海關檢查櫃檯，行李區另設有表單 QR Code 橫幅及免費機場Wi-Fi登入資訊，供旅客在個人設備上填寫。CQA主頁仍列出“Guam Electronic Declaration Form”桌面版與移動版入口。領土邊界：依19 CFR 7.2，關島在美國關稅領土之外，關島的海關管理隸屬關島政府，美國本土旅客規則不自動適用。免稅額度數量及Guam EDF本身是否附帶現金門檻，官方頁面未作說明。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 最早抵達前72小時起電子提交；抵達當日可在A.B. Won Pat國際機場行李提取區自助終端（kiosk）補辦，再前往關島海關檢查櫃檯。

procedures.name_en: CBP declaration on arrival in the United States (States/DC/PR) with articles from Guam — oral if conditions met, otherwise written Customs Form 6059-B
procedures.name_zh: 自关岛携物品抵达美国（各州/DC/波多黎各）时向CBP申报——符合条件可口头申报，否则填写6059-B书面申报
procedures.agency: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), federal
procedures.applicability_en: This applies on arrival in the United States customs territory (the States, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico) for a person carrying articles from Guam. Under 19 CFR 148.11, all articles brought into the United States by any individual must be declared to a CBP officer at the port of first arrival. Under 19 CFR 148.12, returning residents and nonresidents arriving in the United States may make an oral declaration under stated conditions; for a returning resident, direct or indirect arrival from Guam falls under the $1,600 aggregate fair-retail-value condition (not more than $800 of which acquired elsewhere than Guam and similar locations) — this figure is an eligibility condition for oral declaration tied to personal exemptions, not a general duty-free allowance table. Under 19 CFR 148.13, unless an oral declaration is accepted, the declaration shall be in writing on Customs Form 6059-B, listing all articles acquired abroad, and each written declaration shall be acknowledged before the Customs officer who examines the baggage. Under 19 CFR 7.2(a), goods from Guam are subject to column 1 HTSUS rates — that is tariff treatment only, and general tariff rates are not to be read as traveller allowance tables. The Government of Guam publishes no separate departure declaration for leaving Guam; this is the federal declaration made on arrival in the United States. An oral declaration is possible only where the officer accepts it under 19 CFR 148.12; otherwise 19 CFR 148.13 requires the written Customs Form 6059-B.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向严格限定为：携自关岛物品抵达美国关税领土（各州、哥伦比亚特区、波多黎各）——与关岛抵达EDF相反方向，仅就该方向单列程序。依19 CFR 148.11，任何个人带入美国的一切物品必须在美国首抵港向CBP官员申报。依19 CFR 148.12，返美居民与非居民抵达美国可在所列条件下口头申报；返美居民自关岛直接或间接抵达适用合计公允零售价1,600美元条件（其中在关岛以外地点取得者不超过800美元）——该数字是关联个人免税额的口头申报资格条件，不是普遍免税额度表。依19 CFR 148.13，除非获准口头申报，申报须以Customs Form 6059-B书面作出，列明在境外取得的一切物品，并在查验行李的海关官员面前确认。依19 CFR 7.2(a)，自关岛进口货物适用HTSUS第一栏税率——仅为关税待遇，一般关税税率不得当作旅客额度表。关岛政府未公布离开关岛时的单独申报；本项是在抵达美国时向联邦海关作出的申报。渠道无论按schema还是按实质均为conditional（视条件而定）：仅当关员依19 CFR 148.12接受时方存在口头申报，其余情形一律依19 CFR 148.13以Customs Form 6059-B书面办理。
procedures.timing_en: Channel: conditional. At the port of first arrival in the United States: orally where the CBP officer accepts an oral declaration under the conditions of 19 CFR 148.12, otherwise in writing on Customs Form 6059-B acknowledged before the Customs officer who examines the baggage (19 CFR 148.13).
procedures.timing_zh: 渠道：conditional（视条件而定）。在美国首抵港办理：CBP关员依19 CFR 148.12所列条件接受口头申报者口头办理；否则依19 CFR 148.13填写Customs Form 6059-B，并在查验行李的海关官员面前确认。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 自關島攜物品抵達美國（各州/DC/波多黎各）時向CBP申報——符合條件可口頭申報，否則填寫6059-B書面申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向嚴格限定為：攜自關島物品抵達美國關稅領土（各州、哥倫比亞特區、波多黎各）——與關島抵達EDF相反方向，僅就該方向單列程序。依19 CFR 148.11，任何個人帶入美國的一切物品必須在美國首抵港向CBP官員申報。依19 CFR 148.12，返美居民與非居民抵達美國可在所列條件下口頭申報；返美居民自關島直接或間接抵達適用合計公允零售價1,600美元條件（其中在關島以外地點取得者不超過800美元）——該數字是關聯個人免稅額的口頭申報資格條件，不是普遍免稅額度表。依19 CFR 148.13，除非獲准口頭申報，申報須以Customs Form 6059-B書面作出，列明在境外取得的一切物品，並在查驗行李的海關官員面前確認。依19 CFR 7.2(a)，自關島進口貨物適用HTSUS第一欄稅率——僅為關稅待遇，一般關稅稅率不得當作旅客額度表。關島政府未公佈離開關島時的單獨申報；本項是在抵達美國時向聯邦海關作出的申報。渠道無論按schema還是按實質均為conditional（視條件而定）：僅當關員依19 CFR 148.12接受時方存在口頭申報，其餘情形一律依19 CFR 148.13以Customs Form 6059-B書面辦理。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 渠道：conditional（視條件而定）。在美國首抵港辦理：CBP關員依19 CFR 148.12所列條件接受口頭申報者口頭辦理；否則依19 CFR 148.13填寫Customs Form 6059-B，並在查驗行李的海關官員面前確認。

procedures.name_en: Report to customs when carrying more than US$10,000 in currency or monetary instruments between Guam and a place outside the United States (FinCEN Form 105)
procedures.name_zh: 在关岛与美国以外地点之间随身携带超过 1 万美元现金或货币工具时向海关报告（FinCEN Form 105）
procedures.agency: U.S. federal reporting rule under 31 U.S.C. 5316 (FinCEN Form 105, filed with the customs officer); in Guam, the report can be declared and filed with the Guam Customs and Quarantine Agency (CQA)
procedures.applicability_en: This is a U.S. federal reporting rule that applies in Guam; it is not a Guam-only form. Who: anyone who physically carries, mails or ships currency or other monetary instruments totalling more than US$10,000 at one time (strictly more than; US or foreign currency, and instruments, counted together) into the United States from outside it, or out of the United States to a place outside it. Under 31 CFR 1010.100, 'United States' includes the territories, among them Guam. So the report is triggered on trips between Guam and any place outside the United States, for example Japan or the Philippines. Trips between Guam and the U.S. mainland or another U.S. territory stay inside the 'United States' as the rule defines it and do not fall under this report (goods are governed by separate customs rules). How: file FinCEN Form 105 (Report of International Transportation of Currency or Monetary Instruments) with the customs officer at the port when you enter or before you depart. 31 CFR 1010.306 says the form can be obtained from U.S. Customs and Border Protection or FinCEN. The Guam Customs and Quarantine Agency (CQA) says that in Guam, people importing or exporting currency or monetary instruments can declare and file the required report with CQA; it does not say which form it uses. Carrying more than US$10,000 is not illegal; failing to report it is. CQA also warns that a circulating notice titled 'Declaration of Cash Negotiable Instrument of Over USD $10,000 or Equivalent' is unofficial and unauthorized. This applies to money you carry yourself. Reports for mailed or shipped instruments and a recipient's 15-day report are separate federal rules and are not covered here. No fee is stated.
procedures.applicability_zh: 这是适用于关岛的美国联邦报告规则，并非关岛专属表格。适用对象：任何人一次实际携带、邮寄或发运合计超过 1 万美元（严格大于；美元或外币，现金与货币工具合并计算）的现金或其他货币工具，自美国境外进入美国，或自美国运往美国境外。依 31 CFR 1010.100，“美国”包括各领土，关岛在内。因此关岛与美国以外任何地点（例如日本、菲律宾）之间的往来会触发该报告；关岛与美国本土或其他美国领土之间的往来仍在该规则所定义的“美国”之内，不适用本报告（货物另受其他海关规则调整）。办理方式：入境时或离境前，向港口海关官员提交 FinCEN Form 105（国际现金或货币工具运送报告）。31 CFR 1010.306 规定，该表可向美国海关与边境保护局（CBP）或 FinCEN 索取。关岛海关与检疫局（CQA）称，在关岛，进口或出口现金、货币工具者可向 CQA 申报并提交所需报告；CQA 未说明所用表格。携带超过 1 万美元并不违法，未报告才违法。CQA 另警示，网上流传的《超过 10,000 美元现金可转让票据申报》通知并非官方文件，未经 CQA 授权。本条仅涉及本人随身携带的钱款；邮寄、发运的货币工具报告及收件人 15 日内报告属另行的联邦规则，不在此列。未载明费用。
procedures.timing_en: When you enter the United States from outside it (for example, arriving in Guam from abroad) or before you leave the United States for a place outside it (for example, departing Guam for abroad), with the customs officer at the port; in Guam, with CQA.
procedures.timing_zh: 自境外进入美国时（例如从国外抵达关岛），或离开美国前往境外之前（例如从关岛飞往国外），向港口海关官员提交；在关岛即向 CQA 提交。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 在關島與美國以外地點之間隨身攜帶超過 1 萬美元現金或貨幣工具時向海關報告（FinCEN Form 105）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 這是適用於關島的美國聯邦報告規則，並非關島專屬表格。適用對象：任何人一次實際攜帶、郵寄或發運合計超過 1 萬美元（嚴格大於；美元或外幣，現金與貨幣工具合併計算）的現金或其他貨幣工具，自美國境外進入美國，或自美國運往美國境外。依 31 CFR 1010.100，“美國”包括各領土，關島在內。因此關島與美國以外任何地點（例如日本、菲律賓）之間的往來會觸發該報告；關島與美國本土或其他美國領土之間的往來仍在該規則所定義的“美國”之內，不適用本報告（貨物另受其他海關規則調整）。辦理方式：入境時或離境前，向港口海關官員提交 FinCEN Form 105（國際現金或貨幣工具運送報告）。31 CFR 1010.306 規定，該表可向美國海關與邊境保護局（CBP）或 FinCEN 索取。關島海關與檢疫局（CQA）稱，在關島，進口或出口現金、貨幣工具者可向 CQA 申報並提交所需報告；CQA 未說明所用表格。攜帶超過 1 萬美元並不違法，未報告才違法。CQA 另警示，網上流傳的《超過 10,000 美元現金可轉讓票據申報》通知並非官方文件，未經 CQA 授權。本條僅涉及本人隨身攜帶的錢款；郵寄、發運的貨幣工具報告及收件人 15 日內報告屬另行的聯邦規則，不在此列。未載明費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 自境外進入美國時（例如從國外抵達關島），或離開美國前往境外之前（例如從關島飛往國外），向港口海關官員提交；在關島即向 CQA 提交。

procedures.name_en: Arrival information to Customs for arriving passengers (Kiribati Customs Administration and Enforcement — Customs Act 2019, s 57)
procedures.name_zh: 抵达旅客向海关提供信息（基里巴斯海关管理与执法局——2019年海关法第57条）
procedures.agency: Kiribati Customs Administration and Enforcement (Ministry of Finance and Economic Development), Comptroller of Customs
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: persons (passengers and crew) arriving in Kiribati on a craft (ship or aircraft). Section 57 of the Customs Act 2019: a person arriving in Kiribati on craft must, immediately after they arrive, provide a customs officer with the required information necessary to permit the officer to identify who they are and the types of goods the person is importing into Kiribati; the section text does not itself distinguish whether the craft came from outside or inside Kiribati. The Act does not prescribe whether the section 57 information is given on a paper form, orally, or electronically; the obligation applies on arrival, and the Act leaves the medium unstated. Section 57 governs the arrival information obligation only; the Customs Act 2019's enforcement, seizure and baggage-entry provisions in other sections are separate obligations.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：乘船舶或航空器（craft）抵达基里巴斯的人员（旅客与船员）。2019年海关法第57条：乘船舶或航空器抵达基里巴斯的人员须在抵达后立即向海关关员提供必要信息，以便该关员识别其身份及该人携带进口基里巴斯的物品类型；条文本身未区分运输工具来自基里巴斯境内或境外。法案未规定第57条信息以纸质、口头还是电子方式提供；该义务须在抵达时履行，法案未写明采用何种方式。第57条仅约束抵达时提供信息的义务；法案其他执法、扣押与行李入境外条款为单独义务。
procedures.timing_en: Immediately after arrival in Kiribati on the craft.
procedures.timing_zh: 乘船舶或航空器（craft）抵达基里巴斯后立即。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵達旅客向海關提供資訊（基里巴斯海關管理與執法局——2019年海關法第57條）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：乘船舶或航空器（craft）抵達基里巴斯的人員（旅客與船員）。2019年海關法第57條：乘船舶或航空器抵達基里巴斯的人員須在抵達後立即向海關關員提供必要資訊，以便該關員識別其身份及該人攜帶進口基里巴斯的物品類型；條文本身未區分運輸工具來自基里巴斯境內或境外。法案未規定第57條資訊以紙質、口頭還是電子方式提供；該義務須在抵達時履行，法案未寫明採用何種方式。第57條僅約束抵達時提供資訊的義務；法案其他執法、扣押與行李入境外條款為單獨義務。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 乘船舶或航空器（craft）抵達基里巴斯後立即。

procedures.name_en: Cross-border currency declaration — Currency Declaration Act 2009 (17 MIRC Ch. 2) s 203(1)
procedures.name_zh: 跨境货币申报——2009年货币申报法（17 MIRC第2章）第203(1)条
procedures.agency: Declaration is made to an "authorised officer" as defined by Currency Declaration Act 2009 s 202(1)(a) (customs officer, immigration officer, police officer, quarantine officer, an official of the Banking Commission, or an official of the Postal Services Authority). 申报向2009年货币申报法第202(1)(a)条定义的"获授权官员"（海关、移民、警察、检疫官员，银行委员会或邮政管理局官员）作出。
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: both entry into and departure from the Republic of the Marshall Islands. A person who enters or leaves the Republic with currency amounting to $10,000 or more, or its equivalent in any other currency, must make a declaration to an authorised officer in the form prescribed in Schedule 1 of the Chapter (s 203(1)). "Currency" is defined broadly (s 202(1)(c)): coin and paper money of the Republic or a foreign country that is legal tender and customarily used as a medium of exchange; monetary instruments exchangeable for money (cheques, travellers cheques, money orders, negotiable instruments); precious metals and precious stones; instruments specified by the Minister of Finance by Order; and currency in electronic form. Failure to declare, or a false declaration, is an offence liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $50,000 and or forfeiture of the currency under s 210 (s 203(3)). Scope note: the parallel obligation in s 203(2) for currency transmitted out of or received into the Republic by postal services, courier services or transhipment is a separate scenario and is not covered here. The Schedule 1 prescribed form itself is not attached to the captured official PDF, so the form's name, format and submission channel remain unverified; no fee is prescribed in the official text. Legal basis: Currency Declaration Act 2009 (P.L. 2009-29, commenced May 11, 2009), as amended by P.L. 2019-101 and P.L. 2020-25 (Nitijela compilation rev. _3).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：进入和离开马绍尔群岛共和国双向适用。本人进入或离开该国时携带货币达1万美元（$10,000）或以上、或以任何其他货币折算等值者，须按本章附表1规定的表格向获授权官员作出申报（第203(1)条）。"货币"定义很宽（第202(1)(c)条）：马绍尔群岛或外国作为法定通货并惯常用作交换媒介的硬币和纸币；可兑换为货币的票据（支票、旅行支票、汇票、可转让票据）；贵金属和宝石；财政部长以命令指定的票据；以及电子形式货币。未申报或作虚假申报属犯罪，一经定罪可处不超过5万美元（$50,000）罚款及/或按第210条没收该货币（第203(3)条）。范围说明：第203(2)条就经由邮政、快递或转运将货币寄出或收进该国的申报义务属另一情形，此处不涵盖。附表1规定表格本身未附于所获官方PDF，表格名称、样式及提交渠道仍未核验；所获文本未规定任何费用。法源：2009年货币申报法（P.L. 2009-29，2009年5月11日生效），经P.L. 2019-101及P.L. 2020-25修订（Nitijela汇编 _3版）。
procedures.timing_en: On entry: a person entering the Republic with currency amounting to $10,000 or more (threshold inclusive), or its equivalent in another currency, declares at the time of entry (s 203(1)). On departure: a person leaving the Republic with currency at or above that threshold declares at the time of departure (s 203(1)). The duty arises only when the threshold is met; travellers below it are not required to file. The official text states no separate deadline, and the medium of the Schedule 1 form is unverified.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时：本人携货币达1万美元（$10,000）或以上（门槛含本数）、或等值其他货币进入共和国者，于入境之时申报（第203(1)条）。出境时：携货币达到同门槛离开共和国者，于出境之时申报（第203(1)条）。仅在达到门槛时产生义务；未达门槛的旅客无须填报。所获文本未另规定期限；附表1表格介质未核验。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境貨幣申報——2009年貨幣申報法（17 MIRC第2章）第203(1)條
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：進入和離開馬紹爾群島共和國雙向適用。本人進入或離開該國時攜帶貨幣達1萬美元（$10,000）或以上、或以任何其他貨幣折算等值者，須按本章附表1規定的表格向獲授權官員作出申報（第203(1)條）。"貨幣"定義很寬（第202(1)(c)條）：馬紹爾群島或外國作為法定通貨並慣常用作交換媒介的硬幣和紙幣；可兌換為貨幣的票據（支票、旅行支票、匯票、可轉讓票據）；貴金屬和寶石；財政部長以命令指定的票據；以及電子形式貨幣。未申報或作虛假申報屬犯罪，一經定罪可處不超過5萬美元（$50,000）罰款及/或按第210條沒收該貨幣（第203(3)條）。範圍說明：第203(2)條就經由郵政、快遞或轉運將貨幣寄出或收進該國的申報義務屬另一情形，此處不涵蓋。附表1規定表格本身未附於所獲官方PDF，表格名稱、樣式及提交渠道仍未核驗；所獲文本未規定任何費用。法源：2009年貨幣申報法（P.L. 2009-29，2009年5月11日生效），經P.L. 2019-101及P.L. 2020-25修訂（Nitijela彙編 _3版）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時：本人攜貨幣達1萬美元（$10,000）或以上（門檻含本數）、或等值其他貨幣進入共和國者，於入境之時申報（第203(1)條）。出境時：攜貨幣達到同門檻離開共和國者，於出境之時申報（第203(1)條）。僅在達到門檻時產生義務；未達門檻的旅客無須填報。所獲文本未另規定期限；附表1表格介質未核驗。

procedures.name_en: Dutiable goods declaration — FSM Code Title 54 Ch.2 §227 (Customs & Tax Administration)
procedures.name_zh: 应税货物申报——FSM法典第54编第2章§227（海关与税务管理局）
procedures.agency: Customs & Tax Administration (CTA), Department of Finance and Administration, Federated States of Micronesia
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: the duty attaches to the importation of dutiable goods, not to arrival as such; it applies to persons importing dutiable goods into the FSM, including arriving passengers carrying dutiable goods. Core duty (section 227, civil penalties and interest): it is the duty of an importer to know and declare, fully and accurately, the types, quantities, and values of all dutiable goods which he or she imports; understatement carries a percentage penalty on the understated duty. Scope boundary (section 238(5), Personal Baggage): goods that are the personal baggage of passengers in a vessel or aircraft and are not taxable goods may be released without entry — non-dutiable personal baggage requires no cargo entry. Consequence of non-disclosure (section 253(9)): dutiable goods found in the possessions or baggage of a person who has denied having dutiable goods, or who has not fully disclosed them to a Customs officer, are subject to forfeiture; inspection is not a substitute for declaring — the duty to declare is the importer's own affirmative duty. Travellers carrying goods and claiming the per-trip duty-free allowance in section 222(3) are covered separately by FM-traveller-dutyfree-declare.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：该义务附着于应税货物的进口，而非入境行为本身；适用于向FSM进口应税货物的人员，含携带应税货物的入境旅客。核心义务（第227条，民事罚款与利息）：进口商有义务充分、准确地知道并申报其进口的全部应税货物的类型、数量和价值；少报按少报税额的百分比加处罚款。范围边界（第238(5)条，个人行李）：船舶或航空器旅客的个人行李中不属于应税货物的物品，可在未办理入境申报的情况下放行——非应税个人行李无须办理货运报关（cargo entry）。未披露的后果（第253(9)条）：在否认携带应税货物或未向海关关员充分披露的人员的随身物品或行李中发现的应税货物，可予没收；查验不能替代申报——申报是进口商本人的积极义务。携带货物并主张第222(3)条每次出行免税额度的旅客，另见FM-traveller-dutyfree-declare。
procedures.timing_en: Conditional: the duty attaches upon importing dutiable goods; for arriving passengers, the declaration is made at entry/clearance on arrival, with personal baggage handled at the port of entry.
procedures.timing_zh: 有条件触发：义务随应税货物进口而产生；对入境旅客，于抵达时在入境/通关环节申报，个人行李在入境口岸处理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 應稅貨物申報——FSM法典第54編第2章§227（海關與稅務管理局）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：該義務附著於應稅貨物的進口，而非入境行為本身；適用於向FSM進口應稅貨物的人員，含攜帶應稅貨物的入境旅客。核心義務（第227條，民事罰款與利息）：進口商有義務充分、準確地知道並申報其進口的全部應稅貨物的類型、數量和價值；少報按少報稅額的百分比加處罰款。範圍邊界（第238(5)條，個人行李）：船舶或航空器旅客的個人行李中不屬於應稅貨物的物品，可在未辦理入境申報的情況下放行——非應稅個人行李無須辦理貨運報關（cargo entry）。未披露的後果（第253(9)條）：在否認攜帶應稅貨物或未向海關關員充分披露的人員的隨身物品或行李中發現的應稅貨物，可予沒收；查驗不能替代申報——申報是進口商本人的積極義務。攜帶貨物並主張第222(3)條每次出行免稅額度的旅客，另見FM-traveller-dutyfree-declare。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 有條件觸發：義務隨應稅貨物進口而產生；對入境旅客，於抵達時在入境/通關環節申報，個人行李在入境口岸處理。

procedures.name_en: Per-trip duty-free allowance and duty to declare exempt goods at entry — FSM Code §222(3), §238(9); FSM Customs Regulations (1997) §2.3
procedures.name_zh: 每次出行免税额度与免税货物入境申报义务——FSM法典§222(3)、§238(9)及1997年《FSM Customs Regulations》§2.3
procedures.agency: Customs & Tax Administration (CTA), Department of Finance and Administration, Federated States of Micronesia
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: triggered only where the person carries goods and claims the statutory duty-free allowance, not by entry as such; applies to individuals entering or returning to the FSM from a foreign jurisdiction (visitors and returning residents alike), on each trip. Allowance (section 222(3)): each time, the person may bring in duty free, provided the goods are for that person's own personal use or consumption and not for resale or exchange, and provided the person is permitted by applicable State law to possess, use, and consume such goods: up to 200 cigarettes; up to one pound of tobacco or twenty cigars; up to 52 fluid ounces or 1500 milliliters of distilled alcoholic beverages; and up to $200 worth of goods other than tobacco products, beer and malt beverages, distilled alcoholic beverages, and wine. Declaration duty: goods exempt under section 222(3) through (8) must nevertheless be declared and cleared upon entry on such form and in such manner as the Commissioner may prescribe (FSM Customs Regulations, October 1, 1997, §2.3(a)(1)); all tax exempt goods shall be identified and cleared on the official clearance form (section 238(9)). Conditions (Regulations §2.3(b)): the goods must accompany the importing individual — goods received by mail or other unaccompanied shipment do not qualify; a person bringing in tobacco or alcohol must be old enough and otherwise qualified to possess, use, and consume them under the law of the state of entry (e.g., a mother, father, and minor child traveling together could import two, not three, allowances); wine, beer, and malt beverages may never be imported duty-free under this exemption; the burden of establishing the exemption is on the person claiming it (preponderance of the evidence, §2.3(a)(2)). These duties are distinct from section 238(5) (personal baggage that is not taxable goods may be released without entry) and from the section 227/253(9) duties and forfeiture consequences in FM-importer-declare. Form: the declaration must be made on the Commissioner-prescribed form (Regs §2.3(a)(1): on such form and in such manner as the Commissioner may prescribe; §238(9): official clearance form); the official text does not state the form's name or whether it is provided on paper or electronically. The Customs Entry Form used for cargo is not the traveller form.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：仅在携带货物并主张法定免税额度时触发，而非入境行为本身；适用于从外国司法管辖区进入或返回FSM的个人（含入境访客与返回居民），每次入境均适用。额度（第222(3)条）：在货物供该人本人自用或消费、不为转售或交换、且该人依目的地州法律获准持有、使用和消费该类货物的条件下，每次可免税带入：最多200支香烟；最多1磅烟草或20支雪茄；最多52液盎司或1500毫升蒸馏酒精饮料；以及除烟草制品、啤酒和麦芽饮料、蒸馏酒精饮料及葡萄酒之外、价值最多200美元（$200）的其他货品。申报义务：依第222(3)至(8)条免税的进口货物仍须在入境时按Commissioner规定的表式和方式申报并清关（1997年10月1日《FSM Customs Regulations》§2.3(a)(1)）；所有免税货物均须在官方清关单（official clearance form）上列明并清关（第238(9)条）。条件（条例§2.3(b)）：货物必须随进口本人同行带入——邮寄或其他非随行运输的货物不合资格；带入烟草或酒类者须已达入境州法律要求的年龄并具备其他资格（例如父母二人与未成年子女同行，只能按两份而非三份烟草或酒类额度）；葡萄酒、啤酒和麦芽饮料在任何情况下不得依该豁免免税带入；主张豁免的举证责任在主张人（优势证据标准，§2.3(a)(2)）。上述申报义务与第238(5)条（非应税个人行李可免办entry放行）及FM-importer-declare所载第227条/第253(9)条义务与没收后果相互分立。表式：申报须按Commissioner规定的表式和方式办理（条例§2.3(a)(1)；第238(9)条官方清关单official clearance form）；官方文本未载明该表式的名称及其纸质或电子交付方式。货运用的Customs Entry Form不是旅客表式。
procedures.timing_en: Conditional: triggered when a person entering or returning to the FSM carries goods and claims the section 222(3) allowance; the declaration and clearance are made at that entry, at entry/clearance on arrival.
procedures.timing_zh: 有条件触发：进入或返回FSM的人员携带货物并主张第222(3)条额度时触发；申报与清关于该次入境时、在抵达后的入境/通关环节办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 每次出行免稅額度與免稅貨物入境申報義務——FSM法典§222(3)、§238(9)及1997年《FSM Customs Regulations》§2.3
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：僅在攜帶貨物並主張法定免稅額度時觸發，而非入境行為本身；適用於從外國司法管轄區進入或返回FSM的個人（含入境訪客與返回居民），每次入境均適用。額度（第222(3)條）：在貨物供該人本人自用或消費、不為轉售或交換、且該人依目的地州法律獲准持有、使用和消費該類貨物的條件下，每次可免稅帶入：最多200支香菸；最多1磅菸草或20支雪茄；最多52液盎司或1500毫升蒸餾酒精飲料；以及除菸草製品、啤酒和麥芽飲料、蒸餾酒精飲料及葡萄酒之外、價值最多200美元（$200）的其他貨品。申報義務：依第222(3)至(8)條免稅的進口貨物仍須在入境時按Commissioner規定的表式和方式申報並清關（1997年10月1日《FSM Customs Regulations》§2.3(a)(1)）；所有免稅貨物均須在官方清關單（official clearance form）上列明並清關（第238(9)條）。條件（條例§2.3(b)）：貨物必須隨進口本人同行帶入——郵寄或其他非隨行運輸的貨物不合資格；帶入菸草或酒類者須已達入境州法律要求的年齡並具備其他資格（例如父母二人與未成年子女同行，只能按兩份而非三份菸草或酒類額度）；葡萄酒、啤酒和麥芽飲料在任何情況下不得依該豁免免稅帶入；主張豁免的舉證責任在主張人（優勢證據標準，§2.3(a)(2)）。上述申報義務與第238(5)條（非應稅個人行李可免辦entry放行）及FM-importer-declare所載第227條/第253(9)條義務與沒收後果相互分立。表式：申報須按Commissioner規定的表式和方式辦理（條例§2.3(a)(1)；第238(9)條官方清關單official clearance form）；官方文本未載明該表式的名稱及其紙質或電子交付方式。貨運用的Customs Entry Form不是旅客表式。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 有條件觸發：進入或返回FSM的人員攜帶貨物並主張第222(3)條額度時觸發；申報與清關於該次入境時、在抵達後的入境/通關環節辦理。

procedures.name_en: Cross-border cash, bearer negotiable instruments and precious items declaration — Nauru Customs Service / Nauru Revenue Office (Cash Border Regulation Framework)
procedures.name_zh: 跨境现金、无记名流通票据与贵重物品申报——瑙鲁海关服务局/瑙鲁税务局（现金边境监管框架）
procedures.agency: Nauru Customs Service (Department of Finance), with the Nauru Revenue Office and Financial Intelligence Unit
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: persons bringing cash into or taking cash out of Nauru. Inbound: per the official Government Guide, a person must make a declaration if bringing into Nauru cash, bearer negotiable instruments (BNI), or precious metals/precious stones (gold, silver, diamonds, sapphire) with a value of more than $5,000 (strictly more than, exclusive; the threshold was lowered from more than $10,000; the operative clauses state no currency — '$5,000' as written in the Guide, with 'AUD' appearing only in the quoted, repealed 1999 proclamation). Outbound: in compliance with sections 96 and 96A of the Proceeds of Crime Act, a person must declare and fill in a Border Declaration Form for the same categories exceeding $5,000 (strictly more than); where the person is taking only cash out of Nauru, prior approval of the Chief Collector of Customs must be obtained before travel (Customs (Prohibited Exports) Order 2023, which repealed the 1999 proclamation). Outbound steps per the Guide: (1) obtain the Chief Collector's approval using the application provided by the Nauru Customs Service (Annex 2 'Application to export cash out of Nauru' — cash amount for export, currency, source of funds); (2) tick the cash box on the Immigration/Customs/Quarantine Departure Card provided at the airport; (3) complete the Border Declaration Form (Annex 1 — provided at the airport for completion or downloadable; Part A asks 'Are you carrying more than $5,000 in cash/bearer negotiable instruments/precious metals or stones: Into Nauru / Out of Nauru', and for outbound cash 'Have you received approval to export cash? YES' — the form prints a YES tick line and no NO option appears in the text); (4) attach the Chief Collector's approval. Penalties stated in the Guide: non-compliance with the declaration requirements — fine up to $20,000 or imprisonment up to 2 years, or both (POCA ss.96, 96A); exporting cash without the Chief Collector's approval — fine up to $300,000 (Customs Act 2014 s.250(3)(a)). Legal basis includes the Proceeds of Crime (Border Declaration Form) Regulations 2023 as amended 2024; the FIU Laws panel still lists the POCA (Border Declaration Form) (Amendment) Regulations 2024 as the latest border-declaration-form instrument with no 2025/2026 successor. No age condition appears in the Guide. The Guide does not state whether any goods/passage declaration form is also required of all arriving travellers.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：携现金进入或带出瑙鲁的人员。入境：据政府官方指南，携现金、无记名流通票据（BNI）或贵金属/宝石（黄金、白银、钻石、蓝宝石）价值超过$5,000（严格大于，不含本数；门槛已从$10,000下调）进入瑙鲁者必须申报；操作性条款未标注币种，按指南原文记「$5,000」（「AUD」仅出现在文中引述的、已废止的1999年公告里）。出境：依《犯罪收益法》第96和96A条，对同类超过$5,000（严格大于，不含本数）物品须申报并填写边境申报表（Border Declaration Form）；仅携现金出境者还须在出行前取得海关总监察长（Chief Collector of Customs）的批准（2023年海关禁止出口令，其废止了1999年公告）。出境步骤（依指南）：（1）用瑙鲁海关服务局提供的申请表取得海关总监察长批准（指南附件2「Application to export cash out of Nauru」，含拟出口现金额、币种、资金来源等栏）；（2）在机场提供的移民/海关/检疫离境卡上勾选相应栏；（3）填写边境申报表（附件1，机场提供填写或可下载；其A部分设问「你是否携带超过$5,000的现金/无记名流通票据/贵金属或宝石：进入瑙鲁/带出瑙鲁」，出境现金另须答「是否已取得现金出口批准？YES」——表单仅印YES勾选栏，文本中无NO选项）；（4）附上海关总监察长批准文件。指南所载罚则：不履行申报义务——最高$20,000罚款或最高2年监禁或并科（POCA第96、96A条）；未经海关总监察长批准出口现金——最高$300,000罚款（2014年海关法第250(3)(a)条）。法律依据含2023年《犯罪收益（边境申报表）条例》（2024年修订）；FIU现行Laws栏仍把「POCA (Border Declaration Form) (Amendment) Regulations 2024」列为最新边境申报表条例，无2025/2026年后继法。指南全文无年龄条件。指南未说明所有入境旅客是否另须填写物品/通行申报表。
procedures.timing_en: Inbound: at the border on arrival (Border Declaration Form). Outbound: Chief Collector approval prior to travel (Annex 2 application); at departure — tick the Departure Card cash box, complete the Border Declaration Form and attach the approval.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境：抵达时在边境以边境申报表申报。出境：出行前取得海关总监察长批准（附件2申请表）；离境时在离境卡勾选相应栏、填写边境申报表并附批准文件。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境現金、無記名流通票據與貴重物品申報——瑙魯海關服務局/瑙魯稅務局（現金邊境監管框架）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：攜現金進入或帶出瑙魯的人員。入境：據政府官方指南，攜現金、無記名流通票據（BNI）或貴金屬/寶石（黃金、白銀、鑽石、藍寶石）價值超過$5,000（嚴格大於，不含本數；門檻已從$10,000下調）進入瑙魯者必須申報；操作性條款未標註幣種，按指南原文記「$5,000」（「AUD」僅出現在文中引述的、已廢止的1999年公告裡）。出境：依《犯罪收益法》第96和96A條，對同類超過$5,000（嚴格大於，不含本數）物品須申報並填寫邊境申報表（Border Declaration Form）；僅攜現金出境者還須在出行前取得海關總監察長（Chief Collector of Customs）的批准（2023年海關禁止出口令，其廢止了1999年公告）。出境步驟（依指南）：（1）用瑙魯海關服務局提供的申請表取得海關總監察長批准（指南附件2「Application to export cash out of Nauru」，含擬出口現金額、幣種、資金來源等欄）；（2）在機場提供的移民/海關/檢疫離境卡上勾選相應欄；（3）填寫邊境申報表（附件1，機場提供填寫或可下載；其A部分設問「你是否攜帶超過$5,000的現金/無記名流通票據/貴金屬或寶石：進入瑙魯/帶出瑙魯」，出境現金另須答「是否已取得現金出口批准？YES」——表單僅印YES勾選欄，文本中無NO選項）；（4）附上海關總監察長批准文件。指南所載罰則：不履行申報義務——最高$20,000罰款或最高2年監禁或併科（POCA第96、96A條）；未經海關總監察長批准出口現金——最高$300,000罰款（2014年海關法第250(3)(a)條）。法律依據含2023年《犯罪收益（邊境申報表）條例》（2024年修訂）；FIU現行Laws欄仍把「POCA (Border Declaration Form) (Amendment) Regulations 2024」列為最新邊境申報表條例，無2025/2026年後繼法。指南全文無年齡條件。指南未說明所有入境旅客是否另須填寫物品/通行申報表。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境：抵達時在邊境以邊境申報表申報。出境：出行前取得海關總監察長批准（附件2申請表）；離境時在離境卡勾選相應欄、填寫邊境申報表並附批准文件。
